tagline.en: Snap Research's camera-control layer for video diffusion — steer the camera along a 3D trajectory while a CogVideoX backbone renders the scene.
tagline.zh: Snap Research 为视频扩散模型打造的相机控制层——用 3D 轨迹引导镜头运动,由 CogVideoX 主干负责生成画面。

en: AC3D is a camera-control method for text-to-video diffusion from Snap Research. It lets you specify how the camera moves through a scene, so instead of an uncontrolled clip you get one that follows a chosen trajectory — a dolly, an orbit, a pan.

It works as a ControlNet-style add-on to a CogVideoX video backbone: you give it a text prompt plus a sequence of per-frame camera poses (RealEstate10K-style pose rows), and it renders a video that respects that camera path. The workflow can start from an existing RealEstate10K layout or from a source video paired with its camera poses.
In WorldFoundry, AC3D runs through the shared video pipeline in its own environment, so you pick the checkpoint, hand it a prompt and a camera trajectory, and it writes out the resulting clip.
zh: AC3D 是 Snap Research 提出的文生视频相机控制方法。它让你指定镜头在场景中的运动方式,于是生成的不再是随机镜头,而是沿着你选定轨迹运动的画面——推轨、环绕或摇镜。
它以 ControlNet 式的插件形式作用在 CogVideoX 视频主干上:给它一段文本提示词,再加上逐帧的相机位姿序列(RealEstate10K 风格的位姿行),它就会生成一段遵循该镜头路径的视频。工作流可以从现成的 RealEstate10K 布局出发,也可以从一段源视频配上对应相机位姿开始。
在 WorldFoundry 中,AC3D 通过共享视频 pipeline 在其独立环境里运行——选好 checkpoint,给它提示词和相机轨迹,它就会输出对应的片段。

whenToUse.en: Reach for AC3D when you need explicit, trajectory-level control over camera motion in generated video — orbits, dollies and pans defined by real camera poses rather than left to chance.
whenToUse.zh: 当你需要对生成视频的镜头运动做明确的、轨迹级别的控制时——用真实相机位姿定义环绕、推轨、摇镜,而非听天由命——AC3D 是合适之选。

notFor.en: Not a plain text-to-video model if you don't care about camera paths — the value is the trajectory control, which means you need to supply camera poses. It also runs in its own environment rather than the shared stack.
notFor.zh: 如果你并不关心镜头路径,它并非普通的文生视频模型——它的价值在于轨迹控制,因此你需要提供相机位姿。此外它运行在独立环境中,而非共享环境。

en: Trajectory-level camera control for video generation
Built as a ControlNet-style add-on to a CogVideoX video backbone
Accepts RealEstate10K-style per-frame camera poses
Ships with both code and weights
zh: 面向视频生成的轨迹级相机控制
以 ControlNet 式插件作用于 CogVideoX 视频主干
接受 RealEstate10K 风格的逐帧相机位姿
代码与权重一并提供

tagline.en: The classic way to animate a Stable Diffusion image model — a plug-in motion module turns text prompts into short videos.
tagline.zh: 让 Stable Diffusion 图像模型动起来的经典方案——一个可插拔的运动模块,把文本提示词变成短视频。

en: AnimateDiff is a widely-used approach for turning a text-to-image diffusion model into a text-to-video generator. Rather than training a video model from scratch, it inserts a learned motion module into a frozen Stable Diffusion backbone so the frames move coherently.

Because it builds on the Stable Diffusion v1.5 ecosystem, it pairs naturally with community image checkpoints (the default demo uses a RealisticVision-style base) and a CLIP text encoder. The motion module is the reusable piece that adds temporal consistency on top of whatever image model you plug in.
In WorldFoundry, AnimateDiff runs through the shared video pipeline: give it a text prompt and it renders a short animated clip. The primary AnimateDiff weights are Apache-2.0 licensed.
zh: AnimateDiff 是把文生图扩散模型改造成文生视频生成器的一种广泛使用的方法。它不从零训练视频模型,而是在冻结的 Stable Diffusion 主干中插入一个学习到的运动模块,使各帧连贯运动。
由于它构建在 Stable Diffusion v1.5 生态之上,可以自然地搭配社区图像 checkpoint(默认 demo 使用 RealisticVision 风格的底模)以及 CLIP 文本编码器。运动模块是可复用的核心组件,它为你接入的任意图像模型叠加时序一致性。
在 WorldFoundry 中,AnimateDiff 通过共享视频 pipeline 运行:给它一段文本提示词,它就会渲染一小段动画片段。AnimateDiff 主权重采用 Apache-2.0 许可。

whenToUse.en: A good fit when you want to animate the familiar Stable Diffusion v1.5 style and reuse existing image checkpoints, or when you want a lightweight, well-understood route into text-to-video.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想为熟悉的 Stable Diffusion v1.5 画风注入动态、并复用已有图像 checkpoint,或想要一条轻量、成熟的文生视频入口时,它很合适。

notFor.en: Not the choice for long-form or highly cinematic video — it produces short clips, and quality is tied to the SD v1.5-era backbone rather than newer large video models.
notFor.zh: 不适合长视频或追求高度电影感的场景——它生成的是短片段,画质也受限于 SD v1.5 时代的主干,而非更新的大型视频模型。

en: Plug-in motion module for Stable Diffusion image models
Reuses community SD v1.5 checkpoints for varied styles
Primary AnimateDiff weights are Apache-2.0
Simple text-to-video workflow
zh: 作用于 Stable Diffusion 图像模型的可插拔运动模块
复用社区 SD v1.5 checkpoint 实现多样画风
AnimateDiff 主权重采用 Apache-2.0 许可
简单的文生视频工作流

tagline.en: An interactive world model built on Wan2.1 — animate an image into video while steering the camera through the scene.
tagline.zh: 构建在 Wan2.1 之上的交互式世界模型——把一张图片动画为视频,同时操控镜头在场景中穿行。

en: Astra is an interactive world model that turns a still image into video with camera control. You give it a starting frame and a camera direction, and it generates a clip that moves the viewpoint through the scene as if you were exploring it.

It is built on the open Wan2.1 text-to-video 1.3B backbone, adding a camera-control pathway on top so the generated motion follows your chosen viewpoint. This ties it to the image-to-video and interactive world-model family rather than plain prompt-to-clip generation.
In WorldFoundry, Astra runs inference through the shared Studio/API pipeline: provide an input image and a camera control, and it renders the resulting camera-driven video.
zh: Astra 是一个交互式世界模型,能把静态图片转成带相机控制的视频。你给它一帧起始画面和一个镜头方向,它就会生成一段让视点在场景中移动的片段,仿佛你正在其中探索。
它构建在开源的 Wan2.1 文生视频 1.3B 主干之上,并在其上叠加了相机控制通路,使生成的运动遵循你选定的视点。因此它属于图生视频与交互式世界模型这一类,而非单纯的提示词生成片段。
在 WorldFoundry 中,Astra 通过共享的 Studio/API pipeline 运行推理:给它一张输入图片和一个相机控制指令,它就会渲染出相应的镜头驱动视频。

whenToUse.en: Use Astra when you want to explore or 'walk into' a still image as a camera-controlled video — turning a single frame into an interactive, viewpoint-driven scene.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想把一张静态图片当作可控镜头的视频来探索、'走进'其中时,用 Astra——把单帧画面变成可交互、由视点驱动的场景。

notFor.en: Not a text-only video generator — it starts from an input image and a camera control, so it's not the tool for pure prompt-to-video without a source frame.
notFor.zh: 它不是纯文本视频生成器——它需要一张输入图片和相机控制作为起点,因此不适合没有源帧、只靠提示词生成视频的情形。

en: Interactive, camera-controlled world model
Image-to-video: animate a still frame into a moving scene
Built on the open Wan2.1 text-to-video 1.3B backbone
Runs through the shared Studio/API pipeline
zh: 交互式、可控镜头的世界模型

notes: Being-H0.5 is a cross-embodiment VLA policy. It is intentionally routed through embodied action profiles, not video generation.

Official BeingHPolicy consumes multi-view RGB, robot state, language instruction, data_config_name, dataset_name, and embodiment_tag; output is robot-specific actions plus action_unified when RTC is enabled.

tagline.en: BeingBeyond's cross-embodiment vision-language-action policy — turn camera views, robot state and a language instruction into robot actions.
tagline.zh: BeingBeyond 的跨本体视觉-语言-动作策略——把相机视角、机器人状态和语言指令转化为机器人动作。

en: Being-H0.5 is a vision-language-action (VLA) policy from BeingBeyond for robot control. It takes in what the robot sees and its current state, reads a natural-language instruction, and outputs the actions the robot should take — a policy you roll out step by step to accomplish a task.

It is designed to be cross-embodiment: the same model is trained and evaluated across different robot setups and benchmarks. It consumes multi-view RGB images, robot state, a language instruction, and an embodiment tag, and produces robot-specific actions. The published checkpoints include a 2B model plus variants tuned for LIBERO and RoboCasa environments.

In WorldFoundry, Being-H0.5 is routed through the embodied action pipeline rather than video generation: you pick a checkpoint and profile matching your robot/benchmark, feed it observations and an instruction, and it returns an action trace.
zh: Being-H0.5 是 BeingBeyond 面向机器人控制的视觉-语言-动作(VLA)策略。它接收机器人所看到的画面和当前状态,读取一条自然语言指令,输出机器人应采取的动作——这是一个你逐步展开(rollout)以完成任务的策略。
它被设计为跨本体:同一模型在不同的机器人配置和基准上训练与评测。它接收多视角 RGB 图像、机器人状态、语言指令以及本体标签(embodiment tag),产出针对具体机器人的动作。已发布的 checkpoint 包含一个 2B 模型,以及针对 LIBERO 和 RoboCasa 环境调优的变体。
在 WorldFoundry 中,Being-H0.5 走的是具身动作 pipeline,而非视频生成:选定与你的机器人/基准匹配的 checkpoint 和配置,给它观测和指令,它就会返回一段动作轨迹。

whenToUse.en: Use Being-H0.5 when you need a language-conditioned robot policy that generalizes across embodiments — for example driving manipulation tasks in LIBERO or RoboCasa from multi-view observations and an instruction.
whenToUse.zh: 当你需要一个语言驱动、能跨本体泛化的机器人策略时——例如根据多视角观测和指令在 LIBERO 或 RoboCasa 中执行操作任务——使用 Being-H0.5。

notFor.en: Not a media-generation model — it outputs robot actions, not images or video. You need robot observations, state, and an embodiment setup to run it meaningfully.
notFor.zh: 它不是媒体生成模型——输出的是机器人动作,而非图像或视频。要有意义地运行它,你需要机器人观测、状态以及本体配置。

en: Cross-embodiment vision-language-action policy
Consumes multi-view RGB, robot state and a language instruction
2B checkpoint with LIBERO and RoboCasa variants
Outputs robot-specific action rollouts
zh: 跨本体的视觉-语言-动作策略
接收多视角 RGB、机器人状态与语言指令
2B checkpoint,并提供 LIBERO 与 RoboCasa 变体
输出针对具体机器人的动作 rollout

tagline.en: Add precise camera-trajectory control to text-to-video diffusion — define the camera path and generate a clip that follows it.
tagline.zh: 为文生视频扩散模型加上精确的相机轨迹控制——定义镜头路径,生成沿其运动的片段。

en: CameraCtrl is a camera-control method for text-to-video generation. It lets you drive the camera along an explicit trajectory, so a generated clip moves through the scene the way you specify instead of with arbitrary motion.

You supply a text prompt together with a camera trajectory, and the model renders a video that honors that path. It works as a control layer on top of a video diffusion backbone, following the official trajectory-based demo contract.

In WorldFoundry, CameraCtrl runs through its in-tree synthesis backend on the shared pipeline: choose the checkpoint, provide a prompt and a trajectory, and it produces the trajectory-conditioned video.
zh: CameraCtrl 是面向文生视频的相机控制方法。它让你沿明确的轨迹驱动镜头,使生成片段按你指定的方式在场景中运动,而非随意移动。
你提供一段文本提示词以及一条相机轨迹,模型便会渲染出遵循该路径的视频。它作为控制层作用在视频扩散主干之上,遵循官方的基于轨迹的 demo 约定。
在 WorldFoundry 中,CameraCtrl 通过其内置合成后端在共享 pipeline 上运行:选好 checkpoint,给它提示词和轨迹,它就会生成受轨迹约束的视频。

whenToUse.en: Reach for CameraCtrl when you want deliberate camera movement in generated video defined by a trajectory — pans, orbits and dollies you plan rather than leave to the model.
whenToUse.zh: 当你希望生成视频中的镜头运动由轨迹精心设计——摇镜、环绕、推轨都由你规划而非交给模型随意发挥时,选择 CameraCtrl。

notFor.en: Not needed if you don't care about camera motion — its purpose is trajectory control, so you have to supply a camera path. Checkpoints are downloaded separately as external assets.
notFor.zh: 如果你不在意镜头运动,则无需它——它的用途是轨迹控制,因此你必须提供相机路径。Checkpoint 作为外部资源需单独下载。

en: Trajectory-level camera control for text-to-video
Control layer on top of a video diffusion backbone
Follows the official trajectory demo contract
Ships with both code and weights
zh: 面向文生视频的轨迹级相机控制
作用于视频扩散主干之上的控制层
遵循官方轨迹 demo 约定
代码与权重一并提供

tagline.en: THUDM's open video model — text-to-video and image-to-video across 2B and 5B checkpoints, with the 2B under Apache-2.0.
tagline.zh: THUDM 开源的视频模型——支持文生视频与图生视频,涵盖 2B 与 5B checkpoint,其中 2B 采用 Apache-2.0 许可。

en: CogVideoX is an open video generation family from THUDM (Tsinghua). It generates video from a text prompt and can also animate a still image into motion, and it has become a common backbone for video-diffusion research and tooling.

The family spans a 2B and a 5B model, including image-to-video checkpoints and the CogVideoX1.5 5B line. The 2B checkpoint is released under Apache-2.0; the larger variants carry an 'other' license, so check terms per checkpoint. Generation parameters like the number of inference steps, frame count, resolution and fps are exposed so you can tune the output.

In WorldFoundry, CogVideoX runs through its in-tree runtimes: 2B text-to-video, 5B text-to-video, and 5B image-to-video are wired up so you pick a checkpoint, give it a prompt (plus an image for image-to-video), and it renders the clip.
zh: CogVideoX 是 THUDM(清华)开源的视频生成家族。它可以根据文本提示词生成视频,也能让静态图片动起来,并已成为视频扩散研究与工具链中常见的主干。
该家族涵盖 2B 与 5B 模型,包括图生视频 checkpoint 以及 CogVideoX1.5 5B 系列。2B checkpoint 采用 Apache-2.0 许可;更大的变体使用 'other' 许可,因此请逐个 checkpoint 核对条款。推理步数、帧数、分辨率、fps 等生成参数均对外开放,便于你调节输出。
在 WorldFoundry 中,CogVideoX 通过其内置运行时运行:2B 文生视频、5B 文生视频和 5B 图生视频均已接入——选一个 checkpoint,给它提示词(图生视频再加一张图),它就会渲染出片段。

whenToUse.en: A strong open choice for both text-to-video and image-to-video, with a size range to trade quality against hardware — start on the Apache-2.0 2B, step up to 5B for higher fidelity.
whenToUse.zh: 无论文生视频还是图生视频,它都是有力的开源选择,且提供不同规模在画质与硬件间权衡——从 Apache-2.0 的 2B 起步,追求更高保真度时升级到 5B。

notFor.en: Note the licensing split: only the 2B is Apache-2.0, while the 5B and 1.5 variants use an 'other' license, so review terms before commercial use. Outputs are short clips rather than long-form video.
notFor.zh: 注意许可差异:仅 2B 为 Apache-2.0,而 5B 与 1.5 变体使用 'other' 许可,商用前请审阅条款。其输出为短片段,而非长视频。

en: Text-to-video and image-to-video in one open family
2B and 5B checkpoints, including the CogVideoX1.5 5B line

Tunable inference steps, frame count, resolution and fps

2B 与 5B checkpoint,含 CogVideoX1.5 5B 系列
2B 采用 Apache-2.0(更大变体为 'other' 许可)

tagline.en: Insta360's depth estimator for 360° panoramas — recover metric depth across a full equirectangular view.
tagline.zh: Insta360 面向 360° 全景的深度估计器——在完整的等距柱状全景视图上恢复度量深度。

en: Depth Any Panoramas (DAP) is a depth-estimation model from Insta360 Research aimed at 360° panoramic imagery. Ordinary depth models are built for standard perspective photos; DAP is tailored to the distortion and wraparound of full panoramas.

It estimates depth from a panoramic image, including metric depth, giving you a geometric read of the whole surrounding scene rather than a single narrow field of view. This makes it useful as a geometry prior — a source of 3D structure that other stages can build on.

In WorldFoundry, DAP is exposed as an independent geometry prior through the shared geometry-prior pipeline: feed it a panorama and it returns a depth estimate that downstream 3D and 4D components can consume.
zh: Depth Any Panoramas(DAP)是 Insta360 Research 面向 360° 全景图像的深度估计模型。普通深度模型是为标准透视照片设计的;DAP 则针对全景图特有的畸变与环绕特性做了适配。
它从全景图像估计深度,包括度量深度,从而给出对整个环绕场景的几何解读,而非只看一个狭窄视场。这使它可作为几何先验(geometry prior)——为其他环节提供三维结构的来源。
在 WorldFoundry 中,DAP 作为独立的几何先验通过共享的 geometry-prior pipeline 对外提供:给它一张全景图,它就会返回可供下游 3D、4D 组件使用的深度估计。

whenToUse.en: Use DAP when your input is 360° panoramic imagery and you need depth or metric geometry over the full sphere — for example to seed 3D reconstruction or scene understanding from panoramas.
whenToUse.zh: 当你的输入是 360° 全景图像、需要覆盖整个球面的深度或度量几何时——例如从全景图出发做三维重建或场景理解——使用 DAP。

notFor.en: Not the tool for ordinary perspective photos — it's specialized for panoramas. It's a geometry prior, not a full reconstruction pipeline on its own.
notFor.zh: 它不适合普通透视照片——它专为全景图设计。它是几何先验,本身并非完整的重建 pipeline。

在完整全景视图上支持度量深度
可作为 3D/4D 环节复用的几何先验
通过共享 geometry-prior pipeline 对外提供

en: Depth Anything 3 Metric Prior is the newest generation of the Depth Anything family, from ByteDance Seed. Where the earlier versions focused on relative depth, this metric variant predicts depth in real-world units from a single image.

In WorldFoundry it is packaged as an independent depth prior built around the DA3METRIC-LARGE checkpoint, with its own runtime configuration kept separate from other pipelines. That makes it a clean, self-contained source of metric geometry.
It runs through the shared geometry-prior pipeline: feed it an image and it returns a metric depth estimate that downstream 3D and 4D stages can consume.
zh: Depth Anything 3 Metric Prior 是 Depth Anything 家族的最新一代,来自 ByteDance Seed。相较早期版本聚焦相对深度,这一度量变体能从单张图像预测以真实世界单位表示的深度。
在 WorldFoundry 中,它被封装为围绕 DA3METRIC-LARGE checkpoint 构建的独立深度先验,并拥有与其他 pipeline 分离的独立运行时配置。这使它成为干净、自成一体的度量几何来源。
它通过共享的 geometry-prior pipeline 运行:给它一张图像,它就会返回可供下游 3D、4D 环节使用的度量深度估计。

whenToUse.en: Use this when you want the latest Depth Anything generation and need metric depth from single images — real-world-scaled geometry to feed a 3D/4D workflow.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想使用最新一代 Depth Anything、并需要从单张图像获得度量深度时使用它——为 3D/4D 工作流提供以真实尺度表示的几何。

notFor.en: It's a geometry prior that outputs depth, not a full reconstruction pipeline, and it targets standard images rather than 360° panoramas.

tagline.en: The original Depth Anything — a robust monocular depth estimator that predicts relative depth from a single image.
tagline.zh: 初代 Depth Anything——稳健的单目深度估计器,从单张图像预测相对深度。

en: Depth Anything V1 is a widely-adopted foundation model for monocular depth estimation: from one ordinary image it predicts a dense depth map. It became popular for being robust across diverse scenes without per-scene tuning.

It's a ViT-based model offered in small, base and large sizes, so you can trade accuracy against speed and memory. In this profile it produces relative depth and geometry artifacts you can export for downstream use.
In WorldFoundry, Depth Anything V1 runs through the in-tree depth pipeline: feed it an image and it returns a depth map and geometry output that later 3D/4D stages can build on.
zh: Depth Anything V1 是被广泛采用的单目深度估计基础模型:从一张普通图像预测出稠密深度图。它因在各种场景下无需逐场景调参即可稳健工作而广受欢迎。
它是基于 ViT 的模型,提供 small、base、large 三种规模,便于你在精度与速度、显存之间权衡。在该配置下,它产出相对深度和几何产物,可导出供下游使用。
在 WorldFoundry 中,Depth Anything V1 通过内置深度 pipeline 运行:给它一张图像,它就会返回可供后续 3D、4D 环节使用的深度图与几何输出。

whenToUse.en: A solid default when you need relative monocular depth from single images and want a well-tested, general-purpose estimator to feed geometry into a 3D/4D workflow.
whenToUse.zh: 当你需要从单张图像获得相对单目深度,并想要一个经过充分检验的通用估计器为 3D/4D 工作流提供几何输入时,它是可靠的默认选择。

notFor.en: It predicts relative depth rather than calibrated metric distances, so it's not the pick when you need absolute metric measurements. Newer Depth Anything versions may give sharper results.
notFor.zh: 它预测的是相对深度而非标定的度量距离,因此当你需要绝对度量测量时并不适用。更新的 Depth Anything 版本可能带来更清晰的结果。

en: Robust monocular depth from a single image
ViT-based, available in small / base / large sizes
Exports relative depth and geometry artifacts
General-purpose across diverse scenes
zh: 从单张图像获得稳健的单目深度
基于 ViT,提供 small / base / large 三种规模
导出相对深度与几何产物
在多样场景下通用

tagline.zh: 作为几何先验的 Depth Anything V2——从单张图像获得更清晰、更细致的单目深度。

en: Depth Anything V2 is the second-generation monocular depth model in the Depth Anything line. Like its predecessor it predicts a dense depth map from a single image, with the V2 release known for finer detail and cleaner, more robust depth.

In WorldFoundry it is packaged as an independent depth prior. The large checkpoint drives the shared priors factory and is reused by the video-depth prior, so the same implementation supplies both single-image and video-oriented depth.
It runs through the shared geometry-prior pipeline: give it an image and it returns a depth estimate that downstream 3D and 4D stages can consume as a geometric prior.
zh: Depth Anything V2 是 Depth Anything 系列的第二代单目深度模型。与前代一样,它从单张图像预测稠密深度图,而 V2 以更细的细节、更干净稳健的深度著称。
在 WorldFoundry 中,它被封装为独立的深度先验。large checkpoint 驱动共享的先验工厂,并被视频深度先验复用,因此同一实现同时服务于单图与面向视频的深度需求。
它通过共享的 geometry-prior pipeline 运行:给它一张图像,它就会返回可供下游 3D、4D 环节作为几何先验使用的深度估计。

whenToUse.en: Choose V2 when you want the Depth Anything family's monocular depth with improved detail and robustness — a strong default geometry prior for single images and video-depth workflows.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想要 Depth Anything 系列的单目深度,并追求更好的细节与稳健性时,选择 V2——它是单图与视频深度工作流中有力的默认几何先验。

notFor.en: As a prior it predicts depth rather than delivering a finished reconstruction, and it's tuned for standard images rather than 360° panoramas.
notFor.zh: 作为先验,它预测深度而非交付完整重建,并且是为标准图像而非 360° 全景调优的。

en: Second-generation Depth Anything with finer detail
Monocular depth from a single image
Shared implementation also powers the video-depth prior
Exposed through the geometry-prior pipeline

从单张图像获得单目深度
同一实现亦驱动视频深度先验

en: DualCamCtrl is a camera-control world model that turns a still image into video while following a defined camera path. It is a depth-conditioned, image-to-video approach: alongside the input image it uses depth and camera information to drive coherent, controllable motion through the scene.

It builds on the Wan2.1 video family — including the Wan2.1-Fun camera-control and image-to-video checkpoints — adding the DualCamCtrl control weights on top. The default workflow follows the official RGB / depth / camera demo contract: an input image, a depth image, and a camera trajectory file.

In WorldFoundry, DualCamCtrl runs through its in-tree inference runtime on the shared pipeline. By default it loads checkpoints from the Hugging Face / local cache, and you can also point it at pre-staged local paths.
zh: DualCamCtrl 是一个可控相机的世界模型,它把静态图片沿设定的相机路径转成视频。它是一种带深度条件的图生视频方法:除输入图片外,还借助深度和相机信息,驱动画面在场景中连贯、可控地运动。
它构建在 Wan2.1 视频家族之上——包括 Wan2.1-Fun 的相机控制与图生视频 checkpoint——并在其上叠加 DualCamCtrl 控制权重。默认工作流遵循官方的 RGB / 深度 / 相机 demo 约定:一张输入图片、一张深度图,以及一个相机轨迹文件。

whenToUse.en: Use DualCamCtrl when you want to animate an image into a camera-controlled clip and can supply depth and a camera trajectory — for depth-aware, viewpoint-driven video from a single frame.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想把一张图片动画成可控相机的片段,并能提供深度和相机轨迹时,使用 DualCamCtrl——从单帧出发生成深度感知、由视点驱动的视频。

notFor.en: It expects an input image plus depth and camera inputs, so it's not a pure text-to-video tool. Checkpoints are downloaded rather than bundled, so plan for the download.
notFor.zh: 它需要一张输入图片以及深度和相机输入,因此不是纯文生视频工具。Checkpoint 需下载而非随附,请预留下载时间。

tagline.en: NAVER LABS Europe's DUSt3R — feed-forward 3D reconstruction from a few images, no camera calibration required.
tagline.zh: NAVER LABS Europe 的 DUSt3R——从少量图像前馈式重建 3D,无需相机标定。

en: DUSt3R, from NAVER LABS Europe, made multi-view 3D reconstruction dramatically simpler. From just a couple of images it predicts dense 3D geometry in a single feed-forward pass — without needing known camera intrinsics or poses up front.

Instead of the traditional multi-stage structure-from-motion pipeline, it directly regresses point maps that align the views into a shared 3D space, from which geometry, depth and camera information can be recovered. This made it a widely-used foundation for 3D vision.

In WorldFoundry, DUSt3R is vendored as a 3D base model and exposed through the shared geometry-prior pipeline, so downstream 3D and 4D stages can draw on its reconstruction. Note the upstream weights carry a CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0 (non-commercial) license.
zh: DUSt3R 来自 NAVER LABS Europe,它让多视图 3D 重建变得极为简单。仅凭两三张图像,它就能在一次前馈推理中预测出稠密的 3D 几何——无需事先知道相机内参或位姿。
它不走传统的多阶段 structure-from-motion 流程,而是直接回归 point map,将各视角对齐到统一的 3D 空间,并由此恢复几何、深度和相机信息。这使它成为被广泛使用的 3D 视觉基础方法。
在 WorldFoundry 中,DUSt3R 作为 3D 基础模型内置,并通过共享的 geometry-prior pipeline 对外提供,供下游 3D、4D 环节使用其重建结果。注意其上游权重采用 CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0(非商用)许可。

whenToUse.en: Reach for DUSt3R when you need quick 3D reconstruction or geometry from a small set of uncalibrated images, without setting up a full structure-from-motion pipeline.
whenToUse.zh: 当你需要从少量、未标定的图像快速得到 3D 重建或几何,而不想搭建完整的 structure-from-motion 流程时,选择 DUSt3R。

notFor.en: The upstream weights are non-commercial (CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0), so review the license before commercial use. In WorldFoundry it's a base model surfaced as a prior, not a standalone end-to-end app.
notFor.zh: 其上游权重为非商用(CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0),商用前请审阅许可。在 WorldFoundry 中,它是以先验形式呈现的基础模型,而非独立的端到端应用。

en: Feed-forward multi-view 3D reconstruction
Works from uncalibrated images — no known intrinsics/poses needed
Recovers dense geometry, depth and camera information
Upstream weights are CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0 (non-commercial)
zh: 前馈式多视图 3D 重建
可从未标定图像工作——无需已知内参/位姿
恢复稠密几何、深度与相机信息

en: This is the base-model profile behind the DUSt3R entry: the underlying network and checkpoint that produce feed-forward 3D reconstruction from images. DUSt3R, from NAVER LABS Europe, predicts dense 3D geometry from a small set of uncalibrated views in a single pass.

tagline.en: Geometry-consistent world modeling on Wan2.1 — generate camera-controlled video while keeping the underlying 3D structure coherent.
tagline.zh: 构建在 Wan2.1 之上、几何一致的世界建模——在生成可控相机视频的同时保持底层 3D 结构连贯。

en: FantasyWorld, from AMAP and Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications authors, is a world model that couples video generation with 3D prediction so the generated scene stays geometrically consistent as the camera moves. The idea is to unify video and 3D so motion doesn't drift or break the underlying structure.

It animates an input image into a camera-controlled clip, building on the Wan2.1 image-to-video family and using MoGe as a geometry component. You provide a starting image and a camera path, and it renders video whose geometry holds together across the trajectory.

In WorldFoundry, the default FantasyWorld route runs the in-tree Wan2.1 camera-control pipeline. Running it requires the FantasyWorld Wan2.1 weights along with the Wan2.1 image-to-video and MoGe assets.
zh: FantasyWorld 由 AMAP 与北京邮电大学的作者们提出,是一个将视频生成与 3D 预测耦合起来的世界模型,使生成场景在镜头移动时保持几何一致。其思路是统一视频与 3D,让运动不至于漂移或破坏底层结构。
它把一张输入图片动画成可控相机的片段,构建在 Wan2.1 图生视频家族之上,并使用 MoGe 作为几何组件。你提供起始图片和相机路径,它就会渲染出在整条轨迹上几何都保持连贯的视频。
在 WorldFoundry 中,FantasyWorld 的默认入口运行内置的 Wan2.1 相机控制 pipeline。运行它需要 FantasyWorld Wan2.1 权重,以及 Wan2.1 图生视频和 MoGe 资源。

whenToUse.en: Use FantasyWorld when you want camera-controlled video from an image and care about geometric consistency across the camera path — exploring a scene while its 3D structure stays coherent.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想从一张图片生成可控相机的视频、并在意整条镜头路径上的几何一致性时——在探索场景的同时保持其 3D 结构连贯——使用 FantasyWorld。

notFor.en: It expects an input image and a camera path rather than text alone, and it depends on several local assets (FantasyWorld and Wan2.1 weights plus MoGe), so plan for the setup.
notFor.zh: 它需要输入图片和相机路径,而非仅靠文本;并且依赖多个本地资源(FantasyWorld 与 Wan2.1 权重以及 MoGe),请预留准备工作。

en: FlashWorld, from the FlashWorld team (imlixinyang), turns an image or a text prompt into a 3D scene. Instead of the slow, per-scene optimization that traditional 3D reconstruction relies on, it aims to produce a navigable scene quickly.

It builds on the Wan2.2 text-to-image/video backbone and pairs it with a scene representation you can render from new camera positions. You give it an image (or a prompt) and it generates the scene together with camera-conditioned views.
In WorldFoundry you run FlashWorld through the shared pipeline as an image-conditioned camera-scene task — provide an image, and it renders the generated scene along a camera path.
zh: FlashWorld 由 FlashWorld 团队(imlixinyang)开发,能把一张图片或一段文字提示词生成为 3D 场景。与传统 3D 重建依赖逐场景的缓慢优化不同,它的目标是快速产出可漫游的场景。
它以 Wan2.2 的文/图生成底座为基础,搭配可从新相机位姿渲染的场景表示。你给它一张图片(或提示词),它就会生成场景以及相机条件下的视角。
在 WorldFoundry 中,你通过统一 pipeline 以图像条件的相机场景任务运行 FlashWorld——提供一张图片,它便会沿相机轨迹渲染出生成的场景。

whenToUse.en: Reach for FlashWorld when you want to generate an explorable 3D scene from a single image or a prompt without running a lengthy per-scene reconstruction pass.

tagline.en: A single-image camera-calibration prior — recover intrinsics and the gravity direction to feed downstream 3D pipelines.
tagline.zh: 单图相机标定先验——从一张图片恢复内参与重力方向,为下游 3D 流程提供几何先验。

en: GeoCalib, from the CVG group (cvg), is a camera-calibration prior. From a single image it estimates the camera's parameters and the direction of gravity, giving downstream systems a geometric anchor to build on.

Rather than a standalone generator, it plays the role of a geometry prior: camera calibration, gravity (up-vector) estimation, and a general geometric prior that other 3D and world models can consume.

In WorldFoundry it is exposed as an independent geometry-prior component. Other pipelines — for example scene reconstruction that needs to know where the camera is pointing — import it as a shared building block rather than keeping a private copy.
zh: GeoCalib 由 CVG 团队(cvg)开发,是一个相机标定先验。它能从单张图片估计相机参数与重力方向,为下游系统提供可依赖的几何锚点。
它并非独立的生成器,而是承担几何先验的角色:相机标定、重力(向上向量)估计,以及可供其他 3D 与世界模型消费的通用几何先验。
在 WorldFoundry 中,它作为独立的几何先验组件对外提供。其他 pipeline——例如需要知道相机朝向的场景重建——会把它作为共享构件引入,而不必各自维护私有副本。

whenToUse.en: Use it when a 3D or reconstruction pipeline needs camera intrinsics or a gravity direction estimated from a single image, as a prior that upstream steps can rely on.
whenToUse.zh: 当某个 3D 或重建 pipeline 需要从单张图片估计相机内参或重力方向、作为上游步骤可依赖的先验时,使用它。

notFor.en: It is a calibration and geometry prior, not an image, video, or 3D-scene generator — it produces camera and gravity estimates, not rendered content.
notFor.zh: 它是标定与几何先验,不是图像、视频或 3D 场景的生成器——它输出的是相机与重力估计,而非渲染内容。

en: Estimates camera calibration from a single image
Recovers the gravity (up) direction
Serves as a shared geometry prior for downstream 3D pipelines
Exposed as an independent, reusable component in WorldFoundry
zh: 从单张图片估计相机标定
恢复重力(向上)方向
为下游 3D 流程提供共享几何先验
在 WorldFoundry 中作为独立、可复用的组件对外提供

tagline.en: GigaAI's open Apache-2.0 vision-language-action policy — a 3.5B world-model-powered VLA that predicts robot actions.
tagline.zh: GigaAI 开源的 Apache-2.0 视觉-语言-动作策略——3.5B、由世界模型驱动的 VLA,用于预测机器人动作。

en: GigaBrain-0, from GigaAI (open-gigaai), is a vision-language-action (VLA) policy for robotics. Given camera observations and a language instruction, it predicts the actions a robot should take to complete a task.

It is a world-model-powered VLA: the released GigaBrain-0-3.5B-Base and GigaBrain-0.1-3.5B-Base checkpoints are Apache-2.0 licensed. The stack draws on PaliGemma as a vision-language backbone and the FAST action tokenizer, and outputs predicted action trajectories rather than generated video.
In WorldFoundry it runs through the embodied action profiles for action prediction and policy rollout, emitting an action trace that describes the robot's intended motions.
zh: GigaBrain-0 由 GigaAI(open-gigaai)开发,是面向机器人的视觉-语言-动作(VLA)策略。给定相机观测与语言指令,它会预测机器人为完成任务应采取的动作。
它是一个由世界模型驱动的 VLA:已发布的 GigaBrain-0-3.5B-Base 与 GigaBrain-0.1-3.5B-Base checkpoint 采用 Apache-2.0 许可。其技术栈以 PaliGemma 作为视觉-语言底座,并使用 FAST 动作 tokenizer,输出的是预测的动作轨迹,而非生成的视频。
在 WorldFoundry 中,它通过具身动作 profile 运行,用于动作预测与策略 rollout,产出描述机器人预期动作的 action trace。

whenToUse.en: Use it when you need an openly-licensed VLA policy that maps visual observations plus a language instruction to robot actions, for action prediction or policy rollout in embodied settings.
whenToUse.zh: 当你需要一个开放许可的 VLA 策略,把视觉观测加语言指令映射为机器人动作、用于具身场景中的动作预测或策略 rollout 时,使用它。

notFor.en: It outputs action trajectories, not images or video, so it is not a visual generator. Reproducing specific task benchmarks also requires the corresponding task-specific normalization assets, which are provided separately.
notFor.zh: 它输出的是动作轨迹而非图像或视频,并非视觉生成器。复现特定任务基准还需要相应的任务归一化资源,这些资源需单独获取。

Predicts robot action trajectories from image + instruction
Builds on a PaliGemma vision-language backbone and the FAST action tokenizer

从图像加指令预测机器人动作轨迹

tagline.zh: 腾讯混元的交互式游戏世界模型——以图像为条件,用方向性相机控制驱动场景。

en: Hunyuan GameCraft, from Tencent Hunyuan, is an interactive world model for game-style scenes. Starting from a conditioning image, it generates video that responds to directional controls, letting you steer through the scene.

It works as an image-to-video model with camera control: the demo drives a scene with forward, backward, left, and right actions and renders a continuous clip. It is built on Tencent's Hunyuan video generation stack.
In WorldFoundry it runs as an interactive-video task — supply a starting image and a sequence of movement actions, and it produces the corresponding navigated video.
zh: Hunyuan GameCraft 由腾讯混元开发,是面向游戏风格场景的交互式世界模型。它从一张条件图片出发,生成能响应方向控制的视频,让你在场景中穿行。
它以带相机控制的图生视频方式工作:官方 demo 用前进、后退、左、右等动作驱动场景,并渲染出连续片段。它构建于腾讯混元的视频生成技术栈之上。
在 WorldFoundry 中,它以交互式视频任务运行——提供一张起始图片和一串移动动作,它便生成对应的漫游视频。

whenToUse.en: Reach for GameCraft when you want to explore an image-conditioned scene interactively, driving a camera through it with directional actions to produce game-style navigation video.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想以交互方式探索一个图像条件场景、用方向动作驱动相机穿行、生成游戏风格漫游视频时,可以选择 GameCraft。

notFor.en: It targets a multi-GPU inference setup and needs the Hunyuan-GameCraft checkpoint plus its dedicated environment, so it is not a lightweight single-card option.
notFor.zh: 它面向多卡推理配置,需要 Hunyuan-GameCraft 的 checkpoint 及其专用环境,并非轻量的单卡方案。

tagline.en: Tencent Hunyuan's feed-forward 3D reconstruction model — turn images or video into point clouds, Gaussian splats, depth and normals.
tagline.zh: 腾讯混元的前馈式 3D 重建模型——把图像或视频转成点云、高斯 splat、深度图与法线图。

en: HunyuanWorld-Mirror, from Tencent Hunyuan (HY-World), is a 3D reconstruction model. It takes images or video of a scene and reconstructs its geometry in a single feed-forward pass, without a lengthy per-scene optimization.

The model outputs a rich set of geometry products from the same input: a point-cloud PLY, a Gaussian-splat PLY, depth maps, and normal maps. Its modalities span image-to-3D and video-to-3D reconstruction, released as code and weights.
In WorldFoundry it runs through the HunyuanWorld-Mirror pipeline as a 3D task — hand it one or more images (or a path to them), and it writes the reconstruction artifacts to the output directory.
zh: HunyuanWorld-Mirror 由腾讯混元(HY-World)开发,是一个 3D 重建模型。它接收场景的图像或视频,以单次前馈方式重建其几何,而无需耗时的逐场景优化。
该模型可从同一输入产出一整套几何结果:点云 PLY、高斯 splat PLY、深度图与法线图。其模态涵盖图像到 3D 与视频到 3D 的重建,以代码加权重形式发布。
在 WorldFoundry 中,它通过 HunyuanWorld-Mirror pipeline 以 3D 任务运行——给它一张或多张图片(或它们的路径),它便把重建结果写入输出目录。

whenToUse.en: Use it when you want fast, feed-forward 3D reconstruction from images or video, producing point clouds, Gaussian splats, and depth/normal maps in one pass.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想从图像或视频进行快速的前馈式 3D 重建、一次性产出点云、高斯 splat 与深度/法线图时,使用它。

notFor.en: It is a reconstruction model, not a text- or image-to-video generator. Running it needs the checkpoint, a compatible GPU, and 3D dependencies such as gsplat and open3d.
notFor.zh: 它是重建模型,不是文/图生视频的生成器。运行它需要 checkpoint、兼容的 GPU,以及 gsplat、open3d 等 3D 依赖。

en: Feed-forward 3D reconstruction from images or video
Outputs point-cloud and Gaussian-splat PLY, plus depth and normal maps
Supports both image-to-3D and video-to-3D
Released with code and weights
zh: 从图像或视频进行前馈式 3D 重建
输出点云与高斯 splat PLY,以及深度图和法线图
同时支持图像到 3D 与视频到 3D
以代码加权重形式发布

tagline.zh: 腾讯混元的图像条件世界漫游模型——生成可控相机、长距离的视频,并兼具 3D 能力。

en: HunyuanWorld-Voyager, from Tencent Hunyuan (HY-World), is a world-generation model that explores a scene from a single conditioning image. It renders video as if a camera were traveling through the world, and its outputs support 3D reconstruction as well.

It is built for long-range generation: starting from an image, it produces a conditioned video following a camera path. Released as code and weights, its modalities span image-to-video, 3D reconstruction, and long-range world generation.
In WorldFoundry it runs as a world / video task — provide a starting image (and camera conditioning), and it generates the traveled-through video clip.
zh: HunyuanWorld-Voyager 由腾讯混元(HY-World)开发,是一个从单张条件图片出发探索场景的世界生成模型。它像相机在世界中穿行一样渲染视频,其输出也支持 3D 重建。
它面向长距离生成:从一张图片出发,沿相机轨迹生成条件视频。以代码加权重形式发布,模态涵盖图生视频、3D 重建与长距离世界生成。
在 WorldFoundry 中,它以世界/视频任务运行——提供一张起始图片(及相机条件),它便生成穿行世界的视频片段。

whenToUse.en: Reach for Voyager when you want to expand a single image into an explorable world and render long-range, camera-following video whose geometry can also be reconstructed in 3D.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想把单张图片扩展成可探索的世界、渲染沿相机行进的长距离视频,且其几何还能重建为 3D 时,可以选择 Voyager。

tagline.zh: 腾讯混元的交互式世界模型——从单张图片出发,用相机与动作控制实时驱动场景。

en: HY-WorldPlay, from Tencent Hunyuan (HY-World), is an interactive world model. From a starting image and a stream of camera or action inputs, it generates video of the scene as you move through it.

It is designed for streaming, real-time interaction with camera-action control. The system builds on Tencent's HunyuanVideo-1.5 for video generation, alongside supporting components such as a Qwen2.5-VL vision-language model and a FLUX.1 Redux image module.
In WorldFoundry it runs as an image-pose-video task — supply an image and a sequence of poses or actions, and it renders the corresponding interactive world video.
zh: HY-WorldPlay 由腾讯混元(HY-World)开发,是一个交互式世界模型。从一张起始图片和一串相机或动作输入出发,它生成随你移动而变化的场景视频。
它面向流式、实时的交互,支持相机-动作控制。系统以腾讯 HunyuanVideo-1.5 作为视频生成底座,并搭配 Qwen2.5-VL 视觉-语言模型、FLUX.1 Redux 图像模块等支撑组件。
在 WorldFoundry 中,它以图像-位姿-视频任务运行——提供一张图片和一串位姿或动作,它便渲染出对应的交互式世界视频。

whenToUse.en: Use it when you want to interactively play through a world from a single image, steering with camera and action controls to generate streaming, real-time-style video.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想从单张图片交互式地穿行一个世界、用相机与动作控制来生成流式、实时风格的视频时,使用它。

notFor.en: It targets a multi-GPU setup and needs the HY-WorldPlay and HunyuanVideo-1.5 assets, so it is not a lightweight single-card option.

tagline.en: MeiGen-AI's long-horizon world model — navigate a scene from a single image and generate extended, memory-consistent video.
tagline.zh: MeiGen-AI 的长时程世界模型——从单张图片出发在场景中导航,生成带记忆一致性的长视频。

en: Infinite-World, from MeiGen-AI, is an interactive world model built for long-horizon generation. From a single conditioning image it lets you navigate a scene and keeps generating video well beyond a short clip.
Its design emphasizes memory, so the world stays consistent as the sequence extends over a long horizon. It works as an image-to-video model with interactive navigation, released as code and weights.
In WorldFoundry it runs as a world / video task — provide a starting image and navigation input, and it produces a long-horizon world video together with preview metadata.
zh: Infinite-World 由 MeiGen-AI 开发,是一个面向长时程生成的交互式世界模型。从一张条件图片出发,它让你在场景中导航,并能持续生成远超短片的视频。
其设计强调记忆,使世界在序列延展到长时程时仍保持一致。它以带交互导航的图生视频方式工作,并以代码加权重形式发布。
在 WorldFoundry 中,它以世界/视频任务运行——提供一张起始图片和导航输入,它便产出长时程的世界视频以及预览元数据。

whenToUse.en: Reach for Infinite-World when you want to explore a scene interactively from a single image and generate extended video that stays coherent over a long horizon.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想从单张图片交互式探索场景、并生成在长时程内保持连贯的长视频时,可以选择 Infinite-World。

notFor.en: It needs the checkpoint and a capable GPU, and its focus is image-conditioned long-horizon navigation rather than free-form text-to-video.
notFor.zh: 它需要 checkpoint 与足够的 GPU,重点在于图像条件的长时程导航,而非自由的文生视频。

tagline.en: InSpatio's video-conditioned world model — extend and re-render a scene along new trajectories and camera views, built on Wan2.1.
tagline.zh: InSpatio 的视频条件世界模型——沿新轨迹与相机视角扩展并重渲染场景,底座基于 Wan2.1。

en: InSpatio-World, from InSpatio, is a world model that generates video conditioned on an input video and a chosen trajectory. It can continue a scene, follow new camera motion, and synthesize novel views.

It builds on the Wan2.1 text-to-video 1.3B backbone and adds spatial components — for example a Depth Anything depth model and a Florence-2 vision model — to support trajectory-conditioned generation and novel-view synthesis. The InSpatio-World checkpoint is Apache-2.0 licensed.
In WorldFoundry it runs as a video-conditioned world-generation task, covering trajectory-conditioned video and novel-view synthesis. All components resolve from local checkpoints.
zh: InSpatio-World 由 InSpatio 开发,是一个以输入视频和指定轨迹为条件生成视频的世界模型。它能续写场景、跟随新的相机运动,并合成新视角。
它以 Wan2.1 文生视频 1.3B 为底座,并加入空间组件——例如 Depth Anything 深度模型与 Florence-2 视觉模型——来支持轨迹条件生成与新视角合成。InSpatio-World 的 checkpoint 采用 Apache-2.0 许可。
在 WorldFoundry 中,它以视频条件的世界生成任务运行,涵盖轨迹条件视频与新视角合成。所有组件均从本地 checkpoint 解析。

whenToUse.en: Use it when you have an input video and want to extend the scene or re-render it along a new camera trajectory, including synthesizing novel views.
whenToUse.zh: 当你有一段输入视频、想沿新的相机轨迹扩展或重渲染场景(包括合成新视角)时,使用它。

notFor.en: It is video-conditioned, so it expects an input video rather than a pure text prompt, and needs its checkpoints and a GPU to run.
notFor.zh: 它是视频条件的,期望输入一段视频而非纯文字提示词,并需要其 checkpoint 与 GPU 才能运行。

en: InSpatio-WorldFM, from InSpatio, is a world foundation model focused on spatial intelligence. It generates video frames of a 3D world and can also produce panoramic views of the scene.

As a foundation-style world model, it treats frame generation and 3D spatial structure together, released as code and weights. It renders both a video stream and panorama artifacts from the same generation.
In WorldFoundry it runs through the WorldFM pipeline as a meta-demo task, producing the model's standard video and panorama output structure.

作为基础模型式的世界模型,它把帧生成与 3D 空间结构统一处理,以代码加权重形式发布。它从同一次生成中同时渲染视频流与全景结果。
在 WorldFoundry 中,它通过 WorldFM pipeline 以 meta-demo 任务运行,产出该模型标准的视频与全景输出结构。

whenToUse.en: Use it when you want a world foundation model that generates both a video stream and panoramic views of a 3D scene.
whenToUse.zh: 当你需要一个世界基础模型、同时生成 3D 场景的视频流与全景视角时,使用它。

notFor.en: It needs the WorldFM assets and a GPU to run, and is oriented toward world/panorama generation rather than plain text-to-video.
notFor.zh: 它需要 WorldFM 相关资源与 GPU 才能运行,面向世界/全景生成,而非普通的文生视频。

tagline.en: An Apache-2.0 embodied world model — a 4B text/image-to-video generator with a distilled robot recipe for fast rollouts.
tagline.zh: Apache-2.0 的具身世界模型——4B 文/图生视频生成器,含蒸馏机器人配方以实现快速 rollout。

en: Kairos is an embodied world model that generates video from text, an image, or both. It is aimed at robotics and embodied settings, where predicting how a scene evolves helps drive action.

It comes in 4B variants: a 480P pretrained checkpoint, a 720P checkpoint, and a distilled 480P robot recipe tuned for faster inference. The runtime is Apache-2.0 licensed, and the default route uses the distilled robot 480P recipe. The stack pairs the Kairos model with a Qwen text encoder and a Wan2.1 text-to-video component.

In WorldFoundry it runs as text-to-video, image-to-video, text-image-to-video, or an embodied-world-model task. The 480P distilled route is the default; the 720P and non-distilled variants are available by pointing at the corresponding checkpoints.
zh: Kairos 是一个具身世界模型,能从文字、图片或二者共同生成视频。它面向机器人与具身场景——预测场景如何演变有助于驱动动作。
它提供 4B 的多个变体:480P 预训练 checkpoint、720P checkpoint,以及为更快推理调优的蒸馏 480P 机器人配方。其运行时采用 Apache-2.0 许可,默认路径使用蒸馏机器人 480P 配方。技术栈将 Kairos 模型与 Qwen 文本编码器、Wan2.1 文生视频组件组合在一起。
在 WorldFoundry 中,它以文生视频、图生视频、文+图生视频或具身世界模型任务运行。480P 蒸馏路径为默认;指向相应 checkpoint 即可使用 720P 与非蒸馏变体。

whenToUse.en: Use it when you want an openly-licensed embodied world model to generate video from text and/or an image, especially for robot-style scenes — the distilled 480P recipe favors faster rollouts.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想用一个开放许可的具身世界模型、从文字和/或图片生成视频,尤其是机器人风格的场景时,使用它——蒸馏 480P 配方更利于快速 rollout。

notFor.en: It targets a multi-GPU inference setup and needs the Kairos, Qwen, and Wan2.1 checkpoints laid out per its config, so it is not a lightweight single-card option.
notFor.zh: 它面向多卡推理配置,需要按其配置布置 Kairos、Qwen 与 Wan2.1 的 checkpoint,并非轻量的单卡方案。

tagline.en: Vchitect's long-video model — generate extended, controllable clips from an image with depth and trajectory guidance, on Wan2.1.
tagline.zh: Vchitect 的长视频模型——以深度和轨迹引导、从图片生成可控的长片段,底座基于 Wan2.1。

en: LongVie 2, from Vchitect, is a controllable long-video generation model. It extends a clip well beyond a single segment by chaining generated segments together while keeping the motion continuous.

It is built on canonical Wan2.1 components — the I2V 14B 480P and T2V 1.3B backbones — and adds LongVie-specific control and attention. Each 81-frame segment takes a prompt plus dense depth and sparse pointmap/track control videos, and the first segment also takes an image. Continuations reuse the previous final frame, an eight-frame history, and the noise state to stay coherent. Full-quality defaults are 81 frames at 16 FPS and 50 denoising steps, at 640×352.
In WorldFoundry it runs as image-to-video, long-video-generation, depth-controlled-video, and trajectory-controlled-video tasks, producing queued control-video segments (not real-time interaction).
zh: LongVie 2 由 Vchitect 开发,是一个可控的长视频生成模型。它通过把生成的片段串接起来、并保持运动连续,从而把视频扩展到远超单段的长度。
它构建在经典的 Wan2.1 组件之上——I2V 14B 480P 与 T2V 1.3B 底座——并加入 LongVie 专属的控制与注意力机制。每个 81 帧片段需要一段提示词,外加稠密深度与稀疏点图/轨迹控制视频,首个片段还需要一张图片。续写会复用上一段的最后一帧、八帧历史与噪声状态以保持连贯。全质量默认为 81 帧、16 FPS、50 步去噪,分辨率 640×352。
在 WorldFoundry 中,它以图生视频、长视频生成、深度控制视频与轨迹控制视频任务运行,产出排队的控制视频片段(而非实时交互)。

whenToUse.en: Reach for LongVie 2 when you need extended video that stays coherent across segments and want fine control via depth maps and trajectory/track inputs, starting from an image.
whenToUse.zh: 当你需要跨片段保持连贯的长视频,并想通过深度图与轨迹/track 输入进行精细控制、从一张图片开始时,可以选择 LongVie 2。

notFor.en: It expects a prompt plus dense depth and sparse track control videos per segment, so it is not a one-shot text-to-video tool; full-quality runs target a multi-GPU setup and it is queued rather than real-time.
notFor.zh: 它对每个片段都需要提示词加稠密深度与稀疏 track 控制视频,并非一键式文生视频工具;全质量运行面向多卡配置,且为排队执行而非实时。

en: Controllable long-video generation via segment continuation
Depth-controlled and trajectory/track-controlled inputs
Built on canonical Wan2.1 I2V 14B and T2V 1.3B components
Full-quality output: 81-frame segments at 640×352, 16 FPS
zh: 通过片段续写实现可控的长视频生成
支持深度控制与轨迹/track 控制输入
构建于经典的 Wan2.1 I2V 14B 与 T2V 1.3B 组件之上
全质量输出:81 帧片段、640×352、16 FPS

tagline.en: NVIDIA's generative 3D and 4D world model — turn inputs into explorable scenes.
tagline.zh: NVIDIA 的生成式 3D/4D 世界模型——把输入转化为可探索的场景。

en: Lyra is a generative 3D and 4D world model from NVIDIA's Spatial Intelligence Lab. Rather than producing a flat video, it builds a scene you can look around and move through, aimed at open, generative world generation.

WorldFoundry ships both Lyra-1 and Lyra-2 pipelines, with Lyra-2 as the default and Lyra-1 available as an explicit variant. Alongside the world model it uses a Depth Anything 3 asset for geometry, and it includes a native World Explorer for interactive rendering.
In WorldFoundry you pick the Lyra variant you want and run it through the shared pipeline. Runtime execution needs local Lyra checkpoints, the text-encoder and DA3 assets, and a working CUDA setup.
zh: Lyra 是 NVIDIA Spatial Intelligence Lab 推出的生成式 3D/4D 世界模型。它不生成平面视频，而是构建一个可以环视、可以在其中移动的场景，面向开放式的生成式世界生成。
WorldFoundry 同时提供 Lyra-1 与 Lyra-2 两条 pipeline，默认使用 Lyra-2，Lyra-1 作为显式变体保留。除世界模型外，它还借助 Depth Anything 3 资产处理几何，并自带一个用于交互式渲染的原生 World Explorer。
在 WorldFoundry 中，你选定想用的 Lyra 变体，通过统一 pipeline 运行即可。运行时需要本地 Lyra checkpoint、文本编码器与 DA3 资产，以及可用的 CUDA 环境。

whenToUse.en: Reach for Lyra when you want to generate an explorable 3D/4D scene rather than a fixed clip — for spatial world building and interactive exploration. Lyra-2 is the recommended starting point.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想生成一个可探索的 3D/4D 场景、而非固定片段时，选择 Lyra——适合空间世界构建与交互式探索。Lyra-2 是推荐的起点。

notFor.en: Not a lightweight or plug-and-play model: it depends on local checkpoints, text-encoder and DA3 assets, and CUDA runtime dependencies, so plan for the setup and hardware.
notFor.zh: 它不是轻量或即插即用的模型：依赖本地 checkpoint、文本编码器与 DA3 资产，以及 CUDA 运行时依赖，请预留环境搭建与硬件资源。

Lyra-1 and Lyra-2 pipelines, with Lyra-2 as the default

From NVIDIA's Spatial Intelligence Lab

tagline.en: Skywork's MIT-licensed interactive world model — steer a streaming game-style video with actions.
tagline.zh: Skywork 开源的 MIT 许可交互式世界模型——用动作实时操控游戏风格视频。

en: Matrix-Game 2.0 is an interactive world model from Skywork AI, released with open code and weights under the MIT license. Instead of rendering a fixed clip, it generates a streaming, game-style video that responds to action inputs, letting you drive the scene as it unfolds.

It works from an image plus a stream of control actions and produces action-controlled game video. WorldFoundry follows the official universal-mode defaults and uses an in-tree action-condition generator, so you don't need an external checkout to run it.
In WorldFoundry you launch the universal image route, provide a starting image and actions, and it synthesizes the interactive video for you.
zh: Matrix-Game 2.0 是 Skywork AI 推出的交互式世界模型，以 MIT 许可开放代码与权重。它不生成固定片段，而是生成随动作输入实时响应的、流式的游戏风格视频，让你能在场景展开的同时进行操控。
它以一张图片加上一串控制动作作为输入，输出受动作控制的游戏视频。WorldFoundry 沿用官方 universal 模式默认配置，并使用内置的动作条件生成器，无需外部代码库即可运行。
在 WorldFoundry 中，你启动 universal image 路径，给它一张起始图片与动作序列，它就会为你合成这段可交互视频。

whenToUse.en: Use it when you want an openly-licensed interactive world model — generating game-like video that you can steer with actions from a starting image, rather than a one-shot render.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想要一个开放许可的交互式世界模型时使用——从起始图片出发、用动作操控生成游戏式视频，而非一次性渲染。

notFor.en: Not for classic offline text-to-video prompting or long non-interactive films; its focus is short, action-driven interactive rollouts. Checkpoints are downloaded separately.
notFor.zh: 不适合传统离线的文生视频提示或长篇非交互影片；它专注于短时、动作驱动的交互式生成。Checkpoint 需单独下载。

en: MIT license, open code and weights
Interactive, action-controlled game-style video
Streaming generation you can steer in real time

tagline.en: Skywork's next-generation interactive world model, tuned for long-horizon, streaming scenes.
tagline.zh: Skywork 新一代交互式世界模型，面向长时程、流式场景。

en: Matrix-Game 3.0 is the next step in Skywork AI's interactive world-model family, released with open code and weights. Like its predecessor it generates game-style video that responds to actions, with an emphasis on longer-horizon, streaming scenes.

It runs image-conditioned: you give it a starting image and control actions such as moving forward or turning the camera, and it synthesizes the scene from there. The runtime is vendored in-tree in WorldFoundry, including an efficient light VAE path, so no external Matrix-Game checkout is needed at run time — only the checkpoint assets.
In WorldFoundry you launch the cityscape image route, provide an image and actions, and it produces the interactive video.
zh: Matrix-Game 3.0 是 Skywork AI 交互式世界模型家族的下一步，开放代码与权重。与上一代一样，它生成随动作响应的游戏风格视频，并更强调长时程、流式的场景。
它以图像为条件运行：你给它一张起始图片和前进、转动镜头等控制动作，它就从此处合成场景。其运行时已内置于 WorldFoundry（包含高效的 light VAE 路径），运行时无需外部 Matrix-Game 代码库，只需 checkpoint 资产。
在 WorldFoundry 中，你启动 cityscape image 路径，给它一张图片与动作序列，它就会生成这段可交互视频。

whenToUse.en: Choose it when you want an openly-licensed interactive world model geared toward longer, streaming rollouts driven by camera and movement actions from an initial image.

tagline.en: A monocular metric-depth model — recover real-world depth in meters from a single image.
tagline.zh: 单目度量深度模型——从单张图片恢复以米为单位的真实深度。

en: Metric3D is a monocular depth model that estimates metric depth — depth in real-world units — from a single image, rather than only relative depth. In WorldFoundry it serves as an independent geometry prior that other pipelines can build on.

It handles monocular depth estimation, metric depth estimation, and acts as a geometry prior. WorldFoundry exposes it through the shared geometry-prior pipeline and operator contract, and the VIPE SLAM defaults reference it by name through the shared priors factory.
In WorldFoundry you can call it directly for depth on a single image, or let a higher-level pipeline pull it in as its depth prior.
zh: Metric3D 是一个单目深度模型，从单张图片估计度量深度——即以真实世界单位表示的深度，而不仅是相对深度。在 WorldFoundry 中，它作为一个独立的几何先验，可供其他 pipeline 复用。
它支持单目深度估计、度量深度估计，并可充当几何先验。WorldFoundry 通过统一的几何先验 pipeline 与算子契约暴露它，VIPE SLAM 的默认配置也通过共享先验工厂按名称引用它。
在 WorldFoundry 中，你可以直接调用它对单张图片估计深度，也可以让更高层的 pipeline 把它作为深度先验引入。

whenToUse.en: Use it when you need metric (real-scale) depth from a single image, or a reusable depth prior that downstream 3D and SLAM pipelines can consume.
whenToUse.zh: 当你需要从单张图片得到度量（真实尺度）深度，或需要一个可供下游 3D 与 SLAM pipeline 复用的深度先验时，使用它。

notFor.en: It's a geometry prior, not a full scene reconstructor or generator — pair it with higher-level pipelines for those tasks.
notFor.zh: 它是几何先验，而非完整的场景重建或生成器——重建与生成任务请搭配更高层的 pipeline。

en: Metric depth (real-world units) from a single image

Reusable geometry prior across WorldFoundry pipelines

tagline.en: Ai2's Apache-2.0 vision-language-action policy — turn camera views and instructions into robot actions.
tagline.zh: Ai2 的 Apache-2.0 视觉-语言-动作策略——把相机画面与指令转化为机器人动作。

en: MolmoAct2 is a vision-language-action (VLA) policy from Ai2 (Allen Institute for AI). It takes camera views and an instruction and predicts robot actions, so instead of generating video it drives a robot policy. The core checkpoints are released under Apache-2.0.

It comes in several profiles tuned for different robots and benchmarks — DROID, bimanual YAM, SO100/SO101, LIBERO, and a Think-LIBERO variant — each with its own camera setup and action space. WorldFoundry runs an in-tree runtime under its action-generation stack, loading the checkpoints through explicit local model and processor classes with remote code disabled, and automatically picks BF16, FP16, or FP32 based on your GPU.
In WorldFoundry you select the profile that matches your robot, point it at the checkpoint, and run the policy-rollout route to get action traces.
zh: MolmoAct2 是 Ai2（艾伦人工智能研究所）推出的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略。它接收相机画面和一条指令，预测机器人动作——因此它不生成视频，而是驱动机器人策略。核心 checkpoint 以 Apache-2.0 许可发布。
它提供多个针对不同机器人与基准调优的配置——DROID、双臂 YAM、SO100/SO101、LIBERO，以及 Think-LIBERO 变体——每个都有各自的相机设置与动作空间。WorldFoundry 在其动作生成栈下运行内置运行时，通过显式的本地模型与处理器类加载 checkpoint（禁用远程代码），并根据你的 GPU 自动选择 BF16、FP16 或 FP32。
在 WorldFoundry 中，你选择与机器人匹配的配置，指向对应 checkpoint，运行 policy-rollout 路径即可得到动作轨迹。

whenToUse.en: Use it when you need an openly-licensed VLA policy for robot control — mapping camera input and instructions to actions across DROID, YAM, SO100/101, or LIBERO-style setups.
whenToUse.zh: 当你需要一个开放许可的 VLA 策略来控制机器人时使用——把相机输入与指令映射为动作，覆盖 DROID、YAM、SO100/101 或 LIBERO 类设置。

notFor.en: Not a video or image generator — its output is action traces, not pixels. Pick the profile that matches your robot, since camera layout and action dimensions differ per profile.
notFor.zh: 它不是视频或图像生成器——输出的是动作轨迹而非画面。请选择与你机器人匹配的配置，因为不同配置的相机布局与动作维度各不相同。

Core checkpoints under Apache-2.0
Profiles for DROID, bimanual YAM, SO100/101, LIBERO, and Think-LIBERO
Automatic BF16/FP16/FP32 precision by GPU
zh: 出自 Ai2 的视觉-语言-动作策略
核心 checkpoint 采用 Apache-2.0 许可

tagline.en: Geometry estimation for dynamic scenes — reconstruct structure even when things are moving.
tagline.zh: 面向动态场景的几何估计——即使画面中有物体在运动也能重建结构。

en: MonST3R estimates scene geometry in the presence of motion. Where many reconstruction methods assume a static scene, MonST3R is built to recover structure from video where objects and the camera are moving, extending the DUSt3R line of pointmap-based reconstruction to dynamic content.

In WorldFoundry it runs the in-tree, non-interactive demo path and exports the result as a GLB scene you can open in standard 3D viewers. The Studio default disables the optional flow loss so previews aren't blocked; the full dynamic-mask setup additionally needs RAFT2 and SAM2 assets configured.
In WorldFoundry you feed it a video through the geometry route and it materializes a GLB scene artifact.
zh: MonST3R 在有运动的情况下估计场景几何。许多重建方法假设场景静止，而 MonST3R 专为从物体与相机都在移动的视频中恢复结构而设计，把 DUSt3R 一脉的 pointmap 重建方法扩展到动态内容。
在 WorldFoundry 中，它运行内置的非交互 demo 路径，把结果导出为可在标准 3D 查看器中打开的 GLB 场景。Studio 默认关闭可选的 flow loss，以免阻塞预览；完整的动态掩码设置还需要配置 RAFT2 与 SAM2 资产。
在 WorldFoundry 中，你通过几何路径给它一段视频，它就会生成一个 GLB 场景产物。

whenToUse.en: Reach for MonST3R when you need geometry from video that contains motion — moving objects or a moving camera — and want an exportable 3D scene.
whenToUse.zh: 当你需要从含运动（移动物体或移动相机）的视频中获取几何，并希望得到可导出的 3D 场景时，选择 MonST3R。

notFor.en: The public source is non-commercial, so downstream use must honor the upstream license. Full dynamic-mask results require RAFT2 and SAM2 assets set up alongside it.
notFor.zh: 其公开源码为非商业用途，下游使用须遵守上游许可。完整的动态掩码效果需要额外配置 RAFT2 与 SAM2 资产。

tagline.en: Tencent ARC's motion controller for video — direct camera moves and object motion in generation.
tagline.zh: 腾讯 ARC 的视频运动控制器——在生成中指挥镜头运动与物体运动。

en: MotionCtrl adds explicit motion control to video generation. From Tencent ARC, it lets you separately steer camera movement and object motion, so a text-to-video or image-to-video result follows the trajectory you intend rather than whatever the base model happens to produce.

It works as a control layer over a video diffusion backbone, taking camera poses and object-motion cues as conditions. WorldFoundry vendors the MotionCtrl model stack, control modules, sampler, default inference config, and camera/object-motion fixtures in-tree; the checkpoints stay as external assets in the usual cache.
In WorldFoundry you run the default route with a prompt (or image) plus a camera-pose fixture, and it renders a motion-controlled clip.
zh: MotionCtrl 为视频生成加入了显式的运动控制。它出自腾讯 ARC，可以分别指挥镜头运动与物体运动，让文生视频或图生视频的结果沿着你设定的轨迹进行，而不是任由底座模型自由发挥。
它作为视频扩散底座之上的控制层工作，以相机位姿和物体运动线索作为条件。WorldFoundry 将 MotionCtrl 的模型栈、控制模块、采样器、默认推理配置以及相机/物体运动 fixture 内置于代码中；checkpoint 仍作为外部资产存放在常规缓存里。
在 WorldFoundry 中，你用一段提示词（或图片）加一份相机位姿 fixture 运行默认路径，它就会渲染出一段受运动控制的片段。

whenToUse.en: Use it when you want fine control over camera movement or object motion in generated video — following a specified camera trajectory rather than accepting the model's default motion.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想对生成视频中的镜头运动或物体运动进行精细控制时使用——沿指定的相机轨迹运动，而非接受模型默认的运动。

notFor.en: It's a motion-control layer, not a standalone high-fidelity generator; results depend on the underlying video backbone and the checkpoints, which are downloaded separately.
notFor.zh: 它是运动控制层，而非独立的高保真生成器；效果取决于底层视频底座与 checkpoint，后者需单独下载。

tagline.en: A 4D world model from in-the-wild monocular video, built on Wan components.
tagline.zh: 基于 Wan 组件、从野外单目视频构建 4D 世界模型。

en: NeoVerse is a 4D world model that works from in-the-wild monocular video — ordinary single-camera footage rather than multi-view rigs. It comes from authors at CASIA and CreateAI and aims to lift casual video into a controllable 4D scene.

In WorldFoundry it's assembled natively on top of the shared Wan components, adding its own control and reconstruction roles plus a LoRA on top. The official video-input path treats the scene as dynamic (static_scene=false), following the README-style tilt-up demo.
In WorldFoundry you run the tilt-up video route with local NeoVerse assets. Runtime execution needs the NeoVerse, Wan, reconstructor, LoRA, and CUDA assets in place.
zh: NeoVerse 是一个 4D 世界模型，从野外单目视频出发——即普通的单相机拍摄，而非多视角装置。它由 CASIA 与 CreateAI 的作者提出，目标是把随手拍摄的视频提升为可控的 4D 场景。
在 WorldFoundry 中，它原生构建在共享的 Wan 组件之上，加入自有的控制与重建角色以及一层 LoRA。官方的视频输入路径把场景视为动态（static_scene=false），沿用 README 中的 tilt-up 演示。
在 WorldFoundry 中，你用本地 NeoVerse 资产运行 tilt-up 视频路径。运行时需要备好 NeoVerse、Wan、重建器、LoRA 与 CUDA 资产。

whenToUse.en: Use it when you want to build a 4D world from everyday monocular video rather than staged multi-camera capture, and can supply the local assets it depends on.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想从日常单目视频（而非布置好的多相机采集）构建 4D 世界，并能提供其所依赖的本地资产时，使用它。

notFor.en: Not a lightweight or plug-and-play route: real inference is checkpoint- and GPU-gated and requires NeoVerse, Wan, reconstructor, LoRA, and CUDA assets. Plan for the setup.
notFor.zh: 它不是轻量或即插即用的路径：真实推理受 checkpoint 与 GPU 限制，需要 NeoVerse、Wan、重建器、LoRA 与 CUDA 资产。请预留环境搭建。

tagline.en: An MIT-licensed 7B vision-language-action policy — a strong open baseline for robot control.
tagline.zh: MIT 许可的 7B 视觉-语言-动作策略——机器人控制的开放强基线。

en: OpenVLA is an open vision-language-action (VLA) policy: a 7B model that takes camera images plus a language instruction and predicts robot actions. It's a widely-used open baseline for generalist robot manipulation, released under the MIT license.

WorldFoundry offers the base openvla-7b checkpoint and a LIBERO-10 fine-tuned variant. The runtime vendors the Prismatic/OpenVLA architecture code in-tree, so imports don't depend on external repos or remote code, and it emits an action-trace artifact rather than video.
In WorldFoundry you run the action-prediction or policy-rollout route on the base checkpoint by default; pass unnorm_key=libero_10 to switch to the LIBERO-10 fine-tune.
zh: OpenVLA 是一个开放的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略：一个 7B 模型，接收相机图像加语言指令，预测机器人动作。它是被广泛使用的通用机器人操作开放基线，采用 MIT 许可。
WorldFoundry 提供基础的 openvla-7b checkpoint 与一个在 LIBERO-10 上微调的变体。其运行时把 Prismatic/OpenVLA 架构代码内置于代码库，导入不依赖外部仓库或远程代码，输出的是动作轨迹产物而非视频。
在 WorldFoundry 中，你默认在基础 checkpoint 上运行动作预测或 policy-rollout 路径；传入 unnorm_key=libero_10 即可切换到 LIBERO-10 微调版本。

whenToUse.en: Use it when you want a well-known, openly-licensed VLA baseline for robot manipulation — mapping images and instructions to actions, with a LIBERO-10 fine-tune ready to go.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想要一个知名、开放许可的 VLA 基线用于机器人操作时使用——把图像与指令映射为动作，并有现成的 LIBERO-10 微调版本。

notFor.en: Not a video or image generator — its output is action traces, and it's kept out of video-generation scorecards. At 7B it needs adequate GPU memory to run.
notFor.zh: 它不是视频或图像生成器——输出为动作轨迹，且不进入视频生成的评分体系。作为 7B 模型，运行需要足够的 GPU 显存。

7B vision-language-action policy for robot manipulation
Base checkpoint plus a LIBERO-10 fine-tune
In-tree architecture, no remote code dependency
zh: MIT 许可，权重开放
面向机器人操作的 7B 视觉-语言-动作策略

tagline.en: A depth-completion prior — refine and complete metric depth using a prompt depth signal.
tagline.zh: 深度补全先验——借助 prompt 深度信号细化并补全度量深度。

en: Prior Depth Anything is a depth-completion prior. Rather than predicting depth from scratch, it takes a prompt metric-depth signal and refines or completes it, producing cleaner, denser metric depth. In WorldFoundry it lives as an independent prior that higher-level geometry pipelines can share.

It covers depth completion, metric depth estimation, and acts as a geometry prior, exposed through WorldFoundry's shared geometry-prior pipeline and operator contract. Because it consumes prompt depth, it pairs naturally with a base depth model — for example refining a Depth Anything 3 metric-depth condition.
In WorldFoundry you can invoke it directly to complete a depth input, or let a downstream pipeline pull it in as a shared prior.
zh: Prior Depth Anything 是一个深度补全先验。它不从零预测深度，而是接收一个 prompt 度量深度信号，对其进行细化或补全，产出更干净、更稠密的度量深度。在 WorldFoundry 中，它作为独立先验存在，可供更高层的几何 pipeline 共享。
它涵盖深度补全、度量深度估计，并充当几何先验，通过 WorldFoundry 统一的几何先验 pipeline 与算子契约暴露。由于它消费 prompt 深度，因此天然适合与基础深度模型搭配——例如细化 Depth Anything 3 的度量深度条件。
在 WorldFoundry 中，你可以直接调用它补全一份深度输入，也可以让下游 pipeline 把它作为共享先验引入。

whenToUse.en: Use it when you already have a coarse or sparse metric-depth signal and want to complete or refine it — for example cleaning up the output of a base depth model.
whenToUse.zh: 当你已有一份粗糙或稀疏的度量深度信号、想对其补全或细化时使用——例如清理基础深度模型的输出。

notFor.en: It's a completion prior that expects a prompt depth input, not a from-scratch depth estimator or a full scene reconstructor.
notFor.zh: 它是需要 prompt 深度输入的补全先验，而非从零开始的深度估计器或完整的场景重建器。

en: Depth completion and refinement from a prompt depth signal
Produces metric depth
Reusable geometry prior across WorldFoundry pipelines
Pairs naturally with a base depth model

tagline.en: Re-render an existing video from a new camera trajectory, built on Wan2.1.
tagline.zh: 以全新相机轨迹重新渲染已有视频，基于 Wan2.1 构建。

en: ReCamMaster performs camera-controlled video re-rendering: give it a single input video and a target camera trajectory, and it generates the same scene as if shot from a different camera path. It comes from the Kling team at Kuaishou together with academic collaborators.

It's built on Wan2.1 — the runtime uses a ReCamMaster checkpoint alongside Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B — and WorldFoundry exposes the pipeline, operator, and synthesis runtime in-tree under the Kling namespace. The main route is a video-to-video demo driven by a camera trajectory.
In WorldFoundry you run the camera-controlled re-rendering route with local ReCamMaster and Wan assets. Runtime execution needs Wan2.1, the ReCamMaster checkpoint, torchvision, and CUDA in place.
zh: ReCamMaster 做的是相机控制的视频重渲染：给它一段输入视频和一条目标相机轨迹，它会生成同一场景在另一条相机路径下拍摄的效果。它出自快手 Kling 团队与学术合作者。
它构建在 Wan2.1 之上——运行时使用 ReCamMaster checkpoint 搭配 Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B——WorldFoundry 在 Kling 命名空间下内置了对应的 pipeline、算子与合成运行时。主路径是由相机轨迹驱动的视频到视频演示。
在 WorldFoundry 中，你用本地 ReCamMaster 与 Wan 资产运行相机控制重渲染路径。运行时需要备好 Wan2.1、ReCamMaster checkpoint、torchvision 与 CUDA。

whenToUse.en: Use it when you have an existing video and want to re-render it along a new camera path — for camera-trajectory changes and video-to-video re-shooting.
whenToUse.zh: 当你已有一段视频、想沿新的相机路径重新渲染时使用——用于相机轨迹变化与视频到视频的重拍。

notFor.en: Not a from-scratch text-to-video generator; it re-renders an input video. Real inference is checkpoint- and GPU-gated and needs Wan2.1 plus the ReCamMaster checkpoint.
notFor.zh: 它不是从零开始的文生视频生成器；它重渲染一段输入视频。真实推理受 checkpoint 与 GPU 限制，需要 Wan2.1 加 ReCamMaster checkpoint。

en: RoboFlamingo adapts a vision-language model into a robot policy. It builds on the OpenFlamingo backbone (with an MPT language model) to turn camera images and language instructions into robot actions, showing that a capable VLM can be fine-tuned into an effective manipulation policy.

WorldFoundry vendors the RoboFlamingo/OpenFlamingo architecture and inference code in-tree and stages the released RoboFlamingo policy checkpoint together with its OpenFlamingo and MPT backbone components. It runs as a VLM/VLA policy that emits action traces, not video.

WorldFoundry 将 RoboFlamingo/OpenFlamingo 的架构与推理代码内置于代码库，并将已发布的 RoboFlamingo 策略 checkpoint 连同其 OpenFlamingo 与 MPT 骨干组件一并准备好。它作为输出动作轨迹（而非视频）的 VLM/VLA 策略运行。
在 WorldFoundry 中，你用准备好的 checkpoint 运行策略路径，即可产出机器人动作轨迹。

whenToUse.en: Use it when you want a VLM-based robot policy — mapping camera images and instructions to actions using an OpenFlamingo-derived backbone.

tagline.en: An action-conditioned interactive world model, built as a Wan network variant.
tagline.zh: 动作条件的交互式世界模型，作为 Wan 网络变体构建。

en: SCOPE is an interactive, game-oriented world model with action conditioning. From a starting image and a stream of actions, it generates video that responds to what you do, framed as an action-conditioned image-to-video model.

In WorldFoundry its action conditioning is integrated as a canonical Wan network variant, reusing the shared Wan encoder, VAE, loader, scheduler, and staged runner — only its action-conditioned network stays model-specific. The large model weights remain external HuggingFace assets injected via a model directory.
In WorldFoundry you run the image-action-to-video route with staged SCOPE weights, an input image, and an action sequence to synthesize the interactive result.
zh: SCOPE 是一个面向游戏、带动作条件的交互式世界模型。它从一张起始图片和一串动作出发，生成对你操作作出响应的视频，定位为动作条件的图生视频模型。
在 WorldFoundry 中，它的动作条件被集成为一个标准的 Wan 网络变体，复用共享的 Wan 编码器、VAE、加载器、调度器与分阶段 runner——只有其动作条件网络保持模型专属。大模型权重仍作为外部 HuggingFace 资产，通过模型目录注入。
在 WorldFoundry 中，你用准备好的 SCOPE 权重、一张输入图片和一段动作序列运行图像-动作到视频路径，即可合成交互式结果。

whenToUse.en: Use it when you want an action-conditioned interactive world model — generating video that reacts to an action stream from a starting image.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想要一个动作条件的交互式世界模型时使用——从起始图片出发、生成对动作序列作出反应的视频。

notFor.en: Not for offline text-to-video; it's action-conditioned and needs an input image and actions. The model weights are external assets you stage yourself, and it requires the run to be explicitly enabled for execution.
notFor.zh: 不适合离线文生视频；它是动作条件的，需要输入图片和动作。模型权重为需自行准备的外部资产，且需显式开启执行才能运行。

tagline.en: NYU VisionX's Solaris — an interactive world model that generates video you can steer, including multi-agent scenes.
tagline.zh: NYU VisionX 出品的 Solaris——一个可交互的世界模型，能生成你可以操控的视频，包括多智能体场景。

en: Solaris is a world model from NYU's VisionX group. Rather than producing a fixed clip, it generates video as an interactive, controllable world — you can influence how the scene unfolds, and it supports multi-agent settings where several actors move at once.

The model is run inference-only in WorldFoundry, with its pretrained weights and evaluation data hosted on Hugging Face under nyu-visionx/solaris. Because it is built to be steered, it fits interactive generation and world-simulation experiments rather than one-shot text-to-video.
zh: Solaris 是 NYU VisionX 团队的世界模型。它不是产出一段固定片段，而是把视频当作一个可交互、可控的世界来生成——你可以影响场景如何演进，并且支持多个角色同时运动的多智能体设定。
在 WorldFoundry 中以推理模式运行，其预训练权重与评测数据托管在 Hugging Face 的 nyu-visionx/solaris 下。由于它天生面向操控，更适合交互式生成与世界模拟类实验，而非一次性的文生视频。

whenToUse.en: Reach for Solaris when you want an interactive, steerable world model rather than a one-shot video generator — especially for multi-agent scenes where you want to influence how the world evolves.
whenToUse.zh: 当你需要的是一个可交互、可操控的世界模型，而不是一次性视频生成器时，选择 Solaris——尤其适合希望影响世界演进的多智能体场景。

notFor.en: Not the simplest path for plain text-to-video; it is built around interactive world simulation and needs its pretrained weights staged from Hugging Face first.
notFor.zh: 若只想做简单的文生视频，它并非最省事的选择；它围绕交互式世界模拟构建，且需先从 Hugging Face 准备好预训练权重。

Supports multi-agent world scenes
Open pretrained weights hosted on Hugging Face (nyu-visionx/solaris)
Research-backed model from NYU VisionX

支持多智能体世界场景

tagline.en: Splatt3R — feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting from a pair of uncalibrated images, no poses or camera intrinsics required.
tagline.zh: Splatt3R——从一对未标定图像前馈生成 3D 高斯泼溅，无需相机位姿或内参。

en: Splatt3R is a feed-forward 3D reconstruction model from Brandon Smart and collaborators. Given two ordinary photos of a scene, it predicts a 3D Gaussian Splatting representation in a single pass — no per-scene optimization, and no camera poses or calibration needed.

It builds on the DUSt3R/MASt3R line of pointmap-based geometry models, extending them to directly output splats you can render from new viewpoints. In WorldFoundry the runtime produces a PLY Gaussian splat file as its artifact, ready to load into standard splat viewers.
Because it is feed-forward, reconstruction is fast compared with optimization-based Gaussian Splatting: you supply the image pair and get a 3D scene out.
zh: Splatt3R 是 Brandon Smart 及合作者的前馈式 3D 重建模型。给它同一场景的两张普通照片，它便一次前向推理即可预测出 3D 高斯泼溅表示——无需逐场景优化，也不需要相机位姿或标定。
它承袭 DUSt3R/MASt3R 这一基于 pointmap 的几何模型路线，并将其扩展为可直接输出用于新视角渲染的高斯泼溅。在 WorldFoundry 中，运行时会产出一个 PLY 高斯泼溅文件，可直接载入常见的 splat 查看器。
由于是前馈式，其重建速度相比基于优化的高斯泼溅要快得多：给它一对图像，就能得到一个 3D 场景。

whenToUse.en: Great when you want fast 3D reconstruction from just two casual photos, with no camera calibration and no lengthy per-scene optimization.
whenToUse.zh: 当你希望仅凭两张随手拍的照片快速做 3D 重建，且不想做相机标定或漫长的逐场景优化时，它非常合适。

notFor.en: Aimed at sparse two-view reconstruction rather than dense many-view capture; checkpoints are external assets you stage separately.
notFor.zh: 面向稀疏双视图重建，而非稠密多视图采集；checkpoint 是外部资源，需单独准备。

en: Reconstructs 3D from a pair of uncalibrated images
Feed-forward — no per-scene optimization
Outputs a PLY Gaussian splat artifact
Built on the DUSt3R / MASt3R geometry lineage
zh: 从一对未标定图像重建 3D
前馈式——无需逐场景优化
输出 PLY 高斯泼溅文件
构建于 DUSt3R / MASt3R 几何模型路线之上

tagline.en: StarVLA — a vision-language-action policy built on Qwen3-VL that turns camera views and instructions into robot actions.
tagline.zh: StarVLA——基于 Qwen3-VL 的视觉-语言-动作策略，把相机画面与指令转化为机器人动作。

en: StarVLA is a vision-language-action (VLA) model for embodied control. It takes visual observations plus a language instruction and predicts the actions a robot should execute, using the Qwen3-VL-4B vision-language model as its backbone.

The main policy checkpoint, Qwen3-VL-OFT-LIBERO-4in1, is trained on the LIBERO manipulation benchmark and runs in an OFT (optimized fine-tuning) prediction route. A companion world-action variant (WM4A, MIT-licensed) pairs the policy with a Wan2.2 video model to model how actions play out in the world. Predictions are returned both in environment-space and normalized form, with unnormalization driven by the checkpoint's statistics.
In WorldFoundry the policy and world-action code run inference-only in-tree, so you can drive the model with local checkpoints without a separate upstream checkout.
zh: StarVLA 是面向具身控制的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型。它接收视觉观测加一条语言指令，预测机器人应执行的动作，主干采用 Qwen3-VL-4B 视觉语言模型。
主策略 checkpoint Qwen3-VL-OFT-LIBERO-4in1 在 LIBERO 操作基准上训练，以 OFT（优化微调）路线做动作预测。配套的 world-action 变体 WM4A（MIT 许可）将策略与 Wan2.2 视频模型结合，用以建模动作在世界中的展开。预测同时返回环境空间与归一化两种形式，反归一化由 checkpoint 统计量驱动。
在 WorldFoundry 中，策略与 world-action 代码以推理模式内置运行，你可以用本地 checkpoint 直接驱动模型，无需单独拉取上游代码。

whenToUse.en: Use StarVLA when you need a VLA policy that maps images and language instructions to robot actions, particularly for LIBERO-style manipulation tasks.
whenToUse.zh: 当你需要一个把图像与语言指令映射到机器人动作的 VLA 策略时，尤其针对 LIBERO 类操作任务，可选择 StarVLA。

notFor.en: Heavy to run — the policy is built on a 4B vision-language model and was exercised on an 80GB GPU; you also need to stage the checkpoints and base VLM locally.
notFor.zh: 运行开销较大——策略建立在 4B 视觉语言模型之上，需在 80GB 级 GPU 上运行；同时需在本地准备好 checkpoint 与基座 VLM。

en: Vision-language-action policy on a Qwen3-VL-4B backbone
Trained for LIBERO manipulation (4-in-1 checkpoint)
Optional world-action variant with a Wan2.2 video model (MIT license)
Returns both environment-space and normalized actions
zh: 基于 Qwen3-VL-4B 主干的视觉-语言-动作策略
面向 LIBERO 操作训练（4-in-1 checkpoint）
可选 world-action 变体，搭配 Wan2.2 视频模型（MIT 许可）

tagline.en: VGGT-Omega — a feed-forward geometry transformer that recovers 3D scene structure from images for reconstruction and novel views.
tagline.zh: VGGT-Omega——前馈式几何 Transformer，从图像恢复 3D 场景结构，用于重建与新视角合成。

en: VGGT-Omega is a visual geometry transformer in the VGGT family, distributed on Hugging Face as facebook/VGGT-Omega. It predicts 3D scene structure directly from images in a single feed-forward pass, supporting 3D reconstruction, Gaussian splatting, and novel-view synthesis.

The model works from as little as a single image and outputs geometry you can export as a scene. In WorldFoundry the runtime follows the official scene-export route, emitting a predictions.npz file alongside a GLB scene artifact you can open in standard 3D tools.
Note the checkpoint is released under CC-BY-NC-4.0, so its use is limited to non-commercial purposes.
zh: VGGT-Omega 是 VGGT 系列中的视觉几何 Transformer，在 Hugging Face 上以 facebook/VGGT-Omega 发布。它以单次前馈推理直接从图像预测 3D 场景结构，支持 3D 重建、高斯泼溅与新视角合成。
该模型最少只需一张图即可工作，并输出可导出为场景的几何。在 WorldFoundry 中，运行时遵循官方的场景导出路线，产出 predictions.npz 文件以及可用常见 3D 工具打开的 GLB 场景文件。
注意该 checkpoint 采用 CC-BY-NC-4.0 许可，因此仅限非商业用途。

whenToUse.en: Choose VGGT-Omega for fast, feed-forward 3D geometry recovery from images — reconstruction, splatting, or novel-view synthesis — when you can work within a non-commercial license.
whenToUse.zh: 当你需要从图像快速前馈恢复 3D 几何（重建、泼溅或新视角合成），且可接受非商业许可时，选择 VGGT-Omega。

notFor.en: The CC-BY-NC-4.0 license rules out commercial use. Weights are staged separately and not bundled in source.
notFor.zh: CC-BY-NC-4.0 许可排除了商业用途。权重需单独准备，不随源码打包。

Covers reconstruction, Gaussian splatting, and novel-view synthesis
Exports predictions.npz plus a GLB scene artifact
CC-BY-NC-4.0 — non-commercial use

tagline.en: VMem — an interactive world model with surfel-indexed memory, so navigable video stays consistent as you explore.
tagline.zh: VMem——带 surfel 索引记忆的交互式世界模型，让可导航视频在你探索时保持一致。

en: VMem is an interactive video world model that generates a scene you can move through. Its key idea is memory: it maintains a geometry-indexed record of what it has already rendered, so as you navigate the world stays consistent instead of drifting or forgetting earlier views.

It streams video frame by frame in response to camera motion, making it suited to interactive exploration rather than fixed clips. Under the hood it pairs a Stable Diffusion 2.1 backbone with a CLIP image encoder and DUSt3R/CUT3R-style geometry for its spatial memory.
In WorldFoundry the VMem runtime is built in-tree, so you can run the navigation experience with staged VMem and CUT3R checkpoints and no external checkout.
zh: VMem 是一个可交互的视频世界模型，能生成你可以在其中穿行的场景。它的核心是记忆：维护一份以几何为索引的、对已渲染内容的记录，因此你导航时世界会保持一致，而不会漂移或遗忘先前的视角。
它随相机运动逐帧流式生成视频，因而适合交互式探索，而非固定片段。其内部将 Stable Diffusion 2.1 主干与 CLIP 图像编码器，以及 DUSt3R/CUT3R 风格的几何结合起来，构成空间记忆。
在 WorldFoundry 中，VMem 运行时内置于代码树中，你只需准备好 VMem 与 CUT3R 的 checkpoint，无需外部代码即可运行导航体验。

whenToUse.en: Use VMem when you want to explore a generated scene interactively and need earlier views to stay consistent as the camera moves — its memory is built for that.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想交互式地探索一个生成场景，并希望相机移动时先前的视角保持一致时，选择 VMem——它的记忆机制正为此而生。

notFor.en: Not aimed at one-shot text-to-video; it needs several staged checkpoints (VMem, CUT3R, and the diffusion/CLIP backbones) and is driven by camera navigation.
notFor.zh: 不面向一次性文生视频；它需要准备多个 checkpoint（VMem、CUT3R 以及扩散/CLIP 主干），并由相机导航驱动。

en: Interactive, navigable video world model
Geometry-indexed memory keeps views consistent over time
Streams frames in response to camera motion
Built on Stable Diffusion 2.1 with CLIP and CUT3R/DUSt3R geometry
zh: 可交互、可导航的视频世界模型
以几何为索引的记忆让视角随时间保持一致
随相机运动流式生成帧
基于 Stable Diffusion 2.1，结合 CLIP 与 CUT3R/DUSt3R 几何

tagline.en: Alibaba's open video model — Apache-2.0 text-to-video and image-to-video, from an 8GB-friendly 1.3B up to 14B.
tagline.zh: 阿里开源的视频模型——Apache-2.0 许可,支持文生视频与图生视频,从 8GB 显存可跑的 1.3B 到 14B。

en: Wan2.1 is Wan-AI's open-weight video generation family, released under Apache-2.0 with no gating. It turns a text prompt into a short video, and can also animate a still image into motion.

The family comes in four sizes so you can trade quality for hardware: a lightweight text-to-video 1.3B that fits in roughly 8GB of VRAM, a larger 14B for higher fidelity, and two image-to-video 14B checkpoints tuned for 480p and 720p. Under the hood it pairs a UMT5 text encoder with a dedicated video VAE and a diffusion denoiser.

In WorldFoundry you run Wan2.1 through the shared pipeline — pick a checkpoint, give it a prompt (and an image for image-to-video), and it writes out an MP4. The 1.3B text-to-video route renders a 5-second clip at 832×480.
zh: Wan2.1 是 Wan-AI 开源的视频生成模型家族,采用 Apache-2.0 许可、无使用门槛。它可以把一段文字提示词生成为短视频,也能让一张静态图片动起来。
该家族提供四种规模,方便你在画质与硬件间权衡:约 8GB 显存即可运行的轻量文生视频 1.3B、追求更高保真度的 14B,以及针对 480p 和 720p 调优的两个图生视频 14B。其内部由 UMT5 文本编码器、专用视频 VAE 与扩散去噪器组合而成。
在 WorldFoundry 中,你通过统一 pipeline 运行 Wan2.1——选一个 checkpoint,给它提示词(图生视频再加一张图),它就会输出一段 MP4。1.3B 文生视频路径可生成 832×480、约 5 秒的片段。

whenToUse.en: A strong default when you want an openly-licensed video model to prototype text-to-video on modest hardware — the 1.3B fits in about 8GB. Step up to the 14B or image-to-video checkpoints when you need higher fidelity or want to animate an existing image.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想用一个开放许可的视频模型、在普通硬件上做文生视频原型时,它是很好的默认选择——1.3B 约 8GB 显存即可运行。若需要更高保真度,或想让已有图片动起来,可升级到 14B 或图生视频 checkpoint。

notFor.en: Longer clips or sustained narrative shots — outputs are short (around 5 seconds). Checkpoints are downloaded separately rather than bundled, so plan for the download and disk space.
notFor.zh: 不适合较长片段或需要连续叙事的镜头——输出较短(约 5 秒)。Checkpoint 需单独下载而非随附,请预留下载时间与磁盘空间。

en: Apache-2.0, fully open weights across all four checkpoints
Text-to-video and image-to-video in one family
1.3B runs in roughly 8GB VRAM
1.3B output: 832×480, ~5s at 16 fps
zh: Apache-2.0,四个 checkpoint 全部完全开放权重
文生视频与图生视频同属一个家族
1.3B 约 8GB 显存即可运行

tagline.en: Warp-as-History — camera-controlled image-to-video that warps past frames as geometric history for consistent motion.
tagline.zh: Warp-as-History——相机可控的图生视频，把过往帧作为几何历史进行 warp，实现一致的运动。

en: Warp-as-History turns a still image into a video along a camera path you control. Its central idea is to warp already-generated frames forward as a geometric 'history', so the model conditions on where the scene has been and produces coherent, camera-consistent motion.

The system combines a Helios diffusion runtime with a Pi3 geometry module used for camera-pose-to-warp rendering, driven through CLI scripts with the model, LoRA, and Pi3X checkpoints supplied as local assets. In WorldFoundry the official runtime is vendored in-tree.
Because its upstream stack pins specific Python and PyTorch versions, it runs in a dedicated environment profile rather than the shared one.
zh: Warp-as-History 把一张静态图沿你控制的相机路径生成为视频。其核心思想是把已生成的帧向前 warp，作为一段几何“历史”，让模型以场景此前的状态为条件，产出连贯、相机一致的运动。
该系统将 Helios 扩散运行时与用于相机位姿到 warp 渲染的 Pi3 几何模块结合，通过 CLI 脚本驱动，模型、LoRA 与 Pi3X 的 checkpoint 以本地资源提供。在 WorldFoundry 中，官方运行时被内置于代码树。
由于其上游技术栈固定了特定的 Python 与 PyTorch 版本，它在专用环境配置中运行，而非共享环境。

whenToUse.en: Reach for Warp-as-History when you want to animate a single image along a controlled camera trajectory and care about geometric, camera-consistent motion.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想让一张图沿受控相机轨迹动起来，并在意几何一致、相机一致的运动时，选择 Warp-as-History。

notFor.en: Runs in a dedicated environment because its stack pins specific Python/PyTorch versions; large checkpoints (Helios, LoRA, Pi3X) must be staged locally first.
notFor.zh: 因技术栈固定了特定 Python/PyTorch 版本，需在专用环境中运行；大型 checkpoint（Helios、LoRA、Pi3X）须先在本地准备好。

Warps prior frames as geometric history for consistency
Combines a Helios diffusion runtime with Pi3 geometry

将过往帧作为几何历史 warp，以保持一致性
