en: WorldCam is a world model developed by KAIST, Adobe Research, and MAUM AI. It generates video worlds you can steer with precise camera control, and is designed for long-horizon, interactive, game-like scenes rather than short fixed clips.

It builds on the Wan2.1 text-to-video 1.3B backbone, adding conditioning on a camera pose so you can direct how the viewpoint moves through the generated world. In WorldFoundry the runtime is in-tree and supports the official-style conditioning-video path with local WorldCam and Wan assets.
zh: WorldCam 是由 KAIST、Adobe Research 与 MAUM AI 共同研发的世界模型。它生成可用精确相机控制来操控的视频世界，专为长时程、可交互、类游戏的场景设计，而非短促固定的片段。
它以 Wan2.1 文生视频 1.3B 为主干，加入相机位姿条件，让你能指挥视点如何在生成世界中移动。在 WorldFoundry 中，运行时内置于代码树，支持官方风格的条件视频路线，并可使用本地的 WorldCam 与 Wan 资源。

whenToUse.en: Use WorldCam when you want precise camera control over a generated world and are interested in long-horizon, interactive, game-style video.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想对生成世界进行精确相机控制，并关注长时程、可交互、游戏风格的视频时，选择 WorldCam。

notFor.en: Released as code only, so you supply the WorldCam and Wan2.1 weights yourself; it targets camera-conditioned world generation rather than plain prompt-to-video.
notFor.zh: 以纯代码形式发布，权重需你自行准备 WorldCam 与 Wan2.1；它面向相机条件的世界生成，而非单纯的提示词到视频。

tagline.zh: YUME——一个交互式世界模型，把图像或视频转化为你可探索的世界，提供 540P 与 720P 两种变体。

en: YUME is an interactive world-video model. Given a conditioning image or video, it generates an explorable world, so instead of a fixed clip you get a scene you can move through and interact with.

It ships in two forms: YUME I2V at 540P for image-to-world generation, and the larger YUME-1.5 5B at 720P, which also accepts text alongside image or video conditioning. Both come with open code and weights, hosted on Hugging Face under stdstu123.
In WorldFoundry both variants run through a shared in-tree pipeline and a unified environment, so you can switch between the 540P and 720P routes without changing setup.
zh: YUME 是一个交互式世界视频模型。给它一张条件图像或一段视频，它便生成一个可探索的世界——你得到的不是固定片段，而是一个可以穿行、可以交互的场景。
它提供两种形态：面向图生世界的 YUME I2V（540P），以及更大的 YUME-1.5 5B（720P），后者还可在图像或视频条件之外接受文本。两者均开放代码与权重，托管于 Hugging Face 的 stdstu123 下。
在 WorldFoundry 中，两个变体都通过共享的内置 pipeline 与统一环境运行，你无需改动配置即可在 540P 与 720P 路线间切换。

whenToUse.en: Use YUME when you want to turn an image (or video) into an interactive, explorable world — pick 540P I2V for lighter runs or the 720P 5B variant for higher resolution and text conditioning.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想把一张图（或一段视频）变成可交互、可探索的世界时，选择 YUME——较轻量选 540P I2V，追求更高分辨率与文本条件则选 720P 的 5B 变体。

notFor.en: Built around interactive world exploration rather than one-shot text-to-video; you stage its weights from Hugging Face first.
notFor.zh: 围绕交互式世界探索构建，而非一次性文生视频；需先从 Hugging Face 准备好权重。

en: Interactive, explorable world generation from image or video
Two variants: 540P I2V and 720P 5B (YUME-1.5)
720P variant also accepts text conditioning
Open code and weights on Hugging Face

两种变体：540P I2V 与 720P 5B（YUME-1.5）
720P 变体还可接受文本条件
开放代码与权重，托管于 Hugging Face

en: ZeroScope is a well-known open text-to-video model from the cerspense project, built on a classic U-Net diffusion architecture. It turns a text prompt into a short video clip and has long been a popular, easy-to-run choice in the open community.

It comes in two checkpoints: zeroscope_v2_576w as the base generator, and zeroscope_v2_XL for upscaling to higher resolution. In WorldFoundry it runs through a Diffusers-based route, matching the standard ZeroScope pipeline.
Both checkpoints are released under CC-BY-NC-4.0, which limits use to non-commercial purposes.
zh: ZeroScope 是 cerspense 项目发布的知名开源文生视频模型，采用经典的 U-Net 扩散架构。它把一段文字提示词生成为短视频，长期以来是开源社区中易于上手、广受欢迎的选择。
它提供两个 checkpoint：作为基础生成器的 zeroscope_v2_576w，以及用于放大到更高分辨率的 zeroscope_v2_XL。在 WorldFoundry 中，它通过基于 Diffusers 的路线运行，与标准 ZeroScope pipeline 一致。
两个 checkpoint 均采用 CC-BY-NC-4.0 许可，仅限非商业用途。

whenToUse.en: A good pick for quick, lightweight text-to-video prototyping in the open ecosystem — use the 576w base to generate and the XL checkpoint to upscale, within a non-commercial license.
whenToUse.zh: 在开源生态中做快速、轻量的文生视频原型时是不错的选择——用 576w 基础模型生成、再用 XL checkpoint 放大，需遵守非商业许可。

notFor.en: The CC-BY-NC-4.0 license rules out commercial use. It is a legacy U-Net diffusion model, so quality trails newer transformer-based video models.

tagline.en: Action Chunking Transformer (ACT) — an imitation-learning robot policy that predicts action chunks from camera observations.
tagline.zh: Action Chunking Transformer（ACT）——一个模仿学习机器人策略，从相机观测预测动作块。

en: ACT, the Action Chunking Transformer, is a classic imitation-learning policy for robot manipulation, from Tony Zhao and collaborators. Instead of predicting one action at a time, it predicts short chunks of future actions, which makes execution smoother and more robust.

Architecturally it is a DETR-style transformer with a conditional VAE (DETR-VAE) and a ResNet image backbone: camera observations go in, and a trajectory of chunked actions comes out. In WorldFoundry the inference-only policy runs in-tree and emits an action trace that downstream embodied benchmarks can replay.

The upstream repository publishes training and evaluation recipes but not a ready-made pretrained policy, so running prediction requires you to stage your own trained checkpoint and its matching dataset statistics.
zh: ACT，即 Action Chunking Transformer，是 Tony Zhao 及合作者提出的经典模仿学习机器人操作策略。它不是一次预测一个动作，而是预测未来一小段动作块，从而让执行更平滑、更稳健。
在架构上，它是 DETR 风格的 Transformer，配合条件 VAE（DETR-VAE）与 ResNet 图像主干：输入相机观测，输出分块动作的轨迹。在 WorldFoundry 中，仅推理的策略在代码树内运行，产出可供下游具身基准回放的动作轨迹。
上游仓库公开了训练与评测配方，但未提供现成的预训练策略，因此运行预测需要你自行准备训练好的 checkpoint 及其匹配的数据集统计量。

whenToUse.en: Use ACT when you want a proven action-chunking imitation policy for robot manipulation and you have (or will train) your own checkpoint and dataset statistics.
whenToUse.zh: 当你需要一个成熟的动作分块模仿策略用于机器人操作，并且已有（或将训练）自己的 checkpoint 与数据集统计量时，选择 ACT。

notFor.en: No pretrained policy is shipped — you must stage a trained policy checkpoint and matching dataset statistics before it can predict actions.
notFor.zh: 不附带预训练策略——需先准备训练好的策略 checkpoint 与匹配的数据集统计量，才能预测动作。

en: Action-chunking imitation policy for robot manipulation
DETR-VAE transformer with a ResNet image backbone
Outputs a replayable action trace for embodied benchmarks
Runs inference-only in-tree with your staged checkpoint
zh: 面向机器人操作的动作分块模仿策略
DETR-VAE Transformer 搭配 ResNet 图像主干
输出可供具身基准回放的动作轨迹
以推理模式内置运行，使用你准备的 checkpoint

tagline.en: AlayaWorld — an interactive world model built on LTX-2.3, with camera control, spatial memory, and long-video rollout.
tagline.zh: AlayaWorld——构建于 LTX-2.3 的交互式世界模型，具备相机控制、空间记忆与长视频自回归生成。

en: AlayaWorld, from Alaya Lab, is an interactive world model that turns an image and text into a controllable video world. You can drive it with camera trajectories, and it supports autoregressive long-video generation so scenes can extend well beyond a short clip.

It is built as an extension of the LTX-2.3 video architecture, reusing its transformer, VAE, and a Gemma-based text connector, and adding action conditioning, a temporal-history encoder, and spatial memory backed by a Depth Anything 3 model for geometry. Inputs span image, text, and camera trajectory; outputs are video. Its released merged checkpoint is around 33.6 GB.
AlayaWorld is released with code and restricted weights, and it also draws on a gated Gemma-3 12B model as part of its stack.
zh: AlayaWorld 来自 Alaya Lab，是一个交互式世界模型，把图像与文本转化为可控的视频世界。你可以用相机轨迹来驱动它，并且它支持自回归的长视频生成，让场景可以远远超出短片段的长度。
它作为 LTX-2.3 视频架构的扩展构建，复用其 transformer、VAE 与基于 Gemma 的文本连接器，并加入动作条件、时序历史编码器，以及由 Depth Anything 3 模型提供几何支撑的空间记忆。输入涵盖图像、文本与相机轨迹，输出为视频。其发布的合并 checkpoint 约 33.6 GB。
AlayaWorld 以代码加受限权重的形式发布，其技术栈中还用到一个受访问限制的 Gemma-3 12B 模型。

whenToUse.en: Reach for AlayaWorld when you want a camera-controllable, image-and-text-driven world model that can roll out long videos with spatial memory across the scene.
whenToUse.zh: 当你需要一个相机可控、由图像与文本驱动、并能带着跨场景空间记忆生成长视频的世界模型时，选择 AlayaWorld。

notFor.en: Heavyweight — its merged checkpoint is around 33.6 GB, weights are release-restricted, and its stack pulls in a gated Gemma-3 12B model you must have access to.
notFor.zh: 较为重量级——合并 checkpoint 约 33.6 GB，权重发布受限，且技术栈依赖一个需获授权的 Gemma-3 12B 模型。

Inputs span image, text, and camera trajectory

tagline.en: ATI-Wan2.1-14B — ByteDance's trajectory-controlled image-to-video, adding drawn motion paths on top of Wan2.1 14B.
tagline.zh: ATI-Wan2.1-14B——字节跳动的轨迹可控图生视频，在 Wan2.1 14B 之上加入手绘运动路径控制。

en: ATI (from ByteDance Research) is a controllable image-to-video method that lets you steer motion by drawing trajectories: you sketch paths on the input image and the model animates the scene so objects follow them. This build pairs it with the Wan2.1 image-to-video 14B backbone at 480p.

In WorldFoundry only ATI's inference delta is vendored, reusing the shared in-tree Wan2.1 base implementation; at runtime it loads a read-only union of the ATI weights and locally staged Wan2.1 I2V components. It ships as code with weights, and both the ATI and Wan2.1 checkpoints are resolved from local assets.
zh: ATI（来自字节跳动研究院）是一种可控图生视频方法，让你通过绘制轨迹来操控运动：你在输入图像上勾画路径，模型便让场景中的物体沿其运动。本构建将其与 480p 的 Wan2.1 图生视频 14B 主干结合。
在 WorldFoundry 中，仅内置 ATI 的推理增量部分，复用共享的内置 Wan2.1 基础实现；运行时它加载 ATI 权重与本地准备的 Wan2.1 I2V 组件的只读并集。它以代码加权重形式发布，ATI 与 Wan2.1 的 checkpoint 均从本地资源解析。

notFor.en: Runs on the 14B backbone and requires both ATI and Wan2.1 I2V checkpoints staged locally — plan for the download and hardware.
notFor.zh: 运行于 14B 主干，需在本地同时准备 ATI 与 Wan2.1 I2V 的 checkpoint——请预留下载与硬件资源。

tagline.en: Bernini — ByteDance's Apache-2.0 unified visual model spanning text/image-to-image and text/reference-to-video.
tagline.zh: Bernini——字节跳动的 Apache-2.0 统一视觉模型，覆盖文/图生图与文/参考生视频。

en: Bernini is a unified visual generation model from ByteDance, released under Apache-2.0. A single system handles a broad set of tasks: text-to-image, image-to-image, text-to-video, video-to-video, and reference-conditioned video generation.

Its checkpoint combines a 7B semantic planner with a 14B renderer — the planner works out what to generate and the renderer produces the pixels. The official recipe runs multi-GPU with 8-way Ulysses inference for a single request. In WorldFoundry the official inference source is vendored in-tree and loaded from the self-contained Diffusers checkpoint.
Because the official route is designed for 8-way parallel inference on H100-class GPUs, Bernini targets serious multi-GPU setups rather than single-card use.
zh: Bernini 是字节跳动的统一视觉生成模型，采用 Apache-2.0 许可。单个系统即可处理一系列广泛任务：文生图、图生图、文生视频、视频生视频，以及参考条件的视频生成。
其 checkpoint 将 7B 的语义规划器与 14B 的渲染器结合——规划器决定生成什么，渲染器产出像素。官方配方针对单次请求采用 8 路 Ulysses 多 GPU 推理。在 WorldFoundry 中，官方推理源码被内置于代码树，并从自包含的 Diffusers checkpoint 加载。
由于官方路线为 H100 级 GPU 上的 8 路并行推理而设计，Bernini 面向严肃的多 GPU 环境，而非单卡使用。

whenToUse.en: Use Bernini when you want one openly-licensed model to cover both image and video generation across text, image, and reference conditioning — and you have multi-GPU hardware for its 8-way inference.
whenToUse.zh: 当你希望用一个开放许可的模型，在文本、图像与参考条件下同时覆盖图像与视频生成，并具备支持其 8 路推理的多 GPU 硬件时，选择 Bernini。

notFor.en: The official route assumes 8-way Ulysses inference on H100-class GPUs, so it is not suited to single-card or modest hardware.
notFor.zh: 官方路线假设在 H100 级 GPU 上做 8 路 Ulysses 推理，因此不适合单卡或普通硬件。

Covers text/image-to-image and text/video/reference-to-video
7B semantic planner paired with a 14B renderer
Official recipe uses 8-way Ulysses multi-GPU inference

tagline.en: ByteDance's Bernini-R renderer at 1.3B — an Apache-2.0 model spanning image and video generation, including reference-guided modes.
tagline.zh: 字节跳动 Bernini-R 渲染器的 1.3B 版本——Apache-2.0 许可,覆盖图像与视频生成,并支持参考条件模式。

en: Bernini-R is the renderer of ByteDance's Bernini family, published on Hugging Face under Apache-2.0 in a Diffusers-compatible format. This 1.3B variant is a compact renderer fine-tuned from Wan2.1's 1.3B backbone, so it inherits Wan-style video generation and layers image and reference-conditioned modes on top.

A single model covers a broad task set: text-to-image and image-to-image for stills, text-to-video and video-to-video for motion, and reference-to-video plus reference-video-to-video, where a reference image or clip steers the generated result.
In WorldFoundry you run it through the shared pipeline — pick the checkpoint and task, supply a prompt (and an image, video, or reference where the task calls for it), and it renders the output.
zh: Bernini-R 是字节跳动 Bernini 系列的渲染(生成)模型,以 Diffusers 兼容格式、Apache-2.0 许可发布在 Hugging Face 上。这个 1.3B 变体是从 Wan2.1 的 1.3B 主干微调而来的轻量渲染器,既继承了 Wan 风格的视频生成,又增加了图像与参考条件的生成模式。
一个模型覆盖多种任务:文生图与图生图用于静态图像,文生视频与视频到视频用于动态画面,还有参考到视频与参考视频到视频——用一张参考图或一段参考片段来引导生成结果。
在 WorldFoundry 中,你通过统一 pipeline 运行它:选好 checkpoint 与任务,给出提示词(以及任务需要的图像、视频或参考素材),它便渲染出结果。

whenToUse.en: When you want an openly-licensed, compact renderer that spans both image and video generation — including reference-guided video — and prefer the smaller 1.3B size for lighter setups.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想要一个开放许可、体量紧凑的渲染器,同时覆盖图像与视频生成(含参考引导的视频),并倾向于用更小的 1.3B 规模在较轻量的环境上运行时。

notFor.en: When you need the highest fidelity or larger-scale video, the 14B renderer is the heavier alternative. Checkpoints are downloaded separately rather than bundled.
notFor.zh: 当你追求最高保真度或更大规模的视频时,14B 渲染器是更重的替代选择。Checkpoint 需单独下载,而非随附。

en: Bernini-R is the renderer of ByteDance's Bernini family, published on Hugging Face under Apache-2.0 in a Diffusers-compatible format. This 14B variant is the larger renderer in the family, trading heavier hardware for higher-fidelity output.

A single model covers a broad task set: text-to-image and image-to-image for stills, text-to-video and video-to-video for motion, and reference-to-video plus reference-video-to-video, where a reference image or clip steers the generated result. In WorldFoundry you run it through the shared pipeline — pick the checkpoint and task, supply a prompt (and an image, video, or reference where the task calls for it), and it renders the output.
zh: Bernini-R 是字节跳动 Bernini 系列的渲染(生成)模型,以 Diffusers 兼容格式、Apache-2.0 许可发布在 Hugging Face 上。这个 14B 变体是家族中更大的渲染器,以更重的硬件开销换取更高的输出保真度。
一个模型覆盖多种任务:文生图与图生图用于静态图像,文生视频与视频到视频用于动态画面,还有参考到视频与参考视频到视频——用一张参考图或一段参考片段来引导结果。图像任务可在单卡运行,视频任务则可借助 Ulysses 序列并行分布到多张 GPU 上。

whenToUse.en: When you want an openly-licensed renderer that spans image and video generation — including reference-guided video — and can afford the larger 14B for higher fidelity, optionally scaling video across multiple GPUs.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想要一个开放许可、覆盖图像与视频生成(含参考引导视频)的渲染器,并且能承受更大的 14B 以换取更高保真度、必要时把视频任务扩展到多张 GPU 时。

notFor.en: When hardware is tight, the 1.3B renderer is the lighter option. Checkpoints are downloaded separately rather than bundled, so plan for the download and disk space.

tagline.en: An autoregressive video-diffusion world model from THU-ML that generates video frame-by-frame, built on Wan2.1 for real-time-oriented rollout.
tagline.zh: 来自 THU-ML 的自回归视频扩散世界模型,基于 Wan2.1 逐块生成视频,面向实时化的推进(rollout)。

en: Causal-Forcing is an autoregressive video-diffusion method from THU-ML. Rather than denoising a whole clip at once, it generates video causally — extending the sequence chunk by chunk — which suits streaming and interactive, real-time-oriented generation.

It supports text-to-video and image-to-video, and works alongside Wan2.1 weights: the pretrained checkpoint pairs with a Wan2.1 backbone, and different configurations expose chunk-wise, frame-wise, and Causal-Forcing++ variants. The Hugging Face checkpoint lives under the zhuhz22 account.

In WorldFoundry the official inference path is run in-tree. You supply a prompt (and an image for image-to-video), select a checkpoint and config, and it produces the video; the local Wan2.1 weights and the chosen Causal-Forcing checkpoint need to be staged together.
zh: Causal-Forcing 是 THU-ML 提出的自回归视频扩散方法。它不一次性对整段视频去噪,而是因果地逐块延展序列来生成视频,因此适合流式、交互式、面向实时的生成。
它支持文生视频与图生视频,并与 Wan2.1 权重配合工作:预训练 checkpoint 搭配 Wan2.1 主干,不同配置提供 chunk-wise、frame-wise 以及 Causal-Forcing++ 等变体。Hugging Face 上的 checkpoint 位于 zhuhz22 账号下。
在 WorldFoundry 中,官方推理路径在仓库内直接运行。你给出提示词(图生视频再加一张图),选好 checkpoint 与配置,它就生成视频;需要把本地 Wan2.1 权重与所选的 Causal-Forcing checkpoint 一并准备好。

whenToUse.en: When you want streaming or interactive video generation that grows the sequence over time, rather than rendering a fixed-length clip in one pass — for example real-time-oriented rollout on top of a Wan2.1 backbone.
whenToUse.zh: 当你需要随时间不断延展序列的流式或交互式视频生成,而非一次性渲染固定长度片段时——例如在 Wan2.1 主干之上做面向实时的推进。

notFor.en: It depends on both a Causal-Forcing checkpoint and local Wan2.1 weights, so you need to prepare that pair before running. Frame-wise and Causal-Forcing++ setups require overriding the default config.
notFor.zh: 它同时依赖 Causal-Forcing checkpoint 与本地 Wan2.1 权重,运行前需备好这一对文件。frame-wise 与 Causal-Forcing++ 等设置需要覆盖默认配置。

en: Autoregressive, chunk-by-chunk video generation
Text-to-video and image-to-video
Real-time-oriented rollout on a Wan2.1 backbone
Chunk-wise, frame-wise, and Causal-Forcing++ variants

tagline.en: Microsoft's CogACT — a vision-language-action model that turns images and instructions into robot actions via a diffusion action head, released MIT.
tagline.zh: 微软 CogACT——一个视觉-语言-动作(VLA)模型,通过扩散式动作头把图像与指令转化为机器人动作,MIT 许可。

en: CogACT is a vision-language-action (VLA) model from Microsoft for robot control. It reads camera images and a language instruction and predicts robot actions, combining a Prismatic-style vision-language model (built on Llama-2 7B) with a diffusion transformer that generates the action sequence.

It comes in Small, Base, and Large sizes; the Base checkpoint is released under MIT. All the vision-language and action-head weights ship inside the CogACT checkpoints themselves — a gated Llama-2 mirror is only needed if no compatible local tokenizer is available.

In WorldFoundry, CogACT runs as an inference-only action model: give it an observation and an instruction, and it predicts the next actions for policy rollout. Training, data loaders, and deployment servers from the upstream project are out of scope here.
zh: CogACT 是微软推出的视觉-语言-动作(VLA)模型,用于机器人控制。它读取相机图像和一条语言指令,预测机器人动作——把 Prismatic 风格的视觉-语言模型(基于 Llama-2 7B)与生成动作序列的扩散 transformer 结合起来。
它提供 Small、Base、Large 三种规模,其中 Base checkpoint 以 MIT 许可发布。视觉-语言与动作头的权重都包含在 CogACT checkpoint 自身内;只有在本地没有兼容 tokenizer 时,才需要用到受限访问的 Llama-2 镜像。
在 WorldFoundry 中,CogACT 作为仅推理的动作模型运行:给它一帧观测和一条指令,它便预测接下来的动作用于策略推进(rollout)。上游项目中的训练、数据加载器与部署服务不在此范围内。

whenToUse.en: When you need a vision-language-action policy that maps camera observations and natural-language instructions to robot actions, and want an openly-available model with multiple size options.
whenToUse.zh: 当你需要一个把相机观测与自然语言指令映射为机器人动作的视觉-语言-动作策略,并希望使用开放、有多种规模可选的模型时。

notFor.en: This is a robot action policy, not a video or image generator. It focuses on action prediction and rollout; upstream training and real-world deployment servers are not part of the inference setup.
notFor.zh: 它是机器人动作策略,而非视频或图像生成器。它专注于动作预测与推进;上游的训练与真实部署服务不属于这里的推理配置。

tagline.en: NVIDIA Cosmos Predict 2 — a world-model foundation for image-to-video and Video2World generation, in 2B and 14B sizes.
tagline.zh: NVIDIA Cosmos Predict 2——用于图生视频与 Video2World 生成的世界模型基座,提供 2B 与 14B 两种规模。

en: Cosmos Predict 2 is part of NVIDIA's Cosmos family of world foundation models. It predicts future video from an image or an existing clip — a Video2World setup — aimed at physical-AI and simulation use cases where you want a model that anticipates how a scene evolves.

It comes in two sizes, a 2B and a 14B Video2World checkpoint, both released under the NVIDIA Open Model License (checkpoint access is gated). Internally it pairs a T5 text conditioner with a diffusion denoiser and a rectified-flow scheduler, decoding through a Wan video codec.
In WorldFoundry it runs through the shared native diffusion pipeline — provide an image or video plus a prompt, pick the 2B or 14B checkpoint, and it generates the predicted world video.
zh: Cosmos Predict 2 属于 NVIDIA 的 Cosmos 世界基础模型家族。它从一张图像或一段已有视频预测未来画面——即 Video2World 设定——面向物理 AI 与仿真场景,适合需要模型预判场景如何演变的用途。
它提供 2B 与 14B 两个 Video2World checkpoint,均以 NVIDIA Open Model License 发布(checkpoint 需授权访问)。其内部由 T5 文本条件器、扩散去噪器与 rectified-flow 调度器组合而成,并通过 Wan 视频编解码器解码。
在 WorldFoundry 中,它通过统一的原生扩散 pipeline 运行:给出一张图像或一段视频加上提示词,选择 2B 或 14B checkpoint,它便生成预测的世界视频。

whenToUse.en: When you want a world model that predicts video forward from an image or clip (Video2World) for physical-AI and simulation work, and want to choose between a lighter 2B and a higher-fidelity 14B.
whenToUse.zh: 当你需要一个从图像或片段向前预测视频的世界模型(Video2World),用于物理 AI 与仿真,并希望在更轻的 2B 与更高保真的 14B 之间选择时。

notFor.en: Checkpoints are gated under the NVIDIA Open Model License, so you need to request and stage access. The 14B needs substantially more hardware than the 2B.
notFor.zh: Checkpoint 在 NVIDIA Open Model License 下需授权访问,使用前需申请并准备好权限。14B 所需硬件明显高于 2B。

tagline.en: NVIDIA Cosmos Predict 2.5 — a world-model foundation for text-, image-, and video-to-world generation, in 2B and 14B sizes.
tagline.zh: NVIDIA Cosmos Predict 2.5——支持文本/图像/视频到世界生成的世界模型基座,提供 2B 与 14B 两种规模。

en: Cosmos Predict 2.5 is the next step in NVIDIA's Cosmos family of world foundation models. It generates world video from text, an image, or an existing clip, targeting physical-AI and simulation workloads where you want a model that reasons about how scenes unfold.

It ships in 2B and 14B sizes under the NVIDIA Open Model License. Compared with Predict 2, it adds a Reason1 language conditioner and a flow-UniPC scheduler, decoding through a shared Wan VAE; text prompting, guidance, and image/video latent conditioning all run through the same diffusion pipeline.
In WorldFoundry it runs through the shared native diffusion pipeline — give it a prompt and, optionally, an image or video, pick the 2B or 14B checkpoint, and it generates the world video.
zh: Cosmos Predict 2.5 是 NVIDIA Cosmos 世界基础模型家族的进一步演进。它可从文本、一张图像或一段已有视频生成世界视频,面向物理 AI 与仿真负载,适合需要模型推理场景如何展开的用途。
它以 NVIDIA Open Model License 提供 2B 与 14B 两种规模。相较 Predict 2,它引入 Reason1 语言条件器与 flow-UniPC 调度器,并通过共享的 Wan VAE 解码;文本提示、引导以及图像/视频的隐空间条件都在同一扩散 pipeline 中处理。
在 WorldFoundry 中,它通过统一的原生扩散 pipeline 运行:给出提示词,并可选地附上一张图像或一段视频,选择 2B 或 14B checkpoint,它便生成世界视频。

whenToUse.en: When you want a Cosmos world model that accepts text, image, or video as input for physical-AI and simulation work, and want a choice between a lighter 2B and a higher-fidelity 14B.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想要一个可接受文本、图像或视频输入的 Cosmos 世界模型,用于物理 AI 与仿真,并希望在更轻的 2B 与更高保真的 14B 之间选择时。

notFor.en: Checkpoints are released under the NVIDIA Open Model License and downloaded separately, so plan for access and disk space. The 14B needs substantially more hardware than the 2B.
notFor.zh: Checkpoint 以 NVIDIA Open Model License 发布并需单独下载,请预留访问权限与磁盘空间。14B 所需硬件明显高于 2B。

tagline.en: NVIDIA Cosmos Transfer 2.5 — a control-conditioned world model that steers video generation with spatial signals like edges, via a VACE branch.
tagline.zh: NVIDIA Cosmos Transfer 2.5——控制条件的世界模型,通过 VACE 控制分支用边缘等空间信号引导视频生成。

en: Cosmos Transfer 2.5 is the control-conditioned member of NVIDIA's Cosmos 2.5 world models. Instead of generating video from a prompt alone, it takes spatial control signals — such as edge maps and other conditioning modalities — and transfers them into a coherent generated video, useful for controllable simulation and world generation.

It shares the same native backbone as Predict 2.5 — the Reason1 conditioner, flow-UniPC scheduler, Wan VAE codec, and checkpoint loader — and adds a VACE control branch: a small set of control blocks attached to the base transformer plus a multi-modality control embedder. The 2B checkpoint is released under the NVIDIA Open Model License.
In WorldFoundry it runs through the shared native pipeline via the VACE recipe — supply your control input alongside a prompt and it produces the controlled video.
zh: Cosmos Transfer 2.5 是 NVIDIA Cosmos 2.5 世界模型中支持控制条件的成员。它不只依赖提示词生成视频,而是接收空间控制信号(如边缘图等条件模态),并把它们迁移成连贯的生成视频,适合可控仿真与世界生成。
它与 Predict 2.5 共享同一原生主干——Reason1 条件器、flow-UniPC 调度器、Wan VAE 编解码器与 checkpoint 加载器——并增加了 VACE 控制分支:在基础 transformer 上附加一小组控制块,以及一个多模态控制嵌入器。2B checkpoint 以 NVIDIA Open Model License 发布。
在 WorldFoundry 中,它通过统一原生 pipeline 以 VACE 方案运行:把控制输入与提示词一起给它,它便生成受控视频。

whenToUse.en: When you need controllable video generation guided by spatial signals such as edges — steering the output structure rather than relying on a text prompt alone — within the Cosmos world-model framework.
whenToUse.zh: 当你需要由边缘等空间信号引导的可控视频生成——通过控制输出结构而非仅靠文本提示——并希望在 Cosmos 世界模型框架内完成时。

notFor.en: The control checkpoint is released under the NVIDIA Open Model License and downloaded separately, so plan for access. If you don't need spatial conditioning, Predict 2.5 covers plain text/image/video-to-world.
notFor.zh: 控制 checkpoint 以 NVIDIA Open Model License 发布并需单独下载,请预留访问权限。若不需要空间条件,Predict 2.5 即可覆盖普通的文本/图像/视频到世界生成。

This generator binding exposes T2I, T2V, I2V, and V2V inference, optional synchronized sound, and structured policy, forward-dynamics, and inverse-dynamics action inference.
Cosmos3 Reasoner, training, and vLLM/vLLM-Omni serving workflows are intentionally outside this infer-only integration.
Native transformer loading is structurally exact (814/814 keys for Nano), the shared Wan VAE38 mapping is exact (196/196), and the AVAE decoder is exact (182/182).
The native 35-step Karras flow-UniPC schedule and numerical updates match the official scheduler exactly. End-to-end GPU output parity for this new native path remains pending.
Use prepare_model_infer.sh to emit a revision report and an explicit pinned snapshot model-ref; an existing unverified or older Cosmos3-Nano directory is not evidence for this profile revision.
Safety screening is an orchestration extension rather than part of the native diffusion model runtime; the generator itself has no guardrail framework dependency.
Uses WorldFoundry's native diffusion loader, joint-modality runner, core attention, Wan VAE38, and flow-UniPC implementation. Diffusers is not installed or imported.
Synchronized sound uses the inference-only native AVAE decoder loaded directly from the official sound-tokenizer safetensors component.
Cosmos3 Reasoner, training, and vLLM/vLLM-Omni serving dependencies are intentionally omitted.

Includes the minimal FastAPI/Pydantic/YAML surface imported by workspace_job so the dedicated model environment can execute the real Workspace inference entrypoint, not only the base runtime. Msgpack and WebSockets complete the declared WorldFoundry job/transport dependency surface.
Pins ffmpeg to conda-forge to keep its OpenH264 ABI consistent; core audio muxing also falls back to the imageio-ffmpeg bundled executable if a host ffmpeg binary cannot start.

tagline.en: NVIDIA Cosmos3 — a joint-modality world model spanning image, video, synchronized sound, and robot action, in Nano and Super sizes.
tagline.zh: NVIDIA Cosmos3——覆盖图像、视频、同步音频与机器人动作的联合模态世界模型,提供 Nano 与 Super 两种规模。

en: Cosmos3 is the broadest world model in NVIDIA's Cosmos family, a joint-modality generator that unifies visual, audio, and action generation. It handles text-to-image, text-to-video, image-to-video, and video-to-video, can produce synchronized sound, and exposes structured action inference — policy, forward dynamics, and inverse dynamics — for physical-AI and embodied use cases.

It comes in Nano and Super sizes, both released under the OpenMDW-1.1 license and non-gated. Internally it combines a joint-modality runner and shared loader with a Karras flow-UniPC scheduler, a shared Wan VAE for visual decoding, and an inference-only AVAE decoder for sound.

In WorldFoundry, base Cosmos3 routes to the Nano checkpoint, and you select the Super variant for the larger model. It runs as an inference-only recipe; the upstream reasoner, guardrail, and serving stacks are orchestration extensions kept outside this generator.
zh: Cosmos3 是 NVIDIA Cosmos 家族中覆盖面最广的世界模型,一个统一视觉、音频与动作生成的联合模态生成器。它支持文生图、文生视频、图生视频与视频到视频,可生成同步音频,并提供结构化的动作推理——策略、前向动力学与逆向动力学——面向物理 AI 与具身场景。
它提供 Nano 与 Super 两种规模,均以 OpenMDW-1.1 许可发布且无使用门槛。其内部由联合模态 runner 与共享加载器,配合 Karras flow-UniPC 调度器、用于视觉解码的共享 Wan VAE,以及仅推理的 AVAE 音频解码器组成。
在 WorldFoundry 中,基础 Cosmos3 选择会路由到 Nano checkpoint,选择 Super 变体则使用更大的模型。它作为仅推理的方案运行;上游的 reasoner、护栏与服务栈属于编排扩展,不包含在该生成器内。

whenToUse.en: When you want a single world model that spans image, video, optional synchronized sound, and robot action inference (policy, forward and inverse dynamics), with an openly-licensed, non-gated checkpoint.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想要一个横跨图像、视频、可选同步音频与机器人动作推理(策略、前向与逆向动力学)的统一世界模型,并使用开放许可、无门槛的 checkpoint 时。

notFor.en: This is the inference-only generator; safety screening, the reasoner, and serving workflows are separate orchestration layers. Pick Nano for lighter runs and Super when you need the larger model.
notFor.zh: 这是仅推理的生成器;安全审查、reasoner 与服务流程属于独立的编排层。轻量运行选 Nano,需要更大模型时选 Super。

en: Joint-modality world model: image, video, sound, and action
Structured policy, forward-dynamics, and inverse-dynamics inference
Nano and Super sizes, non-gated, OpenMDW-1.1 license
Optional synchronized sound via an AVAE decoder
zh: 联合模态世界模型:图像、视频、音频与动作
结构化的策略、前向动力学与逆向动力学推理
Nano 与 Super 两种规模,无门槛,OpenMDW-1.1 许可
可选的同步音频(经 AVAE 解码器)

tagline.en: DIAMOND — a diffusion world model that learns to simulate environments like Atari games and CS:GO, playable directly from its predictions.
tagline.zh: DIAMOND——用扩散模型学习模拟环境的世界模型,可模拟 Atari 游戏与 CS:GO 等场景,并可直接在其预测中游玩。

en: DIAMOND is a diffusion-based world model for reinforcement-learning and game environments. Instead of rendering with a game engine, it learns a diffusion model of an environment's dynamics and generates the next frames from the agent's actions — you can literally play inside the learned model.

It's a lightweight game/RL world-model candidate. The published checkpoints cover environments such as Atari and CS:GO, and a run can use either a local checkpoint or a pretrained game selected non-interactively.

In WorldFoundry the official play/inference stack is run in-tree through the same play entrypoint the upstream repo uses. You point it at staged assets and a checkpoint, and it drives the interactive world model.
zh: DIAMOND 是面向强化学习与游戏环境的扩散式世界模型。它不依赖游戏引擎渲染,而是学习环境动态的扩散模型,并根据智能体的动作生成后续帧——你可以真正在学到的模型里游玩。
它是一个轻量的游戏/强化学习世界模型选项。已发布的 checkpoint 覆盖 Atari 与 CS:GO 等环境,运行时可使用本地 checkpoint,或非交互式地指定一个预训练游戏。
在 WorldFoundry 中,官方的游玩/推理栈在仓库内运行,复用了上游仓库使用的同一 play 入口。你把它指向已准备好的资源与 checkpoint,它便驱动这个交互式世界模型。

whenToUse.en: When you want a diffusion world model that simulates game or RL environments and lets you interact with the learned dynamics — for example playing Atari or CS:GO inside the model.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想要一个模拟游戏或强化学习环境的扩散世界模型,并能与学到的动态交互时——例如在模型内游玩 Atari 或 CS:GO。

notFor.en: Running the full experience needs staged game assets and checkpoints; runtime network downloads are disabled, so prepare those locally first.
notFor.zh: 完整体验需要预先准备好游戏资源与 checkpoint;运行期的网络下载被禁用,请先在本地备好这些文件。

Playable inside the learned dynamics
Checkpoints for environments like Atari and CS:GO
Runs from a local checkpoint or a selected pretrained game
zh: 面向强化学习与游戏环境的扩散世界模型

tagline.en: Diffusion Policy — Stanford's visuomotor robot policy that generates action sequences with a diffusion model, here as a low-dimensional Push-T runtime.
tagline.zh: Diffusion Policy——斯坦福提出的视觉运动机器人策略,用扩散模型生成动作序列,这里以低维 Push-T 运行时提供。

en: Diffusion Policy is a widely-used approach to robot control from Stanford that frames action generation as conditional denoising: given the current state, it uses a diffusion model to generate a short sequence of actions rather than predicting one step at a time. This makes it well-suited to multimodal, precise visuomotor tasks.

The variant here is the low-dimensional Push-T policy, reconstructed in-tree from the released model. It exposes a predict_action interface that emits the Push-T action schema and produces action traces for policy rollout.

In WorldFoundry it runs inference-only. For safety, the original executable workspace checkpoint is not loaded directly; a converted, tensor-only checkpoint is used instead, so conversion happens once in a trusted offline step before running.
zh: Diffusion Policy 是斯坦福提出、被广泛使用的机器人控制方法,它把动作生成建模为条件去噪:给定当前状态,用扩散模型生成一小段动作序列,而非逐步预测。这使它很适合多模态、需要精确控制的视觉运动任务。
这里的变体是低维 Push-T 策略,在仓库内从发布的模型重建而来。它提供 predict_action 接口,输出 Push-T 动作规格,并生成用于策略推进(rollout)的动作轨迹。
在 WorldFoundry 中它仅做推理。出于安全考虑,不直接加载原始的可执行 workspace checkpoint,而改用转换后、仅含张量的 checkpoint;因此需要先在可信的离线环境中完成一次转换,再运行。

whenToUse.en: When you want a diffusion-based visuomotor policy for robot control and action rollout — here specifically the low-dimensional Push-T task — and prefer a well-established action-generation method.
whenToUse.zh: 当你需要一个基于扩散的视觉运动策略用于机器人控制与动作推进时——这里具体为低维 Push-T 任务——并倾向于使用成熟的动作生成方法。

notFor.en: This is a robot action policy, not a video or image generator. The original dill workspace checkpoint is rejected at load; convert it to a tensor-only checkpoint offline first.
notFor.zh: 它是机器人动作策略,而非视频或图像生成器。原始的 dill workspace checkpoint 在加载时会被拒绝;请先在离线环境把它转换为仅含张量的 checkpoint。

en: Diffusion-based visuomotor policy for robot control
Generates action sequences via conditional denoising
Low-dimensional Push-T runtime with a predict_action interface
Loads a safe, tensor-only converted checkpoint
zh: 面向机器人控制的扩散式视觉运动策略
通过条件去噪生成动作序列
低维 Push-T 运行时,提供 predict_action 接口
加载安全的、仅含张量的转换 checkpoint

tagline.en: DINO-WM — a world model that predicts in DINO visual-feature space, enabling planning without reconstructing raw pixels.
tagline.zh: DINO-WM——在 DINO 视觉特征空间中预测的世界模型,无需重建原始像素即可进行规划。

en: DINO-WM is a world model that operates in the latent feature space of pretrained DINO visual features rather than in pixel space. By predicting how those features evolve, it captures scene dynamics compactly and can be used for planning toward goals — a predictive-coding style approach to robot and environment world modeling.
Because it plans in feature space, it doesn't need to reconstruct raw images to reason about the future, which is what makes it suited to task-directed planning and evaluation.

In WorldFoundry the official planning/evaluation route is run in-tree, including the vendored environment simulators needed for planning runs. You stage the checkpoint and task assets, and it drives the planning entrypoint.
zh: DINO-WM 是一个在预训练 DINO 视觉特征的隐空间(而非像素空间)中运作的世界模型。它通过预测这些特征如何演变,以紧凑的方式捕捉场景动态,并可用于面向目标的规划——这是一种预测编码风格的机器人与环境世界建模方法。
由于它在特征空间中规划,推理未来时无需重建原始图像,这正是它适合面向任务的规划与评估的原因。
在 WorldFoundry 中,官方的规划/评估路径在仓库内运行,并包含规划所需、随仓库附带的环境模拟器。你准备好 checkpoint 与任务资源,它便驱动规划入口。

whenToUse.en: When you want a world model that plans in visual-feature space for goal-directed tasks — reasoning about future states without pixel reconstruction — for robot and environment planning.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想要一个在视觉特征空间中为目标导向任务做规划的世界模型——无需像素重建即可推理未来状态——用于机器人与环境规划时。

notFor.zh: 运行规划需要在本地准备好 checkpoint 与任务资源布局,以及随附的环境模拟器;请在运行前备好。

Ships with the environment simulators needed for planning
zh: 在 DINO 视觉特征空间中的世界模型
面向目标规划,无需重建像素

tagline.en: DreamX-World 5B AR — an interactive world model that grows video autoregressively from a starting image, built on a Wan2.2 5B backbone.
tagline.zh: DreamX-World 5B AR——从起始图像自回归延展视频的交互式世界模型,基于 Wan2.2 5B 主干构建。

en: DreamX-World 5B AR is an interactive world model from the AMAP DreamX-World project. Starting from an image, it autoregressively generates video block by block, continuing from the previous frames so the scene evolves over time under a resident, cached runtime.

It uses the released causal 5B checkpoint together with a Wan2.2 TI2V-5B support checkpoint, and runs a distilled four-step AR-forcing schedule for its causal latent blocks. Its attention, cross-attention, latent, and VAE caches stay resident across steps, and decoded frames are output-only — never fed back in as conditioning.
In WorldFoundry it runs through the unified pipeline directly on the two local checkpoints — give it a starting image and controls, and it produces the world video.
zh: DreamX-World 5B AR 是来自 AMAP DreamX-World 项目的交互式世界模型。它从一张图像出发,逐块自回归地生成视频,并从上一批帧继续延展,使场景在常驻、带缓存的运行时中随时间演变。
它使用发布的因果 5B checkpoint,配合 Wan2.2 TI2V-5B 支撑 checkpoint,并对因果隐空间块采用蒸馏的四步 AR-forcing 调度。它的注意力、交叉注意力、隐空间与 VAE 缓存在各步之间保持常驻;解码出的帧仅作为输出,绝不作为条件回灌。
在 WorldFoundry 中,它通过统一 pipeline 直接在两个本地 checkpoint 上运行:给它一张起始图像和控制信号,它便生成世界视频。

whenToUse.en: When you want an interactive, image-to-video world model that extends a scene autoregressively over time from a starting frame, with a resident cached session for continuous rollout.
whenToUse.zh: 当你需要一个交互式的图生视频世界模型,从起始帧出发随时间自回归延展场景,并借助常驻缓存会话实现连续推进时。

notFor.en: It requires both the DreamX-World 5B checkpoint and a Wan2.2 TI2V-5B support checkpoint staged locally; prepare both before running.
notFor.zh: 它需要在本地同时准备好 DreamX-World 5B checkpoint 与 Wan2.2 TI2V-5B 支撑 checkpoint;运行前请备齐两者。

en: Interactive, autoregressive image-to-video world model
Extends the scene block by block from previous frames
Distilled four-step AR-forcing schedule
Built on a causal 5B checkpoint plus a Wan2.2 TI2V-5B backbone
zh: 交互式、自回归的图生视频世界模型
从上一批帧起逐块延展场景
蒸馏的四步 AR-forcing 调度
基于因果 5B checkpoint 与 Wan2.2 TI2V-5B 主干

tagline.en: DreamX-World 5B Cam — a camera-controllable interactive world model that steers image-to-video generation with camera pose, on a Wan2.2 5B backbone.
tagline.zh: DreamX-World 5B Cam——可用相机位姿控制的交互式世界模型,在 Wan2.2 5B 主干上引导图生视频生成。

en: DreamX-World 5B Cam is the camera-controllable variant of the AMAP DreamX-World world model. Starting from an image, it generates video you can steer with camera pose controls, so you can move the viewpoint through the evolving scene interactively.

It runs the 5B Cam checkpoint together with a Wan2.2 TI2V-5B support checkpoint, integrating the camera-conditioned runtime, pose controls, VAE, and text-encoder adapters in one pipeline. A resident session caches weights and prompt embeddings and continues from the previous final frame, and multi-GPU inference is supported with configurable Ulysses sequence parallelism (1/2/3/4/6/8 ranks).
In WorldFoundry it runs through the unified pipeline directly on the local checkpoints — provide a starting image, a prompt, and camera controls, and it produces the world video.
zh: DreamX-World 5B Cam 是 AMAP DreamX-World 世界模型中支持相机控制的变体。它从一张图像出发生成视频,并可用相机位姿控制引导,使你能交互式地在演变的场景中移动视角。
它运行 5B Cam checkpoint,配合 Wan2.2 TI2V-5B 支撑 checkpoint,把相机条件的运行时、位姿控制、VAE 与文本编码器适配器整合进同一 pipeline。常驻会话会缓存权重与提示词嵌入,并从上一批的最后一帧继续;多卡推理支持可配置的 Ulysses 序列并行(1/2/3/4/6/8 rank)。
在 WorldFoundry 中,它通过统一 pipeline 直接在本地 checkpoint 上运行:给出起始图像、提示词与相机控制,它便生成世界视频。

whenToUse.en: When you want an interactive image-to-video world model whose viewpoint you can drive with camera pose controls, and you may want to scale inference across multiple GPUs.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想要一个可用相机位姿控制来驱动视角的交互式图生视频世界模型,并可能希望把推理扩展到多张 GPU 时。

notFor.en: It requires both the DreamX-World 5B Cam checkpoint and a Wan2.2 TI2V-5B support checkpoint staged locally. If you don't need camera control, the AR variant covers plain autoregressive rollout.
notFor.zh: 它需要在本地同时准备好 DreamX-World 5B Cam checkpoint 与 Wan2.2 TI2V-5B 支撑 checkpoint。若不需要相机控制,AR 变体可覆盖普通的自回归推进。

tagline.en: DynamiCrafter — animates a still image into a short video, using video diffusion priors, with 512 and 1024 resolution variants.
tagline.zh: DynamiCrafter——借助视频扩散先验把静态图片动画化为短视频,提供 512 与 1024 两种分辨率变体。

en: DynamiCrafter is an image-to-video model that brings a single still image to life, animating it into a short clip. It leverages pretrained video diffusion priors so the generated motion stays coherent with the input image's content.

The public, non-gated Hugging Face releases come in two main resolution variants — a 512 and a 1024 image-to-video runtime — under the Doubiiu account. Note that the model cards don't expose an explicit license, so review the upstream license terms before redistributing.
In WorldFoundry the image-to-video runtimes are wrapped in-tree. You supply a starting image (and prompt), pick the 512 or 1024 route, and it renders the animated video.
zh: DynamiCrafter 是一个图生视频模型,能让一张静态图片动起来,把它动画化为一段短视频。它借助预训练的视频扩散先验,使生成的运动与输入图像内容保持连贯。
其公开、无门槛的 Hugging Face 发布提供两个主要分辨率变体——512 与 1024 的图生视频运行时——位于 Doubiiu 账号下。需要注意:模型卡未标明明确的 license,因此在再分发前请先查阅上游的许可条款。
在 WorldFoundry 中,图生视频运行时以仓库内封装的方式提供。你给出一张起始图片(以及提示词),选择 512 或 1024 路径,它便渲染出动画化的视频。

whenToUse.en: When you want to animate a single still image into a short video and choose between a lighter 512 route and a higher-resolution 1024 route.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想把一张静态图片动画化为短视频,并在更轻量的 512 路径与更高分辨率的 1024 路径之间选择时。

notFor.en: The Hugging Face model cards don't state an explicit license, so review upstream terms before redistribution. Checkpoints are downloaded separately rather than bundled.
notFor.zh: Hugging Face 模型卡未标明明确的 license,再分发前请先查阅上游条款。Checkpoint 需单独下载而非随附。

tagline.en: NVIDIA's Déjà View Looping Transformer — feed-forward 3D reconstruction, camera pose, and depth from multiple views.
tagline.zh: NVIDIA 的 Déjà View Looping Transformer——从多视图前馈式重建 3D 结构、相机位姿与深度。

en: DVLT (Déjà View Looping Transformer) is a 3D & 4D reconstruction model from NVIDIA's research labs. Given a set of images, it recovers 3D structure, estimates camera poses, and predicts depth — the building blocks for turning a handful of views into a coherent scene.

It follows the feed-forward transformer approach to reconstruction: rather than optimizing a scene per capture, the network infers geometry directly from the input views. Output can be exported as a GLB mesh for downstream 3D use.

In WorldFoundry, DVLT runs through a wrapper that drives the GLB export path. The model weights are distributed separately by NVIDIA under a non-commercial research and evaluation license, so you supply them locally.
zh: DVLT（Déjà View Looping Transformer）是 NVIDIA 研究团队推出的 3D 与 4D 重建模型。给定一组图像，它能恢复 3D 结构、估计相机位姿并预测深度——这些正是把少量视图拼成完整场景的基础构件。
它采用前馈 transformer 的重建思路：无需对每次采集单独优化场景，而是由网络直接从输入视图推断几何。结果可导出为 GLB 网格，便于后续 3D 使用。
在 WorldFoundry 中，DVLT 通过一个包装器运行，驱动 GLB 导出流程。模型权重由 NVIDIA 单独分发，采用非商业研究与评估许可，需你在本地自备。

whenToUse.en: Reach for DVLT when you want feed-forward 3D reconstruction from multiple images — geometry, camera pose, and depth in one pass — and can work within a research/evaluation license.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想从多张图像做前馈式 3D 重建——一次得到几何、相机位姿与深度——且能接受研究/评估许可时，DVLT 是合适之选。

notFor.en: Commercial deployment: the checkpoint is released under an NVIDIA non-commercial research and evaluation license. Weights are downloaded separately, so plan for local staging.
notFor.zh: 不适合商业部署：checkpoint 采用 NVIDIA 非商业研究与评估许可。权重需单独下载，请预留本地准备时间。

en: 3D reconstruction, camera pose estimation, and depth from multi-view inputs
Feed-forward transformer reconstruction — no per-scene optimization
Exports GLB meshes for downstream 3D pipelines
NVIDIA non-commercial research/evaluation license
zh: 从多视图输入完成 3D 重建、相机位姿估计与深度预测
前馈 transformer 重建，无需逐场景优化
可导出 GLB 网格，衔接后续 3D 流程

tagline.en: Alibaba PAI's EasyAnimate — a DiT-based video family for text-to-video, image-to-video, and video-to-video.
tagline.zh: 阿里云 PAI 的 EasyAnimate——基于 DiT 的视频家族，支持文生视频、图生视频与视频到视频。

en: EasyAnimate is a video generation family from Alibaba PAI. It covers text-to-video, image-to-video, and video-to-video, so you can start from a prompt, animate a still image, or transform an existing clip.

The family spans several releases and sizes, including 12B and 7B checkpoints in the V5 and V5.1 generations. The V5.1 7B and 12B weights are Apache-2.0, while some earlier checkpoints carry other terms. Image-to-video uses the InP checkpoint variants, and the plain V5.1 checkpoint handles text-to-video.
In WorldFoundry, EasyAnimate's image-to-video route runs through the shared pipeline with the official V5.1 InP checkpoint and Flow scheduler — give it a source image and a prompt to produce a clip.
zh: EasyAnimate 是阿里云 PAI 推出的视频生成家族。它覆盖文生视频、图生视频与视频到视频，可以从提示词起步、让静态图片动起来，或改造一段已有片段。
该家族跨越多个版本与规模，包括 V5 与 V5.1 代的 12B 与 7B checkpoint。其中 V5.1 的 7B 与 12B 权重为 Apache-2.0，部分较早的 checkpoint 采用其他许可条款。图生视频使用 InP checkpoint 变体，而普通 V5.1 checkpoint 负责文生视频。
在 WorldFoundry 中，EasyAnimate 的图生视频路径通过统一 pipeline 运行，采用官方 V5.1 InP checkpoint 与 Flow 调度器——给它一张源图和提示词即可生成片段。

whenToUse.en: A flexible choice when you need multiple video modes — text-to-video, image-to-video, and video-to-video — in one family, with openly-licensed V5.1 checkpoints available.
whenToUse.zh: 当你需要在同一家族里使用多种视频模式——文生视频、图生视频与视频到视频——且希望有开放许可的 V5.1 checkpoint 时，它很灵活。

notFor.en: Note that licensing varies by checkpoint: V5.1 7B/12B are Apache-2.0, but some earlier releases use other terms — check the specific checkpoint before redistribution. Weights are downloaded separately.
notFor.zh: 注意各 checkpoint 许可不同：V5.1 7B/12B 为 Apache-2.0，但部分较早版本采用其他条款——再分发前请核对具体 checkpoint。权重需单独下载。

tagline.zh: Echo-Infinity——面向长时、连续文生视频生成的自回归视频扩散模型。

en: Echo-Infinity is a world model that generates video from text. It is built around autoregressive video diffusion — generating the sequence forward in time — which is what lets it target long-form output rather than a single short clip.

The Echo-Infinity team ships it as inference code together with model weights. In WorldFoundry it runs as an infer-only path: the runtime is vendored in-tree, and it draws on both Echo-Infinity and Wan2.1 weights staged locally.

Because it targets extended generation, you point it at a text prompt and it rolls the video out over time. Training scripts, prompt datasets, and download helpers are intentionally left out — this is a run-the-model setup, with weights supplied from your local checkpoint directory.
zh: Echo-Infinity 是一个从文本生成视频的世界模型。它以自回归视频扩散为核心——沿时间轴向前逐步生成——这也是它能面向长视频而非单个短片的原因。
Echo-Infinity 团队以推理代码加模型权重的形式发布。在 WorldFoundry 中它以仅推理路径运行：运行时代码内置在仓库内，并依赖本地准备好的 Echo-Infinity 与 Wan2.1 权重。
由于面向长时生成，你给它一段文字提示词，它便沿时间把视频逐步展开。训练脚本、提示词数据集与下载辅助工具被有意省略——这是一套直接运行模型的配置，权重从你本地的 checkpoint 目录提供。

whenToUse.en: Choose Echo-Infinity when you want long, continuous text-to-video and prefer an autoregressive approach that extends the sequence over time rather than producing a fixed short clip.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想要长时、连续的文生视频，且倾向于沿时间延展序列的自回归方式（而非固定短片）时，可选 Echo-Infinity。

notFor.en: It ships as an inference-only runtime — no training scripts or download helpers — so you stage the Echo-Infinity and Wan2.1 weights yourself before running.
notFor.zh: 它以仅推理运行时发布——不含训练脚本或下载辅助工具——因此运行前需自行准备好 Echo-Infinity 与 Wan2.1 权重。

en: Autoregressive video diffusion aimed at long-video generation
Text-to-video world model
Inference-only runtime vendored in WorldFoundry
Draws on Echo-Infinity plus Wan2.1 weights, supplied locally
zh: 面向长视频生成的自回归视频扩散
文生视频世界模型
仅推理运行时，内置于 WorldFoundry
依赖本地提供的 Echo-Infinity 与 Wan2.1 权重

tagline.en: Echo-Memory (Context K=1) — an interactive, action-conditioned world model that keeps a frozen frame of context as memory.
tagline.zh: Echo-Memory（Context K=1）——一个交互式、动作条件的世界模型，以冻结的上下文帧作为记忆。

en: Echo-Memory Context K=1 is an interactive world model in WorldFoundry. From a starting image, plus text and a camera trajectory, it generates video that responds to actions — the kind of controllable rollout used to study memory in world models.

This identity is a fixed recipe: it pairs the Echo-Memory K=1 checkpoint (CC-BY-4.0) with shared Wan2.1 components (Apache-2.0), assembled through WorldFoundry's native diffusion pipeline with a frozen-context memory strategy. It takes image, text, camera-trajectory, and video inputs; you don't pick a memory method at runtime — the K=1 context behavior is baked in.

In practice you provide the conditioning frame and an action or camera path, and the model rolls the scene forward, re-anchoring on its context after each step so the generated world stays consistent.
zh: Echo-Memory Context K=1 是 WorldFoundry 中的交互式世界模型。从一张起始图像，加上文本和相机轨迹，它生成能响应动作的视频——正是用于研究世界模型记忆的那类可控 rollout。
这个模型身份是一套固定配方：它将 Echo-Memory K=1 checkpoint（CC-BY-4.0）与共享的 Wan2.1 组件（Apache-2.0）搭配，通过 WorldFoundry 的原生扩散 pipeline 以冻结上下文记忆策略组装。它接受图像、文本、相机轨迹与视频输入；运行时无需选择记忆方法——K=1 上下文行为已内置。
实际使用时，你提供条件帧和一个动作或相机路径，模型便把场景沿时间推进，每一步后重新锚定到其上下文，让生成的世界保持一致。

whenToUse.en: Use it for interactive, action-conditioned world rollouts from a single image — driving a scene with camera moves or actions — and for research into how world models retain context over time.
whenToUse.zh: 适合从单张图像做交互式、动作条件的世界 rollout——用相机运动或动作驱动场景——以及研究世界模型如何随时间保持上下文。

notFor.en: It's a fixed research recipe, not a general text-to-video generator, and the memory behavior isn't user-configurable. It needs both the Echo-Memory and Wan2.1 weights staged locally.
notFor.zh: 它是一套固定的研究配方，而非通用文生视频生成器，记忆行为也不可由用户配置。运行需在本地准备好 Echo-Memory 与 Wan2.1 权重。

en: Emu3.5 is a multimodal model from BAAI (Beijing Academy of Artificial Intelligence). It handles unified multimodal generation and image generation, and exposes a reasoning path — part of the Emu line of models that treat vision and language within a single generative framework.

In WorldFoundry, Emu3.5 is wired as a complete route that pulls the BAAI/Emu3.5 checkpoint. You supply the model assets locally; the pipeline reports what's missing at runtime if anything isn't staged.
Point it at a multimodal prompt to drive generation. The checkpoint is distributed by BAAI on Hugging Face.
zh: Emu3.5 是 BAAI（北京智源人工智能研究院）推出的多模态模型。它支持统一的多模态生成与图像生成，并提供推理路径——属于在单一生成框架内统一处理视觉与语言的 Emu 系列。

给它一个多模态提示词即可驱动生成。该 checkpoint 由 BAAI 在 Hugging Face 上发布。

whenToUse.en: Reach for Emu3.5 when you want a single multimodal model spanning generation and image output with a reasoning capability, rather than separate task-specific models.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想用单一的多模态模型同时覆盖生成与图像输出并具备推理能力，而非多个单任务模型时，可选 Emu3.5。

tagline.en: FramePack — a low-memory, image-to-video approach designed to keep long-video generation within modest VRAM.
tagline.zh: FramePack——一种低显存的图生视频方案，旨在让长视频生成保持在有限显存内。

en: FramePack, from lllyasviel, is an image-to-video model with a focus on long-form output under tight memory budgets. Its core idea is to compress and pack frame context so that generating a longer clip doesn't blow up VRAM the way a naive approach would.

It ships image-to-video checkpoints built on the HunyuanVideo backbone, including an F1 variant. In WorldFoundry, FramePack runs through a minimal infer-only runtime vendored in-tree: give it a source image and a prompt, and it generates a video through the shared pipeline.
Weights are downloaded separately. The Hugging Face repositories are public and non-gated, but they don't declare an explicit license, so review the upstream terms before redistribution.
zh: FramePack 由 lllyasviel 推出，是一款专注于在紧张显存预算下生成长视频的图生视频模型。其核心思路是压缩并打包帧上下文，使生成较长片段时不会像朴素做法那样显存暴涨。
它提供基于 HunyuanVideo 主干构建的图生视频 checkpoint，包括一个 F1 变体。在 WorldFoundry 中，FramePack 通过内置的极简仅推理运行时运行：给它一张源图和提示词，它便经由统一 pipeline 生成视频。
权重需单独下载。其 Hugging Face 仓库公开且非门控，但未声明明确许可，再分发前请查阅上游条款。

whenToUse.en: A good fit when you want to animate an image into a longer clip on limited hardware — FramePack is built to keep memory use manageable as the video grows.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想在有限硬件上把一张图像扩展成较长片段时很合适——FramePack 的设计目标就是让显存占用随视频变长仍可控。

notFor.en: The Hugging Face repos don't expose an explicit license, so check the upstream terms before redistribution. Weights are downloaded separately.
notFor.zh: 其 Hugging Face 仓库未提供明确许可，再分发前请核对上游条款。权重需单独下载。

tagline.en: Gamma-World — a multi-agent, action-conditioned world model with real-time causal few-step streaming.
tagline.zh: Gamma-World——支持多智能体、动作条件的世界模型，具备实时因果少步流式生成。

en: Gamma-World is a world model for multi-agent, action-conditioned video. From per-player images and per-player actions, it generates video of an interactive world — several agents acting in the same scene at once.

It comes in three inference modes: bidirectional, causal, and a four-step causal variant. The four-step causal-few-step model is the default and is built for streaming, generating in a few denoising steps so it can run responsively. Under the hood it reuses shared infrastructure — Cosmos-Reason1 conditioning, a Wan VAE, scheduling, and windowed execution — assembled as a native diffusion recipe.

To use it, pass a sequence of per-player images along with one action mapping per player (or point it at a compatible eval directory), and it rolls the world forward. The Gamma-World checkpoint is Apache-2.0.
zh: Gamma-World 是一个面向多智能体、动作条件视频的世界模型。它从每个玩家的图像和每个玩家的动作出发，生成交互式世界的视频——多个智能体在同一场景中同时行动。
它提供三种推理模式：双向、因果，以及四步因果变体。四步的 causal-few-step 模型是默认项，专为流式生成打造，只需几步去噪即可运行，因而响应迅速。其内部复用了共享基础设施——Cosmos-Reason1 条件、Wan VAE、调度与窗口化执行——以原生扩散配方组装。
使用时，传入一组每玩家图像并为每个玩家提供一份动作映射（或指向一个兼容的评测目录），它便把世界向前推进。Gamma-World checkpoint 为 Apache-2.0。

whenToUse.en: Use Gamma-World for multi-agent, action-driven world rollouts — several players acting in one scene — especially when you want responsive, streaming generation via the four-step causal mode.
whenToUse.zh: 适合多智能体、动作驱动的世界 rollout——多个玩家在同一场景行动——尤其当你想通过四步因果模式获得响应式流式生成时。

notFor.en: It expects structured per-player image and action inputs rather than a single text prompt, so it's not a plain text-to-video generator. Checkpoints are downloaded separately.
notFor.zh: 它需要结构化的每玩家图像与动作输入，而非单一文本提示词，因此不是普通的文生视频生成器。checkpoint 需单独下载。

tagline.en: NVIDIA's GEN3C — a Cosmos-based world model for camera-controlled video from a single image, with 3D-consistent navigation.
tagline.zh: NVIDIA 的 GEN3C——基于 Cosmos 的世界模型，从单张图像生成相机可控、3D 一致的可导航视频。

en: GEN3C is a world model from NVIDIA that turns an image into video you can navigate with precise camera control. It's built on NVIDIA's Cosmos Predict1 foundation, and its strength is 3D consistency — the generated view stays coherent as the camera moves through the scene.

The pipeline pairs the GEN3C Cosmos-7B checkpoint with MoGe depth estimation. Named camera trajectories, MoGe depth, and RGBD forward warping are handled as native preprocessing that seeds the generation; you can also supply your own pre-rendered 3D-cache tensors if you already have them.
In WorldFoundry, GEN3C runs through the shared native diffusion pipeline: give it a starting image and a camera path, and it renders a camera-controlled clip with the geometry kept consistent.
zh: GEN3C 是 NVIDIA 推出的世界模型，能把一张图像变成可用精确相机控制来导航的视频。它构建于 NVIDIA 的 Cosmos Predict1 基础之上，强项在于 3D 一致性——相机在场景中移动时，生成的视角保持连贯。
该 pipeline 将 GEN3C Cosmos-7B checkpoint 与 MoGe 深度估计搭配。命名相机轨迹、MoGe 深度与 RGBD 前向 warping 作为原生预处理，为生成提供初始条件；若你已有预渲染的 3D-cache 张量，也可直接提供。
在 WorldFoundry 中，GEN3C 通过共享的原生扩散 pipeline 运行：给它一张起始图像和一条相机路径，它便渲染出几何保持一致的、相机可控的片段。

whenToUse.en: Reach for GEN3C when you want to explore a scene from a single image with controlled camera moves and 3D-consistent navigation — for example flying a camera through a still.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想从单张图像出发、以可控相机运动进行 3D 一致的场景导航时——例如让相机穿越一张静态图——GEN3C 很合适。

notFor.en: It's a camera-controlled, image-conditioned world model rather than a general text-to-video generator. Checkpoints (including the MoGe depth model) are downloaded separately.
notFor.zh: 它是相机可控、以图像为条件的世界模型，而非通用文生视频生成器。checkpoint（含 MoGe 深度模型）需单独下载。

Helios Base completed a real A100 Workspace checkpoint-load and decode smoke at 384x640 and 33 frames; the run used three total denoising steps with a [1, 1, 1] pyramid, so it verifies executable Base wiring and a finite nonblank video artifact but does not claim parity with the official [20, 20, 20] quality recipe. Helios follows its official PyTorch 2.10 and source Diffusers environment rather than the shared environment. The former Helios feature repository was removed; this profile pins the public head of the official Diffusers Helios PR (#13208) until it lands on main.

tagline.en: Helios — PKU-YuanGroup's Apache-2.0 video model spanning text-, image-, and video-to-video, with long-video chunked generation.
tagline.zh: Helios——北大袁粒团队的 Apache-2.0 视频模型，覆盖文生/图生/视频到视频，并以分块方式生成长视频。

en: Helios is an open-weight video generation model from PKU-YuanGroup, released under Apache-2.0. It handles text-to-video, image-to-video, and video-to-video, and is built for long-video generation.

It comes in three checkpoints: Distilled (the default, efficient route), Base, and Mid. Helios generates in 33-frame chunks and rounds a requested frame count up to a compatible number of chunks, so longer outputs are produced by extending the sequence chunk by chunk. Resident sessions keep the native frame history across chunks and let you update the prompt at chunk boundaries.

In WorldFoundry the default route uses Helios-Distilled and supports all three modes. Runtime options include group offloading and multi-GPU context parallelism for larger runs; checkpoints are downloaded separately.
zh: Helios 是北大袁粒团队开源的视频生成模型，采用 Apache-2.0 许可。它支持文生视频、图生视频与视频到视频，并面向长视频生成。
它提供三个 checkpoint：Distilled（默认的高效路径）、Base 与 Mid。Helios 以 33 帧为一块生成，会把请求的帧数向上取整到兼容的块数，因此较长输出是通过逐块延展序列产生的。常驻会话在多块之间保留原生帧历史，并允许你在块边界更新提示词。
在 WorldFoundry 中，默认路径使用 Helios-Distilled 并支持全部三种模式。运行时选项包括分组卸载（group offloading）与多 GPU 上下文并行，便于更大规模的运行；checkpoint 需单独下载。

whenToUse.en: A strong open-licensed pick when you need multiple video modes in one model and want long-video output built from chunked generation — start with the efficient Distilled route.
whenToUse.zh: 当你需要在同一模型里使用多种视频模式，并希望通过分块生成得到长视频时，它是很好的开放许可之选——从高效的 Distilled 路径起步即可。

notFor.en: Frame counts are quantized to 33-frame chunks, so exact arbitrary lengths aren't guaranteed. Helios does not offer interactive keyboard-style camera control. Checkpoints are downloaded separately.
notFor.zh: 帧数会量化到 33 帧的块，因此无法保证任意精确长度。Helios 不提供交互式键盘式相机控制。checkpoint 需单独下载。

tagline.en: Tencent's Hy-Embodied-0.5-VLA — an Apache-2.0 vision-language-action model for robot policy, including bimanual manipulation.
tagline.zh: 腾讯的 Hy-Embodied-0.5-VLA——Apache-2.0 的视觉-语言-动作模型，用于机器人策略，含双臂操作。

en: Hy-Embodied-0.5-VLA is Tencent's vision-language-action (VLA) model for embodied robotics. It maps camera observations and instructions to robot actions, driving policy rollouts for tasks including bimanual manipulation.

It ships in two checkpoints tuned for different setups: a UMI variant that outputs a chunk of 50 relative action steps, and a RoboTwin variant that returns 20 relative plus 20 absolute steps and can blend a supplied start pose. Both use a MoT (Mixture-of-Transformers) backbone and take multi-camera, multi-frame observations — RoboTwin, for example, uses six history frames from three cameras. Both checkpoints are Apache-2.0.

In WorldFoundry it runs as an inference-only path — architecture, backbone, preprocessing, and action decoding are kept in-tree — and defaults to strictly local checkpoints. Give it the observation frames and it decodes an action chunk for the robot.
zh: Hy-Embodied-0.5-VLA 是腾讯面向具身机器人的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型。它把相机观测与指令映射为机器人动作，驱动包括双臂操作在内的策略 rollout。
它提供两个针对不同配置调优的 checkpoint：UMI 变体输出一段 50 步相对动作；RoboTwin 变体返回 20 步相对加 20 步绝对动作，并可对传入的起始位姿做融合。两者都采用 MoT（Mixture-of-Transformers）主干，接受多相机、多帧观测——例如 RoboTwin 使用来自三个相机的六帧历史。两个 checkpoint 均为 Apache-2.0。
在 WorldFoundry 中它以仅推理路径运行——架构、主干、预处理与动作解码都内置在仓库内——并默认严格使用本地 checkpoint。给它观测帧，它便为机器人解码出一段动作。

whenToUse.en: Use Hy-Embodied-0.5-VLA for robot policy rollouts from multi-camera observations — pick the UMI or RoboTwin checkpoint to match your setup, including bimanual manipulation tasks.
whenToUse.zh: 适合从多相机观测做机器人策略 rollout——根据你的配置选择 UMI 或 RoboTwin checkpoint，涵盖双臂操作任务。

notFor.en: It expects proper multi-camera, multi-frame robot observations; a single replicated image works only for smoke tests, not for benchmark-quality rollouts. Checkpoints are kept strictly local.
notFor.zh: 它需要规范的多相机、多帧机器人观测；单张复制图像只适合冒烟测试，无法用于基准质量的 rollout。checkpoint 严格保存在本地。

en: Vision-language-action model for robot policy and bimanual manipulation
UMI and RoboTwin checkpoints, both Apache-2.0
MoT (Mixture-of-Transformers) backbone
Multi-camera, multi-frame observation inputs; inference-only, local checkpoints
zh: 面向机器人策略与双臂操作的视觉-语言-动作模型
UMI 与 RoboTwin 两个 checkpoint，均为 Apache-2.0
MoT（Mixture-of-Transformers）主干
多相机、多帧观测输入；仅推理、使用本地 checkpoint

tagline.en: HY-World 2.0 Trajectory Renderer — Tencent Hunyuan's camera-controlled render stage over a pre-built 3D world scene.
tagline.zh: HY-World 2.0 轨迹渲染器——腾讯混元在预构建 3D 世界场景上做相机可控渲染的阶段。

en: The HY-World 2.0 Trajectory Renderer is the camera-controlled rendering stage of Tencent Hunyuan's HY-World 2.0. Given a pre-materialized HY-World scene and a camera path, it renders video along that trajectory — point-cloud rendering that moves a virtual camera through an existing 3D world.

This route is specifically the trajectory-render stage: it takes an image, a camera JSON describing the path, and a scene's point cloud, and produces camera-controlled video. It deliberately loads no model checkpoint — the geometry comes from the scene, not from generated weights — and includes an in-tree point-splat fallback so it doesn't require PyTorch3D.

In WorldFoundry, the one asset you need to supply is a pre-materialized local HY-World scene (its point cloud); the image and camera JSON are ordinary inputs. Building that scene is the job of the separate full HY-World generation pipeline, not this stage.
zh: HY-World 2.0 轨迹渲染器是腾讯混元 HY-World 2.0 中的相机可控渲染阶段。给定一个已构建好的 HY-World 场景和一条相机路径，它沿该轨迹渲染视频——通过点云渲染，让虚拟相机在既有 3D 世界中移动。
这条路径专指轨迹渲染阶段：它接受一张图像、一份描述路径的相机 JSON 和场景的点云，产出相机可控的视频。它有意不加载任何模型 checkpoint——几何来自场景本身，而非生成的权重——并内置了点 splat 回退，因此无需 PyTorch3D。
在 WorldFoundry 中，你唯一需要提供的资产是一个已构建好的本地 HY-World 场景（其点云）；图像与相机 JSON 是常规输入。构建该场景属于独立的完整 HY-World 生成 pipeline，而非此阶段。

whenToUse.en: Use this renderer when you already have a materialized HY-World scene and want to fly a camera through it along a defined trajectory to produce point-cloud-rendered video.
whenToUse.zh: 当你已有一个构建好的 HY-World 场景，想沿定义好的轨迹让相机穿越并产出点云渲染视频时，可用此渲染器。

notFor.en: It doesn't generate a world from scratch — that's the separate full HY-World pipeline's job. It needs a pre-materialized scene point cloud on hand before rendering.
notFor.zh: 它不从零生成世界——那是独立的完整 HY-World pipeline 的职责。渲染前需备有已构建好的场景点云。

en: Camera-controlled video from a pre-built HY-World scene
Point-cloud rendering along a camera JSON trajectory
Loads no model checkpoint — geometry comes from the scene
In-tree point-splat fallback; no PyTorch3D required
zh: 在预构建的 HY-World 场景上生成相机可控视频
沿相机 JSON 轨迹做点云渲染
不加载任何模型 checkpoint——几何来自场景
内置点 splat 回退，无需 PyTorch3D

tagline.en: A camera-controlled video world model from H-EmbodVis, built on the Wan2.1 backbone.
tagline.zh: H-EmbodVis 推出的相机可控视频世界模型,基于 Wan2.1 骨干构建。

en: HyDRA is a world model from H-EmbodVis that generates video you can steer with a camera path. Rather than only producing a clip from a prompt, it lets you specify how the viewpoint moves through the scene, making it suited to camera-controlled and video-to-video work.

It builds on the Wan2.1 text-to-video backbone, reusing that diffusion video generator as its foundation and adding camera-conditioning on top. You provide the driving inputs — a scene and a camera trajectory — and it renders the corresponding video.
zh: HyDRA 是 H-EmbodVis 推出的世界模型,可生成能用相机轨迹控制的视频。它不只是根据提示词产出片段,还允许你指定视角在场景中的移动方式,因此适合相机可控生成与视频到视频的任务。
它构建在 Wan2.1 文生视频骨干之上,复用该扩散视频生成器作为基础,并在其上加入相机条件控制。你提供驱动输入——场景与相机轨迹——它便渲染出对应的视频。

whenToUse.en: Reach for HyDRA when you need explicit control over camera motion in generated video, or want to explore a scene along a chosen viewpoint path rather than accepting whatever framing a plain text-to-video model produces.
whenToUse.zh: 当你需要显式控制生成视频中的相机运动,或希望沿选定视角路径探索场景,而不是被动接受纯文生视频模型给出的构图时,可以选择 HyDRA。

notFor.en: Checkpoints are downloaded separately rather than bundled, so plan for the download and disk space. Licensing terms are not published in the source repository, so review them before any production use.
notFor.zh: Checkpoint 需单独下载而非随附,请预留下载时间与磁盘空间。源仓库未公布许可条款,正式使用前请自行确认。

Supports video-to-video and world-model workflows

构建于 Wan2.1 文生视频骨干之上
支持视频到视频与世界模型工作流

en: I2VGen-XL is an open image-to-video model from Alibaba's ali-vilab group, released under the MIT license. Its main job is to take a still image and animate it into a short video, and it also supports text-to-video generation.

The model is a cascaded, diffusion-based video generator: it conditions on your input image (and optional text) to produce motion that stays faithful to the source frame. In WorldFoundry you run it through the shared pipeline — supply an image, and it generates the corresponding clip.
zh: I2VGen-XL 是阿里 ali-vilab 团队开源的图生视频模型,采用 MIT 许可。它的主要用途是把一张静态图片动画化为短视频,同时也支持文生视频。
该模型是基于扩散的级联式视频生成器:它以输入图片(以及可选文本)为条件,生成忠实于原始画面的运动。在 WorldFoundry 中,你通过统一 pipeline 运行它——提供一张图片,它便生成对应的片段。

whenToUse.en: A good choice when you have a still image you want to bring to life, and want an openly-licensed (MIT) image-to-video model to prototype with.
whenToUse.zh: 当你有一张想让它动起来的静态图片,并希望用一个开放许可(MIT)的图生视频模型做原型时,这是不错的选择。

It handles text-to-video and video-to-video, and its streaming design lets frames come out progressively. In WorldFoundry the route gives you controls over the number of blocks generated, resolution, frame rate, and seed, so you can tune the length and look of the output.
zh: Krea Realtime Video 是 Krea 推出的 14B 视频模型,采用 Apache-2.0 许可。它专为实时与流式生成设计,力求边生成边出画,而非只在完整离线渲染后才产出。
它支持文生视频与视频到视频,其流式设计让画面可以逐步输出。在 WorldFoundry 中,该路径提供生成块数(num_blocks)、分辨率、帧率与随机种子等控制项,便于你调节输出的长度与观感。

whenToUse.en: Choose it when responsiveness matters — interactive or streaming video generation where you want frames to appear progressively rather than waiting on a full batch render, and you want an openly-licensed model to do it with.
whenToUse.zh: 当响应速度很重要时可以选它——需要交互式或流式视频生成、希望画面逐步出现而非等待整批渲染完成,并且想用一个开放许可的模型来实现时。

tagline.zh: Meta(FAIR)推出的新视角合成模型——从全新相机视角渲染场景。

en: LagrNVS is a novel-view-synthesis model from Meta's FAIR research group. Given a scene, it renders how that scene would look from camera viewpoints you did not originally capture, which makes it useful for 3D scene rendering and camera-path playback.

In WorldFoundry it runs through an in-tree adapter that drives the upstream inference command, taking your scene and a target camera path and producing the synthesized views. The published checkpoint is gated, so access requires the appropriate credentials.
zh: LagrNVS 是 Meta FAIR 研究团队推出的新视角合成模型。给定一个场景,它能渲染出该场景在你原本未拍摄的相机视角下的样子,因而适用于 3D 场景渲染与相机路径回放。
在 WorldFoundry 中,它通过一个内置适配器运行,驱动上游的推理命令,以你的场景与目标相机路径为输入,产出合成视角。已发布的 checkpoint 受访问限制,需要相应凭据才能获取。

whenToUse.en: Use it when you have a captured scene and want to render it from new camera angles or along a camera path — for example generating fly-through views the original capture never contained.
whenToUse.zh: 当你已有一个拍摄的场景,并希望从新的相机角度、或沿某条相机路径渲染它时可以使用——例如生成原始拍摄中并不存在的穿越视角。

tagline.en: Robbyant's Apache-2.0 model for streaming 3D reconstruction — point clouds, camera pose, and depth from video.
tagline.zh: Robbyant 推出的 Apache-2.0 模型,面向流式 3D 重建——从视频还原点云、相机位姿与深度。

en: LingBot-Map is a 3D reconstruction model from Robbyant, released under Apache-2.0. It recovers scene geometry from imagery, producing point clouds along with camera-pose and depth estimates.

A distinguishing trait is its streaming and windowed reconstruction: rather than needing the whole sequence up front, it can process frames incrementally through the LingBotMap pipeline. In WorldFoundry the wrapper accepts either a checkpoint file or a local Hugging Face snapshot directory, and defaults to SDPA attention so it runs without extra dependencies; you can opt into FlashInfer when it is available.
zh: LingBot-Map 是 Robbyant 推出的 3D 重建模型,采用 Apache-2.0 许可。它从影像中还原场景几何,产出点云,并同时给出相机位姿与深度估计。
它的一大特点是支持流式与窗口式重建:无需一次性拿到整段序列,而可通过 LingBotMap pipeline 逐步处理帧。在 WorldFoundry 中,该封装既可接受 checkpoint 文件、也可接受本地 Hugging Face 快照目录,并默认使用 SDPA 注意力以便无额外依赖即可运行;当 FlashInfer 可用时你也可以启用它。

whenToUse.en: Reach for it when you need 3D structure from video or image sequences — point clouds, camera poses, or depth — especially in a streaming setting where frames arrive over time rather than all at once.
whenToUse.zh: 当你需要从视频或图像序列中获取 3D 结构——点云、相机位姿或深度——尤其是在帧随时间陆续到达而非一次性给出的流式场景中时,可以选择它。

notFor.en: Checkpoints are external assets that you download separately from robbyant/lingbot-map rather than getting bundled, so stage them before running.

zh: Apache-2.0 许可的 3D 重建模型
支持从影像进行流式与窗口式重建
输出点云、相机位姿与深度
默认 SDPA 注意力,可选启用 FlashInfer

recipes.name: LingBot-Video
recipes.summary: Robbyant's Apache-2.0 video family — a lightweight 1.3B dense model and a 30B-A3B mixture-of-experts, for text-to-video and image-to-video.

notes: The runtime owns only inference code. Rewriter and training surfaces are outside this integration.
T2I produces an image despite the default runtime profile artifact being the T2V video route.
The upstream recommended stack requires a dedicated Transformers 5 / Diffusers 0.39 environment.
The released Dense 1.3B checkpoint has a 121-frame, 832x480 quality-oriented Workspace artifact.

The released MoE 30B-A3B main transformer, 8.88GB text encoder, and FP32 VAE completed a real single-A100 Workspace run with the optional refiner disabled. The one-step smoke produced five fully decodable 192x320 frames (artifact SHA256 4458abda4089e0019587ab388f6ce10f47964af3033f32e060729ddb961ad7f7), proving the large-checkpoint execution path only; its visibly blurred output is not a quality demo.

A second MoE Workspace run used 20 denoising steps for nine 256x416 frames. Its first, middle, and last frames show a coherent industrial workbench, black robot mechanism, and red block without the one-step blur; artifact SHA256 is b3211b8ece8a73519bb7c3589cbeebf8c59b4cc473c86cc0e630f833dad2c6f3. This is a quality-oriented short smoke, not parity with the official 480x832, 121-frame, 40-step recipe.
The MoE single-device path is physically validated only on A100 80GB; Hopper, Blackwell, and multi-GPU entries are supported targets pending hardware-specific validation.

The in-tree Diffusers backend is validated with the existing CUDA 12.8 unified environment (PyTorch 2.11, Diffusers 0.38, Transformers 5.3); the previous dedicated environment resolved to an unprovisioned Python 3.12 prefix and could not import NumPy or Torch.

tagline.en: Robbyant's Apache-2.0 video family — a lightweight 1.3B dense model and a 30B-A3B mixture-of-experts, for text-to-video and image-to-video.
tagline.zh: Robbyant 开源的视频家族——轻量 1.3B dense 模型与 30B-A3B 专家混合模型,支持文生视频与图生视频。

en: LingBot-Video is an open video-generation family from Robbyant, released under Apache-2.0. It generates video from text, from text plus an image, and can also produce still images from text, so it spans several generation modes in one lineup.

The family comes in two flavors: a compact Dense 1.3B for lighter workloads, and a larger MoE 30B-A3B mixture-of-experts model that activates a smaller expert subset per step for higher-capacity generation. WorldFoundry ships the inference code with direct Diffusers, optional SGLang, FSDP, context-parallel and CFG-parallel paths, plus an optional refiner stage.
The upstream recommended stack expects a dedicated environment (Transformers 5 / Diffusers 0.39), which WorldFoundry provisions for the route.
zh: LingBot-Video 是 Robbyant 开源的视频生成家族,采用 Apache-2.0 许可。它可从文本、从文本加图片生成视频,也能从文本产出静态图像,因而在一条产品线中覆盖多种生成模式。
该家族提供两种形态:紧凑的 Dense 1.3B 适合较轻负载,而更大的 MoE 30B-A3B 专家混合模型每步仅激活一部分专家,以实现更高容量的生成。WorldFoundry 提供的推理代码包含直接 Diffusers、可选 SGLang、FSDP、上下文并行与 CFG 并行等路径,并带一个可选的 refiner 阶段。
上游推荐的运行栈需要专用环境(Transformers 5 / Diffusers 0.39),WorldFoundry 已为该路径准备好。

whenToUse.en: Pick the Dense 1.3B when you want a lighter, openly-licensed video model to prototype text-to-video or image-to-video. Step up to the MoE 30B-A3B when you need higher-capacity generation and have the GPU budget for it.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想用一个较轻、开放许可的视频模型做文生视频或图生视频原型时,选 Dense 1.3B。当你需要更高容量的生成且具备相应 GPU 预算时,升级到 MoE 30B-A3B。

notFor.en: Both Dense and MoE checkpoints are external assets you download separately rather than getting bundled. The MoE model in particular is large and demands substantial GPU memory.
notFor.zh: Dense 与 MoE 的 checkpoint 都是需单独下载的外部资源,而非随附。尤其是 MoE 模型体量庞大,对 GPU 显存要求可观。

Two sizes: Dense 1.3B and MoE 30B-A3B mixture-of-experts

tagline.zh: Robbyant 推出的动作条件世界模型——由动作驱动生成可交互视频。

en: LingBot-World Base Act is an interactive world model from Robbyant. Instead of generating video from a prompt alone, it is conditioned on actions: you feed it actions and it produces the video that would result, making it suited to interactive, action-driven scenarios.

It builds on Robbyant's in-tree LingBot runtime and the shared Wan base modules, resolving the dedicated action checkpoint (Base-Act) rather than the camera-conditioned variant. It runs in its own environment to keep the action-conditioned path behaving correctly.
zh: LingBot-World Base Act 是 Robbyant 推出的可交互世界模型。它不是仅凭提示词生成视频,而是以动作为条件:你输入动作,它便产出相应的视频结果,因而适合交互式、由动作驱动的场景。
它构建在 Robbyant 内置的 LingBot 运行时与共享的 Wan 基础模块之上,并解析专用的动作 checkpoint(Base-Act),而非相机条件变体。它在专属环境中运行,以保证动作条件路径行为正确。

whenToUse.en: Use it when you want to drive video generation with actions — exploring how a scene evolves in response to inputs, rather than producing a fixed clip from a single text prompt.
whenToUse.zh: 当你希望用动作来驱动视频生成——探索场景如何随输入演变,而非用单条文本提示词产出固定片段时,可以使用它。

notFor.en: Weights are staged locally rather than bundled, so download them before running. It relies on a dedicated environment, so it is not a drop-in for a generic shared setup.
notFor.zh: 权重需在本地准备而非随附,请在运行前先下载。它依赖专属环境,因此不适合直接放入通用共享配置中。

tagline.en: A camera-controlled video world model built on Wan2.1, with geometry- and segmentation-aware conditioning.
tagline.zh: 基于 Wan2.1 构建的相机可控视频世界模型,带几何与分割感知的条件控制。

en: LiveWorld is a world model that generates video you can steer with a camera path. Beyond producing a clip, it lets you control how the viewpoint moves through a scene, which suits camera-controlled and video-to-video work.

It composes several models around the Wan2.1 text-to-video backbone: it draws on a vision-language model, a segmentation model, and geometry/depth components to condition generation on the scene's structure. In WorldFoundry it runs through a geometry-aware, monitor-centric inference route, taking your scene inputs and a camera trajectory to render the output.
zh: LiveWorld 是一个世界模型,可生成能用相机轨迹控制的视频。除了产出片段,它还允许你控制视角在场景中的移动方式,因而适合相机可控生成与视频到视频的任务。
它围绕 Wan2.1 文生视频骨干组合了多个模型:借助视觉语言模型、分割模型以及几何/深度组件,让生成以场景结构为条件。在 WorldFoundry 中,它通过一条几何感知、以监视视角为中心的推理路径运行,以你的场景输入与相机轨迹为条件渲染输出。

whenToUse.en: Reach for LiveWorld when you need camera-controlled video that respects scene geometry — steering the viewpoint through a structured scene rather than accepting the framing of a plain text-to-video model.
whenToUse.zh: 当你需要尊重场景几何的相机可控视频——在结构化场景中操控视角,而非被动接受纯文生视频模型的构图时,可以选择 LiveWorld。

notFor.en: It depends on several separate checkpoints (the Wan backbone plus vision, segmentation, and geometry components) that are staged locally rather than bundled, so plan for multiple downloads and disk space.
notFor.zh: 它依赖多个独立 checkpoint(Wan 骨干加上视觉、分割与几何组件),这些都需在本地准备而非随附,请为多次下载与磁盘空间做好准备。

tagline.zh: Vchitect 推出的可控长视频模型——基于 Wan2.1 的图生视频,支持深度与轨迹控制。

en: LongVie is a controllable long-video generation model from Vchitect. It starts from an image and extends it into longer video, and accepts control signals — depth maps and motion trajectories — so you can guide both the content and the movement of the result.

It is built on the canonical Wan2.1 components: the Wan model, its text encoders and VAE, and VACE-style control roles, run through a shared staged diffusion runner. This LongVie-1 route uses the control-weight path and preserves the official segment size, history/noise continuation state, VRAM management, and optional ring/ulysses sequence-parallel controls.
zh: LongVie 是 Vchitect 推出的可控长视频生成模型。它从一张图片出发,将其延展为更长的视频,并接受控制信号——深度图与运动轨迹——从而让你既能引导内容、也能引导结果中的运动。
它构建在标准的 Wan2.1 组件之上:Wan 模型、其文本编码器与 VAE,以及 VACE 式的控制角色,并通过共享的分阶段扩散 runner 运行。这条 LongVie-1 路径使用控制权重路径,保留了官方的分段尺寸、历史/噪声续接状态、显存管理,以及可选的 ring/ulysses 序列并行控制。

whenToUse.en: Choose it when you want long video generated from a starting image with explicit control over depth or motion trajectory — useful when you need the output to follow a specified structure or path rather than free-running.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想从一张起始图片生成长视频,并需要对深度或运动轨迹进行显式控制时可以选它——适用于希望输出遵循特定结构或路径、而非自由发挥的情形。

notFor.en: The run relies on staged checkpoints and only executes the checkpoint-backed GPU path when you explicitly request it, so prepare the weights and enable execution first.
notFor.zh: 运行依赖已准备好的 checkpoint,且只有在你显式请求时才执行由 checkpoint 支撑的 GPU 路径,请先准备好权重并启用执行。

Optional ring/ulysses sequence-parallel controls
zh: 从图片出发的可控长视频生成
支持深度控制与轨迹控制的生成

tagline.en: Lightricks' LTX-2 and LTX-2.3 — a distilled, fast image-to-video route with a built-in spatial upscaler.
tagline.zh: Lightricks 的 LTX-2 与 LTX-2.3——蒸馏加速的图生视频路径,内置空间超分。

en: LTX-2.x is Lightricks' newer generation of the LTX video family, covering the LTX-2 and LTX-2.3 checkpoints. It is a diffusion transformer for video generation, and in WorldFoundry the runnable route is image-to-video: you give it a starting image and it produces the clip.

The route uses a distilled schedule to keep generation fast, running two denoising stages with the official Spatial Upscaler applied between them for higher-resolution output; the upscaler is loaded automatically as part of the pipeline. It runs on WorldFoundry's native diffusion infrastructure — a shared component loader, multi-stage runner, and scheduler — rather than a third-party inference backend.
The family also advertises text-to-video and video-to-video, but in WorldFoundry those describe the upstream models; the currently runnable local variants are image-to-video only.
zh: LTX-2.x 是 Lightricks 新一代 LTX 视频家族,涵盖 LTX-2 与 LTX-2.3 两个 checkpoint。它是用于视频生成的扩散 Transformer,在 WorldFoundry 中可运行的路径是图生视频:你给它一张起始图片,它便产出片段。
该路径采用蒸馏调度以保持生成速度,运行两个去噪阶段,并在两者之间应用官方的空间超分器(Spatial Upscaler)以获得更高分辨率的输出;超分器作为 pipeline 的一部分自动加载。它运行在 WorldFoundry 的原生扩散基础设施上——共享的组件加载器、多阶段 runner 与调度器——而非第三方推理后端。
该家族也标注了文生视频与视频到视频,但在 WorldFoundry 中这些描述的是上游模型;当前本地可运行的变体仅为图生视频。

whenToUse.en: Use it when you want fast, distilled image-to-video generation with high-resolution output from a recent, actively developed model family.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想要快速、蒸馏加速的图生视频生成,并需要来自较新、活跃开发的模型家族的高分辨率输出时,可以使用它。

notFor.en: Text-to-video and video-to-video are not runnable local routes here — only image-to-video. Checkpoints are released under Lightricks' own (non-standard) license terms, so review them before production use.
notFor.zh: 这里文生视频与视频到视频并非可运行的本地路径——仅支持图生视频。Checkpoint 采用 Lightricks 自有(非标准)许可条款,正式使用前请自行确认。

en: LTX-2 and LTX-2.3 checkpoints, ungated
Fast distilled image-to-video schedule
Built-in official spatial upscaler for higher resolution
Runs on native diffusion infrastructure, no third-party backend
zh: LTX-2 与 LTX-2.3 checkpoint,无访问限制
快速的蒸馏图生视频调度
内置官方空间超分,输出更高分辨率
运行于原生扩散基础设施,无第三方后端

与其后继 LTX-2.x 一样,该路径运行两个去噪阶段,并在两者之间自动应用官方空间超分器,运行于 WorldFoundry 的原生 Transformer、VAE、调度器与联合状态 runner 之上。它提供实用的控制项——参考图片、帧率、guidance scale、分辨率、帧数、步数与随机种子。该家族已发布 0.9.5、0.9.7-dev 与 0.9.8 等 checkpoint。
