tagline.en: Sand AI's open, Apache-2.0 video model — animate a still image into motion.
tagline.zh: Sand AI 开源的视频模型——Apache-2.0 许可,把静态图片生成为动态视频。

en: MAGI-1 is an open video generation model from Sand AI, released under Apache-2.0 with no gating. It takes a still image and animates it into a short clip, and can drive broader video generation from that starting frame.

The model generates video autoregressively, extending the scene forward rather than denoising a whole clip at once. You supply an input image and sampling controls; it renders the motion out from there.
In WorldFoundry you run MAGI-1 through the shared pipeline — point it at the local checkpoint, give it an image, tune the sampling settings, fps, and seed, and it writes out a video.
zh: MAGI-1 是 Sand AI 开源的视频生成模型,采用 Apache-2.0 许可、无使用门槛。它以一张静态图片为起点,将其生成为一段短视频,也可从该起始帧展开更广义的视频生成。
该模型采用自回归方式生成视频,沿时间向前扩展画面,而非一次性对整段片段去噪。你提供输入图片与采样控制,它便从这一帧开始渲染出运动。
在 WorldFoundry 中,你通过统一 pipeline 运行 MAGI-1——指向本地 checkpoint,给它一张图片,调好采样设置、fps 与 seed,它就会输出一段视频。

whenToUse.en: Reach for MAGI-1 when you want an openly-licensed model to turn a single image into motion, and you value an autoregressive approach that grows the clip frame by frame.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想用一个开放许可的模型把单张图片变成动态视频,并看重逐帧向前扩展的自回归生成方式时,可以选择 MAGI-1。

notFor.en: Text-only prompting without a starting image isn't its focus — it works from an input frame. The checkpoint is downloaded separately, so plan for the download and disk space.
notFor.zh: 它并非以纯文字提示、无起始图片的生成为主——它需要一帧输入图片。Checkpoint 需单独下载,请预留下载时间与磁盘空间。

Autoregressive generation that extends the scene forward
Runs through WorldFoundry's shared pipeline with fps and seed controls

自回归生成,沿时间向前扩展画面

tagline.en: vivo Camera Research's camera-controlled world model — steer a video with camera trajectories from a single image.
tagline.zh: vivo Camera Research 的相机可控世界模型——从单张图片出发,用相机轨迹操控视频。

en: MagicWorld is an interactive world model from vivo Camera Research. Starting from an image, it generates video you can steer with camera motion, letting you explore a scene along a chosen trajectory.

It builds on established video and geometry tooling: a Wan2.1-Fun image-to-video backbone for generation and Apple's Depth Pro for depth, combined so camera control stays grounded in the scene's 3D structure. WorldFoundry also wires a dedicated MagicWorld-Fast camera path.
In WorldFoundry you give it a starting image and a camera trajectory, and it renders a camera-controlled clip through the shared pipeline.
zh: MagicWorld 是 vivo Camera Research 的交互式世界模型。它以一张图片为起点生成视频,你可以用相机运动来操控,沿选定轨迹在场景中漫游。
它构建在成熟的视频与几何工具之上:以 Wan2.1-Fun 图生视频骨干负责生成,配合 Apple 的 Depth Pro 估计深度,使相机控制始终锚定在场景的 3D 结构上。WorldFoundry 还接入了专门的 MagicWorld-Fast 相机路径。
在 WorldFoundry 中,你给它一张起始图片和一条相机轨迹,它就会通过统一 pipeline 渲染出一段相机可控的片段。

whenToUse.en: Use MagicWorld when you want to explore a scene from a single image with explicit camera control — panning, orbiting, or moving through it along a trajectory.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想从单张图片出发、用明确的相机控制(平移、环绕、沿轨迹推进)去探索一个场景时,适合使用 MagicWorld。

tagline.en: Skywork's Matrix-Game 1.0 — an interactive world model that generates a controllable game-style world from a starting image.
tagline.zh: Skywork 的 Matrix-Game 1.0——从起始图片生成可交互游戏式世界的世界模型。

en: Matrix-Game 1.0 is an interactive world model in the Matrix-Game family from Skywork. Given an initial image, it generates a controllable, game-like world you can move through.

The model is built from a diffusion transformer (DiT) with a dedicated text encoder and a video VAE, and WorldFoundry runs it through a vendored copy of the official runtime so behavior stays faithful to upstream.
In WorldFoundry you provide a starting image and let the pipeline generate the world. It is registered as its own model — separate from later Matrix-Game versions — with its own weights and runner.
zh: Matrix-Game 1.0 是 Skywork 推出的 Matrix-Game 家族中的交互式世界模型。给定一张初始图片,它便生成一个可操控、类似游戏的世界供你在其中移动。
该模型由扩散 Transformer(DiT)、专用文本编码器与视频 VAE 组成,WorldFoundry 通过内置的官方运行时副本运行它,使行为忠实于上游。
在 WorldFoundry 中,你提供一张起始图片,由 pipeline 生成世界。它作为独立模型注册——与后续 Matrix-Game 版本区分开——拥有自己的权重与运行器。

whenToUse.en: Choose Matrix-Game 1.0 when you want to spin up an interactive, game-style world from an image and explore it, using the original Matrix-Game generation stack.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想从一张图片生成可交互的游戏式世界并加以探索,且希望使用初代 Matrix-Game 的生成栈时,可以选择 Matrix-Game 1.0。

notFor.en: It runs on an older CUDA/torch stack, so a modern NVIDIA unified environment is recommended. Checkpoints (DiT shards, text encoder, VAE) are downloaded separately and take significant disk space.
notFor.zh: 它基于较旧的 CUDA/torch 栈,因此建议在较新的 NVIDIA 统一环境中运行。Checkpoint(DiT 分片、文本编码器、VAE)需单独下载,占用较多磁盘空间。

tagline.en: Matrix-Game 3.5 First-Person — an Apache-2.0 world model that generates long, camera-steered first-person video from an image.
tagline.zh: Matrix-Game 3.5 第一人称——Apache-2.0 许可,从图片生成相机可控、长时程的第一人称视频。

en: Matrix-Game 3.5 First-Person Base is an interactive world model from Riemann Dynamics, released under Apache-2.0. Starting from an image, it generates first-person video you can steer with a camera trajectory, and it can roll the scene forward over a long horizon.

This is the 25-step bidirectional 5B base model. It's built on the Wan2.2-TI2V-5B backbone and pairs a conditioner, latent initializer, scheduler, denoiser, and decoder, using a depth model (Depth-Anything's DA3) as a geometry dependency. Generation proceeds block by block — each block adds 84 new frames and consumes 84 camera poses — so you can extend a rollout well beyond a single short clip. This ID is permanently bound to the first-person mode.
In WorldFoundry you supply a starting image and a camera trajectory, and the pipeline generates the first-person rollout, exporting frames at 1280×704, 16 fps.
zh: Matrix-Game 3.5 First-Person Base 是 Riemann Dynamics 推出的交互式世界模型,采用 Apache-2.0 许可。它以一张图片为起点生成第一人称视频,你可以用相机轨迹操控,并能在长时程上持续推进画面。
这是 25 步双向 5B 基础模型,构建在 Wan2.2-TI2V-5B 骨干之上,由条件器、隐变量初始化器、调度器、去噪器与解码器组成,并以深度模型(Depth-Anything 的 DA3)作为几何依赖。生成按块进行——每块新增 84 帧、消耗 84 个相机位姿——因此你可以把 rollout 扩展到远超单段短片的长度。该 ID 永久绑定第一人称模式。
在 WorldFoundry 中,你提供一张起始图片和一条相机轨迹,pipeline 便生成第一人称 rollout,以 1280×704、16 fps 导出帧序列。

whenToUse.en: Use this model when you want camera-steered, first-person world exploration from an image, especially longer rollouts built up block by block rather than a single short clip.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想从图片出发做相机可控的第一人称世界探索,尤其是按块累积、比单段短片更长的 rollout 时,适合使用该模型。

notFor.en: The currently released weights are the 25-step base model, not a few-step real-time distilled version, so generation is not real-time. Its depth dependency (DA3) carries a separate non-commercial license you must follow, and checkpoints are downloaded separately.
notFor.zh: 当前发布的是 25 步基础模型,而非少步实时蒸馏版本,因此生成并非实时。其深度依赖(DA3)带有单独的非商用许可,需遵守;Checkpoint 需单独下载。

Camera-steered, first-person world generation from an image

Output: 1280×704 frames at 16 fps; depth dependency (DA3) is non-commercial

从图片出发的相机可控第一人称世界生成

From a starting image it generates third-person video you can steer with a camera trajectory, and it accepts subject-reference images so a protagonist keeps a consistent appearance.

This is the 25-step bidirectional 5B base model, built on the Wan2.2-TI2V-5B backbone with a conditioner, latent initializer, scheduler, denoiser, and decoder, plus a depth model (Depth-Anything's DA3) as a geometry dependency. Subject references are optional — you can pass none, a single image, or up to a small set of crops, and the runtime uses up to two references per request. Generation runs block by block (each block adds 84 frames and consumes 84 camera poses) for long-horizon rollouts.

In WorldFoundry you provide a starting image, a camera trajectory, and optionally one or more subject references; the pipeline generates the third-person rollout, exporting frames at 1280×704, 16 fps.
zh: Matrix-Game 3.5 Third-Person Base 是 Riemann Dynamics 推出的交互式世界模型,采用 Apache-2.0 许可。它以一张图片为起点生成第三人称视频,你可以用相机轨迹操控,并接受主体参考图,让主角保持外观一致。
这是 25 步双向 5B 基础模型,构建在 Wan2.2-TI2V-5B 骨干之上,由条件器、隐变量初始化器、调度器、去噪器与解码器组成,并以深度模型(Depth-Anything 的 DA3)作为几何依赖。主体参考图是可选的——可以不给、给一张,或给少量裁剪图,运行时每次请求最多使用两张参考。生成按块进行(每块新增 84 帧、消耗 84 个相机位姿),支持长时程 rollout。
在 WorldFoundry 中,你提供一张起始图片、一条相机轨迹,以及可选的一或多张主体参考图;pipeline 便生成第三人称 rollout,以 1280×704、16 fps 导出帧序列。

whenToUse.en: Use this model for camera-steered, third-person world exploration from an image, especially when you want a protagonist to stay consistent via subject-reference images across a long rollout.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想从图片出发做相机可控的第三人称世界探索,尤其希望通过主体参考图让主角在长 rollout 中保持一致时,适合使用该模型。

notFor.en: The released weights are the 25-step base model, not a few-step real-time distilled version, so generation is not real-time. The runtime uses at most two subject references per request, its depth dependency (DA3) carries a separate non-commercial license, and checkpoints are downloaded separately.
notFor.zh: 当前发布的是 25 步基础模型,而非少步实时蒸馏版本,因此生成并非实时。运行时每次请求最多使用两张主体参考,其深度依赖(DA3)带有单独的非商用许可,Checkpoint 需单独下载。

Camera-steered, third-person generation with subject-reference support
Long-horizon rollouts built block by block (84 new frames per block)
Output: 1280×704 frames at 16 fps; depth dependency (DA3) is non-commercial

en: MMAudio generates audio to accompany video. Give it a silent clip and it produces a matching soundtrack; give it a text prompt and it synthesizes audio to match the description.

It's a multimodal audio generation model that conditions on video (and text) to produce sound that tracks what's happening on screen, which makes it a natural companion to video generators that output silent clips.
In WorldFoundry you run MMAudio through the shared pipeline for video-to-audio or text-to-audio, pairing it with a generated video to add sound.

它是一个多模态音频生成模型,以视频(以及文字)为条件,产出与画面内容对应的声音,因而是那些只输出无声片段的视频生成模型的天然搭档。
在 WorldFoundry 中,你通过统一 pipeline 运行 MMAudio,做视频转音频或文生音频,与生成的视频配合以补上声音。

whenToUse.en: Use MMAudio to add a synchronized soundtrack to a silent video, or to generate audio from a text description — a useful finishing step after generating video.

tagline.en: MVDiffusion — correspondence-aware multi-view image generation for consistent panoramas and scene texturing.
tagline.zh: MVDiffusion——具备对应关系感知的多视图图像生成,用于一致的全景与场景纹理化。

en: MVDiffusion is a multi-view image generation method from researchers at Simon Fraser University and ByteDance. It generates multiple views of a scene together — for tasks like holistic panorama generation and scene texturing — rather than one image at a time.

Its key idea is correspondence-awareness: the model reasons about how pixels correspond across views so the generated images stay geometrically consistent with one another. This makes it well-suited to producing coherent panoramas and applying textures across a 3D scene.

In WorldFoundry, MVDiffusion runs through an in-tree subprocess adapter over the upstream source. You supply the inputs and it produces multi-view results; the required source checkout, checkpoints, and CUDA dependencies are reported at inference time if missing.
zh: MVDiffusion 是来自西蒙弗雷泽大学与字节跳动研究者的多视图图像生成方法。它一次性协同生成场景的多个视图——用于全景生成、场景纹理化等任务——而非逐张出图。
其核心思想是对应关系感知:模型会推理像素在不同视图间如何对应,使生成的多张图像在几何上彼此一致。这让它很适合产出连贯的全景,以及在 3D 场景上铺设纹理。
在 WorldFoundry 中,MVDiffusion 通过内置的子进程适配器在上游源码上运行。你提供输入,它便产出多视图结果;若缺少所需的源码检出、checkpoint 或 CUDA 依赖,会在推理时报告。

whenToUse.en: Use MVDiffusion when you need multiple, mutually-consistent views of a scene — generating panoramas or texturing a 3D scene where cross-view geometric consistency matters.
whenToUse.zh: 当你需要一个场景的多张、彼此一致的视图时——例如生成全景或为 3D 场景铺纹理,而跨视图的几何一致性很重要——适合使用 MVDiffusion。

notFor.en: It's a research method, not a plug-and-play video generator; it requires the upstream source checkout, checkpoints, and CUDA dependencies staged locally before it can render.
notFor.zh: 它是一种研究方法,而非即插即用的视频生成器;渲染前需在本地准备好上游源码检出、checkpoint 与 CUDA 依赖。

Runs via an in-tree subprocess adapter over the upstream source

tagline.en: NVIDIA GEAR's DreamZero — an Apache-2.0 world-action model that predicts video and robot actions from camera observations.
tagline.zh: NVIDIA GEAR 的 DreamZero——Apache-2.0 许可的世界-动作模型,从相机观测预测视频与机器人动作。

en: DreamZero is an embodied world-action model from NVIDIA's GEAR-Dreams, released under Apache-2.0. It takes camera and proprioceptive observations from a robot and predicts both future video and the actions to take, making it a policy for real-world manipulation.

It ships in two checkpoints — one trained on DROID and one on AgiBot — and builds on a Wan2.1-I2V-14B video backbone with a UMT5 text encoder. In WorldFoundry the default 14B server runs across two CUDA ranks, while a lighter Wan2.2 5B entrypoint can run on a single rank. The policy follows the DROID/RoboArena observation contract: two external cameras, a wrist camera, joint and gripper positions, and a prompt.
In WorldFoundry, DreamZero runs as a distributed policy server that a WebSocket client drives; it emits action-trace artifacts and preserves the predicted-video contract in metadata.
zh: DreamZero 是 NVIDIA GEAR-Dreams 推出的具身世界-动作模型,采用 Apache-2.0 许可。它接收机器人的相机与本体感知观测,同时预测未来视频与要执行的动作,可作为真实世界操作任务的策略。

它提供两个 checkpoint——一个在 DROID 上训练、一个在 AgiBot 上训练——构建于 Wan2.1-I2V-14B 视频骨干之上,配 UMT5 文本编码器。在 WorldFoundry 中,默认 14B 服务跨两个 CUDA rank 运行,而更轻量的 Wan2.2 5B 入口可在单个 rank 上运行。该策略遵循 DROID/RoboArena 观测约定:两路外部相机、一路腕部相机、关节与夹爪位置,以及提示词。
在 WorldFoundry 中,DreamZero 作为分布式策略服务运行,由 WebSocket 客户端驱动;它产出 action-trace 产物,并在元数据中保留预测视频的约定。

whenToUse.en: Use DreamZero when you want an embodied world-action policy that predicts both video and robot actions from multi-camera observations, in the DROID/RoboArena setup.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想要一个具身的世界-动作策略,在 DROID/RoboArena 设定下从多相机观测同时预测视频与机器人动作时,适合使用 DreamZero。

notFor.en: It's a robot policy, not a general text-to-video generator, and expects the DROID/RoboArena observation setup. Checkpoint-backed execution needs a staged DROID or AgiBot checkpoint and a compatible multi-GPU CUDA topology.
notFor.zh: 它是机器人策略,而非通用的文生视频生成器,并需要 DROID/RoboArena 的观测设定。基于 checkpoint 的运行需要就位的 DROID 或 AgiBot checkpoint,以及兼容的多 GPU CUDA 拓扑。

Predicts both future video and robot actions
DROID and AgiBot checkpoints on a Wan2.1-I2V-14B backbone
Runs as a distributed policy server driven over WebSocket

tagline.en: NVIDIA GR00T — a vision-language-action foundation model for generalist humanoid and robot policies.
tagline.zh: NVIDIA GR00T——面向通用人形机器人与机器人策略的视觉-语言-动作基础模型。

en: GR00T is NVIDIA's vision-language-action (VLA) foundation model for robots, from the Isaac GR00T project. It takes camera views, robot state, and a language instruction, and outputs the actions a humanoid or generalist robot should take.

WorldFoundry integrates the N1 line, including a 2B model and an N1.7 checkpoint fine-tuned on the LIBERO benchmark, with a Cosmos-Reason2-2B backbone as its vision-language component. It runs from a flattened in-tree package with checkpoint-hosted Python disabled, so only trusted local code executes.

In WorldFoundry you run GR00T as a policy — feed it observations and an instruction, and it produces action rollouts. The staged assets carry only the runtime subset needed, and inference performs no download.
zh: GR00T 是 NVIDIA 面向机器人的视觉-语言-动作(VLA)基础模型,出自 Isaac GR00T 项目。它接收相机视图、机器人状态与一条语言指令,输出人形或通用机器人应执行的动作。
WorldFoundry 接入了 N1 系列,包括一个 2B 模型和在 LIBERO 基准上微调的 N1.7 checkpoint,以 Cosmos-Reason2-2B 作为其视觉-语言骨干。它从扁平化的内置包运行,并禁用 checkpoint 内托管的 Python,因此只执行受信任的本地代码。
在 WorldFoundry 中,你把 GR00T 作为策略运行——给它观测与指令,它便产出动作 rollout。就位的资产只含所需的运行时子集,推理过程不进行下载。

whenToUse.en: Use GR00T when you want a vision-language-action policy for humanoid or generalist robot control, driving actions from camera observations and a language instruction.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想要一个用于人形或通用机器人控制的视觉-语言-动作策略,从相机观测与语言指令驱动动作时,适合使用 GR00T。

tagline.en: A generalist robot policy from Berkeley's RAIL lab — one transformer that drives many robots from camera views and language instructions.
tagline.zh: 来自伯克利 RAIL 实验室的通用机器人策略——用一个 transformer,根据摄像头画面与语言指令驱动多种机器人。

en: Octo is an open generalist robot policy from the RAIL lab at UC Berkeley. Instead of training a separate controller for every robot and task, it learns a single transformer that maps camera observations and a language instruction to robot actions, and it was designed to transfer across a wide range of embodiments.

It ships in two sizes — octo-small and octo-base (the 1.5 releases) — so you can trade capacity for speed. At inference the policy consumes the recent observation history and emits an action chunk, i.e. a short sequence of future actions, which is the standard way these policies keep motion smooth.
In WorldFoundry, Octo runs as an embodied action policy: you give it observations and an instruction, and it rolls out actions rather than generating pixels or video.
zh: Octo 是加州大学伯克利分校 RAIL 实验室推出的开放通用机器人策略。它不为每个机器人和任务单独训练控制器,而是学习一个 transformer,把摄像头观测和语言指令映射为机器人动作,并且从设计之初就着眼于在多种机器人本体间迁移。
它提供两种规模——octo-small 与 octo-base(均为 1.5 版本),便于在容量与速度之间权衡。推理时,策略读取近期的观测历史,输出一个 action chunk(即一小段未来动作序列),这也是这类策略保持动作连贯的常规做法。
在 WorldFoundry 中,Octo 作为具身动作策略运行:你提供观测与指令,它输出的是一串动作,而非图像或视频。

whenToUse.en: Reach for Octo when you want an open, pretrained starting point for robot manipulation or generalist control — either evaluated directly or fine-tuned onto your own robot and action space.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想要一个开放的、预训练的机器人操控或通用控制起点时,可以选择 Octo——既可直接评测,也可微调到你自己的机器人与动作空间上。

notFor.en: Not a video or image generator — it produces robot actions, so it only makes sense inside a robot or simulation setup with a matching observation and action space.

en: OmniVinci is an omni-modal understanding model from NVIDIA. Rather than generating media, it reasons over what you give it — an image, a video clip, or an audio track — and answers questions about the content in natural language.

It handles a spread of tasks under one model: general multimodal reasoning, audio reasoning, image question answering, and video question answering. That makes it a single entry point when your input mixes several modalities and you want a unified answer.

In WorldFoundry, OmniVinci runs as an understanding route: you supply media plus a question or instruction, and it returns a text response. Model assets are fetched from the published checkpoint before a run.
zh: OmniVinci 是 NVIDIA 推出的全模态理解模型。它不生成媒体,而是对你给出的内容——图像、视频片段或音频——进行推理,并用自然语言回答与内容相关的问题。
它用一个模型覆盖多类任务:通用多模态推理、音频推理、图像问答与视频问答。当输入混合了多种模态、你又希望得到统一答案时,它就是一个便捷的入口。
在 WorldFoundry 中,OmniVinci 作为理解路径运行:你提供媒体加上一个问题或指令,它返回文本回答。运行前会从发布的 checkpoint 拉取模型资产。

whenToUse.en: Use OmniVinci when you need to ask questions about images, video, or audio — captioning, content Q&A, or reasoning that spans more than one modality at once.
whenToUse.zh: 当你需要就图像、视频或音频提问时——如描述生成、内容问答,或跨越多种模态的推理——可以使用 OmniVinci。

notFor.en: Not a generator: it does not create images or video, only understands and answers about them. It needs its checkpoint and assets available before running.
notFor.zh: 它不是生成器:不会创建图像或视频,只做理解与问答。运行前需要准备好其 checkpoint 与资产。

Text-out understanding route, not a media generator

tagline.en: TencentARC's open reimplementation of MAGVIT2 — an Apache-2.0 visual tokenizer plus autoregressive class-conditional image generation.
tagline.zh: TencentARC 对 MAGVIT2 的开源复现——Apache-2.0 许可的视觉 tokenizer,配合自回归的类别条件图像生成。

en: Open-MAGVIT2 is TencentARC's open reproduction of the MAGVIT2 approach. At its heart is a powerful visual tokenizer that turns images into discrete tokens; on top of that sits an autoregressive model that generates images token by token.

The released route does class-conditional image generation: you pick an ImageNet class and the model synthesizes a matching image at the standard 256×256 output size. It is autoregressive rather than a prompt-to-video pipeline, so it fits token-based generation and tokenizer research.
In WorldFoundry, Open-MAGVIT2 runs as an in-tree class-conditional image generator — choose a class label and it writes out a PNG.
zh: Open-MAGVIT2 是 TencentARC 对 MAGVIT2 方法的开源复现。其核心是一个强大的视觉 tokenizer,把图像转成离散 token;在此之上是一个自回归模型,逐 token 生成图像。
发布的路径做类别条件图像生成:你选定一个 ImageNet 类别,模型即以标准的 256×256 尺寸合成对应图像。它是自回归方式,而非从提示词直接到视频的流程,因此适合基于 token 的生成与 tokenizer 研究。
在 WorldFoundry 中,Open-MAGVIT2 作为内置的类别条件图像生成器运行——选一个类别标签,它就输出一张 PNG。

whenToUse.en: Use Open-MAGVIT2 when you want an openly-licensed visual tokenizer or a reference for token-based autoregressive image generation, including class-conditional ImageNet synthesis.
whenToUse.zh: 当你需要一个开放许可的视觉 tokenizer,或需要基于 token 的自回归图像生成参考(含 ImageNet 类别条件合成)时,可以使用 Open-MAGVIT2。

notFor.en: Not a text-to-image or text-to-video model — the released route is class-conditional (ImageNet labels), so it isn't driven by free-form prompts.
notFor.zh: 它不是文生图或文生视频模型——发布的路径是类别条件(ImageNet 标签),不接受自由文本提示词驱动。

en: Open-Sora is HPC-AI Tech's open effort to make high-quality text-to-video generation accessible. You give it a text prompt and it produces a short video clip, with weights released under Apache-2.0.

The pipeline pairs an STDiT diffusion transformer (the STDiT-v3 checkpoint) with a dedicated video VAE (OpenSora-VAE-v1.2) that compresses and reconstructs video latents; an earlier high-quality STDiT-v1 checkpoint is also available. In WorldFoundry, Open-Sora runs through the shared pipeline — supply a prompt, and it renders a video.
zh: Open-Sora 是 HPC-AI Tech 让高质量文生视频更易获得的开源项目。你给它一段文字提示词,它生成一段短视频片段,权重以 Apache-2.0 许可发布。

在 WorldFoundry 中,Open-Sora 通过统一 pipeline 运行——给出提示词,它就渲染出一段视频。

tagline.zh: Physical Intelligence 开源的 π(pi)系列视觉-语言-动作策略——面向真实机器人的流式通用控制器。

en: OpenPI is Physical Intelligence's open release of its π family of vision-language-action (VLA) policies. These models take camera views and a language instruction and output robot actions, aiming at generalist manipulation rather than a single hard-coded skill.

The release covers several variants — including pi0-base, the LIBERO-tuned pi05-libero, and the faster pi0-fast-base and pi0-fast-droid checkpoints — so you can pick between broad pretrained policies and ones adapted to specific benchmarks or robots. Runtime construction expects complete, locally staged checkpoints.
In WorldFoundry, OpenPI runs as an embodied policy: it consumes observations and an instruction and produces an action trace and rollout, not video or images.
zh: OpenPI 是 Physical Intelligence 开源的 π 系列视觉-语言-动作(VLA)策略。这类模型读取摄像头画面与语言指令,输出机器人动作,目标是通用操控而非单一写死的技能。
此次发布包含多个变体——如 pi0-base、面向 LIBERO 调优的 pi05-libero,以及更快的 pi0-fast-base 与 pi0-fast-droid,便于你在宽泛的预训练策略与针对特定基准或机器人适配的版本之间选择。运行时构建需要完整、已在本地准备好的 checkpoint。
在 WorldFoundry 中,OpenPI 作为具身策略运行:它读取观测与指令,产出的是动作轨迹与 rollout,而非视频或图像。

whenToUse.en: Use OpenPI when you want state-of-the-art open VLA policies as a base for robot manipulation — evaluated on benchmarks like LIBERO or adapted to your own hardware.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想以先进的开放 VLA 策略作为机器人操控基础时,可以使用 OpenPI——既可在 LIBERO 等基准上评测,也可适配到你自己的硬件。

notFor.en: Not a media generator — it outputs robot actions and needs a robot or simulator with matching action space. Checkpoints must be prepared locally before a run.
notFor.zh: 它不是媒体生成器——输出的是机器人动作,需要动作空间匹配的机器人或仿真环境。运行前须在本地准备好 checkpoint。

tagline.en: A Wan2.2-based video generator — text-to-video, image-to-video, and video extension from one pipeline.
tagline.zh: 基于 Wan2.2 的视频生成器——用一个 pipeline 实现文生视频、图生视频与视频扩展。

en: Pusa VidGen (Pusa V1) is a video generation model that builds on the Wan2.2 architecture. It covers several jobs from one pipeline: turning a text prompt into video, animating a still image, and extending an existing clip with more motion.

It assembles from the Wan2.2 denoisers, conditioner, and VAE, with the Pusa-Wan2.2-V1 weights on top; it can also draw on the Wan2.2 base and Lightning weights. This lets it reuse a mature video backbone while adding its own capabilities.

In WorldFoundry, Pusa VidGen runs through a dedicated pipeline that writes out a generated video when you explicitly request execution — provide a prompt (and an image for image-to-video, or a clip to extend).
zh: Pusa VidGen(Pusa V1)是一个基于 Wan2.2 架构的视频生成模型。它用一个 pipeline 覆盖多项任务:把文字提示词生成为视频、让静态图片动起来,以及为已有片段续接更多动作。
它由 Wan2.2 的去噪器、条件模块与 VAE 组装而成,并在其上加载 Pusa-Wan2.2-V1 权重;它还可借助 Wan2.2 base 与 Lightning 权重。这让它在复用成熟视频骨干的同时,加入自有能力。
在 WorldFoundry 中,Pusa VidGen 通过专属 pipeline 运行,当你明确请求执行时输出生成的视频——给出提示词(图生视频再加一张图,或提供一段待扩展的片段)。

whenToUse.en: Use Pusa VidGen when you want text-to-video, image-to-video, and clip extension from a single Wan2.2-based pipeline.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想用一个基于 Wan2.2 的 pipeline 同时实现文生视频、图生视频与片段扩展时,可以使用 Pusa VidGen。

notFor.en: It relies on Wan2.2 base weights alongside its own, so plan for staging those checkpoints. The pipeline only produces video when execution is explicitly requested.
notFor.zh: 它在自有权重之外还依赖 Wan2.2 base 权重,请预留准备这些 checkpoint 的时间。pipeline 仅在明确请求执行时才产出视频。

en: Built on the Wan2.2 video architecture
Text-to-video, image-to-video, and video extension in one pipeline
Reuses Wan2.2 denoisers, conditioner, and VAE
Can leverage Wan2.2 base and Lightning weights

文生视频、图生视频与视频扩展同在一个 pipeline

Text, image, audio, and video in one model

tagline.en: Autoregressive video diffusion for long clips — generates extended text-to-video by rolling generation forward frame block by frame block.
tagline.zh: 面向长片段的自回归视频扩散——逐帧块向前推进,生成较长的文生视频。

en: RollingForcing is an autoregressive video diffusion model built for long video generation. Where many models render a fixed short clip in one shot, it rolls generation forward over time, producing extended text-to-video sequences block by block.

It builds on a causal variant of the Wan2.1 backbone and uses an attention-sink KV cache to keep earlier context in view as the video grows longer, following a rolling multi-frame block scheme. The released route is text-to-video, driven by a prompt, and runs in BF16.
In WorldFoundry, RollingForcing runs as an inference-only long-video route — give it a prompt and it decodes a long clip at 832×480, 16 fps.
zh: RollingForcing 是一个面向长视频生成的自回归视频扩散模型。许多模型一次性渲染出固定的短片,而它随时间向前滚动生成,按帧块逐段产出较长的文生视频序列。
它构建在 Wan2.1 骨干的因果变体之上,采用 attention-sink KV 缓存,在视频变长时保留早期上下文,遵循滚动的多帧块方案。发布的路径是由提示词驱动的文生视频,以 BF16 运行。
在 WorldFoundry 中,RollingForcing 作为仅推理的长视频路径运行——给它提示词,它就解码出一段 832×480、16 fps 的长片段。

whenToUse.en: Use RollingForcing when you want long, continuous text-to-video rather than a fixed short clip — for research on extended autoregressive video generation.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想要长而连续的文生视频、而非固定短片时,可以使用 RollingForcing——适合扩展式自回归视频生成的研究。

notFor.en: Licensed for academic use only — commercial and production use is not permitted. It also needs BF16 and enough GPU memory, so low-memory cards may struggle.
notFor.zh: 仅授权学术使用——不允许商用与生产使用。它还需要 BF16 与足够的显存,低显存显卡可能吃力。

en: Autoregressive video diffusion aimed at long clips
Causal Wan2.1 backbone with attention-sink KV cache
Text-to-video output at 832×480, 16 fps
Academic-use-only license
zh: 面向长片段的自回归视频扩散
因果 Wan2.1 骨干配合 attention-sink KV 缓存

whenToUse.en: Use SAMA 14B when you need to edit existing video with reference-image or mask guidance rather than generate a clip from a text prompt alone.
whenToUse.zh: 当你需要在参考图或掩码引导下编辑已有视频,而非仅凭文本提示词生成片段时,可以使用 SAMA 14B。

tagline.zh: Segment and Track Anything——结合 SAM、GroundingDINO 与 AOT 的视频分割与目标跟踪先验。

en: Segment and Track Anything is a video segmentation and object-tracking system, used in WorldFoundry as a perception prior. Rather than generating media, it finds objects in a video and follows them across frames, producing masks and tracks.

It combines several well-known components: SAM for segmentation, GroundingDINO for text-grounded detection (so you can name what to segment), and AOT/DeAOT for propagating masks through a video. That mix lets it segment and track objects with or without explicit prompts.
In WorldFoundry, it is exposed through the shared geometry-prior contract — feed it a video and it returns segmentation and tracking outputs that downstream 3D/4D and generation steps can build on.
zh: Segment and Track Anything 是一个视频分割与目标跟踪系统,在 WorldFoundry 中用作感知先验。它不生成媒体,而是在视频中找出目标并跨帧跟随,产出掩码与轨迹。
它结合了几个知名组件:用于分割的 SAM、用于文本 grounding 检测的 GroundingDINO(让你可以用名称指定要分割的对象),以及用于在视频中传播掩码的 AOT/DeAOT。这一组合让它在有或没有显式提示的情况下都能分割并跟踪目标。
在 WorldFoundry 中,它通过共享的几何先验契约暴露——输入一段视频,它返回分割与跟踪结果,供下游的 3D/4D 与生成步骤使用。

whenToUse.en: Use this prior when you need to segment and track objects through a video — masks and object trajectories to feed downstream 3D/4D or generation pipelines.
whenToUse.zh: 当你需要在视频中分割并跟踪目标——获得掩码与目标轨迹以供下游 3D/4D 或生成流程使用时,可以使用这个先验。

notFor.en: Not a generative model — it outputs segmentation and tracks, not new video or images. Real inference needs its component checkpoints and assets available.
notFor.zh: 它不是生成模型——输出的是分割与轨迹,而非新的视频或图像。真正推理需要准备好其各组件的 checkpoint 与资产。

tagline.en: Autoregressive video diffusion for fast, streaming generation — real-time-oriented text-to-video and image-to-video.
tagline.zh: 面向快速、流式生成的自回归视频扩散——偏实时的文生视频与图生视频。

en: Self-Forcing is an autoregressive video diffusion model designed for fast, streaming generation. It generates video frame by frame in a way aimed at real-time throughput, rather than rendering a whole clip in a single batched pass.

It supports both text-to-video and image-to-video, and is distributed with code and weights. It relies on local Wan2.1 weights under the expected layout, and the Self-Forcing checkpoint (self_forcing_dmd.pt) on top.

In WorldFoundry, Self-Forcing runs the vendored official inference path — supply a prompt (and an image for image-to-video), and it produces a video. Checkpoint paths default to the standard layout and can be overridden if staged elsewhere.
zh: Self-Forcing 是一个面向快速、流式生成的自回归视频扩散模型。它逐帧生成视频,目标是实时吞吐,而不是一次性批量渲染整段片段。
它同时支持文生视频与图生视频,并以代码加权重的形式发布。它依赖按预期布局放置的本地 Wan2.1 权重,并在其上加载 Self-Forcing checkpoint(self_forcing_dmd.pt)。
在 WorldFoundry 中,Self-Forcing 运行内置的官方推理路径——给出提示词(图生视频再加一张图),它就产出视频。checkpoint 路径默认使用标准布局,如放在别处可覆盖设置。

whenToUse.en: Use Self-Forcing when you want fast, streaming-style video generation from text or an image, including experiments toward real-time output.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想从文本或图片做快速、流式风格的视频生成(包括面向实时输出的实验)时,可以使用 Self-Forcing。

notFor.en: It needs local Wan2.1 weights staged in a compatible layout alongside its own checkpoint — set those up before a run.

tagline.en: Skywork's 14B reference-to-video model — generates video guided by a reference image, with audio and video-to-video routes.
tagline.zh: Skywork 的 14B 参考图生视频模型——以参考图引导生成视频,并支持音频与视频到视频路径。

en: SkyReels V3 is Skywork's video generation model, released here as the 14B reference-to-video (R2V) checkpoint. It generates video guided by a reference image, using dual text-and-image conditioning so both a prompt and a reference shape the output.

Beyond reference-to-video, its tasks span audio-guided video and video-to-video generation. Under the hood it builds on a Wan-style network with a UMT5 text conditioner, a latent codec, and a UniPC scheduler, and it loads directly into the shared native graph.
In WorldFoundry, SkyReels V3 runs through the shared diffusion runner — provide a reference image and prompt (and, for the relevant routes, audio or a source video), and it renders a clip.
zh: SkyReels V3 是 Skywork 的视频生成模型,此处以 14B 参考图生视频(R2V)checkpoint 发布。它以参考图引导生成视频,采用文本与图像双重条件,让提示词和参考图共同塑造输出。
除参考图生视频外,它的任务还涵盖音频引导视频与视频到视频生成。其内部构建在 Wan 风格网络之上,配有 UMT5 文本条件模块、latent 编解码器与 UniPC 调度器,并直接加载到共享的原生图中。
在 WorldFoundry 中,SkyReels V3 通过共享扩散 runner 运行——提供参考图与提示词(相应路径下再加音频或源视频),它就渲染出片段。

whenToUse.en: Use SkyReels V3 when you want video generation anchored to a reference image, or need audio-guided or video-to-video routes in one model.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想让视频生成锚定到一张参考图,或需要在一个模型里使用音频引导或视频到视频路径时,可以使用 SkyReels V3。

notFor.en: The reference-to-video route expects a reference image, so it isn't a pure prompt-only generator. At 14B, plan for adequate GPU memory.
notFor.zh: 参考图生视频路径需要一张参考图,因此它不是纯提示词生成器。14B 规模请预留充足的显存。

tagline.en: Skywork's open video family with FPS-conditioned generation, spanning a lightweight 1.3B and a higher-fidelity 14B for text-to-video and image-to-video.
tagline.zh: Skywork 开源的视频模型家族，支持 FPS 条件生成，涵盖轻量 1.3B 与更高保真的 14B，覆盖文生视频与图生视频。

en: SkyReels-V2 is Skywork's open-weight video generation family. It turns a text prompt into a short video, and can also animate a still image into motion.

The lineup comes in two sizes so you can trade quality for hardware: a lightweight 1.3B at 540p and a larger 14B at 720p, each available for both text-to-video and image-to-video. The generation is built on an FPS-conditioned diffusion approach related to the Wan video architecture, pairing a text conditioner, a video VAE, and a diffusion denoiser.
In WorldFoundry you run SkyReels-V2 through the shared pipeline — pick a checkpoint, give it a prompt (and a reference image for image-to-video), and it writes out a video clip.
zh: SkyReels-V2 是 Skywork 开源权重的视频生成模型家族。它可以把一段文字提示词生成为短视频，也能让一张静态图片动起来。
该系列提供两种规模，方便你在画质与硬件间权衡：540p 的轻量 1.3B 与 720p 的更大 14B，且文生视频、图生视频两条路径都各有对应 checkpoint。其生成基于与 Wan 视频架构相关的 FPS 条件扩散方法，由文本条件器、视频 VAE 与扩散去噪器组合而成。
在 WorldFoundry 中，你通过统一 pipeline 运行 SkyReels-V2——选一个 checkpoint，给它提示词（图生视频再加一张参考图），它就会输出一段视频。

whenToUse.en: A good open choice when you want text-to-video or image-to-video and would like to trade off between the lighter 540p 1.3B and the higher-fidelity 720p 14B depending on your hardware.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想做文生视频或图生视频，并希望根据硬件在更轻量的 540p 1.3B 与更高保真的 720p 14B 之间取舍时，它是不错的开放选择。

notFor.en: Longer clips or sustained narrative shots — outputs are short. Checkpoints are downloaded separately, so plan for the download and disk space; the weights carry a custom (non-Apache) license, so review the terms before commercial use.
notFor.zh: 不适合较长片段或需要连续叙事的镜头——输出较短。Checkpoint 需单独下载，请预留下载时间与磁盘空间；权重采用自定义（非 Apache）许可，商用前请先查阅条款。

Two sizes: 1.3B at 540p and 14B at 720p

tagline.en: A camera-controlled world model — generate and edit video along a specified camera trajectory, grounded in 3D geometry.
tagline.zh: 一个相机可控的世界模型——沿指定相机轨迹生成与编辑视频，并以 3D 几何为基础。

en: Spatia is a world model that generates video under explicit camera control. Rather than leaving camera motion to chance, you specify a trajectory and the model produces frames that follow it, keeping the scene spatially consistent as the viewpoint moves.

It combines a video generation backbone (built on Wan2.2-TI2V-5B) with a geometry component from MapAnything, which supplies dense scene structure so that camera paths can be expressed as world-to-camera trajectories. This lets it support camera-controlled video and video-to-video editing along a chosen path.

In WorldFoundry you run it through the shared pipeline — provide the inputs and a camera trajectory, and it writes out a video that follows that path. The bundled source is required, and the default MapAnything geometry checkpoint carries a research-only CC-BY-NC-4.0 license.
zh: Spatia 是一个在显式相机控制下生成视频的世界模型。相机运动不再随机，而是由你指定一条轨迹，模型生成沿该轨迹推进的画面，并在视角移动时保持场景的空间一致性。
它将视频生成骨干（基于 Wan2.2-TI2V-5B）与来自 MapAnything 的几何组件相结合，后者提供稠密的场景结构，使相机路径可以用 world-to-camera 轨迹来表达。由此它支持相机可控视频以及沿指定路径的视频到视频编辑。
在 WorldFoundry 中，你通过统一 pipeline 运行它——提供输入与相机轨迹，它就会输出一段沿该路径推进的视频。运行需要随附的源码，且默认的 MapAnything 几何 checkpoint 采用仅限研究的 CC-BY-NC-4.0 许可。

whenToUse.en: When you want video generation or editing with explicit camera control — following a chosen trajectory through a scene while keeping geometry consistent.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想在显式相机控制下进行视频生成或编辑——沿指定轨迹穿过场景、同时保持几何一致时。

notFor.en: Commercial use of the default geometry component — the MapAnything checkpoint is research-only under CC-BY-NC-4.0. Weights are downloaded separately, so plan for the download.
notFor.zh: 不适合将默认几何组件用于商业用途——MapAnything checkpoint 采用仅限研究的 CC-BY-NC-4.0 许可。权重需单独下载，请预留下载时间。

en: SpatialLadder is a compact 3B multimodal reasoning model aimed at spatial understanding. It takes an image or video together with a question and produces a reasoned answer, with particular attention to spatial relationships in the scene.

Because it is multimodal, it handles both image and video question answering as well as broader spatial-reasoning prompts, making it useful when a task hinges on where things are and how they relate in space.
In WorldFoundry you run it through the shared pipeline — provide an image or video and your question, and it returns an answer.
zh: SpatialLadder 是一个紧凑的 3B 多模态推理模型，聚焦空间理解。它接收一张图像或一段视频以及一个问题，产出经过推理的回答，尤其关注场景中的空间关系。
由于是多模态模型，它既能处理图像与视频问答，也能应对更广义的空间推理提示词，适合那些取决于物体位置及其空间关系的任务。
在 WorldFoundry 中，你通过统一 pipeline 运行它——提供一张图像或一段视频以及你的问题，它就会返回答案。

whenToUse.en: When you need a lightweight multimodal model to answer questions about images or videos where spatial relationships matter.

recipes.name: Stable Video Infinity 2.0
recipes.summary: EPFL VITA's long-video model — extends image-to-video into extended, prompt-streamed clips by continuing motion clip after clip.

notes: The runtime uses SVI 2.0's official five-motion-frame continuation and full reference padding defaults.
The official 999-clip cap is bounded to two clips per prompt unless use_first_prompt_only is explicitly enabled.
Each clip receives a distinct seed by default; prompt streams repeat each prompt twice before advancing.
The source tree contains inference code only. Wan and SVI weights are resolved from local checkpoint staging.

A full Workspace default run on an A100 loaded all seven Wan2.1-I2V-14B DiT shards, T5, CLIP, the FP32 VAE path, and all 400 released SVI 2.0 LoRA pairs. It generated two linked 81-frame, 50-step clips and removed the five-frame overlap to produce 157 frames at 832x544 and 24 FPS.

The 157-frame H.264 artifact fully decoded to a finite uint8 array. Its SHA256 is 987a9fe3d938ed835ac6d64e45acb5921520741d51e8075b24aa1fe0d9320ee9; the segment seam temporal MAE is 7.58, 0.9% above the official native clip's observed 7.51 maximum frame delta.

An exact-setting 81-frame comparison against the pinned official runtime reached 31.03 dB PSNR, 4.05 pixel MAE, and 0.993 luma correlation. The fixed single-clip artifact SHA256 is 7a5b542ec863180ef96a4ac478c6e557fa72613025d5223f09108c62e1e41b1e.
Hopper, Blackwell, and lower-memory offload configurations are explicit runtime targets, not hardware-validated claims.
The official project reports A100 80GB, CUDA 12, and Torch 2.4-2.8 testing; WorldFoundry uses its shared cu128 runtime.
FlashAttention 2.8 can be installed as an optimization, but the in-tree attention dispatcher has supported fallbacks.
xfuser is installed for the optional use_usp execution path; single-process inference leaves it unused.
FastAPI, Pydantic, and YAML are declared because Workspace dispatch imports the real workspace_job entrypoint inside the model environment.

tagline.en: EPFL VITA's long-video model — extends image-to-video into extended, prompt-streamed clips by continuing motion clip after clip.
tagline.zh: EPFL VITA 的长视频模型——通过逐片续接运动，把图生视频扩展为更长、可按提示流生成的片段。

en: Stable Video Infinity 2.0 (SVI) is a long-video generation approach from the VITA lab at EPFL. Starting from an image-to-video base, it continues motion across successive clips so that short generations chain into a longer, coherent video.

It works by continuing motion frames from one clip into the next, padding with reference frames, and advancing through a stream of prompts — letting the content evolve over time. The runtime reuses Wan2.1's image-to-video components (its DiT, T5 and CLIP encoders, and VAE) plus the released SVI LoRA weights, giving each clip its own seed so successive segments differ.

In WorldFoundry you run it through the shared pipeline — provide an input image and a prompt (or a stream of prompts), and it writes out an extended video, stitching the per-clip segments into one continuous H.264 output. The code is inference-only; Wan and SVI weights are resolved separately.
zh: Stable Video Infinity 2.0（SVI）是 EPFL VITA 实验室提出的长视频生成方法。它以图生视频为基座，在连续片段间续接运动，使多段短生成串联成一段更长、连贯的视频。
其做法是把一段片段的运动帧续接到下一段、用参考帧做填充，并沿着一串提示词推进——让内容随时间演化。运行时复用 Wan2.1 的图生视频组件（其 DiT、T5 与 CLIP 编码器以及 VAE），再加上已发布的 SVI LoRA 权重，并为每段片段分配独立随机种子，使各段之间产生差异。
在 WorldFoundry 中，你通过统一 pipeline 运行它——提供一张输入图与提示词（或一串提示词），它就会输出一段扩展视频，把逐片段拼接为一条连续的 H.264 输出。其代码为纯推理；Wan 与 SVI 权重需单独获取。

whenToUse.en: When you want longer, coherent video that goes beyond a single short clip — driven from an image and evolved through a stream of prompts.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想生成超越单段短片、更长且连贯的视频——由一张图片驱动、沿一串提示词演化时。

notFor.en: Pure text-to-video from scratch — it starts from an input image. It also relies on separately staged Wan2.1 and SVI weights, so plan for the downloads and disk space.
notFor.zh: 不适合从零开始的纯文生视频——它以输入图片为起点。它还依赖单独部署的 Wan2.1 与 SVI 权重，请预留下载时间与磁盘空间。

tagline.en: Stability AI's SEVA — generative novel view synthesis with camera control, turning input images into new camera viewpoints.
tagline.zh: Stability AI 的 SEVA——具备相机控制的生成式新视角合成，把输入图像转成新的相机视角。

en: Stable Virtual Camera (also known as SEVA) is a model from Stability AI, with authors from the University of Oxford and UC Berkeley. It performs generative novel view synthesis: given input images of a scene, it renders new views from camera positions you specify.

Unlike purely geometric reprojection, it generates the new viewpoints, so it can fill in content that was not directly visible in the inputs while following your requested camera control. This makes it useful for exploring a captured scene from fresh angles.

In WorldFoundry you run it through the shared pipeline via the upstream demo entrypoint — provide input images and target camera parameters, and it renders the synthesized views. The checkpoint is gated on Hugging Face, so you need approved access to download it.
zh: Stable Virtual Camera（又名 SEVA）是 Stability AI 的模型，作者来自牛津大学与加州大学伯克利分校。它执行生成式新视角合成：给定一个场景的输入图像，它能从你指定的相机位置渲染出新的视角。
与纯粹的几何重投影不同，它是生成新视角，因此能补全输入中并未直接可见的内容，同时遵循你请求的相机控制。这让它很适合从全新角度探索已拍摄的场景。
在 WorldFoundry 中，你通过统一 pipeline、经由上游 demo 入口运行它——提供输入图像与目标相机参数，它就会渲染出合成视角。该 checkpoint 在 Hugging Face 上受限，需获批访问后方可下载。

whenToUse.en: When you want to synthesize new camera viewpoints of a scene from input images, with control over the target camera — going beyond what strict geometric reprojection can show.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想从输入图像合成场景的新相机视角、并对目标相机加以控制——超越严格几何重投影所能呈现的内容时。

notFor.en: Open, ungated use — the checkpoint is gated on Hugging Face, so you must request and be granted access before running.
notFor.zh: 不适合开放、无门槛的使用——该 checkpoint 在 Hugging Face 上受限，运行前你需申请并获批访问。

en: Step-Video-T2V is StepFun's open text-to-video model, released under the permissive MIT license. It turns a text prompt into a generated video clip.

Under the hood it combines a DiT-based denoiser, StepFun's own Step-LLM text encoder, a CLIP encoder, a scheduler, and a video VAE decoder. In WorldFoundry these run in-process as native role-based components on the shared diffusion runner, so prompt encoding and VAE decoding happen locally rather than through external services.
In WorldFoundry you run it through the shared pipeline — point at the checkpoint, give it a prompt, and it writes out a video.
zh: Step-Video-T2V 是 StepFun 开源的文生视频模型，采用宽松的 MIT 许可。它可以把一段文字提示词生成为视频片段。
其内部由基于 DiT 的去噪器、StepFun 自研的 Step-LLM 文本编码器、CLIP 编码器、调度器与视频 VAE 解码器组合而成。在 WorldFoundry 中，这些以原生角色化组件的形式跑在统一扩散运行器上，因此提示词编码与 VAE 解码都在本地完成，无需依赖外部服务。
在 WorldFoundry 中，你通过统一 pipeline 运行它——指向 checkpoint，给它提示词，它就会输出一段视频。

whenToUse.en: A solid open, MIT-licensed choice when you want to run text-to-video locally and prefer everything executing in-process rather than through external caption or VAE services.

en: T2V-Turbo is a text-to-video model designed for speed. It builds on the VideoCrafter2 base model and applies a T2V-Turbo LoRA that distills the sampling process, so high-quality clips can be produced in only a few denoising steps.

In WorldFoundry the two pieces stay separate as declarative inputs — the VideoCrafter2 base and the ordered T2V-Turbo LoRA — and are assembled on the shared native diffusion runner with its LVDM components, checkpoint loader, and offload policy.

在 WorldFoundry 中，这两部分作为声明式输入保持独立——VideoCrafter2 基座与有序的 T2V-Turbo LoRA——并在统一原生扩散运行器上组装，配合其 LVDM 组件、checkpoint 加载器与显存卸载策略。
在 WorldFoundry 中，你通过统一 pipeline 运行它——提供基座与 LoRA，给它提示词，它就会输出一段视频。

whenToUse.en: When you want fast text-to-video generation with few denoising steps, and are comfortable supplying the VideoCrafter2 base together with the T2V-Turbo LoRA.

tagline.en: UniDepth V2 — a monocular metric depth estimator used as a geometry prior, predicting real-scale depth from a single image.
tagline.zh: UniDepth V2——用作几何先验的单目度量深度估计器，从单张图像预测真实尺度的深度。

en: UniDepth V2 estimates depth from a single image. Beyond relative depth, it predicts metric depth — depth in real-world scale — which makes it suitable as a geometry prior that other parts of a pipeline can build on.

In WorldFoundry it is exposed as an independent geometry prior through a shared geometry-prior contract, so a depth or point-cloud output can feed downstream 3D and 4D tasks. The default checkpoint is a ViT-L/14 backbone, resolved from Hugging Face or from a local path you provide.
In WorldFoundry you enable it as a prior — give it an image, and it produces the depth estimate and can export the corresponding points.
zh: UniDepth V2 从单张图像估计深度。它不仅给出相对深度，还预测度量深度——即真实世界尺度的深度——因此很适合用作几何先验，供 pipeline 中其他环节在其之上构建。
在 WorldFoundry 中，它通过统一的几何先验契约作为独立几何先验暴露出来，深度或点云输出可供下游 3D 与 4D 任务使用。默认 checkpoint 采用 ViT-L/14 骨干，可从 Hugging Face 解析或由你提供本地路径。
在 WorldFoundry 中，你把它作为先验启用——给它一张图像，它就会产出深度估计，并能导出对应的点。

whenToUse.en: When you need metric (real-scale) monocular depth from a single image as a geometry prior for downstream 3D or 4D pipelines.
whenToUse.zh: 当你需要从单张图像获得度量（真实尺度）单目深度、并作为下游 3D 或 4D pipeline 的几何先验时。

notFor.en: Commercial use — the upstream release is CC-BY-NC-4.0, so respect the non-commercial terms when enabling this prior. It is a depth estimator, not a generator.
notFor.zh: 不适合商业用途——上游发布采用 CC-BY-NC-4.0，启用该先验时请遵守其非商业条款。它是深度估计器，而非生成模型。

Usable as an independent geometry prior for 3D/4D tasks
ViT-L/14 default checkpoint
Non-commercial license (CC-BY-NC-4.0)

可作为独立几何先验用于 3D/4D 任务

tagline.en: UniK3D — a universal-camera monocular 3D estimator used as a geometry prior, handling pinhole and panoramic views alike.
tagline.zh: UniK3D——用作几何先验的通用相机单目 3D 估计器，同样适用于针孔与全景视角。

en: UniK3D estimates metric 3D structure from a single image and is designed to work across camera types — from standard pinhole images to wide-field and panoramic (360°) views. This universal-camera design is what sets it apart, letting one model handle very different capture geometries.

In WorldFoundry it is exposed as an independent geometry prior through a shared geometry-prior contract, producing depth and 3D estimates that downstream tasks can build on. It can estimate the camera automatically, while pinhole and panorama camera settings remain available as explicit overrides. The default checkpoint uses a ViT-L backbone, resolved from Hugging Face or a local path.
In WorldFoundry you enable it as a prior — give it an image, and it produces metric depth and 3D structure, adapting to the camera model.
zh: UniK3D 从单张图像估计度量 3D 结构，并被设计为可跨相机类型工作——从标准针孔图像到大视场乃至全景（360°）视角。这种通用相机设计正是它的独特之处，让一个模型能应对差异很大的成像几何。
在 WorldFoundry 中，它通过统一的几何先验契约作为独立几何先验暴露出来，产出深度与 3D 估计供下游任务构建。它可以自动估计相机，同时针孔与全景相机设置仍作为显式覆盖项保留。默认 checkpoint 采用 ViT-L 骨干，可从 Hugging Face 解析或由本地路径提供。
在 WorldFoundry 中，你把它作为先验启用——给它一张图像，它就会产出度量深度与 3D 结构，并自适应相机模型。

whenToUse.en: When you need metric monocular 3D or depth as a geometry prior and your inputs span different camera types — including wide-field or panoramic images.
whenToUse.zh: 当你需要度量的单目 3D 或深度作为几何先验、且输入涵盖不同相机类型——包括大视场或全景图像时。

notFor.en: Commercial use — the upstream release is CC-BY-NC-4.0, so respect the non-commercial terms when enabling this prior. It is a 3D/depth estimator, not a generator.
notFor.zh: 不适合商业用途——上游发布采用 CC-BY-NC-4.0，启用该先验时请遵守其非商业条款。它是 3D/深度估计器，而非生成模型。

The 2B model is built from role-based diffusion components — a DiT denoiser, a text conditioner, a scheduler, a latent initializer, and an SD3-style decoder. In WorldFoundry these are assembled natively and run on the shared diffusion pipeline.
In WorldFoundry you run it through the shared pipeline — point at the checkpoint, give it a prompt, and it writes out a video.
zh: Vchitect-2.0 T2V 是 Vchitect 项目开源的文生视频模型，采用 Apache-2.0 许可。它可以把一段文字提示词生成为视频片段。
这个 2B 模型由角色化的扩散组件构成——DiT 去噪器、文本条件器、调度器、latent 初始化器与 SD3 风格解码器。在 WorldFoundry 中，它们被原生组装并跑在统一扩散 pipeline 上。
在 WorldFoundry 中，你通过统一 pipeline 运行它——指向 checkpoint，给它提示词，它就会输出一段视频。

whenToUse.en: A good openly-licensed choice when you want a compact 2B text-to-video model to prototype with, under a permissive Apache-2.0 license.

tagline.en: Tencent ARC's camera-controlled world model — turn a single image into video you can steer with camera moves.
tagline.zh: 腾讯 ARC 的镜头可控世界模型——把一张图片生成为可用相机运动来操控的视频。

en: VerseCrafter is a world model from Tencent ARC that generates video from a still image while letting you drive the virtual camera. It sits at the intersection of image-to-video generation and 4D scene control, so instead of just animating a picture you can specify how the viewpoint moves through the scene.

It builds on a Wan2.1 text-to-video backbone and adds camera-conditioned rendering, drawing on a geometry model (MoGe) to keep the scene coherent as the camera moves. The result is video generation with explicit control over camera trajectory rather than motion left entirely to chance.

In WorldFoundry you run VerseCrafter through the shared pipeline: provide an input image and a camera path, and it renders a video that follows that viewpoint. Note that the upstream release is research-only and non-commercial, and is not intended for use in the EU.
zh: VerseCrafter 是腾讯 ARC 推出的世界模型,它从一张静态图片生成视频,同时让你操控虚拟相机。它处于图生视频与 4D 场景控制的交汇点——你不只是让画面动起来,还能指定视角如何在场景中移动。
它以 Wan2.1 文生视频骨干为基础,加入了相机条件化渲染,并借助几何模型(MoGe)在镜头移动时保持场景连贯。由此,视频生成对相机轨迹拥有明确控制,而不是把运动完全交给随机。
在 WorldFoundry 中,你通过统一 pipeline 运行 VerseCrafter:给它一张输入图片和一条相机路径,它会渲染出沿该视角运动的视频。请注意,上游发布为研究用途、非商业许可,且不适用于欧盟地区。

whenToUse.en: Reach for VerseCrafter when you want to animate a still image with deliberate camera motion — dolly, orbit, or push-in shots — rather than uncontrolled generation. It fits camera-driven and world-model exploration workflows.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想让静态图片按刻意设计的相机运动(推、拉、环绕等)动起来,而非放任式生成时,VerseCrafter 很合适。它适合以相机为主导的世界模型探索类工作流。

tagline.en: Temporally consistent video depth — the Video Depth Anything prior for stable, flicker-free depth across frames.
tagline.zh: 时序一致的视频深度——Video Depth Anything 先验,让逐帧深度稳定、无闪烁。

en: Video Depth Anything is a depth model from the Depth Anything team, used here as a geometry prior. Where single-image depth estimators tend to flicker frame to frame, this model is designed to produce depth that stays temporally consistent across a whole video.

In WorldFoundry it plugs in as an independent temporal depth prior, exposed through the shared geometry-prior interface. Reconstruction and 4D pipelines (such as VIPE-style profiles) can select it to supply per-frame depth without owning the model code themselves.
You use it as a building block rather than an end-to-end generator: feed it a video, and it returns depth maps that downstream geometry and scene-reconstruction steps can rely on.
zh: Video Depth Anything 是 Depth Anything 团队的深度模型,在这里作为几何先验使用。单张图像的深度估计往往逐帧闪烁,而该模型专为在整段视频上保持时序一致的深度而设计。
在 WorldFoundry 中,它作为一个独立的时序深度先验接入,通过统一的几何先验接口暴露。重建与 4D pipeline(例如 VIPE 类配置)可以选用它来提供逐帧深度,而无需自行维护模型代码。
它是一个构建模块而非端到端生成器:输入一段视频,它返回可供下游几何与场景重建步骤依赖的深度图。

whenToUse.en: Use it when a pipeline needs depth over video that doesn't jitter between frames — for 3D/4D reconstruction, scene geometry, or as a prior feeding other components.
whenToUse.zh: 当某条 pipeline 需要在视频上获得逐帧不抖动的深度时使用它——用于 3D/4D 重建、场景几何,或作为喂给其他组件的先验。

notFor.en: Not a video or image generator — it estimates depth, and requires its checkpoint to be available before it can run.
notFor.zh: 它不是视频或图像生成器——它做的是深度估计,且需要先备好其 checkpoint 才能运行。

en: Temporally consistent depth across an entire video
From the Depth Anything team's model lineage
Drops into the shared geometry-prior interface as a reusable component
Selectable by reconstruction / 4D pipeline profiles
zh: 整段视频上时序一致的深度
出自 Depth Anything 团队的模型脉络

tagline.en: An open video-generation family for both text-to-video and image-to-video, spanning VideoCrafter1 and VideoCrafter2.
tagline.zh: 面向文生视频与图生视频的开源视频生成家族,涵盖 VideoCrafter1 与 VideoCrafter2。

en: VideoCrafter is an open-source family of video-generation models covering both text-to-video and image-to-video. It spans the earlier VideoCrafter1 checkpoints and the newer VideoCrafter2, giving you a few routes depending on the task.

The lineup includes a VideoCrafter1 text-to-video model, a VideoCrafter1 image-to-video model, and VideoCrafter2 for text-to-video. VideoCrafter2 in particular is released under Apache-2.0 with open weights.

In WorldFoundry these run as inference-only routes: pick a checkpoint and set prompt, frame count, fps, and seed, and the shared pipeline renders the clip. Training and dataset tooling are intentionally left out — this is for generation, not fine-tuning.
zh: VideoCrafter 是一个开源视频生成模型家族,涵盖文生视频与图生视频。它跨越了较早的 VideoCrafter1 系列与较新的 VideoCrafter2,让你可以按任务选择不同路径。
阵容包括一个 VideoCrafter1 文生视频模型、一个 VideoCrafter1 图生视频模型,以及用于文生视频的 VideoCrafter2。其中 VideoCrafter2 采用 Apache-2.0 许可,权重开放。
在 WorldFoundry 中,它们以推理路径运行:选一个 checkpoint,设定提示词、帧数、fps 与随机种子,统一 pipeline 便会渲染片段。训练与数据集工具被有意省略——它面向生成,而非微调。

whenToUse.en: A good pick when you want an established open video model and need to choose between text-to-video and image-to-video. Reach for VideoCrafter2 when you want the openly-licensed text-to-video route.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想要一个成熟的开源视频模型,并需要在文生视频与图生视频之间选择时,它是不错的选择。若想走开放许可的文生视频路径,选 VideoCrafter2。

notFor.en: Not for training or fine-tuning here — only inference is packaged. Licensing on the older VideoCrafter1 checkpoints isn't stated, so check terms before commercial use.
notFor.zh: 此处不适合训练或微调——仅打包了推理。较旧的 VideoCrafter1 checkpoint 未标明许可,商用前请先确认条款。

Covers VideoCrafter1 and VideoCrafter2 checkpoints
VideoCrafter2 is Apache-2.0 with open weights
Inference-only routes with prompt, fps, frame-count, and seed controls

tagline.zh: 以托管 API 形式提供的 Wan 2.5——通过阿里云 DashScope 使用文生视频与图生视频,无需本地 GPU。

en: Wan 2.5 API is a hosted route to the Wan video model, served through Alibaba's DashScope platform rather than run locally. It covers both text-to-video and image-to-video.

Because it's a cloud service, there are no weights to download and no GPU to provision — you send a prompt (and an image for image-to-video) and receive generated video back. You supply your own DashScope API key.
In WorldFoundry you use it through the hosted-API pipeline: configure your key, choose the task, and the service handles generation on the provider side.
zh: Wan 2.5 API 是 Wan 视频模型的托管方式,通过阿里云 DashScope 平台提供,而非本地运行。它同时覆盖文生视频与图生视频。
由于是云服务,无需下载权重、也无需准备 GPU——你发送提示词(图生视频再加一张图),即可拿回生成的视频。你需要自备 DashScope API key。

tagline.en: Wan2.1 VACE — the controllable editing branch of Wan2.1 for video editing, reference-driven, and mask-guided generation.
tagline.zh: Wan2.1 VACE——Wan2.1 的可控编辑分支,支持视频编辑、参考驱动与掩码引导生成。

en: Wan2.1 VACE is the controllable-generation branch of Wan-AI's Wan2.1 video model. Rather than only generating from a prompt, it's built for editing and control: video-to-video editing, image-to-video, and generation guided by reference images or source video and masks.

It's assembled from the core Wan network with a UMT5 text conditioner, a video VAE, and the shared scheduler and runner, and comes in two sizes — a 14B checkpoint and a 1.3B diffusers variant. The 14B route defaults to a 1280×720, 81-frame, 50-step generation shape.

In WorldFoundry you can supply image references, a source video with masks, or precomputed conditioning, and it produces edited or controlled video through the shared pipeline — no separate backend required.
zh: Wan2.1 VACE 是 Wan-AI 旗下 Wan2.1 视频模型的可控生成分支。它不只是从提示词生成,更为编辑与控制而设计:视频到视频的编辑、图生视频,以及由参考图像、源视频与掩码引导的生成。
它由核心 Wan 网络搭配 UMT5 文本条件器、视频 VAE 以及统一的调度器与运行器组装而成,提供两种规模——14B checkpoint 与 1.3B 的 diffusers 变体。14B 路径的默认生成规格为 1280×720、81 帧、50 步。
在 WorldFoundry 中,你可以提供图像参考、带掩码的源视频或预先计算好的条件,它便通过统一 pipeline 产出经编辑或受控的视频——无需单独的后端。

whenToUse.en: Reach for VACE when you need control over the output — editing existing video, conditioning on reference images, or guiding generation with masks — rather than free-form text-to-video.
whenToUse.zh: 当你需要对输出加以控制时——编辑已有视频、以参考图像为条件,或用掩码引导生成——而非自由式文生视频,选 VACE。

notFor.en: Overkill if you just want plain text-to-video (base Wan2.1 is simpler). The 14B checkpoint targets 720p, 81-frame generation, so plan for the compute and download.
notFor.zh: 如果只想做普通文生视频,它就显得过重(基础版 Wan2.1 更简单)。14B checkpoint 面向 720p、81 帧生成,请预留相应算力与下载。

en: Controllable video editing, reference-driven and mask-guided generation
Two sizes: 14B and a 1.3B diffusers variant
14B default shape: 1280×720, 81 frames, 50 steps
Built on the Wan2.1 network with a UMT5 conditioner and video VAE
zh: 可控的视频编辑,支持参考驱动与掩码引导生成
两种规模:14B 与 1.3B diffusers 变体
基于 Wan2.1 网络,搭配 UMT5 条件器与视频 VAE

tagline.zh: Wan2.1-Fun 14B Control Camera——出自阿里 PAI VideoX-Fun 的镜头可控图生视频。

en: Wan2.1-Fun V1.1 14B Control Camera is a camera-controlled video model from Alibaba PAI's VideoX-Fun project, built on the Wan2.1 lineage. It generates video from an input image while letting you steer the virtual camera.

This is the dedicated 14B camera-control checkpoint: you give it a starting image and a camera trajectory, and it renders a clip that follows that viewpoint. It's the larger, higher-capacity option in the Wan2.1-Fun camera-control family.
In WorldFoundry you run it through the shared pipeline, providing the image and camera path; the checkpoint route is wired for camera-conditioned image-to-video.
zh: Wan2.1-Fun V1.1 14B Control Camera 是阿里 PAI 的 VideoX-Fun 项目推出的镜头可控视频模型,构建在 Wan2.1 脉络之上。它从输入图片生成视频,同时让你操控虚拟相机。
这是专门的 14B 相机控制 checkpoint:你给它一张起始图片和一条相机轨迹,它便渲染出沿该视角运动的片段。它是 Wan2.1-Fun 相机控制家族中容量更大的选项。
在 WorldFoundry 中,你通过统一 pipeline 运行它,提供图片与相机路径;该 checkpoint 路径为镜头条件化的图生视频而接入。

whenToUse.en: Use it when you want camera-driven image-to-video at higher capacity — deliberate dolly, orbit, or push-in shots from a starting frame, with the larger 14B model.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想要更大容量的、以相机为主导的图生视频时用它——从起始帧出发做刻意的推、拉、环绕镜头,并采用更大的 14B 模型。

notFor.en: Heavier than the smaller camera-control checkpoints, so it needs more compute. Requires the checkpoint to be downloaded before use.
notFor.zh: 比更小的相机控制 checkpoint 更重,需要更多算力。使用前需先下载 checkpoint。

Runs through the shared WorldFoundry pipeline

tagline.zh: Wan2.2——阿里 Apache-2.0 许可的新一代视频家族,覆盖文生视频、图生视频与文+图生视频。

en: Wan2.2 is the next generation of Wan-AI's open video model, versioned separately from Wan2.1 upstream. It covers text-to-video, image-to-video, and combined text-and-image-to-video, all released under Apache-2.0 with open weights.

The family comes in a few sizes: A14B checkpoints for text-to-video and for image-to-video, plus a more compact TI2V-5B that handles the combined text-and-image-to-video path. That gives you a choice between higher fidelity and lighter footprint.
In WorldFoundry you run Wan2.2 through the shared pipeline — pick a checkpoint, provide a prompt (and an image where applicable), and it renders the clip.
zh: Wan2.2 是 Wan-AI 开源视频模型的新一代,在上游与 Wan2.1 分开版本管理。它覆盖文生视频、图生视频以及文+图生视频,全部采用 Apache-2.0 许可、权重开放。
该家族提供多种规模:用于文生视频和图生视频的 A14B checkpoint,以及更紧凑、负责文+图生视频路径的 TI2V-5B。你可以在更高保真度与更轻量之间做选择。
在 WorldFoundry 中,你通过统一 pipeline 运行 Wan2.2——选一个 checkpoint,给出提示词(需要时再加一张图),它就渲染出片段。

whenToUse.en: A strong default when you want an openly-licensed, current-generation video model. Choose the A14B checkpoints for fidelity, or the 5B TI2V route when you want a lighter model that takes both text and an image.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想要一个开放许可、当前一代的视频模型时,它是有力的默认选择。追求保真度选 A14B checkpoint;想要更轻量、同时接受文字与图片的模型则选 5B 的 TI2V 路径。

notFor.en: The A14B checkpoints are large, so plan for the compute and download. Checkpoints are fetched separately rather than bundled.
notFor.zh: A14B checkpoint 较大,请预留算力与下载。Checkpoint 需单独获取而非随附。

This is the A14B checkpoint — the higher-capacity option in the Wan2.2-Fun camera-control family, aimed at more detailed results than the 5B variant. You give it a starting image and a camera trajectory, and it renders a clip that follows that viewpoint.
In WorldFoundry you run it through the shared pipeline, providing the image and camera path; the checkpoint route is wired for camera-conditioned image-to-video.

在 WorldFoundry 中,你通过统一 pipeline 运行它,提供图片与相机路径;该 checkpoint 路径为镜头条件化的图生视频而接入。

whenToUse.en: Use it when you want camera-driven image-to-video at higher capacity on the Wan2.2 base — deliberate camera moves from a starting frame with more detail than the 5B model.

tagline.en: Generate a perpetual 3D journey — wander from one scene into the next, growing a coherent world as you go.
tagline.zh: 生成一段可持续漫游的 3D 旅程——从一个场景走向下一个，边走边生长出连贯的世界。

en: WonderJourney, from Koven Yu and collaborators, generates a perpetual sequence of connected 3D scenes. Starting from a text prompt or an image, it produces a wandering journey where the camera keeps moving forward into freshly imagined, geometrically consistent surroundings.

Rather than a single static reconstruction, it repeatedly extends the scene: as the viewpoint advances it imagines what should come next and lifts it into 3D, so you can fly through a continuous world. This makes it a good fit for scene expansion and image-to-3D-world exploration.

In WorldFoundry, WonderJourney runs through the shared 3D/4D pipeline: you provide a starting prompt or image and a configuration, and it drives the generation flow to produce the journey. Some runtime assets and dependencies must be staged locally before a full run.
zh: WonderJourney 出自 Koven Yu 及其合作者，用于生成一段持续连接的 3D 场景序列。从一句文本提示词或一张图片出发，它会产出一段不断向前漫游的旅程，镜头持续推进到新想象出的、几何上保持一致的环境中。
它不是生成单个静态重建，而是反复扩展场景：随着视角前进，它想象接下来该出现什么，并将其提升到 3D，于是你可以在一个连续的世界里穿行。这让它很适合场景扩展与从图像出发的 3D 世界探索。
在 WorldFoundry 中，WonderJourney 通过共享的 3D/4D pipeline 运行：你给出起始提示词或图片以及一份配置，它便驱动生成流程产出这段旅程。完整运行前，需要在本地准备好部分运行时资源与依赖。

whenToUse.en: Reach for it when you want to generate an open-ended, fly-through 3D experience from a prompt or a single image — extending a scene outward into a continuous journey rather than reconstructing a fixed capture.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想从一句提示词或一张图片生成开放式、可穿行的 3D 体验时选择它——把一个场景不断向外扩展成连续旅程，而不是重建一次固定的采集。

notFor.en: Not a metrically-accurate reconstruction tool — it imagines new content rather than measuring a real capture. A full run needs the required runtime assets and dependencies in place.
notFor.zh: 它不是度量精确的重建工具——它是在想象新内容，而非测量真实采集。完整运行需要事先准备好所需的运行时资源与依赖。

tagline.en: Interactive 3D scene generation from a single image — build an explorable world and extend it where you look.
tagline.zh: 从单张图片进行交互式 3D 场景生成——构建可探索的世界，并在你注视的方向上扩展它。

en: WonderWorld, from authors at Stanford University and MIT, generates an interactive 3D scene from a single input image. It turns one picture into an explorable world you can move through, and lets you extend the scene in whatever direction you choose to look.

It works by reconstructing the visible content into 3D and then filling in newly revealed regions — inpainting, segmenting, and estimating depth and normals — before turning them into a 3D Gaussian representation you can render from new viewpoints. The emphasis is on interactivity: the world grows as you explore it rather than being fully generated up front.

In WorldFoundry, WonderWorld runs through the shared 3D/4D pipeline: you supply a source image and configuration, and it drives the scene-generation flow. Running it end to end requires the checkpoint and runtime assets, plus PyTorch3D-compatible extensions, to be set up locally.
zh: WonderWorld 出自斯坦福大学与麻省理工的研究者，用于从单张输入图片生成交互式 3D 场景。它把一张图片变成可以在其中穿行探索的世界，并允许你朝任意注视方向扩展场景。
它先把可见内容重建为 3D，再补全新暴露出的区域——做图像补全、分割，并估计深度与法向——随后转化为可从新视角渲染的 3D 高斯表示。它强调交互性：世界随你的探索而生长，而非一次性全部生成。
在 WorldFoundry 中，WonderWorld 通过共享的 3D/4D pipeline 运行：你提供一张源图片和配置，它便驱动场景生成流程。端到端运行需要在本地准备好 checkpoint、运行时资源以及与 PyTorch3D 兼容的扩展。

whenToUse.en: Use it when you want to turn a single image into an interactive, explorable 3D scene and grow that world outward as you navigate — for demos, prototyping, or immersive exploration.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想把单张图片变成可交互、可探索的 3D 场景，并在导航过程中把这个世界不断向外扩展时使用它——适合演示、原型与沉浸式探索。

notFor.en: Not a precise metric reconstruction of a real capture, and it has meaningful setup requirements — checkpoint and runtime assets plus PyTorch3D-compatible extensions must be available locally.
notFor.zh: 它不是对真实采集的精确度量重建，且有一定的环境要求——需在本地准备好 checkpoint、运行时资源以及与 PyTorch3D 兼容的扩展。

tagline.en: An affordance-aware vision-language-action policy — turn camera views and a language instruction into robot actions.
tagline.zh: 一个具备可供性感知的视觉-语言-动作策略——把相机视角和语言指令转化为机器人动作。

en: A1 is a vision-language-action (VLA) policy for robot manipulation. It takes what the robot sees together with a natural-language instruction and predicts the actions to carry it out — a policy you roll out step by step to complete a task.

It builds on a vision-language backbone and a dedicated action head, combining components such as a Molmo/CLIP-style visual encoder with L1, DiT, or flow-based action decoders. The runtime derives action dimensions directly from the checkpoint and validates each action-token boundary, and it loads tokenizer and checkpoint assets locally without executing checkpoint code. A LIBERO-Spatial checkpoint is available alongside a pretraining checkpoint.

In WorldFoundry, A1 runs through the embodied action pipeline rather than video generation: you pick a checkpoint, feed it observations and an instruction, and it returns an action chunk you can execute or evaluate.
zh: A1 是一个面向机器人操作的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略。它接收机器人所看到的画面以及一条自然语言指令，预测出执行任务所需的动作——这是一个你逐步展开（rollout）以完成任务的策略。

它构建在视觉-语言骨干和专用动作头之上，组合了诸如 Molmo/CLIP 风格视觉编码器与 L1、DiT 或 flow 动作解码器等组件。运行时直接从 checkpoint 推导动作维度并校验每个动作 token 的边界，且在本地加载 tokenizer 与 checkpoint 资源、不执行 checkpoint 代码。除预训练 checkpoint 外，还提供一个 LIBERO-Spatial checkpoint。
在 WorldFoundry 中，A1 走的是具身动作 pipeline，而非视频生成：选定一个 checkpoint，给它观测和指令，它便返回可执行或可评测的动作块（action chunk）。

whenToUse.en: Use it when you need a language-conditioned robot policy that maps images and an instruction to actions, with a LIBERO-Spatial checkpoint ready for manipulation tasks.
whenToUse.zh: 当你需要一个语言驱动的机器人策略、把图像与指令映射为动作时使用它，并有现成的 LIBERO-Spatial checkpoint 可用于操作任务。

notFor.en: Not a media-generation model — it outputs action traces, not images or video. To run it meaningfully you need robot observations and an instruction, plus the checkpoint assets staged locally.
notFor.zh: 它不是媒体生成模型——输出的是动作轨迹，而非图像或视频。要有意义地运行它，你需要机器人观测和指令，并在本地准备好 checkpoint 资源。

en: Affordance-aware vision-language-action policy for manipulation
Visual encoder plus L1 / DiT / flow action heads
Action dimensions derived from the checkpoint, with per-token validation

en: ABot-M0 is a vision-language-action (VLA) policy for robot manipulation, including bimanual tasks. It reads camera views, robot state and a language instruction, and predicts the actions to carry the task out.

It pairs a Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct vision-language backbone with a flow-based action expert, with optional geometry fusion, released preprocessing, and action de-normalization built in. The runtime accepts the released config and dataset-statistics layout directly and chooses its compute precision based on the GPU generation it finds. Task checkpoints are released for LIBERO, RoboCasa and RoboTwin2 environments.

In WorldFoundry, ABot-M0 runs through the embodied action pipeline rather than video generation: you pick a checkpoint matching your benchmark, feed it observations and an instruction, and it returns an action trace. Only inference components are included — training, deployment services and robot SDK code are out of scope.

tagline.en: A world-action model that couples video prediction with action generation for robot manipulation.
tagline.zh: 一个把视频预测与动作生成耦合起来的世界-动作模型，面向机器人操作。

en: AHA-WAM is a world-action model (WAM) for robot control: it jointly reasons about what the world will look like next and what actions the robot should take. It reads recent observations plus an instruction and predicts an action chunk for the task.

It runs paired video and action experts with a shared cache, keeps a six-frame history, and performs two-phase chunked inference. It builds on a Wan2.1-based video stack — a video VAE and a UMT5 text encoder — with the released RoboTwin2.0 checkpoint targeting dual-arm ALOHA-style setups. All assets load locally with strict key matching, and the compute precision and device placement adapt to the available GPUs.

In WorldFoundry, AHA-WAM runs through the embodied action pipeline rather than video generation: you feed it multi-view camera observations and robot state, and it returns an open-loop action chunk. Trainers, datasets, simulators and deployment servers are out of scope.
zh: AHA-WAM 是一个面向机器人控制的世界-动作模型（WAM）：它同时推理世界接下来会是什么样子，以及机器人该采取什么动作。它读取近期观测加一条指令，为任务预测出一个动作块。
它运行成对的视频专家与动作专家、共享同一缓存，保留六帧历史，并执行两阶段的分块推理。它构建在基于 Wan2.1 的视频栈之上——视频 VAE 与 UMT5 文本编码器——已发布的 RoboTwin2.0 checkpoint 面向双臂 ALOHA 风格配置。所有资源以严格键匹配在本地加载，计算精度与设备放置会根据可用 GPU 自适应。
在 WorldFoundry 中，AHA-WAM 走的是具身动作 pipeline，而非视频生成：你给它多视角相机观测和机器人状态，它便返回一个开环动作块。训练器、数据集、仿真器与部署服务不在其中。

whenToUse.zh: 当你想要一个在预测视频的同时给出机器人动作的世界-动作模型、用于双臂操作时使用它——例如从多视角观测执行 RoboTwin2.0 风格的任务。

notFor.zh: 尽管带有视频栈，它并不是通用视频生成器——其目的是动作预测，运行需要机器人观测与状态。训练、仿真与部署工具均不包含。

recipes.name: Causal-rCM
recipes.summary: NVIDIA's Apache-2.0 causal video model — autoregressive, streaming generation over latent-frame chunks.

notes: Causal-rCM generates autoregressively over latent-frame chunks. first_chunk_t and chunk_t select the schedule; the c1-1 frame-wise setting gives the lowest streaming latency and c3-3 more throughput.
The released causal entrypoint is prompt and image conditioned. It exposes no discrete action space, so the input schema declares no actions; the chunk schedule is the streaming control surface.
Distilled few-step sampling is the default (`distilled=True`, 4 steps, mid_t 15/16 5/6 5/8). Setting distilled=False samples the multi-step causal-diffusion teacher with CFG instead.
Setting context_from_last_step=True caches the final denoising forward as the next chunk's context, saving one clean forward pass per chunk. Use it only with a checkpoint trained for noisy context.

Set kv_cache_policy=sliding_window to cap the causal cache at kv_cache_window_blocks (with optional kv_cache_sink_blocks) and allocate only the retained prefix plus one in-flight chunk. The default keep_all policy reproduces the upstream unbounded cache bit-for-bit. RoPE-remapping cache policies stay out of this post-RoPE entrypoint and require the separate extrapolation path.
The upstream imaginaire package is not vendored. WorldFoundry's lazy_config, easy_io, rank-aware logging, and selective activation checkpointing back the vendored runtime instead.
Covers only the vendored causal inference path. Upstream's training extras (megatron-core, transformer_engine, wandb, webdataset, fvcore, hydra-core) are intentionally omitted.
FlashAttention is optional. The vendored attention module dispatches on compute capability and falls back to PyTorch SDPA (cuDNN / FA2 / mem-efficient) when FlashAttention 3 is absent.
MagiAttention is optional and only used when RCM_ATTENTION_BACKEND=magi is set.
Upstream validated torch 2.11 on CUDA 12.6; the exact pin keeps this runtime isolated from the shared WorldFoundry environment.

tagline.en: NVIDIA's Apache-2.0 causal video model — autoregressive, streaming generation over latent-frame chunks.
tagline.zh: NVIDIA 的 Apache-2.0 因果视频模型——在潜在帧块上做自回归、流式生成。

en: Causal-rCM, from NVIDIA research, is a causal video generation model released under Apache-2.0. It generates video autoregressively — one chunk of latent frames at a time — which makes it suited to streaming and interactive world-model use, conditioned on a text prompt and optionally an image.

The chunk schedule is the main control surface: a frame-wise setting gives the lowest streaming latency while larger chunks trade latency for throughput. Distilled few-step sampling is the default for speed, and you can switch to the multi-step causal-diffusion teacher for higher quality. A sliding-window KV cache option lets you bound memory, while the default keep-all policy reproduces the unbounded cache. The released entrypoint is prompt- and image-conditioned and exposes no discrete action space — the chunk schedule is how you steer streaming.

In WorldFoundry, Causal-rCM runs through the shared video pipeline with its causal stack built in-tree. You provide a prompt (and optionally an image), choose a chunk schedule and sampling mode, and it streams out video. The DiT, VAE and text-encoder checkpoints are staged separately before a full run.
zh: Causal-rCM 出自 NVIDIA 研究团队，是一个采用 Apache-2.0 许可的因果视频生成模型。它以自回归方式生成视频——每次一个潜在帧块——因而适合流式与交互式世界模型的用法，条件为文本提示词，可选再加一张图片。
帧块调度是主要的控制面：逐帧设置带来最低的流式延迟，而更大的块以延迟换吞吐。为追求速度，默认采用蒸馏的少步采样，你也可切换到多步因果扩散的教师模型以获得更高质量。滑动窗口 KV 缓存选项可限定显存占用，默认的全保留策略则复现无界缓存。发布的入口以提示词和图片为条件、不暴露离散动作空间——帧块调度就是你引导流式生成的方式。
在 WorldFoundry 中，Causal-rCM 通过共享视频 pipeline 运行，其因果栈内置于代码库。你给出提示词（可选再加一张图片），选择帧块调度与采样模式，它便流式输出视频。DiT、VAE 与文本编码器的 checkpoint 需在完整运行前单独准备。

whenToUse.en: Use it when you want openly-licensed, streaming or interactive video generation — where producing frames chunk by chunk with controllable latency matters more than one-shot batch rendering.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想要开放许可的流式或交互式视频生成时使用它——即逐块产出帧、延迟可控，比一次性批量渲染更重要的场景。

notFor.en: The released entrypoint has no discrete action space, so it is not an action-conditioned game engine — you steer it through prompts and the chunk schedule. Checkpoints are downloaded separately before running.
notFor.zh: 发布的入口没有离散动作空间，因此它不是动作驱动的游戏引擎——你通过提示词和帧块调度来引导。checkpoint 需在运行前单独下载。

en: Apache-2.0 causal video generation
Autoregressive, streaming generation over latent-frame chunks
Chunk schedule trades streaming latency for throughput
Distilled few-step sampling by default, with a multi-step teacher option
zh: Apache-2.0 因果视频生成
在潜在帧块上做自回归、流式生成
帧块调度可在流式延迟与吞吐间权衡
默认蒸馏少步采样，另有多步教师模型可选

tagline.en: An interactive, action-conditioned world model — roll out video that responds to the actions you feed it.
tagline.zh: 一个交互式、动作驱动的世界模型——展开对你输入动作作出响应的视频。

en: Ctrl-World is an interactive world model: rather than generating a fixed clip, it rolls out video that responds to actions you supply, making it suited to game-style and action-conditioned world modeling. You steer the unfolding scene step by step.

It builds on a video-diffusion foundation, pairing a Stable Video Diffusion image-to-video backbone with a CLIP image encoder to condition and continue the rollout. The generation proceeds as a controllable sequence, so the model keeps producing frames as new actions arrive.

In WorldFoundry, Ctrl-World's source is vendored in-tree and exposed through a runtime pipeline: you provide the starting condition and actions, and it drives the rollout entrypoint. The checkpoints and task assets are staged separately before a full run.
zh: Ctrl-World 是一个交互式世界模型：它不是生成一段固定片段，而是展开对你所提供动作作出响应的视频，因此适合游戏风格与动作驱动的世界建模。你逐步引导场景的推进。
它构建在视频扩散基础之上，把 Stable Video Diffusion 的图生视频骨干与 CLIP 图像编码器结合，用于条件化并延续 rollout。生成过程是一个可控序列，因而随着新动作到来，模型会持续产出帧。
在 WorldFoundry 中，Ctrl-World 的源码内置于代码库，并通过运行时 pipeline 对外提供：你给出起始条件和动作，它便驱动 rollout 入口。checkpoint 与任务资源需在完整运行前单独准备。

whenToUse.en: Use it when you want an interactive, action-conditioned world model — driving a video rollout with actions for game-world or embodied-simulation exploration.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想要一个交互式、动作驱动的世界模型时使用它——用动作驱动视频 rollout，用于游戏世界或具身仿真的探索。

notFor.en: Not a one-shot text-to-video generator — its value is the interactive, action-driven rollout, which needs an action stream. Checkpoints and task assets must be staged before running.
notFor.zh: 它不是一次性的文生视频生成器——其价值在于交互式、动作驱动的 rollout，需要有动作流输入。运行前需准备好 checkpoint 与任务资源。

Rolls out video that responds to supplied actions
Built on Stable Video Diffusion with a CLIP image encoder
Source vendored in-tree behind a runtime pipeline

tagline.en: Continuous 3D reconstruction from images — export a point cloud or lift it into 3D Gaussians.
tagline.zh: 从图像做连续 3D 重建——导出点云，或进一步提升为 3D 高斯。

en: CUT3R reconstructs 3D geometry from images, producing a dense point cloud of the captured scene. It belongs to the recent family of feed-forward 3D reconstruction methods that recover geometry directly, without a full traditional structure-from-motion pipeline.

In WorldFoundry it offers two routes: a point-cloud export, and a two-stage path that lifts the reconstruction into a 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) representation you can render from new viewpoints. This makes it useful both as a geometry source and as a way to get a renderable 3D asset.
Both routes are registered in-tree and discovered through Studio. Checkpoint-backed inference depends on staged local or Hugging Face CUT3R weights, so set those up before a full run.
zh: CUT3R 从图像重建 3D 几何，产出所采集场景的稠密点云。它属于近期的前馈式 3D 重建方法家族，直接恢复几何，而无需完整的传统 structure-from-motion 流程。
在 WorldFoundry 中它提供两条路径：点云导出，以及把重建结果提升为可从新视角渲染的 3D 高斯泼溅（3DGS）表示的两阶段路径。这让它既可作为几何来源，也可用于得到可渲染的 3D 资产。
两条路径都在代码库内注册，并通过 Studio 发现。基于 checkpoint 的推理依赖本地或 Hugging Face 上准备好的 CUT3R 权重，请在完整运行前设置好。

whenToUse.en: Use it when you need 3D reconstruction from images — either a point cloud for geometry, or a two-stage lift into 3D Gaussians for a renderable asset.
whenToUse.zh: 当你需要从图像做 3D 重建时使用它——既可得到用于几何的点云，也可通过两阶段路径提升为可渲染的 3D 高斯资产。

notFor.en: Not a text- or image-driven world generator — it reconstructs from real image input rather than imagining new scenes. Checkpoint-backed inference needs the CUT3R weights staged first.
notFor.zh: 它不是文本或图像驱动的世界生成器——它从真实图像输入进行重建，而非想象新场景。基于 checkpoint 的推理需先准备好 CUT3R 权重。

en: Feed-forward 3D reconstruction from images
Point-cloud export route
Two-stage lift into 3D Gaussian Splatting
Registered in-tree and discovered through Studio
zh: 从图像进行前馈式 3D 重建
点云导出路径
两阶段提升为 3D 高斯泼溅
在代码库内注册，通过 Studio 发现

tagline.en: Dexmal's Dexbotic CogACT vision-language-action policy — turn images and an instruction into robot actions.
tagline.zh: Dexmal 的 Dexbotic CogACT 视觉-语言-动作策略——把图像与指令转化为机器人动作。

en: DB-CogACT is a vision-language-action (VLA) policy built on Dexmal's Dexbotic framework and the CogACT approach. It takes camera images and a language instruction, optionally robot state, and predicts an action to execute — a policy you roll out step by step.

The runtime constructs the Dexbotic CogACT policy in-process from an in-tree vendored inference subset and calls its action selection directly, so it does not depend on an external server or repository checkout. Several checkpoints are available across benchmarks — including LIBERO, CALVIN and SimplerEnv variants and single- and dual-arm Dexbotic-CogACT weights — with the LIBERO checkpoint released under Apache-2.0.

In WorldFoundry, DB-CogACT runs through the embodied action pipeline rather than video generation: you pick a checkpoint, feed it a prompt and image observations, and it returns an action trace. Serving components, training and benchmark launchers are out of scope.
zh: DB-CogACT 是一个构建在 Dexmal 的 Dexbotic 框架与 CogACT 方法之上的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略。它接收相机图像和一条语言指令、可选加上机器人状态，预测出要执行的动作——这是一个你逐步展开（rollout）的策略。
运行时从代码库内置的推理子集在进程内构建 Dexbotic CogACT 策略，并直接调用其动作选择，因此不依赖外部服务或仓库检出。它跨多个基准提供了若干 checkpoint——包括 LIBERO、CALVIN 与 SimplerEnv 变体，以及单臂和双臂的 Dexbotic-CogACT 权重——其中 LIBERO checkpoint 采用 Apache-2.0 许可。
在 WorldFoundry 中，DB-CogACT 走的是具身动作 pipeline，而非视频生成：选定一个 checkpoint，给它提示词和图像观测，它便返回一段动作轨迹。服务组件、训练与基准启动器不在其中。

whenToUse.en: Use it when you want a language-conditioned manipulation policy from the Dexbotic/CogACT line, with checkpoints spanning LIBERO, CALVIN, SimplerEnv and single- or dual-arm setups.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想要一个来自 Dexbotic/CogACT 系列的语言驱动操作策略时使用它，其 checkpoint 覆盖 LIBERO、CALVIN、SimplerEnv 以及单臂或双臂配置。

notFor.en: Not a media-generation model — it outputs robot actions, not images or video. You need image observations and an instruction to run it, and serving/training tooling is excluded.
notFor.zh: 它不是媒体生成模型——输出的是机器人动作，而非图像或视频。运行它需要图像观测和指令，且不包含服务与训练工具。

en: Dexbotic CogACT vision-language-action policy
Policy constructed in-process, no external server or checkout needed
Checkpoints across LIBERO, CALVIN, SimplerEnv and single/dual-arm
LIBERO checkpoint released under Apache-2.0
