tagline.en: ByteDance's Depth Anything 3 — a strong foundation model for depth and geometry from images.
tagline.zh: 字节跳动的 Depth Anything 3——从图像预测深度与几何的强大基础模型。

en: Depth Anything 3, from ByteDance Seed, is the latest in the widely-used Depth Anything line of monocular depth and geometry foundation models. It estimates depth and geometric structure from ordinary images, extending the series toward richer 3D understanding.

As a foundation model it is designed to generalize across diverse scenes without per-scene tuning, which is why the Depth Anything family is a common building block for downstream 3D and reconstruction work. WorldFoundry surfaces a Depth Anything 3 export route for producing geometry outputs.

In WorldFoundry, the in-tree route is registered separately from the geometry-prior profile, so you can use Depth Anything 3 either as a direct depth/geometry step or as a prior that feeds downstream 3D and 4D stages.
zh: Depth Anything 3 出自字节跳动 Seed 团队，是被广泛使用的 Depth Anything 单目深度与几何基础模型系列的最新一代。它从普通图像估计深度与几何结构，把该系列推向更丰富的 3D 理解。
作为基础模型，它被设计为无需逐场景调参即可在多样场景上泛化，这也是 Depth Anything 家族常被用作下游 3D 与重建工作构件的原因。WorldFoundry 提供了一条 Depth Anything 3 导出路径，用于产出几何输出。
在 WorldFoundry 中，该内置路径与 geometry-prior 配置分开注册，因此你既可以把 Depth Anything 3 用作直接的深度/几何步骤，也可以把它当作先验，供下游 3D、4D 环节使用。

whenToUse.en: Use it when you need robust depth or geometry estimation from images that generalizes across scenes — either as a standalone step or as a prior for 3D and 4D pipelines.
whenToUse.zh: 当你需要从图像做稳健、可跨场景泛化的深度或几何估计时使用它——既可作为独立步骤，也可作为 3D、4D pipeline 的先验。

notFor.en: Not a generative video or world model — it estimates geometry from real images rather than imagining new scenes.
notFor.zh: 它不是生成式视频或世界模型——它从真实图像估计几何，而非想象新场景。

en: Latest in the Depth Anything depth/geometry foundation-model line
Estimates depth and geometry from ordinary images
Generalizes across diverse scenes without per-scene tuning
Available as a direct export route or as a geometry prior
zh: Depth Anything 深度/几何基础模型系列的最新一代
从普通图像估计深度与几何
无需逐场景调参即可跨多样场景泛化
可作为直接导出路径或几何先验使用

tagline.en: A 1B vision-language-action policy for dexterous, bimanual manipulation with a 36-DoF action space.
tagline.zh: 一个 1B 的视觉-语言-动作策略，面向灵巧、双臂操作，动作空间为 36 自由度。

en: Dexora 1B is a vision-language-action (VLA) policy aimed at dexterous, bimanual robot manipulation. It reads camera views, robot state and a language instruction, and predicts actions across a 36-DoF action space — enough to drive two-armed, fine-grained control.

It is a 1B RDT-style policy that pairs SigLIP and T5 encoders with a diffusion action sampler, loading weights locally with a strict checkpoint loader. The authors publish data and training code but no official policy weights, so running it requires a checkpoint you have trained yourself (Stage-1 or Stage-3). Training, teleoperation, robot SDK and simulator code are out of scope here.

In WorldFoundry, Dexora 1B runs through the embodied action pipeline rather than video generation: you supply observations and an instruction, and it returns an action trace. Because there are no released policy weights, a locally trained checkpoint is mandatory.
zh: Dexora 1B 是一个面向灵巧、双臂机器人操作的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略。它读取相机视角、机器人状态和一条语言指令，在 36 自由度的动作空间上预测动作——足以驱动双臂、精细的控制。
它是一个 1B 的 RDT 风格策略，把 SigLIP 与 T5 编码器同扩散动作采样器结合，通过严格的 checkpoint 加载器在本地载入权重。作者公开了数据与训练代码，但没有发布官方策略权重，因此运行它需要你自行训练的 checkpoint（Stage-1 或 Stage-3）。训练、遥操作、机器人 SDK 与仿真器代码不在其中。
在 WorldFoundry 中，Dexora 1B 走的是具身动作 pipeline，而非视频生成：你提供观测和指令，它便返回一段动作轨迹。由于没有发布的策略权重，本地训练的 checkpoint 是必需的。

whenToUse.en: Use it when you need a language-conditioned policy for dexterous, dual-arm manipulation with a high-DoF action space, and you have a trained checkpoint to load.
whenToUse.zh: 当你需要一个语言驱动、面向灵巧双臂操作且动作空间高自由度的策略，并且手头有已训练好的 checkpoint 可加载时使用它。

notFor.en: Not a plug-and-play model — the release ships no official policy weights, so you must supply a locally trained checkpoint. It outputs robot actions, not images or video.
notFor.zh: 它不是开箱即用的模型——发布中不含官方策略权重，你必须提供本地训练的 checkpoint。它输出的是机器人动作，而非图像或视频。

Dexterous, bimanual control over a 36-DoF action space

Requires a locally trained checkpoint — no official weights released

tagline.en: Dexmal's vision-language-action policy — a Qwen3-based flow action expert that turns multi-view observations into robot action chunks.
tagline.zh: Dexmal 的视觉-语言-动作策略——基于 Qwen3 的 flow action expert,把多视角观测转化为机器人动作序列。

en: DM0 is a vision-language-action (VLA) model from Dexmal, part of the Dexbotic effort. It takes what a robot sees and the instruction it is given, and predicts the actions the robot should execute.

The policy pairs a multimodal perception and language backbone with a Qwen3-based flow action expert. It consumes several camera views plus the robot's proprioceptive state and emits a chunk of future actions in one pass, rather than a single step at a time. Two checkpoints are available on Hugging Face: a base model and a LIBERO-oriented variant.
In WorldFoundry, DM0 runs in-process from local checkpoints — you provide the camera views and state vector, and it returns an action chunk you can feed to a controller or simulator.
zh: DM0 是 Dexmal(Dexbotic 项目)推出的视觉-语言-动作(VLA)模型。它接收机器人所看到的画面与收到的指令,预测机器人应当执行的动作。
该策略把多模态感知与语言主干,同一个基于 Qwen3 的 flow action expert 结合起来。它一次性接收多个相机视角加上机器人的本体状态,直接输出一段未来动作序列,而不是逐步预测单个动作。Hugging Face 上提供两个 checkpoint:一个基座模型,以及一个面向 LIBERO 的变体。
在 WorldFoundry 中,DM0 直接从本地 checkpoint 在进程内运行——你提供相机视角与状态向量,它就返回一段可交给控制器或仿真器执行的动作序列。

whenToUse.en: Reach for DM0 when you need a multi-view VLA policy that maps camera observations and an instruction directly to executable robot actions, or when you want a LIBERO-oriented starting point to build on.
whenToUse.zh: 当你需要一个多视角 VLA 策略、把相机观测与指令直接映射为可执行的机器人动作,或想要一个面向 LIBERO 的起点时,可以选择 DM0。

notFor.en: This is an action policy, not a video or image generator. Checkpoints are downloaded separately, so plan for the download and the compatible robot setup you intend to control.
notFor.zh: 它是动作策略,而非视频或图像生成器。Checkpoint 需单独下载,请预留下载时间,并准备好你打算控制的兼容机器人配置。

en: Vision-language-action policy from Dexmal / Dexbotic
Qwen3-based flow action expert with multi-view input
Predicts an action chunk in a single pass
Base and LIBERO-oriented checkpoints on Hugging Face
zh: 来自 Dexmal / Dexbotic 的视觉-语言-动作策略
基于 Qwen3 的 flow action expert,多视角输入
一次前向即可预测一段动作序列
Hugging Face 上提供基座与面向 LIBERO 的 checkpoint

tagline.zh: EgoWM——以第一人称视角、动作条件化的世界模型,为导航预测第一人称视频。

en: EgoWM is an egocentric world model. Given a first-person view and an intended action, it predicts how the scene ahead would look — a way to imagine the consequences of moving before actually moving, which is useful for navigation.

It is built on Stable Video Diffusion (SVD), and the project ships variants for different action spaces, including a 3-degrees-of-freedom and a 25-degrees-of-freedom setup. WorldFoundry registers the EgoWM source route; running real generation additionally needs the EgoWM checkpoint and assets, fetched separately.
In WorldFoundry you use EgoWM for egocentric navigation and action-conditioned video prediction once its assets are staged.
zh: EgoWM 是一个第一人称视角(egocentric)世界模型。给定一段第一人称画面与一个意图动作,它预测前方场景将会呈现的样子——一种在真正移动之前先想象移动后果的方式,这对导航很有用。
它构建在 Stable Video Diffusion(SVD)之上,项目为不同动作空间提供了变体,包括 3 自由度与 25 自由度两种配置。WorldFoundry 已注册 EgoWM 的源码路由;运行真正的生成还需要 EgoWM 的 checkpoint 与资产,需单独获取。
在 WorldFoundry 中,当资产就位后,你可将 EgoWM 用于第一人称导航与动作条件化的视频预测。

whenToUse.en: Choose EgoWM when you need to predict first-person video conditioned on actions — for example imagining navigation outcomes from an egocentric viewpoint.
whenToUse.zh: 当你需要基于动作预测第一人称视频时(例如从第一人称视角想象导航结果),选择 EgoWM。

In WorldFoundry you point EO-1 at your local checkpoint and run it for action prediction or policy rollout without additional glue code.
zh: EO-1 是 EO-Robotics 推出的具身视觉-语言-动作(VLA)模型。它读取视觉观测与一条自然语言指令,输出机器人应当执行的动作。

在 WorldFoundry 中,你把 EO-1 指向本地 checkpoint,无需额外胶水代码即可运行动作预测或策略 rollout。

whenToUse.en: A good fit when you want a compact, general-purpose embodied VLA policy to drive a robot from images and language instructions.

tagline.en: EventVLA — a Qwen3-VL-based vision-language-action policy with keyframe memory for longer-horizon manipulation.
tagline.zh: EventVLA——基于 Qwen3-VL 的视觉-语言-动作策略,带关键帧记忆,面向更长时程的操作任务。

en: EventVLA is a vision-language-action (VLA) model from InternRobotics. It encodes observations and instructions with a Qwen3-VL backbone and predicts the actions a robot should take, with a design aimed at tasks that unfold over a longer horizon.

Beyond a standard action head, EventVLA adds an event head, temporal anchors, and a compact keyframe-image memory that retains a small set of past frames. This lets the policy reason about what has already happened rather than only the current view. It builds on the Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct encoder and predicts a multi-step action chunk. You can also pass explicit temporal and memory-keyframe images to override the built-in history.
In WorldFoundry, EventVLA runs in-process from local assets — supply the current views (and optionally memory frames), and it returns an action chunk.
zh: EventVLA 是 InternRobotics 推出的视觉-语言-动作(VLA)模型。它用 Qwen3-VL 主干编码观测与指令,预测机器人应执行的动作,设计上面向那些需要在较长时程内展开的任务。
在标准动作头之外,EventVLA 还加入了 event head、时间锚点,以及一个紧凑的关键帧图像记忆,用于保留少量过去的画面。这让策略能够对已经发生的事情进行推理,而不只看当前视角。它构建在 Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct 编码器之上,预测多步动作序列。你也可以显式传入时间序列图像与记忆关键帧,覆盖内置的历史。
在 WorldFoundry 中,EventVLA 直接从本地资产在进程内运行——提供当前视角(以及可选的记忆帧),它就返回一段动作序列。

whenToUse.en: Choose EventVLA when your manipulation task benefits from short-term visual memory — where the right action depends on recent frames, not just the current observation.
whenToUse.zh: 当你的操作任务需要短期视觉记忆时(正确动作取决于最近若干帧,而不只是当前观测),EventVLA 是合适的选择。

notFor.en: It outputs robot actions rather than generated video or images, and closed-loop use requires a matching robot or simulator. Both the EventVLA checkpoint and the Qwen3-VL encoder are downloaded separately.
notFor.zh: 它输出的是机器人动作,而非生成的视频或图像,闭环使用需要匹配的机器人或仿真器。EventVLA checkpoint 与 Qwen3-VL 编码器均需单独下载。

Built on the Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct encoder
Keyframe memory and temporal anchors for longer horizons
Optional explicit temporal and memory-frame inputs
zh: 来自 InternRobotics 的视觉-语言-动作策略
构建于 Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct 编码器
关键帧记忆与时间锚点,面向更长时程

tagline.en: Galaxea G0Plus — an open vision-language-action base model built on PaliGemma, meant to be fine-tuned into task-ready policies.
tagline.zh: Galaxea G0Plus——构建在 PaliGemma 之上的开放视觉-语言-动作基座模型,面向微调为可用策略。

en: Galaxea G0Plus is a vision-language-action (VLA) model from OpenGalaxea. It reads camera observations and an instruction and predicts robot actions, using a PaliGemma-based multimodal backbone paired with a flow-sampling action expert.

The released G0Plus checkpoint is a base model intended as a starting point for downstream fine-tuning rather than a finished, task-ready policy. Its architecture — the model, KV cache, flow sampler, tokenizer adapter, preprocessing, and normalization — is implemented in WorldFoundry, and it pairs with the google/paligemma-3b-pt-224 backbone. Normalization relies on the exact dataset statistics paired with the checkpoint, so those must be staged alongside the weights.
In WorldFoundry, G0Plus runs from staged local assets — provide observations and the matching statistics, and it returns actions for rollout or as a base for your own fine-tune.
zh: Galaxea G0Plus 是 OpenGalaxea 推出的视觉-语言-动作(VLA)模型。它读取相机观测与指令并预测机器人动作,采用基于 PaliGemma 的多模态主干,搭配 flow 采样的 action expert。

已发布的 G0Plus checkpoint 是一个基座模型,定位为下游微调的起点,而非开箱即用的成品策略。其架构——模型本体、KV 缓存、flow 采样器、tokenizer 适配器、预处理与归一化——在 WorldFoundry 中实现,并与 google/paligemma-3b-pt-224 主干配套使用。归一化依赖与 checkpoint 配套的精确数据集统计量,因此需要将它们与权重一并准备好。
在 WorldFoundry 中,G0Plus 从本地准备好的资产运行——提供观测与匹配的统计量,它就返回可用于 rollout 的动作,或作为你自己微调的基座。

whenToUse.en: Use G0Plus as a foundation to fine-tune into your own manipulation policy, especially if you want an openly available PaliGemma-based VLA to build on.
whenToUse.zh: 把 G0Plus 当作基座,微调成你自己的操作策略——尤其当你希望在一个开放可得、基于 PaliGemma 的 VLA 之上构建时。

notFor.en: Don't expect the base checkpoint to solve tasks out of the box; it's meant for fine-tuning. It also needs the exact paired dataset statistics — normalization won't fall back to made-up values — plus the PaliGemma backbone, both downloaded separately.
notFor.zh: 不要指望基座 checkpoint 开箱即用地完成任务,它是用来微调的。它还需要与之配套的精确数据集统计量(归一化不会退回到编造的数值),以及 PaliGemma 主干,两者均需单独下载。

tagline.en: A Gaussian-policy actor from LeRobot — a stochastic action policy for reinforcement-learning-style robot control.
tagline.zh: 来自 LeRobot 的高斯策略 actor——面向强化学习式机器人控制的随机动作策略。

en: Gaussian Actor is the gaussian_actor policy from Hugging Face's LeRobot library. It models a robot's action as a Gaussian distribution, so instead of committing to a single output it produces a mean and spread you can sample from — a common building block in reinforcement-learning control.
It plugs into WorldFoundry through an in-tree action runtime adapter that wraps the LeRobot policy directly, so you can run it for actor policy or reinforcement-learning workflows.
In WorldFoundry, point it at your local checkpoint and feed observations to get actions; when the checkpoint isn't staged yet, the runtime tells you which assets are still needed.
zh: Gaussian Actor 是 Hugging Face LeRobot 库中的 gaussian_actor 策略。它把机器人动作建模为高斯分布,因此不是给出单一输出,而是产生可供采样的均值与方差——这是强化学习控制中的常见构件。
它通过一个 in-tree 的动作运行适配器接入 WorldFoundry,该适配器直接封装 LeRobot 策略,便于你用于 actor 策略或强化学习工作流。
在 WorldFoundry 中,把它指向本地 checkpoint 并喂入观测即可得到动作;当 checkpoint 尚未准备好时,运行时会告诉你还缺哪些资产。

whenToUse.en: Use it when you need a stochastic Gaussian action policy — for reinforcement-learning control or as an actor component where sampling actions from a distribution matters.
whenToUse.zh: 当你需要一个随机的高斯动作策略时使用它——用于强化学习控制,或作为需要从分布中采样动作的 actor 组件。

notFor.en: It's an action policy, not a generative video or image model, and it targets LeRobot-style setups. You'll need to supply a compatible checkpoint and robot or simulator.
notFor.zh: 它是动作策略,而非生成式视频或图像模型,面向 LeRobot 式的配置。你需要提供兼容的 checkpoint 以及机器人或仿真器。

Outputs a distribution over actions to sample from
Suited to reinforcement-learning control
Runs via an in-tree LeRobot action adapter

tagline.en: AgiBot's Genie Envisioner — a robotics world model that turns an image and actions into predicted manipulation video.
tagline.zh: AgiBot 的 Genie Envisioner——机器人世界模型,把图像与动作转化为预测的操作视频。

en: Genie Envisioner is a robotics world model from AgiBot (AgibotTech). It predicts how a manipulation scene will unfold, generating video conditioned on a starting image and a sequence of actions — a way to preview what a robot would see as it acts.

It builds on the LTX-Video generation backbone. In WorldFoundry the Genie Envisioner source is vendored in-tree and exposed through a runtime pipeline that resolves its inference entrypoint. Actually generating video additionally requires the Genie Envisioner checkpoints and per-task assets, which are staged separately.
In WorldFoundry you use it for robotics-world-model, image-to-video, and action-conditioned video tasks once those assets are in place.
zh: Genie Envisioner 是 AgiBot(AgibotTech)推出的机器人世界模型。它预测操作场景将如何展开,基于一张起始图像与一段动作序列生成视频——一种预览机器人在动作过程中会看到什么的方式。
它构建在 LTX-Video 生成主干之上。在 WorldFoundry 中,Genie Envisioner 的源码以 in-tree 方式收录,并通过一个运行时 pipeline 暴露,该 pipeline 会解析其推理入口。真正生成视频还需要 Genie Envisioner 的 checkpoint 与各任务资产,这些需单独准备。
在 WorldFoundry 中,当资产就位后,你可将它用于机器人世界模型、图生视频与动作条件化视频等任务。

whenToUse.en: Use Genie Envisioner when you want to predict manipulation video from an image and actions — previewing or evaluating robot behavior in imagination rather than on hardware.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想从图像与动作预测操作视频时使用 Genie Envisioner——在想象中而非真机上预览或评估机器人行为。

notFor.en: It generates predicted video rather than issuing control actions, and it can't run until its checkpoints and task assets are downloaded and staged.
notFor.zh: 它生成的是预测视频,而非发出控制动作,在其 checkpoint 与任务资产下载并准备好之前也无法运行。

tagline.en: A shared geometry-prior interface in WorldFoundry — a common contract for 3D reconstruction and geometry estimation models.
tagline.zh: WorldFoundry 中的共享几何先验接口——面向 3D 重建与几何估计模型的统一契约。

en: Geometry is the shared geometry-prior surface in WorldFoundry: a common pipeline and operator contract that a family of 3D and geometry models can plug into. Geometry priors are models that infer 3D structure from images — depth, point maps, and related reconstruction outputs.

This entry defines the shared interface rather than a single model. Individual upstream priors — such as DUSt3R, Depth Anything, and Metric3D — register as their own catalog entries with their own weights and provenance, but all speak the same contract described here.
In WorldFoundry you use this contract to work with geometry priors for 3D reconstruction and geometry-estimation tasks; pick a specific prior's catalog entry for its concrete weights and details.
zh: Geometry 是 WorldFoundry 中共享的几何先验接口层:一套统一的 pipeline 与算子契约,供一系列 3D 与几何模型接入。几何先验是指从图像中推断 3D 结构的模型——深度、点图,以及相关的重建输出。
本条目定义的是共享接口,而非某个单一模型。各个上游先验——例如 DUSt3R、Depth Anything、Metric3D——各自作为独立的目录条目注册,拥有各自的权重与来源,但都遵循这里描述的同一套契约。
在 WorldFoundry 中,你借助这套契约来使用几何先验完成 3D 重建与几何估计任务;若需要具体权重与细节,请选择某个具体先验的目录条目。

whenToUse.en: Refer to this entry when you want to understand the common interface geometry priors share; use a specific prior's page (DUSt3R, Depth Anything, Metric3D, etc.) to run actual 3D reconstruction or depth estimation.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想了解几何先验共享的统一接口时,参考本条目;要实际运行 3D 重建或深度估计,请使用某个具体先验的页面(如 DUSt3R、Depth Anything、Metric3D 等)。

notFor.en: This is a shared contract, not a standalone runnable model — there are no weights of its own here. For real inference, choose a concrete geometry-prior model.
notFor.zh: 这是共享契约,而非可独立运行的模型——此处没有自带权重。要做真正的推理,请选择一个具体的几何先验模型。

tagline.en: AgiBot's GO-1 — a vision-language-action foundation policy with a latent planner and diffusion action expert, built for fine-tuning.
tagline.zh: AgiBot 的 GO-1——带隐式规划器与扩散 action expert 的视觉-语言-动作基座策略,面向微调。

en: GO-1 is a vision-language-action (VLA) model from AgiBot (AgiBot-World). It reads visual observations and instructions and predicts robot actions, and is released as a pretrained foundation checkpoint meant to be fine-tuned for specific tasks.

Its architecture combines an InternVision encoder and an InternLM2 language model with a latent planner, an action expert, and a diffusion sampler, together with the tokenizer and preprocessing — all implemented in WorldFoundry. The runtime executes only staged safetensors and never imports checkpoint-provided Python. Because normalization is tied to the training statistics, any fine-tune must stay paired with the exact dataset statistics emitted during its own training.
In WorldFoundry, GO-1 runs from local weights for policy rollout and embodied-benchmark tasks; the upstream recommendation is to full-fine-tune it on your downstream data.
zh: GO-1 是 AgiBot(AgiBot-World)推出的视觉-语言-动作(VLA)模型。它读取视觉观测与指令并预测机器人动作,以预训练基座 checkpoint 形式发布,面向针对具体任务的微调。

其架构把 InternVision 编码器与 InternLM2 语言模型,同隐式规划器、action expert 和扩散采样器结合起来,再加上 tokenizer 与预处理——全部在 WorldFoundry 中实现。运行时只执行准备好的 safetensors,绝不导入 checkpoint 自带的 Python。由于归一化与训练统计量绑定,任何微调都必须与其自身训练时产出的精确数据集统计量配套使用。
在 WorldFoundry 中,GO-1 从本地权重运行,用于策略 rollout 与具身 benchmark 任务;上游推荐在你的下游数据上做全参数微调。

whenToUse.en: A strong foundation when you want to fine-tune a capable VLA policy on your own robot data, with an InternVision + InternLM2 backbone and a diffusion action head.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想在自己的机器人数据上微调一个能力较强的 VLA 策略时,它是很好的基座——采用 InternVision + InternLM2 主干与扩散动作头。

notFor.en: The base checkpoint isn't a finished task policy; upstream expects downstream fine-tuning. A normalized fine-tune must carry its exact matching dataset statistics, and the checkpoint is downloaded separately.
notFor.zh: 基座 checkpoint 并非成品任务策略,上游期望做下游微调。归一化后的微调必须携带其精确匹配的数据集统计量,且 checkpoint 需单独下载。

Pretrained checkpoint intended for downstream fine-tuning

tagline.en: H-RDT — a flow-matching vision-language-action model pretrained on human motion, designed to transfer to robot fine-tunes.
tagline.zh: H-RDT——以人体动作预训练的 flow-matching 视觉-语言-动作模型,面向迁移到机器人微调。

en: H-RDT is a vision-language-action (VLA) model from the EmbodiedFoundation group. It combines a transformer with a flow-matching sampler, a DINOv2-plus-SigLIP vision path, and an optional T5 language path to predict actions from images and instructions.

The official release is a 48-dimensional human-motion pretraining checkpoint — the idea being to learn broadly from human motion first, then fine-tune to a robot's own state and action space. By default it consumes a single 384-pixel image view and returns a 16-step chunk of 48-dimensional actions, using DINOv2 and SigLIP weights bundled in the snapshot. To save memory you can supply precomputed language embeddings and skip loading T5-v1.1-XXL. Robot fine-tunes may redefine the state/action dimension and camera count through their own checkpoint config.
In WorldFoundry, H-RDT runs in-process from local weights; it never imports a source checkout or executes checkpoint-provided Python.
zh: H-RDT 是 EmbodiedFoundation 团队推出的视觉-语言-动作(VLA)模型。它把 transformer 与 flow-matching 采样器、DINOv2 加 SigLIP 的视觉路径,以及可选的 T5 语言路径结合起来,依据图像与指令预测动作。

官方发布的是一个 48 维的人体动作预训练 checkpoint——思路是先从人体动作中广泛学习,再微调到机器人自身的状态与动作空间。默认情况下它接收单个 384 像素的图像视角,返回 16 步、48 维的动作序列,使用快照中自带的 DINOv2 与 SigLIP 权重。为节省显存,你可以提供预先计算好的语言嵌入,从而跳过加载 T5-v1.1-XXL。机器人微调可以通过各自的 checkpoint 配置,重新定义状态/动作维度与相机数量。
在 WorldFoundry 中,H-RDT 从本地权重在进程内运行;它绝不导入源码 checkout,也不执行 checkpoint 自带的 Python。

whenToUse.en: A good base when you want a VLA that starts from broad human-motion pretraining and can be fine-tuned to your robot's specific state, action space, and camera setup.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想要一个从广泛人体动作预训练出发、并可微调到你机器人具体状态、动作空间与相机配置的 VLA 时,它是不错的基座。

notFor.en: The released checkpoint is the human-motion pretraining model, not a ready 14-dimensional robot policy — that comes from your own fine-tune. Full precomputed-free use also downloads T5-v1.1-XXL separately, which is heavy on lower-memory GPUs.
notFor.zh: 已发布的 checkpoint 是人体动作预训练模型,而非可用的 14 维机器人策略——后者来自你自己的微调。若不使用预计算嵌入,还需单独下载 T5-v1.1-XXL,这在显存较小的 GPU 上负担较重。

en: VLA pretrained on human motion, built to transfer to robots
Flow-matching sampler with DINOv2 + SigLIP vision
Default: one 384px view in, 16×48 action chunk out
Optional precomputed language embeddings to skip T5
zh: 以人体动作预训练、面向迁移到机器人的 VLA
flow-matching 采样器,搭配 DINOv2 + SigLIP 视觉
默认:输入单个 384px 视角,输出 16×48 动作序列

tagline.en: An Apache-2.0 heterogeneous masked autoregressive world model that predicts robot video from actions.
tagline.zh: Apache-2.0 许可的异构掩码自回归世界模型,依据动作预测机器人视频。

en: HMA (Heterogeneous Masked Autoregression) is Lirui Wang's open-weight world model for robotics, released under Apache-2.0. Given a scene and a sequence of actions, it predicts how the world unfolds — an action-conditioned video model for robot dynamics.

It comes in two flavours built on different backbones: a MAGVIT-based 362M variant and a MAR-based 1B variant, letting you pick between a lighter discrete-token model and a larger continuous one. The base checkpoints are published on Hugging Face.

In WorldFoundry you run HMA to roll out robot dynamics as video from an initial frame and an action stream. The model checkpoints and robot assets are pulled in at run time, so have them staged before generation.
zh: HMA(异构掩码自回归,Heterogeneous Masked Autoregression)是 Lirui Wang 开源的机器人世界模型,采用 Apache-2.0 许可。给定一个场景与一串动作,它预测世界如何演变——是一个面向机器人动力学的动作条件视频模型。
它提供两种基于不同骨干的形态:基于 MAGVIT 的 362M 变体,以及基于 MAR 的 1B 变体,让你在更轻量的离散 token 模型与更大的连续模型之间选择。基础 checkpoint 已发布于 Hugging Face。
在 WorldFoundry 中,你可以用 HMA 从初始帧加一段动作序列出发,把机器人动力学以视频形式推演出来。模型权重与机器人素材在运行时载入,请在生成前先备好。

whenToUse.en: Reach for HMA when you want an openly-licensed world model to simulate robot dynamics and generate action-conditioned rollouts. The 362M variant is the lighter starting point; the 1B variant offers higher-fidelity continuous prediction.
whenToUse.zh: 当你需要一个开放许可的世界模型来模拟机器人动力学、生成动作条件推演时,HMA 值得一试。362M 变体是更轻量的起点;1B 变体提供更高保真的连续预测。

notFor.en: This is a research world model for robot dynamics, not a general text-to-video generator. Checkpoints and robot assets are downloaded separately, so plan for the download and disk space.
notFor.zh: 它是面向机器人动力学的研究型世界模型,而非通用文生视频生成器。Checkpoint 与机器人素材需单独下载,请预留下载时间与磁盘空间。

en: Apache-2.0 open weights
Action-conditioned video prediction for robot dynamics
Two backbones: MAGVIT 362M and MAR 1B
Base checkpoints available on Hugging Face
zh: Apache-2.0 开放权重
面向机器人动力学的动作条件视频预测
两种骨干:MAGVIT 362M 与 MAR 1B
基础 checkpoint 已上线 Hugging Face

en: HunyuanWorld 1.0 is Tencent Hunyuan's world-generation model. From a text prompt or a single image, it builds a coherent 3D scene you can look around and navigate, rather than a flat video.

The model spans several output forms: text-to-3D-world and image-to-3D-world generation, panoramic views, and mesh export so the result can be brought into downstream 3D tooling. It ships as code and weights.
In WorldFoundry you drive HunyuanWorld from a prompt or image to synthesize the world. The model checkpoints and some third-party assets are resolved at run time, so stage them before generation.
zh: HunyuanWorld 1.0 是腾讯混元的世界生成模型。从一段文字提示词或一张图片出发,它构建出一个连贯、可环视与漫游的 3D 场景,而不只是一段平面视频。
该模型覆盖多种输出形态:文本到 3D 世界、图像到 3D 世界的生成,全景视角,以及网格导出——让结果能接入下游 3D 工具链。它以代码加权重的形式发布。
在 WorldFoundry 中,你从提示词或图片出发驱动 HunyuanWorld 合成世界。模型权重与部分第三方素材在运行时解析载入,请在生成前先备好。

whenToUse.en: Use it when you want to generate an explorable, navigable 3D scene from text or an image — including panoramas and a mesh you can export into other 3D pipelines.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想从文字或图片生成可探索、可漫游的 3D 场景——包括全景图与可导出到其他 3D 流程的网格时,选它。

notFor.en: It targets 3D world synthesis rather than standard clip-style video generation. Checkpoints and third-party assets download separately, so allow for setup time and disk space.
notFor.zh: 它面向 3D 世界合成,而非常规短视频生成。权重与第三方素材需单独下载,请预留准备时间与磁盘空间。

Panoramic views for immersive scenes
Mesh export into downstream 3D tooling
Released with both code and weights

支持全景视角,呈现沉浸式场景
网格可导出至下游 3D 工具链
代码与权重同时发布

en: HY-Embodied is Tencent's vision-language-action (VLA) model for embodied robot control. It takes camera images together with a language instruction and produces robot actions — a policy that maps what the robot sees and is told to do into what it does.

WorldFoundry runs HY-Embodied through an official image-text runtime adapter, so it slots into the shared inference flow. The published checkpoint is hosted on Hugging Face and is pulled in at run time.
In WorldFoundry you give the model observations and an instruction, and it returns an action policy rollout for the robot.
zh: HY-Embodied 是腾讯的视觉-语言-动作(VLA)模型,用于具身机器人控制。它接收相机图像与一条语言指令,输出机器人动作——是一个把「机器人看到什么、被要求做什么」映射到「机器人怎么做」的策略。
WorldFoundry 通过官方的图文运行时适配器运行 HY-Embodied,使其融入统一的推理流程。已发布的 checkpoint 托管于 Hugging Face,在运行时载入。
在 WorldFoundry 中,你把观测与指令交给模型,它便返回机器人的动作策略推演。

whenToUse.en: Use it when you need an embodied VLA policy that turns camera views and a natural-language instruction into robot actions.
whenToUse.zh: 当你需要一个具身 VLA 策略、把相机视角与自然语言指令转化为机器人动作时,选它。

notFor.en: It is a control policy, not a media generator — it outputs robot actions, not video or images. The checkpoint downloads separately, so stage it before running.
notFor.zh: 它是控制策略而非媒体生成器——输出的是机器人动作,而非视频或图像。Checkpoint 需单独下载,请在运行前先备好。

Consumes camera images plus a language instruction
Runs through an official image-text runtime adapter
Checkpoint published on Hugging Face

输入为相机图像加语言指令
通过官方图文运行时适配器运行
Checkpoint 已发布于 Hugging Face

tagline.en: Streaming 3D reconstruction that builds scene geometry from a video as frames arrive.
tagline.zh: 流式 3D 重建,随视频帧到达即时构建场景几何。

en: Infinite VGGT (StreamVGGT) is a 3D reconstruction model that works in a streaming fashion: instead of waiting for a full image set, it ingests frames as they come in and incrementally recovers the scene's 3D structure. It builds on the VGGT line of feed-forward geometry models.
This makes it a fit for long or open-ended video, where reconstructing everything at once is impractical. WorldFoundry vendors the StreamVGGT pipeline in-tree for streaming reconstruction.
In WorldFoundry you feed it a sequence of frames and it produces the reconstructed 3D geometry. Checkpoint-backed inference needs the StreamVGGT weights staged first.
zh: Infinite VGGT(StreamVGGT)是一个以流式方式工作的 3D 重建模型:它不必等待完整的图像集,而是随帧到达逐步摄入,并增量地恢复场景的 3D 结构。它构建在 VGGT 系列前馈几何模型之上。
这让它适合处理长视频或开放式视频——对这类输入,一次性重建全部内容并不现实。WorldFoundry 将 StreamVGGT pipeline 内置在项目中用于流式重建。
在 WorldFoundry 中,你把一段帧序列交给它,它便输出重建的 3D 几何。基于 checkpoint 的推理需要先备好 StreamVGGT 权重。

whenToUse.en: Use it for 3D reconstruction from video where frames arrive over time — long or continuous sequences that you'd rather process incrementally than all at once.
whenToUse.zh: 当你要从随时间到达的视频帧做 3D 重建——面对长序列或连续序列、更希望增量处理而非一次性处理时,选它。

notFor.en: It reconstructs geometry, it does not generate new imagery. The model weights are downloaded separately, so stage them before running.
notFor.zh: 它重建几何,而不生成新图像。模型权重需单独下载,请在运行前先备好。

Handles long or open-ended video sequences
Builds on the VGGT feed-forward geometry approach
Pipeline vendored in-tree in WorldFoundry
zh: 流式、增量的 3D 重建
可处理长视频或开放式视频序列
构建于 VGGT 前馈几何方法之上
pipeline 在 WorldFoundry 中内置

en: InternVLA-A1-3B is InternRobotics' vision-language-action policy. It pairs a Qwen3-VL backbone with an action expert and a flow-matching sampler to turn camera views and an instruction into robot actions.

The runtime works with three cameras, using a past/current image pair from each, and computes the language and history features once before running the action-flow steps. Alongside the base A1-3B checkpoint there is a RoboTwin-tuned variant; it also draws on a Qwen3-VL processor and a Cosmos tokenizer, all staged locally.

In WorldFoundry you supply the multi-camera observations and instruction, and the model returns an action rollout. All checkpoints and supporting assets must be staged on the machine before inference.
zh: InternVLA-A1-3B 是 InternRobotics 的视觉-语言-动作策略。它把 Qwen3-VL 骨干与一个动作专家、一个 flow-matching 采样器结合起来,将相机视角与指令转化为机器人动作。
运行时使用三路相机,每路取过去/当前一对图像,并在动作流步骤之前一次性算好语言与历史特征。除基础 A1-3B checkpoint 外,还有一个 RoboTwin 调优变体;它还会用到 Qwen3-VL 处理器与 Cosmos tokenizer,这些都需本地备好。
在 WorldFoundry 中,你提供多相机观测与指令,模型便返回动作推演。所有 checkpoint 与配套素材须先在机器上备好,方可推理。

notFor.en: It expects a three-camera observation setup and outputs robot actions, not media. Several checkpoints and processor assets must be staged locally, so plan for the download and disk space.

en: LAPA (Latent Action Pretraining) is an approach for learning robot actions from video by discovering a latent action space, rather than relying on labeled action data. The released LAPA-7B-openx model applies this to the Open X-Embodiment data and is available under an MIT license.

It is a visual-action model: it consumes visual context and produces actions as latent action tokens, distinct from a video-generation model even though it draws on video. The 7B checkpoint is published on Hugging Face.
In WorldFoundry you run LAPA to derive action tokens from visual input. The 7B weights are staged as action-token model assets and pulled in at run time.
zh: LAPA(Latent Action Pretraining,潜在动作预训练)是一种从视频中学习机器人动作的方法:它通过发现一个潜在动作空间来学习,而不依赖带标注的动作数据。已发布的 LAPA-7B-openx 将该方法应用于 Open X-Embodiment 数据,以 MIT 许可提供。
它是一个视觉-动作模型:摄入视觉上下文,以潜在动作 token 的形式输出动作——尽管借助视频,但它区别于视频生成模型。7B checkpoint 已发布于 Hugging Face。
在 WorldFoundry 中,你运行 LAPA 从视觉输入推导动作 token。7B 权重以动作 token 模型素材的形式备好,在运行时载入。

whenToUse.en: Use it when you want a latent-action pretraining approach that learns actions from video without action labels, and outputs latent action tokens from visual context.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想要一种潜在动作预训练方法——从视频中无标注地学习动作,并从视觉上下文输出潜在动作 token 时,选它。

notFor.en: It is an action-token model, not a video generator, so don't expect rendered video output. The 7B checkpoint downloads separately, so plan for the download and disk space.
notFor.zh: 它是动作 token 模型而非视频生成器,不要期待渲染出的视频输出。7B checkpoint 需单独下载,请预留下载时间与磁盘空间。

en: MIT-licensed LAPA-7B-openx checkpoint
Learns actions from video without action labels
Latent-action pretraining on Open X-Embodiment data
Outputs latent action tokens from visual context
zh: MIT 许可的 LAPA-7B-openx checkpoint
从视频中学习动作,无需动作标注
在 Open X-Embodiment 数据上做潜在动作预训练
从视觉上下文输出潜在动作 token

tagline.en: A vision-language-action policy pairing Qwen3-VL and DINOv3 with an MMDiT action sampler for robot control.
tagline.zh: 将 Qwen3-VL、DINOv3 与 MMDiT 动作采样器结合的视觉-语言-动作策略,用于机器人控制。

en: LDA-1B is a vision-language-action policy for robot control. It assembles a Qwen3-VL language-vision backbone with a DINOv3 ViT visual model and an MMDiT-based action sampler, mapping observations and instructions to robot actions.

The runtime loads a locally staged tensor state dict (around 14.4 GB) with weights_only loading and never runs checkpoint Python. A paired dataset_statistics.json is required — the runtime validates a 29-dimensional raw action contract before unnormalizing, slicing the model's full 138-dimensional output down to the released 29-dimensional GR1 layout. The RoboCasa checkpoint is hosted on Hugging Face, alongside a Qwen3-VL processor and a DINOv3 model.

In WorldFoundry you provide observations and the model returns an action rollout. All weights and the statistics file must be staged locally before inference. Note the license situation: the source repository declares CC BY-NC 4.0 while the hosted artifact card declares Apache-2.0, and this integration follows the more restrictive source license.
zh: LDA-1B 是用于机器人控制的视觉-语言-动作策略。它把 Qwen3-VL 语言-视觉骨干、DINOv3 ViT 视觉模型与基于 MMDiT 的动作采样器组装在一起,将观测与指令映射为机器人动作。

运行时以 weights_only 方式加载本地备好的张量 state dict(约 14.4 GB),不执行 checkpoint 中的 Python。需要配套的 dataset_statistics.json——运行时会在反归一化前校验一个 29 维的原始动作契约,并把模型完整的 138 维输出按已发布的 29 维 GR1 布局切片。RoboCasa checkpoint 托管于 Hugging Face,并配有 Qwen3-VL 处理器与 DINOv3 模型。
在 WorldFoundry 中,你提供观测,模型返回动作推演。所有权重与统计文件须先本地备好,方可推理。关于许可请留意:源仓库声明 CC BY-NC 4.0,而托管的模型卡声明 Apache-2.0,本集成采用更严格的源仓库许可。

whenToUse.en: Use it when you want a VLA policy that combines a Qwen3-VL backbone with DINOv3 vision and a diffusion-transformer action sampler, targeting RoboCasa-style robot control.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想要一个结合 Qwen3-VL 骨干、DINOv3 视觉与扩散 transformer 动作采样器的 VLA 策略、面向 RoboCasa 风格机器人控制时,选它。

notFor.en: It outputs robot actions, not media, and depends on a mandatory statistics file plus a roughly 14.4 GB state dict that downloads separately. The source license is non-commercial (CC BY-NC 4.0), so check terms before commercial use.
notFor.zh: 它输出机器人动作而非媒体内容,并依赖一个必备的统计文件与约 14.4 GB、需单独下载的 state dict。源仓库许可为非商业用途(CC BY-NC 4.0),商用前请先确认条款。

MMDiT-based action sampler
Outputs the 29-dimensional GR1 action layout
Source license is CC BY-NC 4.0 (non-commercial)
zh: Qwen3-VL 骨干搭配 DINOv3 ViT 视觉
基于 MMDiT 的动作采样器
输出 29 维的 GR1 动作布局
源仓库许可为 CC BY-NC 4.0(非商业)

en: LeWorldModel is a world model that predicts how an environment evolves, offered in several flavours: a latent-space world model, a JEPA-style world model, and a pixel-space world model. This lets you compare how the world is represented — abstract embeddings versus raw pixels.
WorldFoundry exposes an inference-only wrapper around the official evaluation route, following the upstream eval config flow. The published model bundle is hosted on Hugging Face.

In WorldFoundry you run the model through its evaluation entrypoint — for example on the PushT control task. Execution needs the stable-worldmodel packages, the task datasets, and policy weights (when the policy isn't random) staged first.
zh: LeWorldModel 是一个预测环境如何演变的世界模型,提供多种形态:潜空间世界模型、JEPA 风格世界模型,以及像素空间世界模型。这让你可以对比世界的不同表示方式——抽象嵌入与原始像素。

tagline.en: Apache-2.0 autoregressive video-action world model for robot control, with base and task-tuned checkpoints.
tagline.zh: Apache-2.0 许可的自回归视频-动作世界模型,用于机器人控制,含基础与任务调优 checkpoint。

en: LingBot-VA is an autoregressive video-action world model for robot control. It couples world modeling with action generation: as it rolls forward it produces action traces and can carry predicted-video metadata, using a server/client runtime for inference.

It ships three Apache-2.0 checkpoints: a base model plus two post-trained variants tuned for RoboTwin and for LIBERO-Long. The architecture is an inference-only Wan-VA design covering the model graph, a distributed server and client, preprocessing, action diffusion, KV-cache updates, and action decoding, all constructed strictly from local checkpoints.
In WorldFoundry you point the server at a staged checkpoint and drive rollouts that emit action traces. All three checkpoints are open-weight on Hugging Face.
zh: LingBot-VA 是一个用于机器人控制的自回归视频-动作世界模型。它把世界建模与动作生成耦合起来:在向前推演时输出动作轨迹(action trace),并可携带预测视频的元数据,推理采用服务端/客户端运行时。
它发布三个 Apache-2.0 checkpoint:一个基础模型,加上分别针对 RoboTwin 与 LIBERO-Long 调优的两个后训练变体。其架构是一个仅推理的 Wan-VA 设计,涵盖模型图、分布式服务端与客户端、预处理、动作扩散、KV-cache 更新与动作解码,且严格从本地 checkpoint 构建。
在 WorldFoundry 中,你让服务端指向一个备好的 checkpoint,驱动会输出动作轨迹的推演。三个 checkpoint 均为 Hugging Face 上的开放权重。

whenToUse.en: Use it when you want an openly-licensed video-action world model for robot control that produces action rollouts — with task-tuned checkpoints ready for RoboTwin and LIBERO-Long.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想要一个开放许可的视频-动作世界模型、用于机器人控制并产出动作推演——且已备有面向 RoboTwin 与 LIBERO-Long 的任务调优 checkpoint 时,选它。

notFor.en: It runs a server/client stack and constructs strictly from local checkpoints, so the weights must be staged first. Its output is action traces for control, not general video generation.
notFor.zh: 它运行服务端/客户端栈,且严格从本地 checkpoint 构建,因此权重须先备好。其输出是用于控制的动作轨迹,而非通用视频生成。

The selectable base policy was staged from ModelScope and its core blobs match the pinned Hugging Face revision by exact size and SHA-256; it is a pretraining checkpoint, so task-level numerical parity is not claimed.
This is an inference-only environment. The in-tree policy and preprocessing code have no LeRobot, datasets, trainer, or external source-checkout dependency.

tagline.en: Apache-2.0 4B vision-language-action policy on Qwen2.5-VL, for multi-camera robot control.
tagline.zh: Apache-2.0 许可、基于 Qwen2.5-VL 的 4B 视觉-语言-动作策略,面向多相机机器人控制。

en: LingBot-VLA is a 4B vision-language-action policy for robot control, built on a Qwen2.5-VL backbone. It maps camera views and an instruction into robot actions, with feature transforms, robot mapping, and normalization integrated directly for direct policy inference.

It comes as three Apache-2.0 checkpoints: the base 4B model, a RoboTwin post-trained variant, and a depth-augmented RoboTwin variant. The policy expects three configured camera views and a 14-dimensional state for the bundled RoboTwin mapping. The model is built on the meta device and checkpoint tensors stream straight to the chosen device and dtype, which keeps startup memory down; device selection covers CUDA architectures from pre-Ampere through Hopper and newer.
In WorldFoundry you stage the public checkpoint and its Qwen2.5-VL processor assets, supply the multi-camera observations, and the model returns an action rollout.
zh: LingBot-VLA 是一个用于机器人控制的 4B 视觉-语言-动作策略,构建在 Qwen2.5-VL 骨干之上。它把相机视角与指令映射为机器人动作,并直接集成了特征变换、机器人映射与归一化,以支持直接的策略推理。

它提供三个 Apache-2.0 checkpoint:基础 4B 模型、一个 RoboTwin 后训练变体,以及一个带深度增强的 RoboTwin 变体。该策略在其自带的 RoboTwin 映射下,预期三路已配置相机视角与一个 14 维状态。模型在 meta 设备上构建,checkpoint 张量直接流式载入到所选设备与 dtype,从而降低启动内存;设备选择覆盖从 pre-Ampere 到 Hopper 及更新的 CUDA 架构。
在 WorldFoundry 中,你备好公开 checkpoint 及其 Qwen2.5-VL 处理器素材,提供多相机观测,模型便返回动作推演。

whenToUse.en: Use it when you want an openly-licensed Qwen2.5-VL-based VLA policy for multi-camera robot control, with RoboTwin-tuned and depth-augmented variants on hand.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想要一个开放许可、基于 Qwen2.5-VL 的 VLA 策略、用于多相机机器人控制,并备有 RoboTwin 调优与深度增强变体时,选它。

notFor.en: It expects three camera views and a 14D state under the bundled mapping, and outputs robot actions rather than media. The public checkpoint and its Qwen2.5-VL processor assets download separately.
notFor.zh: 在其自带映射下,它预期三路相机视角与 14 维状态,输出的是机器人动作而非媒体内容。公开 checkpoint 及其 Qwen2.5-VL 处理器素材需单独下载。

en: Apache-2.0 4B policy on a Qwen2.5-VL backbone
Base plus RoboTwin and depth-augmented variants
Three camera views with a 14D state (RoboTwin mapping)
Streaming checkpoint load keeps startup memory low
zh: Apache-2.0 的 4B 策略,基于 Qwen2.5-VL 骨干

tagline.en: Apache-2.0 6B vision-language-action policy on a Qwen3-VL MoE backbone, for robot control.
tagline.zh: Apache-2.0 许可、基于 Qwen3-VL MoE 骨干的 6B 视觉-语言-动作策略,用于机器人控制。

en: LingBot-VLA 2.0 is the next-generation LingBot vision-language-action policy for robot control, built on a Qwen3-VL Mixture-of-Experts backbone. It integrates the official policy, batched inference, feature transforms, robot mappings, and normalization directly for action prediction.

The runtime preserves official batched observation inference and Qwen3-VL image_grid_thw handling, works with a 55-dimensional internal representation and a denoising step, and offers optional torch.compile paths. Perception teachers used only during training are excluded — the model consumes their distilled representations from the trained weights. The public 6B checkpoint uses a bundled official-derived inference config, and robot-specific downstream checkpoints can override it with their own config file.
In WorldFoundry you stage the 6B checkpoint (published under Apache-2.0 on Hugging Face) and its Qwen3-VL processor assets, supply observations, and the model returns an action prediction.
zh: LingBot-VLA 2.0 是新一代 LingBot 视觉-语言-动作策略,用于机器人控制,构建在 Qwen3-VL 混合专家(MoE)骨干之上。它直接集成了官方策略、批量推理、特征变换、机器人映射与归一化,用于动作预测。
运行时保留了官方的批量观测推理与 Qwen3-VL 的 image_grid_thw 处理,使用一个 55 维内部表示与一个去噪步骤,并提供可选的 torch.compile 路径。仅用于训练的感知教师被排除在外——模型从训练好的权重中消费它们蒸馏出的表示。公开的 6B checkpoint 采用自带的官方衍生推理配置,机器人专用的下游 checkpoint 可用各自的配置文件覆盖它。
在 WorldFoundry 中,你备好 6B checkpoint(以 Apache-2.0 发布于 Hugging Face)及其 Qwen3-VL 处理器素材,提供观测,模型便返回动作预测。

whenToUse.en: Use it when you want the latest LingBot VLA policy — a Qwen3-VL MoE-based model with batched inference — for robot action prediction and control.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想要最新的 LingBot VLA 策略——一个基于 Qwen3-VL MoE、支持批量推理的模型——用于机器人动作预测与控制时,选它。

notFor.en: It outputs robot actions, not media. The 6B checkpoint and its Qwen3-VL processor assets download separately, so plan for the download and disk space.
notFor.zh: 它输出机器人动作而非媒体内容。6B checkpoint 及其 Qwen3-VL 处理器素材需单独下载,请预留下载时间与磁盘空间。

tagline.en: A memory-augmented vision-language-action policy with an episodic memory bank, for dual-arm robot control.
tagline.zh: 带情景记忆库的记忆增强视觉-语言-动作策略,面向双臂机器人控制。

en: Mem-0 is a memory-augmented vision-language-action policy for robot control. Its runtime pairs an episodic memory bank with a Qwen feature path, a classifier, and a flow-matching action decoder, letting the policy draw on past experience when deciding what to do.

This entry targets the published M1 multi-task execution checkpoint, which runs on its own without a separate high-level planning server. The output matches the official 14-value dual-arm joint layout: internally the model works in a 16-dimensional padded state/action space and drops two padding slots to produce the 14-dimensional environment output. The checkpoint is stored as byte-split parts that the runtime reads as one seekable stream, avoiding a second full copy of the roughly 15.3 GB weights.
In WorldFoundry you stage the M1 checkpoint along with its normalization statistics and a local Qwen backbone, supply observations, and the model returns a dual-arm action chunk.
zh: Mem-0 是一个用于机器人控制的记忆增强视觉-语言-动作策略。其运行时把情景记忆库与 Qwen 特征路径、一个分类器,以及一个 flow-matching 动作解码器结合起来,让策略在决策时能借助过往经验。
本条目面向已发布的 M1 多任务执行 checkpoint,它可独立运行,无需单独的高层规划服务端。输出对齐官方的 14 值双臂关节布局:模型内部在 16 维填充的状态/动作空间中工作,并去掉两个填充槽位,得到 14 维的环境输出。checkpoint 以字节切分的多个部分存储,运行时将其作为一个可寻址流读取,避免为约 15.3 GB 的权重再造一份完整副本。
在 WorldFoundry 中,你备好 M1 checkpoint 及其归一化统计与本地 Qwen 骨干,提供观测,模型便返回一段双臂动作块。

whenToUse.en: Use it when you want a memory-augmented VLA policy for dual-arm robot control, drawing on an episodic memory bank for multi-task execution.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想要一个记忆增强的 VLA 策略、用于双臂机器人控制,并借助情景记忆库完成多任务执行时,选它。

notFor.en: It outputs robot actions, not media. The M1 checkpoint (roughly 15.3 GB), its normalization statistics, and a local Qwen backbone must be staged before running.
notFor.zh: 它输出机器人动作而非媒体内容。M1 checkpoint(约 15.3 GB)、其归一化统计与本地 Qwen 骨干须先备好方可运行。

Flow-matching action decoder on a Qwen feature path
Outputs the official 14-value dual-arm joint layout
Byte-split checkpoint read as one stream, no second copy
zh: 带情景记忆库的记忆增强 VLA 策略
Qwen 特征路径上的 flow-matching 动作解码器

tagline.en: Microsoft's interactive Minecraft world model — steer an autoregressive video simulator with game actions.
tagline.zh: 微软的交互式 Minecraft 世界模型——用游戏动作驱动一个自回归视频模拟器。

en: MineWorld is an interactive world model from Microsoft, built around the game of Minecraft. Rather than generating a fixed clip, it simulates the world frame by frame in response to player actions, so you can move, look, and act and watch the scene evolve accordingly.

It belongs to the family of action-conditioned video world models: given a starting view and a stream of interaction tokens, it autoregressively predicts what the world looks like next. This makes it a testbed for embodied agents and for studying how a learned model captures game dynamics.

In WorldFoundry you drive MineWorld through the shared world-model interface — supply an initial context and a sequence of actions, and it rolls out the resulting video. Model weights and the accompanying validation assets are obtained separately before you run it.
zh: MineWorld 是微软推出的交互式世界模型，以 Minecraft 游戏为载体。它不是生成一段固定的片段，而是根据玩家动作逐帧模拟世界，你可以移动、转视角、执行操作，画面会随之演化。
它属于动作条件视频世界模型这一类方法：给定一个起始画面和一串交互动作，它以自回归方式预测世界的下一帧。这让它成为研究具身智能体、以及考察模型如何习得游戏动态的试验场。
在 WorldFoundry 中，你通过统一的世界模型接口来驱动 MineWorld——给出初始上下文和一串动作，它就会推演出对应的视频。运行前需要单独获取模型权重和配套的数据资源。

whenToUse.en: Reach for MineWorld when you want an interactive, action-controllable simulator of a Minecraft-style environment — for prototyping embodied agents or exploring how a world model responds to player input.
whenToUse.zh: 当你需要一个可交互、可用动作控制的 Minecraft 风格环境模拟器时，可以选择 MineWorld——适合搭建具身智能体原型，或探索世界模型如何回应玩家输入。

notFor.en: Not a general text-to-video tool; it is tied to the Minecraft domain and expects action inputs. Weights and validation data are downloaded separately rather than bundled.
notFor.zh: 它不是通用的文生视频工具，而是绑定在 Minecraft 领域、需要动作输入。权重与验证数据需单独下载，并非随附。

Autoregressive frame-by-frame rollout driven by player actions
From Microsoft, with source and paper openly available
Fits WorldFoundry's shared world-model interface

由玩家动作驱动、逐帧自回归推演

tagline.en: A memory-augmented world model that stitches remembered views into a consistent, explorable scene.
tagline.zh: 一个记忆增强的世界模型，把记住的多个视角拼合成一致、可探索的场景。

en: MosaicMem is an open-source memory-augmented world model for video generation. Its central idea is memory: it ingests keyframe patches, retrieves the views relevant to where you want to look next, and composes them on a shared latent canvas so the generated world stays coherent over time.

This memory-first design targets a common weakness of pure video models — drift and forgetting. By keeping a growing record of what has already been seen and pulling from it during generation, MosaicMem aims for spatial consistency as the viewpoint moves.

In WorldFoundry, MosaicMem is available through the memory layer, which handles keyframe patch ingestion, target-view retrieval, coverage summaries, and latent-canvas composition. The generator weights and assets are supplied separately before you produce output.
zh: MosaicMem 是一个开源的记忆增强世界模型，面向视频生成。它的核心是「记忆」：吸收关键帧的图块，检索出与你下一步想看的方向相关的视角，并在一个共享的 latent canvas 上进行合成，使生成的世界随时间保持连贯。
这种以记忆为先的设计针对纯视频模型的常见短板——漂移与遗忘。通过不断累积已经看过的内容、并在生成时从中取用，MosaicMem 力求在视角移动时保持空间一致性。
在 WorldFoundry 中，MosaicMem 通过记忆层提供：负责关键帧图块的吸收、目标视角检索、覆盖度汇总，以及 latent canvas 合成。生成器权重与资源需在产出前单独准备。

whenToUse.en: Consider MosaicMem when spatial consistency across a moving viewpoint matters — building an explorable scene where previously-seen regions should stay stable rather than being re-hallucinated.
whenToUse.zh: 当移动视角下的空间一致性很重要时，可以考虑 MosaicMem——比如构建一个可探索的场景，让此前看过的区域保持稳定，而不是被重新臆造。

notFor.en: Not the simplest path to a one-off short clip — the memory workflow is aimed at consistent, explorable worlds. Generator weights and assets are obtained separately.
notFor.zh: 如果只想生成一段一次性的短片，它并非最简单的路径——记忆化流程更适合追求一致、可探索的世界。生成器权重与资源需单独获取。

en: Memory-augmented generation for spatial consistency over time
Keyframe patch ingestion plus target-view retrieval
Latent-canvas composition of remembered views
Exposed through WorldFoundry's memory layer
zh: 记忆增强生成，追求随时间的空间一致性
关键帧图块吸收 + 目标视角检索
在 latent canvas 上合成记住的视角
通过 WorldFoundry 的记忆层对外提供

tagline.en: Turn a single image into a navigable 3D world — camera-controlled video backed by a panoramic Gaussian scaffold.
tagline.zh: 把单张图片变成可漫游的 3D 世界——由全景 Gaussian 支架支撑的相机可控视频。

en: MoVerse, from the Orange 3Dv Team, turns a single image into a navigable world. Starting from one picture, it builds a scene you can move a camera through, generating camera-controlled video of the space rather than a single fixed shot.

Under the hood it combines several building blocks: a panoramic Gaussian scaffold that gives the scene 3D structure, depth estimation, panorama synthesis, and a video generator. In WorldFoundry it reuses shared components including GeoCalib, Depth Anything 3, a SHARP panorama stage, Wan, and TAEHV, and it resolves its checkpoints locally.

Because it stitches together a full 3D-aware pipeline, MoVerse expects several model snapshots to be staged in advance and runs offline; it also leans on FLUX for image filling. It is oriented toward high-fidelity scene exploration rather than lightweight clip generation.
zh: MoVerse 由 Orange 3Dv Team 开发，能把单张图片变成可漫游的世界。它从一张图片出发，构建出一个可以移动相机穿行的场景，生成相机可控的视频，而不是一个固定镜头。
其内部由多个模块组合而成：赋予场景 3D 结构的全景 Gaussian 支架、深度估计、全景合成，以及一个视频生成器。在 WorldFoundry 中它复用了共享组件，包括 GeoCalib、Depth Anything 3、SHARP 全景阶段、Wan 和 TAEHV，并在本地解析所需 checkpoint。
由于它串联了一整套具备 3D 感知的流程，MoVerse 需要预先准备好多个模型快照并离线运行，图像填充部分还依赖 FLUX。它面向高保真的场景探索，而非轻量级的片段生成。

whenToUse.en: Choose MoVerse when you want to explore a scene from a single image — generating camera trajectories through a 3D-consistent world for immersive navigation.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想从单张图片出发探索一个场景时，可选择 MoVerse——在一个 3D 一致的世界里生成相机轨迹，实现沉浸式漫游。

notFor.en: A heavyweight pipeline: it runs offline, needs several model snapshots staged in advance plus FLUX access and compatible CUDA kernels, and is best suited to capable GPUs rather than modest hardware.
notFor.zh: 这是一条重型流程：需离线运行，须预先准备好多个模型快照、FLUX 访问权限以及兼容的 CUDA kernel，更适合性能较强的 GPU，而非普通硬件。

tagline.en: A diffusion-transformer robot policy from the LeRobot ecosystem, trained across multiple tasks by imitation.
tagline.zh: 来自 LeRobot 生态的扩散 Transformer 机器人策略，通过模仿学习跨多任务训练。

en: Multi-task DiT is a robot control policy from the LeRobot ecosystem. It uses a diffusion transformer to predict actions, and is trained by imitation learning across multiple manipulation tasks, so a single policy can cover a range of behaviors rather than one narrow skill.

Diffusion-based policies model the distribution of expert actions and sample from it, which tends to handle multimodal behavior gracefully. Pairing that with a transformer backbone gives the model capacity to condition on richer observations and task context.

In WorldFoundry, Multi-task DiT runs through the action runtime as a robot policy: give it observations and it produces an action trace. The policy checkpoint is obtained separately before you roll it out.
zh: Multi-task DiT 是来自 LeRobot 生态的机器人控制策略。它用一个扩散 Transformer 来预测动作，并通过模仿学习在多个操作任务上训练，因此单一策略可覆盖一系列行为，而非某项狭窄技能。
基于扩散的策略会对专家动作的分布建模并从中采样，往往能自然地处理多模态行为。再配上 transformer 主干，模型便有能力依据更丰富的观测和任务上下文进行条件生成。
在 WorldFoundry 中，Multi-task DiT 作为机器人策略在动作运行时中执行：给它观测，它就产出一段动作轨迹。策略 checkpoint 需在推演前单独获取。

whenToUse.en: Use it when you want a single imitation-learned policy that spans several manipulation tasks, and you prefer a diffusion-transformer approach that models the full distribution of expert actions.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想要一个跨多个操作任务、通过模仿学习得到的单一策略，并偏好能对专家动作完整分布建模的扩散 Transformer 方法时，可以选择它。

notFor.en: It is a control policy, not a video or perception model; it expects robot observations and outputs actions. The checkpoint is supplied separately.
notFor.zh: 它是一个控制策略，而非视频或感知模型，需要机器人观测输入、输出动作。checkpoint 需单独提供。

tagline.en: Meta's Navigation World Models — predict egocentric video conditioned on navigation actions.
tagline.zh: Meta 的导航世界模型——在导航动作的条件下预测第一人称视频。

en: Navigation World Models (NWM), from Meta, is a world model built for navigation. Given a starting view and a sequence of movement actions, it predicts the egocentric video an agent would see as it travels through the environment.

This action-conditioned, first-person formulation lets you ask what-if questions about routes: feed in a candidate trajectory and see the imagined rollout. It is an early candidate in WorldFoundry for evaluating navigation video beyond the driving domain, and ships in variants tuned for different navigation settings.

In WorldFoundry, NWM is driven through the world-model interface — provide context and navigation actions, and it rolls out the predicted video. Checkpoints and the supporting datasets are staged separately before you run it.
zh: 导航世界模型（NWM）由 Meta 开发，是一个面向导航构建的世界模型。给定一个起始画面和一串移动动作，它会预测智能体在环境中行进时所看到的第一人称视频。
这种动作条件、第一人称的建模方式，让你可以对路线做「假设」推演：输入一条候选轨迹，看看想象中的推演结果。在 WorldFoundry 里，它是用于评估驾驶领域之外导航视频的早期候选，并提供了针对不同导航场景调优的变体。
在 WorldFoundry 中，NWM 通过世界模型接口驱动——给出上下文和导航动作，它就推演出预测视频。checkpoint 与配套数据集需在运行前单独准备。

whenToUse.en: Reach for NWM when you want to imagine egocentric navigation — predicting what an agent would see along a candidate trajectory, especially in non-driving settings.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想「想象」第一人称导航时，可以选择 NWM——预测智能体沿某条候选轨迹会看到什么，尤其适合非驾驶场景。

notFor.en: Not a general text-to-video model; it is action-conditioned and navigation-oriented. Checkpoints and datasets are staged separately before use.

tagline.en: An open, MIT-licensed interactive Minecraft world model — a playable neural game you steer with actions.
tagline.zh: 开源、MIT 许可的交互式 Minecraft 世界模型——一个用动作操控、可玩的神经网络游戏。

en: Oasis 500M is an interactive world model, released openly under the MIT license through the Open-Oasis project (from Etched). It generates a playable Minecraft-style world one frame at a time, responding to your inputs so the experience feels like a game running entirely inside a neural network.

As an action-conditioned video world model, it takes a starting frame and a stream of actions and autoregressively predicts what happens next. The openly available 500M checkpoint makes it an approachable entry point for experimenting with playable, generative game worlds.

In WorldFoundry, Oasis 500M runs through the shared world-model interface — supply an initial frame and action inputs, and it rolls out the video. The MIT checkpoint and action assets are obtained separately before you run it.
zh: Oasis 500M 是一个交互式世界模型，通过 Open-Oasis 项目（来自 Etched）以 MIT 许可开源。它逐帧生成一个可玩的 Minecraft 风格世界，并回应你的输入，让体验就像一个完全运行在神经网络里的游戏。
作为动作条件的视频世界模型，它接收一个起始帧和一串动作，以自回归方式预测接下来会发生什么。公开可用的 500M checkpoint 让它成为体验可玩、生成式游戏世界的一个易上手入口。

tagline.en: A real-time, audio-visual world model distilled for fast interactive generation.
tagline.zh: 一个实时的视听世界模型，经蒸馏以实现快速交互式生成。

en: OmniForcing is an audio-visual world model built for real-time generation. Rather than producing images alone, it works across both video and audio, aiming to simulate a world you can interact with as it unfolds.

Speed is a core goal: OmniForcing uses distillation to compress a heavier model into a faster one, so it can generate at interactive rates. This makes it suited to live, responsive settings where latency matters as much as quality.
In WorldFoundry, OmniForcing is registered through its official source, with the model checkpoints and runtime assets prepared separately before you generate.
zh: OmniForcing 是一个面向实时生成的视听世界模型。它不只产出画面，而是同时处理视频与音频，目标是模拟一个可以随其展开而交互的世界。
速度是它的核心目标：OmniForcing 通过蒸馏把一个较重的模型压缩成更快的版本，从而能以交互速率生成。这让它适合延迟与画质同样重要的实时、响应式场景。
在 WorldFoundry 中，OmniForcing 通过其官方源接入，模型 checkpoint 与运行时资源需在生成前单独准备。

whenToUse.en: Consider OmniForcing when you need real-time, interactive generation that spans both audio and video, and low latency matters as much as fidelity.
whenToUse.zh: 当你需要同时覆盖音频与视频的实时、交互式生成，且低延迟与画质同等重要时，可以考虑 OmniForcing。

notFor.en: Not aimed at slow, maximum-fidelity offline rendering — its design trades toward speed. Checkpoints and runtime assets are prepared separately before use.
notFor.zh: 它并非面向缓慢、极致保真的离线渲染——其设计偏向速度。checkpoint 与运行时资源需在使用前单独准备。

recipes.name: Open Dreamer
recipes.summary: An open take on Dreamer 4 — a diffusion world model you steer through Minecraft actions.

notes: Open Dreamer source is never vendored; upstream publishes an all-rights-reserved notice. WorldFoundry binds the checkout at ${WORLDFOUNDRY_MODEL_SOURCE_DIR}/open-dreamer-inference, or at $WORLDFOUNDRY_OPEN_DREAMER_SOURCE when that variable is set.
The rollout runs in the checkout's own CUDA-12 JAX environment. The adapter prefers the checkout's .venv/bin/python (created by `uv sync`) and falls back to python_executable when supplied.
Upstream has not released downloadable weights; the Orbax checkpoint must be trained with https://github.com/next-state/open-dreamer or supplied via checkpoint_path.

Context clips must be RGB 368x640, or 360x640 so the entrypoint can zero-pad them to the trained shape. Pass the clip as video= or input_mp4=; the pipeline promotes a filesystem video path into input_mp4.
Interactions without an explicit actions_path are rendered to Minecraft/VPT action JSONL beside the output artifact; context frames are emitted as no-ops because their true actions are unknown.
Mirrors the dependency set of the official rollout harness (reactor-team/open-dreamer, Python 3.11).
JAX CUDA wheels conflict at the ABI level with the shared torch environment, so Open Dreamer keeps a dedicated environment as the unified-environment policy prescribes.

This environment is optional. The adapter prefers the checkout's own .venv/bin/python created by `uv sync`; use this profile when driving the rollout from a WorldFoundry-managed conda environment instead, and set python_executable to its interpreter.
No Open Dreamer source is installed here; the staged official checkout stays on PYTHONPATH at runtime.

tagline.en: An open take on Dreamer 4 — a diffusion world model you steer through Minecraft actions.
tagline.zh: Dreamer 4 的开放实现——一个用 Minecraft 动作操控的扩散世界模型。

en: Open Dreamer is an open reimplementation in the Dreamer 4 lineage — a diffusion-based, interactive world model. It simulates a Minecraft-style environment that you drive with actions, predicting how the world evolves in response to what you do.

You provide a short context clip and a stream of interactions; WorldFoundry renders those interactions into the Minecraft/VPT action space and the model rolls out the resulting video. Context clips are expected as RGB frames at the model's trained resolution, and the rollout runs in the project's own JAX/CUDA environment.

Note that the upstream source is not bundled — it carries an all-rights-reserved notice and publishes no downloadable weights. To run Open Dreamer you point WorldFoundry at your own checkout and a checkpoint you have trained or supplied yourself.
zh: Open Dreamer 是 Dreamer 4 谱系下的一个开放实现——一个基于扩散的交互式世界模型。它模拟一个 Minecraft 风格的环境，你用动作来驱动，模型会预测世界如何随你的操作演化。
你提供一小段上下文片段和一串交互动作；WorldFoundry 会把这些交互渲染进 Minecraft/VPT 动作空间，模型据此推演出视频。上下文片段需是模型训练分辨率下的 RGB 帧，推演在项目自带的 JAX/CUDA 环境中运行。
需要注意的是，上游源码并不随附——它附带保留所有权利的声明，也未发布可下载的权重。要运行 Open Dreamer，你需要让 WorldFoundry 指向你自己的检出目录和一个由你自己训练或提供的 checkpoint。

whenToUse.en: Use Open Dreamer when you want an interactive, diffusion-based Minecraft world model in the Dreamer 4 style and you can bring your own trained checkpoint and environment.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想要一个 Dreamer 4 风格、基于扩散的交互式 Minecraft 世界模型，并且能自备训练好的 checkpoint 与运行环境时，可以使用 Open Dreamer。

notFor.en: There are no downloadable weights and the source is not open for redistribution — you must train or supply your own checkpoint, and set up its JAX/CUDA environment. Not a plug-and-play, ready-weights option.
notFor.zh: 它没有可下载的权重，源码也不开放再分发——你必须自行训练或提供 checkpoint，并搭建其 JAX/CUDA 环境。它不是开箱即用、权重现成的选项。

tagline.zh: 一个用于机器人控制的开放视觉-语言-动作策略，作为独立模型条目收录。

en: OpenPIE 0.6 is a vision-language-action (VLA) policy for robot control, distributed openly on Hugging Face by the exla-ai project. It maps visual observations and a language instruction to robot actions, so a robot can follow natural-language commands to carry out manipulation tasks.

It is tracked in WorldFoundry as its own model entry, separate from the OpenPI pi0 / pi0.5 family, and is served through the in-tree policy runtime. Given observations, it produces an action trace you can roll out.
The policy checkpoint is obtained separately before you run it.
zh: OpenPIE 0.6 是一个用于机器人控制的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略，由 exla-ai 项目在 Hugging Face 上开放发布。它把视觉观测和一条语言指令映射为机器人动作，使机器人能按自然语言指令完成操作任务。
在 WorldFoundry 中，它作为独立的模型条目收录，与 OpenPI 的 pi0 / pi0.5 家族分开，并通过内置的策略运行时提供服务。给定观测，它会产出一段可推演的动作轨迹。
策略 checkpoint 需在运行前单独获取。

whenToUse.en: Use OpenPIE 0.6 when you want an openly available vision-language-action policy to drive a robot from visual input and language instructions.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想用一个公开可得的视觉-语言-动作策略，从视觉输入和语言指令来驱动机器人时，可以使用 OpenPIE 0.6。

notFor.en: A robot control policy, not a video or perception model — it expects observations and outputs actions. The checkpoint is supplied separately.
notFor.zh: 它是机器人控制策略，而非视频或感知模型——需要观测输入、输出动作。checkpoint 需单独提供。

tagline.zh: Physical Intelligence 的 pi0——一个基于 flow 的视觉-语言-动作机器人控制基础模型。

en: pi0 is a vision-language-action foundation model from Physical Intelligence, released through their open OpenPI project. It maps camera observations and a language instruction into continuous robot actions, generating smooth action chunks so a robot can carry out manipulation tasks described in plain language.

Built on a vision-language backbone with a flow-based action expert, pi0 is designed as a generalist policy that can be adapted across robot embodiments and tasks. In WorldFoundry it runs on the in-tree OpenPI runtime with a pi0-specific configuration.
This is an action-generation model: given observations it emits an action trace rather than producing video. The policy checkpoint is obtained separately before you roll it out.
zh: pi0 是 Physical Intelligence 推出的视觉-语言-动作基础模型，通过其开放的 OpenPI 项目发布。它把相机观测和一条语言指令映射为连续的机器人动作，生成平滑的动作片段，使机器人能完成用自然语言描述的操作任务。
pi0 建立在视觉-语言主干之上，并配有一个基于 flow 的动作专家模块，被设计为可跨机器人本体和任务适配的通用策略。在 WorldFoundry 中，它运行于内置的 OpenPI 运行时，并采用 pi0 专属配置。
这是一个动作生成模型：给定观测，它输出的是一段动作轨迹，而非视频。策略 checkpoint 需在推演前单独获取。

whenToUse.en: Reach for pi0 when you want a generalist vision-language-action policy that turns camera input and language instructions into robot actions, and prefer a flow-based approach to smooth action generation.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想要一个通用的视觉-语言-动作策略，把相机输入和语言指令转成机器人动作，并偏好基于 flow 的平滑动作生成时，可以选择 pi0。

notFor.en: An action-generation policy, not a video-generation model — it outputs action traces. The policy checkpoint is supplied separately.
notFor.zh: 它是动作生成策略，而非视频生成模型——输出的是动作轨迹。策略 checkpoint 需单独提供。

tagline.en: The FAST variant of pi0 — an autoregressive VLA policy using tokenized actions for faster control.
tagline.zh: pi0 的 FAST 变体——用 token 化动作的自回归 VLA 策略，控制更快。

en: pi0-FAST is a variant of Physical Intelligence's pi0 vision-language-action model, released through the OpenPI project. Instead of a flow-based action expert, it predicts actions as discrete tokens using the FAST action tokenization, letting the policy generate actions autoregressively.

Tokenized actions let pi0-FAST reuse a compact, transformer-style decoding path, an alternative design point to the flow-based pi0 that can suit different control needs. In WorldFoundry it runs on the in-tree OpenPI runtime with a DROID-oriented FAST configuration.
This is an action-generation model: it emits an action trace rather than video. The pi0-FAST checkpoint is obtained separately before you roll it out.
zh: pi0-FAST 是 Physical Intelligence 的 pi0 视觉-语言-动作模型的一个变体，通过 OpenPI 项目发布。它不采用基于 flow 的动作专家，而是用 FAST 动作 token 化把动作预测为离散 token，让策略以自回归方式生成动作。
token 化动作让 pi0-FAST 得以复用一条紧凑的 transformer 式解码路径，是相对基于 flow 的 pi0 的另一种设计取向，可适配不同的控制需求。在 WorldFoundry 中，它运行于内置 OpenPI 运行时，并采用面向 DROID 的 FAST 配置。
这是一个动作生成模型：它输出的是动作轨迹而非视频。pi0-FAST 的 checkpoint 需在推演前单独获取。

whenToUse.en: Choose pi0-FAST when you want a vision-language-action policy with tokenized, autoregressive action decoding — an alternative to the flow-based pi0 for robot control.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想要一个采用 token 化、自回归动作解码的视觉-语言-动作策略时，可选择 pi0-FAST——它是基于 flow 的 pi0 之外的另一种机器人控制选项。

notFor.en: An action-generation policy, not a video model — it outputs action traces. The pi0-FAST checkpoint is supplied separately.
notFor.zh: 它是动作生成策略，而非视频模型——输出的是动作轨迹。pi0-FAST 的 checkpoint 需单独提供。

Vision-language-action policy from Physical Intelligence's OpenPI
Alternative to the flow-based pi0 action expert
Runs on WorldFoundry's in-tree OpenPI runtime, emitting action traces
zh: 采用 FAST token 化、自回归的 pi0 变体

tagline.zh: pi0.5——Physical Intelligence 更进一步的 VLA 策略，面向机器人控制的更强泛化调优。

en: pi0.5 is the follow-on to pi0 from Physical Intelligence, released through the OpenPI project. It is a vision-language-action policy that turns camera observations and a language instruction into robot actions, extending the pi0 approach toward broader generalization across tasks and settings.

It shares OpenPI's design of a vision-language backbone driving action generation, and in WorldFoundry it runs on the in-tree OpenPI runtime with a pi0.5-specific configuration. The default profile targets a LIBERO manipulation setup.
This is an action-generation model: it emits an action trace rather than producing video. The policy checkpoint is obtained separately before you roll it out.
zh: pi0.5 是 Physical Intelligence 在 pi0 之后推出的后续版本，通过 OpenPI 项目发布。它是一个视觉-语言-动作策略，把相机观测和一条语言指令转成机器人动作，在 pi0 方法的基础上进一步扩展了跨任务、跨场景的泛化能力。
它沿用了 OpenPI「以视觉-语言主干驱动动作生成」的设计，在 WorldFoundry 中运行于内置 OpenPI 运行时，并采用 pi0.5 专属配置。默认配置面向 LIBERO 操作场景。
这是一个动作生成模型：它输出的是动作轨迹，而非视频。策略 checkpoint 需在推演前单独获取。

whenToUse.en: Reach for pi0.5 when you want Physical Intelligence's more recent vision-language-action policy for robot control, aimed at broader generalization than pi0.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想使用 Physical Intelligence 更新一代、面向比 pi0 更强泛化的视觉-语言-动作机器人控制策略时，可以选择 pi0.5。

tagline.en: A feed-forward visual-geometry model that turns images into 3D point clouds and camera trajectories.

en: Pi3 is a visual-geometry reconstruction model from the Pi3 project (yyfz). Given images or video of a scene, it recovers the 3D structure as a point cloud together with the camera path that captured it.

In WorldFoundry, Pi3 is wired up as a point-cloud pipeline for 3D reconstruction and trajectory rendering. You feed it views of a scene and it produces the reconstructed geometry and the estimated camera trajectory, which you can visualize as a point cloud.
zh: Pi3 是 Pi3 项目(yyfz)推出的视觉几何重建模型。给它一组场景图像或视频,它就能把场景的 3D 结构还原为点云,并同时估计出拍摄时的相机轨迹。
在 WorldFoundry 中,Pi3 被接成一条点云 pipeline,用于 3D 重建与轨迹渲染。你输入场景的多个视角,它输出重建后的几何结构与估计出的相机轨迹,并可以点云形式可视化。

whenToUse.en: When you want to reconstruct 3D geometry and camera motion from images or video — building point clouds and recovering trajectories from ordinary views.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想从图像或视频重建 3D 几何与相机运动时——用普通视角构建点云、还原轨迹。

notFor.en: It is a reconstruction model, not a generative one — it does not synthesize new images or video from text.
notFor.zh: 它是重建模型而非生成模型——不能从文字合成新的图像或视频。

en: Feed-forward 3D reconstruction from images or video
Outputs point clouds and estimated camera trajectories
Focused on 3D & 4D geometry rather than generation
zh: 从图像或视频前馈式重建 3D
输出点云与估计的相机轨迹
聚焦 3D & 4D 几何而非生成

tagline.en: A diffusion-transformer robot policy that predicts unified actions from vision and language.
tagline.zh: 一个扩散 Transformer 机器人策略,从视觉与语言预测统一动作。

en: RDT-1B is the Robotics Diffusion Transformer, a vision-language-action policy from THU-ML. It takes camera views and a language instruction and generates robot actions in a unified action space, using a diffusion transformer trained for bimanual manipulation.

The policy pairs a SigLIP vision encoder with a T5-XXL text encoder to read the scene and the instruction, then denoises action sequences with a DPM sampler. In WorldFoundry it runs with two-frame, three-camera preprocessing; you can also feed precomputed text embeddings to lower peak memory.
The released weights are a pretraining checkpoint, so most deployments fine-tune it on the target robot and task before use.
zh: RDT-1B 是 Robotics Diffusion Transformer,由 THU-ML 推出的视觉-语言-动作(VLA)策略。它接收相机画面与一条语言指令,在统一动作空间中生成机器人动作,底层是为双臂操作训练的扩散 Transformer。
该策略用 SigLIP 视觉编码器配合 T5-XXL 文本编码器来理解画面与指令,再用 DPM 采样器对动作序列去噪。在 WorldFoundry 中,它以双帧、三相机的预处理方式运行;你也可以传入预先算好的文本 embedding 来降低显存峰值。
发布的权重是预训练 checkpoint,因此多数部署会先在目标机器人与任务上做微调再使用。

whenToUse.en: When you need a language-conditioned manipulation policy to fine-tune on your own robot — especially bimanual tasks where a strong diffusion-transformer base helps.
whenToUse.zh: 当你需要一个语言条件的操作策略、并要在自己的机器人上微调时——尤其是双臂任务,一个强扩散 Transformer 底座会很有帮助。

notFor.en: Not a plug-and-play policy: the released checkpoint is a pretraining base and typically needs task fine-tuning. It also depends on separate SigLIP and T5 encoders, which must be downloaded.
notFor.zh: 它不是即插即用的策略:发布的 checkpoint 是预训练底座,通常需要针对任务微调。它还依赖单独的 SigLIP 与 T5 编码器,需要下载。

tagline.en: An inference-time action-chunking method that keeps flow-based VLA policies responsive in real time.
tagline.zh: 一种推理期的动作分块方法,让基于 flow 的 VLA 策略在实时控制中保持响应。

en: Real-Time Chunking (RTC) is an inference-time algorithm from Physical Intelligence, not a standalone model with its own weights. It addresses a practical problem in robot control: how to run a policy that predicts actions in chunks while still reacting smoothly and continuously as the world changes.

RTC works alongside flow-based VLA policies, managing how chunks of predicted actions overlap and hand off so control stays responsive. In WorldFoundry it is routed through an in-tree action runtime adapter, and because it processes chunk context rather than generating from scratch, no checkpoint is required to run it.
zh: Real-Time Chunking(RTC)是 Physical Intelligence 提出的推理期算法,而不是有自己权重的独立模型。它解决机器人控制中的一个实际问题:当策略按分块方式预测动作时,如何在世界不断变化时依然平滑、连续地响应。
RTC 与基于 flow 的 VLA 策略配合工作,管理预测动作分块之间的重叠与衔接,让控制保持响应性。在 WorldFoundry 中,它通过一个内置的动作运行时适配器接入;由于它处理的是分块上下文而非从零生成,运行它不需要 checkpoint。

whenToUse.en: When you already run a flow-based VLA policy that predicts action chunks and want smoother, more responsive real-time control.
whenToUse.zh: 当你已经在运行一个按分块预测动作的 flow VLA 策略,并希望获得更平滑、更响应的实时控制时。

notFor.en: It is not a policy or a checkpoint on its own — it works on top of a flow-based VLA policy rather than replacing one.
notFor.zh: 它本身不是策略或 checkpoint——它是叠加在 flow VLA 策略之上使用的,而不是替代策略。

en: Inference-time action-chunking algorithm, not a weights-based model
Keeps chunked flow VLA policies responsive in real time
Runs without a checkpoint via the in-tree action runtime
zh: 推理期的动作分块算法,而非基于权重的模型
让分块式 flow VLA 策略在实时控制中保持响应
通过内置动作运行时运行,无需 checkpoint

tagline.zh: OpenDriveLab 推出的具身操作策略,从多相机画面预测动作序列。

en: RISE is a vision-based robot manipulation policy from OpenDriveLab. It reads camera observations and predicts a sequence of future actions, following a Pi0.5-style action architecture with the project's official deployment preprocessing.

In WorldFoundry the policy runs in-process: three-camera image mapping, input normalization, the action model, and a 50x14 action output all execute through the pipeline. The public asset repository ships the dynamics model and sample data rather than a trained action-policy checkpoint, so you supply compatible trained action weights and their task normalization statistics to run rollouts.
zh: RISE 是 OpenDriveLab 推出的基于视觉的机器人操作策略。它读取相机观测,预测一段未来动作序列,采用 Pi0.5 风格的动作架构,并使用项目官方的部署预处理。
在 WorldFoundry 中,该策略在进程内运行:三相机图像映射、输入归一化、动作模型,以及 50x14 的动作输出都通过 pipeline 执行。公开的资源仓库提供的是动力学模型与示例数据,而非训练好的动作策略 checkpoint,因此你需要自备兼容的训练动作权重及其任务归一化统计量来跑 rollout。

whenToUse.en: When you want an OpenDriveLab manipulation policy with a Pi0.5-style action head and already have (or will train) compatible action weights for your task.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想用 OpenDriveLab 的操作策略、采用 Pi0.5 风格动作头,并且已有(或将训练)针对任务的兼容动作权重时。

notFor.en: Not ready to run out of the box: the public release provides code and a dynamics model but no trained action-policy checkpoint, which you must supply along with its normalization statistics.
notFor.zh: 它不能开箱即用:公开发布提供的是代码与动力学模型,但没有训练好的动作策略 checkpoint,需要你自备并附上其归一化统计量。

tagline.en: Google's Robotics Transformer — a language-conditioned robot policy that maps instructions and views to actions.
tagline.zh: Google 的 Robotics Transformer——一个语言条件的机器人策略,把指令与画面映射为动作。

en: RT-1 (Robotics Transformer) is a foundational language-conditioned robot policy from Google Research. It reads camera images together with a natural-language instruction and produces robot actions, and it was one of the models that popularized the transformer-based approach to real-robot manipulation.

In WorldFoundry the RT-1 TensorFlow SavedModel runtime is vendored in-tree. You point it at a locally staged RT-1 SavedModel directory, give it an instruction and observations, and it emits an action trace; benchmark wrappers handle environment replay and success metrics.
zh: RT-1(Robotics Transformer)是 Google Research 推出的、具有基础意义的语言条件机器人策略。它读取相机图像与一条自然语言指令,输出机器人动作,也是最早把 Transformer 方法带向真实机器人操作的模型之一。
在 WorldFoundry 中,RT-1 的 TensorFlow SavedModel 运行时已内置。你把它指向本地准备好的 RT-1 SavedModel 目录,给它指令与观测,它就会输出一段动作轨迹;基准封装负责环境回放与成功率指标。

whenToUse.en: When you want to run or benchmark a classic language-conditioned robot policy and can stage the RT-1 SavedModel locally.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想运行或评测一个经典的语言条件机器人策略,并能在本地准备好 RT-1 SavedModel 时。

notFor.en: Not runnable without a locally staged RT-1 SavedModel directory. It runs on TensorFlow rather than PyTorch, which may affect how it fits your stack.
notFor.zh: 没有本地准备好的 RT-1 SavedModel 目录就无法运行。它基于 TensorFlow 而非 PyTorch,可能影响它与你技术栈的契合度。

Transformer-based real-robot manipulation
TensorFlow SavedModel runtime, emits action-trace outputs
Requires a locally staged SavedModel checkpoint

tagline.en: NVIDIA's efficient diffusion family — fast high-resolution text-to-image, extended into text-to-video and streaming.
tagline.zh: NVIDIA 的高效扩散家族——快速的高分辨率文生图,并延伸到文生视频与流式生成。

en: Sana is an efficient text-to-image diffusion family from NVIDIA (NVlabs), designed to generate high-resolution images quickly. In WorldFoundry it also spans text-to-video, video-to-video, and image-conditioned generation, so one family covers still images through video.

The lineup is broad. Image checkpoints range from a 600M model up to 1.6B and 4.8B variants, at resolutions from 512px and 1024px all the way to 2K and 4K, plus multilingual, BF16, ControlNet, and fast Sana-Sprint options. The video side includes SANA-Video 2B at 480p and 720p, and the SANA-Streaming long and bidirectional video-to-video routes. It uses a Gemma-2 text encoder, and the streaming routes build on a causal LTX-2 VAE.

Weights live on Hugging Face and are downloaded separately. In WorldFoundry, Sana runs on shared role-based diffusion components (denoiser, encoder, autoencoder, scheduler, and recipe), and the streaming routes accept a source video path or an hf:// URI.
zh: Sana 是 NVIDIA(NVlabs)推出的高效文生图扩散家族,目标是快速生成高分辨率图像。在 WorldFoundry 中,它还覆盖文生视频、视频到视频以及图像条件生成,因此一个家族即可从静态图像贯通到视频。

阵容很广。图像 checkpoint 从 600M 到 1.6B、4.8B,分辨率从 512px、1024px 一直到 2K 与 4K,另有多语言、BF16、ControlNet 以及快速的 Sana-Sprint 选项。视频侧包含 480p 与 720p 的 SANA-Video 2B,以及 SANA-Streaming 的长视频与双向视频到视频路由。它使用 Gemma-2 文本编码器,流式路由构建在因果 LTX-2 VAE 之上。
权重发布在 Hugging Face 上,需单独下载。在 WorldFoundry 中,Sana 运行于共享的、按角色划分的扩散组件(去噪器、编码器、autoencoder、调度器与 recipe)之上,流式路由可接受源视频路径或 hf:// URI。

whenToUse.en: When you want fast, high-resolution text-to-image generation with room to scale from 512px up to 4K, or need one family that also reaches into text-to-video and streaming video-to-video.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想要快速、高分辨率的文生图,并希望从 512px 一路扩展到 4K,或需要一个同时能延伸到文生视频与流式视频到视频的家族时。

notFor.en: Checkpoints are external Hugging Face downloads rather than bundled, so plan for download and disk space. The many variants also mean you should pick the right size and resolution for your hardware.
notFor.zh: Checkpoint 是外部 Hugging Face 下载而非随附,请预留下载与磁盘空间。变体众多,也意味着需要按硬件挑选合适的规模与分辨率。

Sizes from 600M to 1.6B and 4.8B, plus Sana-Sprint and ControlNet
SANA-Video 2B (480p/720p) and SANA-Streaming video routes
Gemma-2 text encoder; streaming uses a causal LTX-2 VAE

tagline.en: Hugging Face's compact vision-language-action policy, built on the LeRobot stack.
tagline.zh: Hugging Face 推出的紧凑型视觉-语言-动作策略,构建于 LeRobot 技术栈之上。

en: SmolVLA is a compact vision-language-action policy from Hugging Face, developed within the LeRobot project. It reads camera views and an instruction and generates robot actions, using a flow-matching action head on top of a small SmolVLM2 vision-language backbone — the emphasis is on a lightweight model that is practical to run and fine-tune.

WorldFoundry ships two checkpoints: a base foundation model for fine-tuning, and a LIBERO task checkpoint that is the default for rollouts. The LIBERO checkpoint carries matching 8-D state and 7-D action statistics and produces a 50-step action chunk (1x50x7), while the base model is kept as a fine-tuning asset. Loading is local-only and preserves the official flow-matching architecture and preprocessing.
zh: SmolVLA 是 Hugging Face 推出的紧凑型视觉-语言-动作策略,在 LeRobot 项目内开发。它读取相机画面与指令并生成机器人动作,在小型 SmolVLM2 视觉-语言主干之上使用 flow-matching 动作头——重点是一个轻量、便于运行与微调的模型。
WorldFoundry 提供两个 checkpoint:用于微调的基础底座模型,以及作为 rollout 默认的 LIBERO 任务 checkpoint。LIBERO checkpoint 带有匹配的 8 维状态与 7 维动作统计量,输出 50 步动作块(1x50x7);基础模型则保留作为微调资源。加载为纯本地方式,保留官方的 flow-matching 架构与预处理。

whenToUse.en: When you want a small, practical VLA policy to run manipulation rollouts or fine-tune on your own robot — the LIBERO checkpoint works as a ready default.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想要一个小巧、实用的 VLA 策略来跑操作 rollout 或在自己的机器人上微调时——LIBERO checkpoint 可作为现成默认。

notFor.en: The base foundation checkpoint lacks a complete task state-normalization contract and is meant for fine-tuning, not direct rollout. It also depends on the SmolVLM2 backbone, which is downloaded separately.
notFor.zh: 基础底座 checkpoint 缺少完整的任务状态归一化契约,用于微调而非直接 rollout。它还依赖 SmolVLM2 主干,需单独下载。

LIBERO task checkpoint is the rollout default (1x50x7 actions)
Local-only loading; base model reserved for fine-tuning

whenToUse.en: When you want a planning-based control policy that learns a world model and uses model-predictive control, rather than a purely reactive policy.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想要一个基于规划的控制策略——学习世界模型并使用模型预测控制,而非纯反应式策略时。

基于规划而非纯反应式控制
