tagline.en: A compact vision-language-action backbone built on LLaVA-Pythia, offered in 400M, 700M, and 1.3B sizes for lightweight robot policy training.
tagline.zh: 基于 LLaVA-Pythia 的轻量视觉-语言-动作骨干,提供 400M、700M、1.3B 三种规模,面向轻量机器人策略训练。

en: TinyVLA is a small vision-language-action model aimed at embodied control on modest hardware. It pairs a LLaVA-Pythia language-vision backbone with CLIP/SigLIP vision fusion and an action head, so a robot can turn an image and a language instruction into predicted actions.

The published backbones come in three sizes — 400M, 700M, and 1.3B — and the action head can be either an ACT-style predictor or a conditional 1D diffusion head. These released weights are VLM backbones intended for policy training: you fine-tune on your own robot data, together with the matching normalization statistics, to obtain a task-ready policy.

In WorldFoundry, TinyVLA runs through the shared action runtime. Both merged weights and a local LoRA plus non-LoRA action tensors are supported, so you can bring your own trained checkpoint and drive action prediction directly.
zh: TinyVLA 是一个面向具身控制、可在普通硬件上运行的小型视觉-语言-动作模型。它把 LLaVA-Pythia 的语言-视觉骨干与 CLIP/SigLIP 视觉融合、动作头结合起来,让机器人能把一张图像加一条语言指令转成预测动作。
已发布的骨干提供 400M、700M、1.3B 三种规模,动作头可以是 ACT 式预测器,也可以是条件式一维扩散头。这些权重是用于策略训练的 VLM 骨干:你需要在自己的机器人数据上做微调,并配套对应的归一化统计量,才能得到可直接执行任务的策略。
在 WorldFoundry 中,TinyVLA 通过统一的动作运行时执行。它同时支持合并后的权重,以及本地的 LoRA 加非 LoRA 动作张量,因此你可以带上自己训练好的 checkpoint,直接进行动作预测。

whenToUse.en: Pick TinyVLA when you want a small, easy-to-train VLA backbone for imitation learning on a specific robot and task, and you plan to fine-tune it on your own demonstrations.
whenToUse.zh: 当你需要一个小巧、易训练的 VLA 骨干,在特定机器人和任务上做模仿学习,并打算用自己的示范数据微调时,TinyVLA 是合适的选择。

notFor.en: It is not a plug-and-play robot policy — the released weights are backbones for training, so you must supply a task-trained action checkpoint and its normalization statistics before it can act.
notFor.zh: 它不是即插即用的机器人策略——发布的权重是用于训练的骨干,你必须自备经任务训练的动作 checkpoint 及其归一化统计量,它才能产生动作。

Choice of ACT or conditional 1D diffusion action head
Works with merged weights or local LoRA plus action tensors

tagline.en: Alibaba DAMO Academy's controllable image-to-video model — drive a clip with camera trajectories, and optionally human motion, on top of a Wan2.1 backbone.
tagline.zh: 阿里达摩院的可控图生视频模型——在 Wan2.1 骨干之上,用相机轨迹、并可选叠加人体动作来驱动视频生成。

en: Uni3C is a controllable video generation model from Alibaba DAMO Academy. Starting from an image, it renders a video that follows a specified camera path, and in its unified mode it can also be driven by human body and hand motion.

It builds on a Wan2.1 image-to-video 14B backbone and a RealisDance-DiT component, offering two paths: a camera-only mode and a unified camera-plus-human mode. Camera mode takes pre-rendered control inputs — a render video, a render mask, and camera info — while unified mode additionally uses SMPL body and hand render videos so the subject's motion tracks your control signal.

In WorldFoundry, you provide the source image and the matching control bundle for the mode you want; the control renders stay explicit inputs rather than being generated for you, so you keep precise control over camera and motion.
zh: Uni3C 是阿里达摩院推出的可控视频生成模型。它从一张图像出发,生成一段沿指定相机路径运动的视频;在统一模式下,还能由人体与手部动作共同驱动。
它基于 Wan2.1 图生视频 14B 骨干与 RealisDance-DiT 组件,提供两条路径:仅相机模式与相机加人体的统一模式。相机模式需要预渲染的控制输入——渲染视频、渲染遮罩与相机信息;统一模式则额外使用 SMPL 人体与手部渲染视频,使主体动作跟随你的控制信号。
在 WorldFoundry 中,你按所选模式提供源图像和对应的控制包;这些控制渲染是显式输入而非自动生成,因此你能对相机与动作保持精确掌控。

whenToUse.en: Reach for Uni3C when you want image-to-video with precise camera control, or when you also need to steer a subject's body and hand motion in the generated clip.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想要带精确相机控制的图生视频,或需要在生成片段中进一步操控主体的人体与手部动作时,适合使用 Uni3C。

notFor.en: It expects pre-rendered control bundles as input rather than producing camera or motion for you, so it is less suited to quick text-only generation without prepared control assets.
notFor.zh: 它需要预渲染的控制包作为输入,而不会替你生成相机或动作,因此不太适合没有准备好控制素材、只凭文字快速生成的场景。

Camera mode uses render video, render mask, and camera info
Unified mode adds SMPL body and hand render videos

tagline.en: Unified World Models from WEIRD Lab (UW) — a robot world model that couples action-conditioned video prediction with policy learning.
tagline.zh: 华盛顿大学 WEIRD Lab 的 Unified World Models——把动作条件视频预测与策略学习结合在一起的机器人世界模型。

en: Unified World Models (UWM) is a research model from the WEIRD Lab at the University of Washington. It brings video prediction and robot action together in one framework, so the same model can imagine how a scene evolves under an action and produce the action itself.

The approach uses a diffusion formulation over video and action, letting it serve both as a world model and as a policy. UWM is distributed as upstream source with evaluation routes such as LIBERO-90 and DROID; the checkpoints and datasets are downloaded separately.

In WorldFoundry, UWM's source and configuration are tracked so you can resolve its model zoo config and inference route. To run real rollouts you stage the required checkpoints and assets, which the runtime plan lists for you.
zh: Unified World Models(UWM)是华盛顿大学 WEIRD Lab 的研究模型。它把视频预测与机器人动作统一到一个框架里,同一个模型既能设想场景在某个动作下如何演化,也能生成动作本身。
该方法在视频与动作上采用扩散式建模,因而既可作为世界模型,也可作为策略。UWM 以上游源码形式发布,附带 LIBERO-90、DROID 等评测路径;checkpoint 与数据集需另行下载。
在 WorldFoundry 中,UWM 的源码与配置已被纳入,你可以解析它的模型库配置与推理路径。要跑真实 rollout,需要按运行时列出的清单准备好相应的 checkpoint 与素材。

whenToUse.en: Use UWM when you want to explore a unified world-model-and-policy approach for manipulation, and you can supply the benchmark checkpoints and datasets it evaluates on.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想探索操作任务上统一世界模型与策略的方法,并能提供它所用评测的 checkpoint 与数据集时,适合使用 UWM。

notFor.en: It is a research codebase rather than a turnkey policy; you must download and stage the checkpoints and datasets yourself before it can generate or evaluate.
notFor.zh: 它更像研究代码库而非开箱即用的策略;你需要自行下载并准备好 checkpoint 与数据集,它才能生成或评测。

Ships with evaluation routes such as LIBERO-90 and DROID
From the WEIRD Lab at the University of Washington

在视频与动作上采用扩散式建模
附带 LIBERO-90、DROID 等评测路径

tagline.en: Meta AI's Visual Geometry Grounded Transformer — a feed-forward model that recovers 3D geometry from images, with a two-stage 3D Gaussian Splatting pipeline.
tagline.zh: Meta AI 的 Visual Geometry Grounded Transformer——从图像前馈式恢复三维几何的模型,并配有两阶段 3D 高斯泼溅(3DGS)流程。

en: VGGT is a 3D reconstruction model from Meta AI (FAIR), presented at CVPR 2025. Given one or more images, its transformer directly predicts 3D geometry — points, depth, and camera information — in a single feed-forward pass, without the slow per-scene optimization that traditional pipelines rely on.

In WorldFoundry it is registered as a two-stage 3D Gaussian Splatting pipeline: VGGT infers scene geometry, which then seeds a 3DGS representation, giving you point clouds and reconstructions from ordinary image input. It is a distinct entry from the related VGGT-World world model.
You feed it images and get back 3D structure — a fast starting point for reconstruction, novel-view work, or downstream 3D understanding.
zh: VGGT 是 Meta AI(FAIR)推出的三维重建模型,发表于 CVPR 2025。给定一张或多张图像,它的 transformer 在一次前馈中直接预测三维几何——点、深度与相机信息,无需传统流程那种缓慢的逐场景优化。
在 WorldFoundry 中,它被注册为两阶段 3D 高斯泼溅流程:VGGT 先推断场景几何,再以此初始化 3DGS 表示,从普通图像输入得到点云与重建结果。它与相关的 VGGT-World 世界模型是不同的条目。
你输入图像,得到三维结构——是重建、新视角合成或下游三维理解的一个快速起点。

whenToUse.en: Choose VGGT when you need fast, feed-forward 3D reconstruction or 3D Gaussian Splatting from images, without running lengthy per-scene optimization.
whenToUse.zh: 当你需要从图像做快速、前馈式的三维重建或 3D 高斯泼溅,又不想跑漫长的逐场景优化时,适合选择 VGGT。

notFor.en: It targets geometry and reconstruction from images rather than text-driven video or scene generation; you provide the input views.
notFor.zh: 它面向从图像恢复几何与重建,而非文本驱动的视频或场景生成;输入视角需由你提供。

It is distributed as upstream research source. In WorldFoundry the source and configuration are registered so you can resolve its model zoo config and inference route; the checkpoints and assets are staged separately, and the runtime lists what it needs.

tagline.zh: 清华 THUML 的 Vid2World——把预训练的视频扩散模型改造成可交互、动作条件的世界模型。

en: Vid2World is a research model from THUML (Tsinghua University's Machine Learning Group). Its idea is to adapt a large pretrained video diffusion model into an interactive world model, so that generation can be conditioned on actions and unfold step by step rather than as one fixed clip.

By repurposing video diffusion for interaction, the model predicts how a scene responds to actions over time — useful for simulation and world-model research. It is distributed as upstream source with an evaluation route.

In WorldFoundry the source and configuration are registered so you can resolve its config and inference route; the checkpoints and config assets are staged separately, with the runtime listing what it needs.
zh: Vid2World 是清华大学机器学习组(THUML)的研究模型。其思路是把大型预训练视频扩散模型改造为可交互的世界模型,使生成可以以动作为条件、逐步展开,而不是一次生成一段固定片段。
通过把视频扩散用于交互,该模型能预测场景随时间对动作的响应——对仿真与世界模型研究很有用。它以上游源码形式发布,并附带评测路径。
在 WorldFoundry 中,其源码与配置已被注册,你可以解析它的配置与推理路径;checkpoint 与配置素材需另行准备,运行时会列出所需内容。

whenToUse.en: Reach for Vid2World when you want an action-conditioned, interactive world model derived from video diffusion, and you can supply its checkpoints and config assets.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想要一个由视频扩散衍生、动作条件的可交互世界模型,并能提供其 checkpoint 与配置素材时,适合使用 Vid2World。

notFor.en: It is a research codebase rather than a turnkey generator; real generation requires you to stage the checkpoints and config assets first.
notFor.zh: 它更像研究代码库而非开箱即用的生成器;真实生成前需先准备好 checkpoint 与配置素材。

en: ViewCrafter is a novel-view synthesis model: give it one or a few images of a scene, and it renders plausible new viewpoints along a camera path. It combines point-cloud geometry — recovered with a DUSt3R-style reconstruction — with a video diffusion model, so the generated views stay geometrically consistent while filling in unseen detail.

It ships as code and weights, with several checkpoints for different frame counts, resolutions, and sparse-view settings, letting you match the model to how many input views you have and the output length you want.
In WorldFoundry the source and configuration are registered; the checkpoints and the DUSt3R/view assets are staged separately, and the runtime lists what it needs before generating.
zh: ViewCrafter 是一个新视角合成模型:给它一张或几张场景图像,它就能沿相机路径渲染出合理的新视角。它把点云几何——由 DUSt3R 式重建恢复——与视频扩散模型结合起来,使生成的视角在几何上保持一致,同时补全未见的细节。
它以代码加权重形式发布,提供多个 checkpoint,对应不同的帧数、分辨率与稀疏视角设置,方便你按输入视角数量和期望的输出长度来匹配模型。
在 WorldFoundry 中,其源码与配置已被注册;checkpoint 以及 DUSt3R/视角素材需另行准备,运行时会在生成前列出所需内容。

whenToUse.en: Use ViewCrafter when you want to synthesize new camera views from limited images — for example generating an orbit or fly-through from a single photo or a sparse set of views.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想从有限图像合成新的相机视角时,适合使用 ViewCrafter——例如从一张照片或稀疏视角生成环绕或穿行镜头。

notFor.en: It focuses on view synthesis from images rather than text-to-video, and it depends on staged DUSt3R and checkpoint assets to run.
notFor.zh: 它专注于从图像做视角合成,而非文生视频,且运行依赖已准备好的 DUSt3R 与 checkpoint 素材。

tagline.en: Vector-Quantized Behavior Transformer — a behavior-generation policy that tokenizes actions to model multi-modal behavior for imitation learning.
tagline.zh: Vector-Quantized Behavior Transformer——一种把动作离散化的行为生成策略,为模仿学习建模多模态行为。

en: VQ-BeT (Vector-Quantized Behavior Transformer) is a behavior-generation policy for imitation learning. It uses vector quantization to turn continuous actions into discrete tokens, then a transformer predicts those tokens — an approach that captures the multi-modal, many-valid-ways nature of human demonstrations.
This makes it well suited to learning policies from demonstration data across manipulation and control tasks, where a plain regression policy would blur distinct behaviors together.

In WorldFoundry, VQ-BeT runs through an in-tree action runtime adapter against the concrete VQ-BeT policy. You bring a trained checkpoint; the runtime reports if the checkpoint is missing so you can stage it.
zh: VQ-BeT(Vector-Quantized Behavior Transformer)是一种用于模仿学习的行为生成策略。它用向量量化把连续动作转成离散 token,再由 transformer 预测这些 token——这种方式能刻画人类示范中多模态、多种合理做法并存的特性。
因此它很适合在操作与控制任务上从示范数据学习策略,而普通回归式策略往往会把不同行为混为一谈。
在 WorldFoundry 中,VQ-BeT 通过内置动作运行时适配器,对接具体的 VQ-BeT 策略运行。你需要带上训练好的 checkpoint;若缺失,运行时会提示,便于你准备。

whenToUse.en: Pick VQ-BeT for imitation learning where demonstrations are multi-modal — many valid actions per state — and you want a policy that models that diversity rather than averaging it away.
whenToUse.zh: 当示范是多模态的——每个状态有多种合理动作——而你希望策略去建模这种多样性而非将其平均掉时,适合选择 VQ-BeT 做模仿学习。

notFor.en: It is a policy algorithm rather than a pretrained robot skill; you supply a trained checkpoint and the task setup before it can roll out.
notFor.zh: 它是策略算法而非预训练的机器人技能;需要你提供训练好的 checkpoint 与任务设置,它才能执行 rollout。

Transformer-based behavior generation for imitation learning
Runs through an in-tree action runtime adapter
Based on the official VQ-BeT repository
zh: 用向量量化把动作离散化,建模多模态行为
基于 transformer 的行为生成,用于模仿学习
通过内置动作运行时适配器运行
基于官方 VQ-BeT 仓库

Two checkpoints are published: a flow variant and a fast variant, so you can trade off between generation style and speed. The weights are available openly on Hugging Face.

whenToUse.en: Use Wall-OSS when you want an openly available VLA policy for robot control and need to choose between a flow variant and a faster variant for your latency budget.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想要一个开放可得的 VLA 策略做机器人控制,并需要在 flow 版本与更快的版本之间按延迟预算选择时,适合使用 Wall-OSS。

en: WoW is a world model from X-Humanoid that generates video from an initial image conditioned on actions — an image-to-world approach for simulating how a scene unfolds. It comes in two model families that share the same goal through different backbones.

The Wan family is built on the Wan video architecture and includes a 1.3B checkpoint (MIT-licensed) plus 14B checkpoints, reusing a conditioner, VAE, scheduler, and staged runner; the 1.3B uses VAE-only first-frame conditioning. tagline.en: An Apache-2.0 world-action model that predicts a robot's future views and its next moves in one flow process.
tagline.zh: Apache-2.0 许可的世界-动作模型，在同一个 flow 过程里同时预测机器人的未来画面与下一步动作。

en: X-WAM is an open world-action model for robot manipulation. Rather than only predicting an action, a single joint flow process reasons over the robot's future — predicting upcoming RGB frames, depth, proprioception, and the actions to take — so perception and control share one model.

It is built on Alibaba's Wan 2.2 text-image-to-video base and released under Apache-2.0. The default policy returns a chunk of future actions together with predicted proprioception; you can optionally let it continue decoding to render the predicted future views (and depth) as a video mosaic. Post-trained variants are provided for RoboCasa and RoboTwin manipulation settings alongside a pretrained checkpoint.

In WorldFoundry you run X-WAM through its self-contained inference runtime — stage the checkpoint locally, feed the robot's multi-view observation and state, and it returns an action chunk. Turning on world decoding additionally writes out the predicted future-view video.
zh: X-WAM 是一个面向机器人操作的开放世界-动作模型。它不只预测动作，而是用一个联合 flow 过程对机器人的未来做整体推理——同时预测接下来的 RGB 画面、深度、本体感受（proprioception）与要执行的动作，让感知与控制共用一个模型。
它构建在阿里巴巴的 Wan 2.2 图文生视频底座之上，采用 Apache-2.0 许可。默认策略会返回一段未来动作，并附带预测的本体感受；你也可以让它继续解码，把预测出的未来画面（乃至深度）渲染成视频拼图。除预训练 checkpoint 外，还提供了针对 RoboCasa 与 RoboTwin 操作场景的后训练变体。
在 WorldFoundry 中，你通过 X-WAM 自带的推理运行时来运行它——先把 checkpoint 放到本地，输入机器人的多视角观测与状态，它便返回一段动作。开启世界解码后，还会额外输出预测的未来画面视频。

whenToUse.en: Use it when you want a robot policy that also acts as a world model — predicting the near-future scene as it decides actions — with ready post-trained variants for RoboCasa and RoboTwin manipulation.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想要一个既是策略、又兼具世界模型能力的机器人模型——在决策动作的同时预测近未来场景——并希望有针对 RoboCasa 与 RoboTwin 操作的现成后训练变体时使用。

notFor.en: Its primary output is an action chunk for robot control, not a video generator for general content. Checkpoints are staged locally, so plan for the download and disk space.
notFor.zh: 它的主要输出是用于机器人控制的动作，而非面向通用内容的视频生成器。Checkpoint 需放到本地，请预留下载时间与磁盘空间。

en: Apache-2.0 licensed, built on Wan 2.2
One flow process predicts future RGB, depth, proprioception, and actions
Post-trained variants for RoboCasa and RoboTwin, plus a pretrained checkpoint
Optional world decoding renders the predicted future views
zh: Apache-2.0 许可，构建于 Wan 2.2 之上
一个 flow 过程同时预测未来 RGB、深度、本体感受与动作
提供 RoboCasa 与 RoboTwin 后训练变体，以及预训练 checkpoint
可选的世界解码能渲染出预测的未来画面

tagline.en: Xiaomi Robotics' vision-language-action policy — a Qwen3-VL backbone with a rectified-flow action head.
tagline.zh: 小米机器人团队的视觉-语言-动作策略——以 Qwen3-VL 为主干，配合 rectified-flow 动作头。

en: Xiaomi-Robotics-1 (XR1) is a vision-language-action (VLA) policy from the Xiaomi Robotics team. It takes camera images plus a language instruction and predicts robot actions, pairing a Qwen3-VL vision-language backbone with a rectified-flow diffusion transformer that decodes the motions.

The policy predicts relative actions with its own preprocessing and normalization, and restores to roughly a 5-billion-parameter model. Precision is chosen automatically for your hardware — fp16 on Turing, bf16 on Ampere and newer, fp32 on CPU — and it runs with an in-tree exact-attention path, so no optional FlashAttention package is required.
In WorldFoundry you load the checkpoint locally and run the policy in-process; it emits an action trace for the robot rather than an image or video.
zh: Xiaomi-Robotics-1（XR1）是小米机器人团队的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略。它接收相机图像加语言指令并预测机器人动作，以 Qwen3-VL 视觉-语言主干搭配一个 rectified-flow 扩散 transformer 来解码动作。
该策略预测相对动作，带有自己的预处理与归一化流程，还原后约为 50 亿参数规模。精度会依你的硬件自动选择——Turing 上用 fp16，Ampere 及更新架构用 bf16，CPU 上用 fp32——并采用内置的精确注意力路径运行，无需额外安装 FlashAttention。
在 WorldFoundry 中，你在本地加载 checkpoint 并在进程内运行该策略；它输出的是给机器人的动作轨迹，而非图像或视频。

whenToUse.en: Use it when you want a Qwen3-VL-based VLA policy for robot manipulation that maps images and instructions to relative actions, with automatic precision selection across GPU generations.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想要一个基于 Qwen3-VL 的 VLA 策略用于机器人操作，把图像与指令映射为相对动作，并希望在不同 GPU 世代间自动选择精度时使用。

notFor.en: Not a video or image generator — its output is action traces. At multi-billion-parameter scale it needs adequate GPU memory, and the checkpoint must be staged locally.
notFor.zh: 它不是视频或图像生成器——输出为动作轨迹。作为数十亿参数规模的模型，运行需要足够的 GPU 显存，且 checkpoint 需放到本地。

Around 5B parameters, predicts relative robot actions
Automatic dtype selection: fp16 / bf16 / fp32 by hardware
Runs on an in-tree exact-attention path, no FlashAttention required
zh: Qwen3-VL 主干搭配 rectified-flow 动作头
约 50 亿参数，预测相对机器人动作
按硬件自动选择精度：fp16 / bf16 / fp32

tagline.en: An interactive world model that turns a starting image and actions into a continuously rolling video.
tagline.zh: 一个交互式世界模型，把起始图片与动作序列续写成连续滚动的视频。

en: ABot-World is an interactive, action-conditioned world model from the amap-cvlab team. Starting from a single image, it generates a video of how the scene unfolds and lets you steer that future with actions, block by block.

This is the 0.5B-LF (low-frame / fast) causal variant, built on Wan-family components — Wan attention, a T5 text encoder, and the Wan2.2 VAE — with FP8 support. It keeps a resident causal state across action blocks, so each new block continues from the last: the first block returns 9 RGB frames and subsequent blocks return 12, rendering at 1280×704.
In WorldFoundry it runs offline-first from a local checkpoint. You give it a starting frame, then drive the rollout with actions, and it streams out the evolving world as decodable video.
zh: ABot-World 是高德视觉实验室（amap-cvlab）团队的交互式、动作条件化世界模型。它从一张图片出发，生成场景如何演变的视频，并让你用动作一块（block）接一块地引导这个未来。
这是 0.5B-LF（低帧率 / 快速）因果变体，构建在 Wan 系列组件之上——Wan 注意力、T5 文本编码器与 Wan2.2 VAE——并支持 FP8。它在各动作块之间保持常驻的因果状态，因此每个新块都从上一块续写：首块返回 9 帧 RGB，后续块返回 12 帧，渲染分辨率为 1280×704。
在 WorldFoundry 中，它以离线优先方式从本地 checkpoint 运行。你给它一帧起始画面，再用动作推进推演，它便把不断演变的世界以可解码视频的形式流式输出。

whenToUse.en: Use it when you want an interactive world model that rolls forward from an image under your action inputs — useful for exploring how a scene responds to control, block by block.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想要一个交互式世界模型、从一张图片出发在你的动作输入下不断向前推演时使用——便于逐块探索场景如何响应控制。

notFor.en: Not a one-shot text-to-video tool — it is action-driven and rolls out in short blocks. It runs offline from a local checkpoint directory, so stage the weights before use.
notFor.zh: 它不是一次成片的文生视频工具——它由动作驱动、以短块方式推演。它从本地 checkpoint 目录离线运行，请先把权重放好再使用。

Lightweight 0.5B causal variant with FP8 support
Resident causal state carries across action blocks
Renders at 1280×704; first block 9 frames, later blocks 12
zh: 构建于 Wan 组件之上的交互式、动作条件化世界模型
轻量 0.5B 因果变体，支持 FP8

tagline.en: A fast world-action model for robot policies, built on Wan with a Mixture-of-Transformers action graph.
tagline.zh: 一个面向机器人策略的快速世界-动作模型，基于 Wan、采用 Mixture-of-Transformers 动作图。

en: FastWAM is a world-action model (WAM) for robot manipulation. It takes camera views and robot state and predicts an action chunk, using a Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) action-inference graph paired with a Wan VAE and a UMT5 text encoder.

It comes with official checkpoints for two popular manipulation settings — LIBERO and RoboTwin — each with matching normalization statistics. The MoT policy is roughly 12 GB before the VAE and text encoder load; instruction embeddings are cached (the UMT5 encoder defaults to CPU, and you can supply precomputed 4096-dimensional tokens), and the video expert's key/value tensors are prefetched once and reused across denoising steps to keep inference fast.
In WorldFoundry you stage a checkpoint locally, pick the LIBERO or RoboTwin variant with its official camera/state contract, and it returns a finite action chunk for the robot.
zh: FastWAM 是一个面向机器人操作的世界-动作模型（WAM）。它接收相机视角与机器人状态并预测一段动作，采用 Mixture-of-Transformers（MoT）动作推理图，搭配 Wan VAE 与 UMT5 文本编码器。
它附带针对两个常用操作场景的官方 checkpoint——LIBERO 与 RoboTwin——各自带有配套的归一化统计。MoT 策略在加载 VAE 与文本编码器前约为 12 GB；指令嵌入会被缓存（UMT5 编码器默认放在 CPU，你也可以直接提供预先算好的 4096 维 token），而视频专家的 key/value 张量只预取一次并在各去噪步之间复用，从而保持推理快速。
在 WorldFoundry 中，你把 checkpoint 放到本地，按官方相机/状态约定选择 LIBERO 或 RoboTwin 变体，它便返回给机器人的一段动作。

whenToUse.en: Use it when you want a Wan-based world-action policy for robot manipulation with ready checkpoints for LIBERO and RoboTwin, and an inference path tuned for speed.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想要一个基于 Wan 的世界-动作策略用于机器人操作，并希望有 LIBERO 与 RoboTwin 的现成 checkpoint、以及为速度调优的推理路径时使用。

notFor.en: Its output is an action chunk for robot control, not general video. Checkpoints and their statistics are staged locally, so plan for the download and disk space.
notFor.zh: 它的输出是用于机器人控制的动作，而非通用视频。Checkpoint 及其统计需放到本地，请预留下载时间与磁盘空间。

en: World-action policy on a Mixture-of-Transformers action graph
Official LIBERO and RoboTwin checkpoints with matching statistics
MoT policy is roughly 12 GB before VAE and text encoder load
Cached instruction embeddings and prefetched key/value tensors speed up inference
zh: 基于 Mixture-of-Transformers 动作图的世界-动作策略
官方 LIBERO 与 RoboTwin checkpoint，附配套统计
MoT 策略在加载 VAE 与文本编码器前约 12 GB
缓存指令嵌入与预取 key/value 张量以加速推理

tagline.en: Tencent Hunyuan's world model for panorama generation and 3D scene reconstruction.
tagline.zh: 腾讯混元的世界模型，用于全景生成与三维场景重建。

en: HY-World 2.0 is Tencent Hunyuan's world model, aimed at generating and reconstructing 3D worlds. WorldFoundry brings it in through two components: HY-Pano 2.0 for panorama generation and WorldMirror 2.0 for scene reconstruction.

The reconstruction path takes input views and exports a rich set of 3D artifacts — depth, normals, a point cloud, a Gaussian splat, camera parameters, and COLMAP sparse files — along with scene metadata, so you get geometry you can inspect and reuse. Upstream, the family targets text-, image-, and video-to-3D-world generation and simulation.
In WorldFoundry you run HY-World 2.0 through its pipeline for panorama and reconstruction workflows; feed it images and it writes out the reconstructed scene and its 3D outputs.
zh: HY-World 2.0 是腾讯混元的世界模型，目标是生成与重建三维世界。WorldFoundry 通过两个组件接入它：用于全景生成的 HY-Pano 2.0，以及用于场景重建的 WorldMirror 2.0。

en: MME-VLA is a vision-language-action (VLA) policy for robot manipulation, from the RoboMME project. It takes camera images and a task description and predicts robot actions, drawing on a perceptual frame-sampling module and a VLM subgoal predictor.

The suite includes several released checkpoints — the perceptual frame-sampling module (Apache-2.0), the MME-VLA policy suite, a Pi0.5 baseline, and a VLM subgoal predictor — so you can compare against a baseline and explore the subgoal-guided approach. WorldFoundry runs the policy in-process through a minimal inference-only entrypoint rather than a websocket server.
In WorldFoundry you stage a checkpoint locally and call the policy directly; it returns an action chunk for the robot rather than an image or video.
zh: MME-VLA 是 RoboMME 项目推出的面向机器人操作的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略。它接收相机图像与任务描述并预测机器人动作，借助一个感知式帧采样模块与一个 VLM 子目标预测器。
该套件包含若干已发布 checkpoint——感知式帧采样模块（Apache-2.0）、MME-VLA 策略套件、Pi0.5 基线，以及 VLM 子目标预测器——便于你与基线对比并探索子目标引导的方法。WorldFoundry 通过一个极简的、仅推理的入口在进程内运行策略，而非启动 websocket 服务。
在 WorldFoundry 中，你把 checkpoint 放到本地并直接调用该策略；它返回给机器人的一段动作，而非图像或视频。

whenToUse.en: Use it when you want a VLA policy for robot manipulation that combines perceptual frame sampling with VLM subgoals, and want a Pi0.5 baseline on hand for comparison.

tagline.en: An MIT-licensed 7B VLA policy with optimized fine-tuning — fast LIBERO action prediction from images and instructions.
tagline.zh: MIT 许可的 7B VLA 策略，采用优化微调（OFT）——从图像与指令快速预测 LIBERO 动作。

en: OpenVLA-OFT is an optimized fine-tuning variant of the OpenVLA vision-language-action policy. Like OpenVLA, it takes camera images plus a language instruction and predicts robot actions; the OFT recipe tunes it for fast, high-quality action prediction on manipulation tasks.

WorldFoundry provides five MIT-licensed 7B checkpoints fine-tuned for the LIBERO suite — spatial, object, goal, LIBERO-10, and a combined checkpoint — each emitting an 8-step, 7-dimensional action chunk from full and wrist camera images plus state. An in-tree fast path computes only the final hidden state and action-position logits, matching the full reference path exactly while doing less work.
In WorldFoundry you stage a checkpoint locally and run the action-prediction or policy-rollout route; it returns an action trace for the robot rather than an image or video.
zh: OpenVLA-OFT 是 OpenVLA 视觉-语言-动作策略的优化微调（OFT）变体。与 OpenVLA 一样，它接收相机图像加语言指令并预测机器人动作；OFT 方案将其调优为在操作任务上快速、高质量地预测动作。
WorldFoundry 提供五个 MIT 许可的 7B checkpoint，均在 LIBERO 套件上微调——spatial、object、goal、LIBERO-10 以及一个组合 checkpoint——每个都从全景与腕部相机图像加状态出发，输出 8 步、7 维的动作。内置的快速路径只计算最终隐藏状态与动作位置的 logits，在减少计算的同时与完整参考路径完全一致。
在 WorldFoundry 中，你把 checkpoint 放到本地并运行动作预测或 policy-rollout 路径；它返回给机器人的动作轨迹，而非图像或视频。

whenToUse.en: Use it when you want a fast, openly-licensed OpenVLA policy tuned for the LIBERO benchmark, with separate checkpoints for the spatial, object, goal, and 10-task settings.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想要一个快速、开放许可、针对 LIBERO 基准调优的 OpenVLA 策略，并需要 spatial、object、goal 与 10 任务设置各自的 checkpoint 时使用。

notFor.en: Not a video or image generator — its output is action traces. At 7B it needs adequate GPU memory (a validated run peaked around 14.5 GiB), and checkpoints are staged locally.
notFor.zh: 它不是视频或图像生成器——输出为动作轨迹。作为 7B 模型，运行需要足够的 GPU 显存（一次验证运行的峰值约为 14.5 GiB），且 checkpoint 需放到本地。

tagline.en: A controllable world model built on NVIDIA's efficient Sana architecture, for camera-driven video generation.
tagline.zh: 构建于英伟达高效 Sana 架构之上的可控世界模型，用于相机驱动的视频生成。

en: SANA-WM is a world model for controllable video generation, built on NVIDIA's Sana architecture — a family known for efficient high-resolution image synthesis. It generates video you can steer with a camera path, keeping the scene coherent as the viewpoint moves.

It reuses the canonical Sana network, encoder, autoencoder, and scheduler, and runs as a resident two-stage pipeline: a bidirectional stage followed by an LTX-2 refiner. It advances the scene in native temporal windows and renders at 1280×704, and WorldFoundry can partition its components — the stage-one model, refiner, refiner text encoder, VAE, and camera intrinsics — across multiple GPUs.
In WorldFoundry you run SANA-WM through its resident pipeline: provide the conditioning and camera control, and it generates the corresponding video.
zh: SANA-WM 是一个用于可控视频生成的世界模型，构建在英伟达的 Sana 架构之上——该家族以高效的高分辨率图像合成而知名。它生成的视频可用相机轨迹引导，在视角移动时保持场景连贯。
它复用了标准的 Sana 网络、编码器、自动编码器与调度器，以常驻的两阶段 pipeline 运行：一个双向阶段，后接一个 LTX-2 精炼器。它以原生时间窗口推进场景，渲染分辨率为 1280×704；WorldFoundry 可把它的各组件——第一阶段模型、精炼器、精炼器文本编码器、VAE 与相机内参——分布到多张 GPU 上。
在 WorldFoundry 中，你通过它的常驻 pipeline 运行 SANA-WM：提供条件与相机控制，它便生成相应的视频。

whenToUse.en: Use it when you want a controllable, camera-driven world model on the efficient Sana architecture, with a refiner stage for quality and multi-GPU component placement for larger runs.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想要一个基于高效 Sana 架构、相机驱动的可控世界模型，带有精炼阶段提升质量、并支持多卡组件分布以应对更大规模运行时使用。

notFor.en: It runs as a multi-GPU resident pipeline, so it expects adequate hardware. The checkpoint must be staged locally before use.
notFor.zh: 它以多卡常驻 pipeline 运行，需具备足够硬件。使用前 checkpoint 需放到本地。

en: Controllable world model on NVIDIA's Sana architecture
Two-stage resident pipeline with a bidirectional stage plus LTX-2 refiner
Camera-controlled video generation at 1280×704
Multi-GPU component placement for larger runs
zh: 基于英伟达 Sana 架构的可控世界模型
两阶段常驻 pipeline：双向阶段加 LTX-2 精炼器
相机可控的视频生成，分辨率 1280×704
支持多卡组件分布以应对更大规模运行

tagline.en: An Apache-2.0 7B VLA policy that adds spatial supervision to OpenVLA-OFT for LIBERO manipulation.
tagline.zh: Apache-2.0 许可的 7B VLA 策略，在 OpenVLA-OFT 基础上加入空间监督，面向 LIBERO 操作。

en: Spatial-Forcing is a vision-language-action policy for robot manipulation from the OpenHelix team. It builds on the OpenVLA-OFT recipe and, during training, uses spatial supervision (via VGGT and an alignment projector) to strengthen the model's 3D understanding — while the released policies run with the standard OpenVLA-OFT inference path.

WorldFoundry provides four Apache-2.0 7B checkpoints fine-tuned for the LIBERO suite — spatial, object, goal, and LIBERO-10. Each takes full and wrist camera images plus an 8-dimensional state, applies a deterministic center crop, and emits an 8-step, 7-dimensional action chunk. The spatial-supervision components are training-only and are not loaded at inference.
In WorldFoundry you stage a checkpoint locally and run the action-prediction or policy-rollout route; it returns an action trace for the robot rather than an image or video.
zh: Spatial-Forcing 是 OpenHelix 团队推出的面向机器人操作的视觉-语言-动作策略。它构建在 OpenVLA-OFT 方案之上，并在训练时借助空间监督（通过 VGGT 与一个对齐投影器）来增强模型的三维理解——而发布出来的策略仍以标准的 OpenVLA-OFT 推理路径运行。
WorldFoundry 提供四个 Apache-2.0 许可的 7B checkpoint，均在 LIBERO 套件上微调——spatial、object、goal 与 LIBERO-10。每个都接收全景与腕部相机图像加一个 8 维状态，施加确定性中心裁剪，并输出 8 步、7 维的动作。空间监督组件仅用于训练，推理时并不加载。
在 WorldFoundry 中，你把 checkpoint 放到本地并运行动作预测或 policy-rollout 路径；它返回给机器人的动作轨迹，而非图像或视频。

whenToUse.en: Use it when you want a LIBERO-tuned VLA policy that leverages spatial supervision for stronger 3D grounding, with openly-licensed checkpoints for all four LIBERO settings.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想要一个针对 LIBERO 调优、借助空间监督获得更强三维定位能力的 VLA 策略，并需要四个 LIBERO 设置的开放许可 checkpoint 时使用。

notFor.en: Not a video or image generator — its output is action traces. The real-robot Pi0 branch has no released checkpoint and is a user-trained path; stage checkpoints locally before use.
notFor.zh: 它不是视频或图像生成器——输出为动作轨迹。真机 Pi0 分支没有发布 checkpoint，属于需用户自行训练的路径；使用前请把 checkpoint 放到本地。

en: Apache-2.0, open 7B weights
Spatial supervision on top of the OpenVLA-OFT recipe
Four LIBERO fine-tunes: spatial, object, goal, and 10
Emits 8×7 action chunks from two-camera input plus 8-D state
zh: Apache-2.0 许可，开放 7B 权重
在 OpenVLA-OFT 方案之上加入空间监督
四个 LIBERO 微调版本：spatial、object、goal 与 10
从双相机输入加 8 维状态输出 8×7 动作

tagline.en: A video-to-audio model that generates a soundtrack to match a silent clip.
tagline.zh: 一个视频到音频模型，为无声片段生成配套的声音。

en: ThinkSound is a video-to-audio generation model: given a video clip, it synthesizes matching audio, turning a silent scene into one with sound. It comes from the FunAudioLLM project and uses a diffusion-based approach to audio generation.

In WorldFoundry it targets the video-to-audio and audio-generation routes — you feed it video and it produces an audio track. It runs from the ThinkSound diffusion checkpoint, staged in your local or Hugging Face cache.
zh: ThinkSound 是一个视频到音频生成模型：给它一段视频，它便合成与之匹配的音频，把无声画面变得有声。它来自 FunAudioLLM 项目，采用基于扩散的音频生成方法。
在 WorldFoundry 中，它面向视频到音频与音频生成路径——你输入视频，它产出一条音轨。它从 ThinkSound 扩散 checkpoint 运行，checkpoint 放在你的本地或 Hugging Face 缓存中。

whenToUse.en: Use it when you want to generate an audio track for a silent video clip — adding sound that follows what happens on screen.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想为一段无声视频生成音轨时使用——添加与画面内容相呼应的声音。

notFor.en: It is an audio generator, not a video model — it produces sound for video you already have. It requires the ThinkSound diffusion checkpoint to be available in your cache before it can run.
notFor.zh: 它是音频生成器，而非视频模型——它为你已有的视频生成声音。运行前需要 ThinkSound 扩散 checkpoint 已在你的缓存中就绪。

en: Video-to-audio generation from the FunAudioLLM project
Diffusion-based audio synthesis
Produces a soundtrack matched to a video clip
zh: 来自 FunAudioLLM 项目的视频到音频生成
基于扩散的音频合成

tagline.en: A vision-language-action policy for robot manipulation, tuned for the LIBERO and LIBERO-plus benchmarks.
tagline.zh: 面向机器人操作的视觉-语言-动作策略，针对 LIBERO 与 LIBERO-plus 基准调优。

en: VLANeXt is a vision-language-action (VLA) policy for robot manipulation. It takes camera images and a language instruction and predicts robot actions, with checkpoints tuned for the LIBERO and LIBERO-plus benchmark settings.

WorldFoundry runs it through a minimal, inference-only entrypoint that calls the official VLA and processor routines in-process — it doesn't depend on an external repository checkout at runtime. The released weights are governed by the S-Lab 1.0 license.
In WorldFoundry you stage a checkpoint locally and run the action-prediction or policy-rollout route; it returns an action trace for the robot rather than an image or video.
zh: VLANeXt 是一个面向机器人操作的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略。它接收相机图像与语言指令并预测机器人动作，其 checkpoint 针对 LIBERO 与 LIBERO-plus 基准设置进行了调优。
WorldFoundry 通过一个极简的、仅推理的入口运行它，在进程内调用官方的 VLA 与 processor 例程——运行时不依赖外部仓库代码。发布的权重采用 S-Lab 1.0 许可。
在 WorldFoundry 中，你把 checkpoint 放到本地并运行动作预测或 policy-rollout 路径；它返回给机器人的动作轨迹，而非图像或视频。

whenToUse.en: Use it when you want a VLA policy tuned for the LIBERO and LIBERO-plus manipulation benchmarks, mapping images and instructions to robot actions.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想要一个针对 LIBERO 与 LIBERO-plus 操作基准调优的 VLA 策略、把图像与指令映射为机器人动作时使用。

notFor.en: Not a video or image generator — its output is action traces. The simulators, training datasets, and benchmark loops are not part of this runtime; stage the checkpoint locally, and note the S-Lab 1.0 license terms.
notFor.zh: 它不是视频或图像生成器——输出为动作轨迹。仿真器、训练数据集与基准循环不属于该运行时；请把 checkpoint 放到本地，并留意 S-Lab 1.0 许可条款。

Tuned for LIBERO and LIBERO-plus benchmarks
In-tree inference entrypoint, no external checkout at runtime
Released under the S-Lab 1.0 license

tagline.en: A 1.3B Wan2.1-Fun control model that animates an image along a camera path you specify.
tagline.zh: 一个 1.3B 的 Wan2.1-Fun 控制模型，沿你指定的相机轨迹让图片动起来。

en: Wan2.1-Fun V1.1 1.3B Control Camera is a camera-controlled image-to-video model from Alibaba PAI's VideoX-Fun project. Give it a starting image and a camera trajectory, and it generates a clip that moves the camera through the scene along that path.

It is the lightweight 1.3B member of the Wan2.1-Fun control family, built on the Wan2.1 architecture with a camera-conditioned control branch. The pose-conditioned route renders the video with just a few denoising steps, producing coherent camera-motion clips at 672×384.
In WorldFoundry you run it through its pipeline — provide the image and camera control, and it writes out the resulting video.
zh: Wan2.1-Fun V1.1 1.3B Control Camera 是阿里巴巴 PAI 的 VideoX-Fun 项目推出的相机可控图生视频模型。给它一张起始图片与一条相机轨迹，它便生成一段沿该轨迹在场景中运镜的片段。
它是 Wan2.1-Fun 控制家族中的轻量 1.3B 成员，构建在 Wan2.1 架构之上，带有相机条件化的控制分支。姿态条件化路径只需少数几个去噪步即可渲染视频，产出 672×384 的连贯运镜片段。
在 WorldFoundry 中，你通过它的 pipeline 运行——提供图片与相机控制，它便输出生成的视频。

whenToUse.en: Use it when you want to animate a still image with controlled camera motion on modest hardware — a lightweight 1.3B option for pose-conditioned camera moves.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想在普通硬件上以可控运镜让静态图片动起来时使用——一个用于姿态条件化运镜的轻量 1.3B 选择。

notFor.en: It generates short camera-motion clips rather than long or narrative video. The camera checkpoint and its Wan components must be staged locally before use.
notFor.zh: 它生成的是短促的运镜片段，而非长片或叙事视频。相机 checkpoint 及其 Wan 组件需先放到本地再使用。

tagline.en: X-VLA — a cross-embodiment vision-language-action policy that drives many different robots from one model family.
tagline.zh: X-VLA——一个跨形态的视觉-语言-动作策略，用同一套模型家族驱动多种不同机器人。

en: X-VLA is a vision-language-action (VLA) model for robot control, built on a Florence-2 vision-language backbone with a soft-prompted transformer and dedicated action transforms. From camera images and a task, it predicts the robot's next actions.

Its defining feature is cross-embodiment: rather than one policy per robot, X-VLA ships a set of checkpoints tuned to specific embodiments and benchmarks — WidowX, Google Robot, LIBERO, CALVIN ABC->D, RoboTwin2, VLABench, AGIWorld, and a soft-fold cloth task — plus a foundation checkpoint for further use. Each checkpoint is bound to its embodiment through an explicit domain ID, and the model emits action chunks for closed-loop rollout.

In WorldFoundry you run X-VLA through the shared policy interface: pick the checkpoint that matches your robot or benchmark, provide the domain ID (required for the foundation checkpoint), and step the policy in a simulator or on hardware. Inference runs in float32 by default, with bf16/fp16 available as performance options.
zh: X-VLA 是用于机器人控制的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，基于 Florence-2 视觉语言骨干，配合软提示 transformer 与专用的动作变换。它从相机图像和任务出发，预测机器人的下一步动作。

它最鲜明的特点是跨形态：X-VLA 不是每个机器人配一个策略，而是提供一组针对具体形态与基准调优的 checkpoint——WidowX、Google Robot、LIBERO、CALVIN ABC->D、RoboTwin2、VLABench、AGIWorld，以及一个软折叠布料任务——外加一个可继续使用的基础 checkpoint。每个 checkpoint 通过显式的 domain ID 绑定到其形态，模型输出用于闭环 rollout 的动作块。
在 WorldFoundry 中，你通过统一的策略接口运行 X-VLA：选一个匹配你的机器人或基准的 checkpoint，提供 domain ID（基础 checkpoint 必填），然后在仿真或真机上逐步执行策略。推理默认使用 float32，也可选 bf16/fp16 以提升性能。

whenToUse.en: Reach for X-VLA when you need a single VLA family that transfers across robots and standard manipulation benchmarks — pick the embodiment-matched checkpoint and roll out the policy in sim or on real hardware.
whenToUse.zh: 当你需要一个能跨机器人和标准操作基准迁移的 VLA 家族时，选用 X-VLA——挑一个与形态匹配的 checkpoint，在仿真或真机上执行策略 rollout。

notFor.en: It's an action policy, not a video or world generator. Checkpoints are downloaded separately rather than bundled, and the foundation checkpoint won't run without an explicit domain ID.
notFor.zh: 它是动作策略，而非视频或世界生成器。Checkpoint 需单独下载而非随附，且基础 checkpoint 必须提供显式 domain ID 才能运行。

en: Cross-embodiment VLA: one family across many robots and benchmarks
Florence-2 backbone with a soft-prompted transformer and action transforms
Nine checkpoints covering WidowX, Google Robot, LIBERO, CALVIN, RoboTwin2, VLABench, AGIWorld, soft-fold, plus a foundation model
float32 by default, with bf16/fp16 as performance options

tagline.en: Xiaomi-Robotics-0 — an Apache-2.0 vision-language-action policy (MiBoT) that predicts robot action chunks across several benchmarks.
tagline.zh: Xiaomi-Robotics-0——Apache-2.0 许可的视觉-语言-动作策略（MiBoT），可在多个基准上预测机器人动作块。

en: Xiaomi-Robotics-0 is a vision-language-action (VLA) policy from Xiaomi Robotics, released under Apache-2.0. Given camera views and a task, it predicts chunks of robot actions for closed-loop control — it is an action policy, not a video or world generator.

The release covers six checkpoints: a pretrain base plus checkpoints tuned for LIBERO, CALVIN ABCD->D and ABC->D, and SimplerEnv on both the Google Robot and WidowX embodiments. The default variant is LIBERO; you select the others by variant id. The pretrain base has no universal embodiment or view contract, so it needs an explicit robot type, camera keys, and view labels; the SimplerEnv variants apply their released resize and center-crop before preprocessing.

In WorldFoundry you run it through the shared policy interface — choose a variant, supply the required embodiment inputs, and step the policy in a simulator or on hardware to get variant-specific action chunks.
zh: Xiaomi-Robotics-0 是小米机器人团队推出的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略，采用 Apache-2.0 许可。给定相机视角与任务，它预测用于闭环控制的机器人动作块——它是动作策略，而非视频或世界生成器。

该发布包含六个 checkpoint：一个预训练基座，以及针对 LIBERO、CALVIN ABCD->D 与 ABC->D、SimplerEnv 上 Google Robot 与 WidowX 两种形态调优的 checkpoint。默认变体是 LIBERO，其余通过 variant id 选择。预训练基座没有通用的形态或视角约定，因此需要显式指定机器人类型、相机键与视角标签；SimplerEnv 变体在预处理前会先应用其发布的缩放与中心裁剪。
在 WorldFoundry 中，你通过统一的策略接口运行它——选一个变体，提供所需的形态输入，然后在仿真或真机上逐步执行策略，得到该变体对应的动作块。

whenToUse.en: A good choice when you want an openly-licensed VLA policy for standard manipulation benchmarks — LIBERO, CALVIN, or SimplerEnv — with a pretrain base you can adapt to your own embodiment.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想要一个开放许可的 VLA 策略、用于标准操作基准（LIBERO、CALVIN 或 SimplerEnv），并需要一个可迁移到自有形态的预训练基座时，它是不错的选择。

notFor.en: It outputs actions, not video or images. Checkpoints are downloaded separately, and the pretrain base won't run without explicit robot type, camera keys, and view labels.
notFor.zh: 它输出的是动作，而非视频或图像。Checkpoint 需单独下载，且预训练基座必须提供显式的机器人类型、相机键与视角标签才能运行。

Six checkpoints: pretrain base plus LIBERO, CALVIN (ABCD/ABC), and SimplerEnv (Google Robot, WidowX)
LIBERO is the default variant; others selected by variant id
Adaptable pretrain base with explicit embodiment and view contract

tagline.en: DreamDojo — NVIDIA's action-conditioned robot world model that rolls a scene forward under a unified multi-embodiment action space.
tagline.zh: DreamDojo——NVIDIA 的动作条件机器人世界模型，在统一的多形态动作空间下把场景沿时间推进。

en: DreamDojo is an action-conditioned robot world model from NVIDIA, released under the NVIDIA Open Model License. It predicts how a scene evolves in response to robot actions, making it a world model for embodied settings rather than a plain video generator or a VLA policy.

It builds on NVIDIA's Cosmos action-conditioned video-to-world runtime and is driven by a 384-dimensional unified action contract that spans several embodiments — GR-1, G1, YAM, AgiBot, MANO hand poses, and latent actions — so different robots map into one shared action space. The release includes a 2B GR-1 post-trained checkpoint, and the family covers both long-horizon rollouts and a distilled real-time variant.

In WorldFoundry you run DreamDojo through its in-tree runtime wrapper for action-conditioned and interactive robot-world generation. Full generation additionally requires the converted checkpoint artifacts and the GR-1 evaluation dataset staged locally.
zh: DreamDojo 是 NVIDIA 推出的动作条件机器人世界模型，采用 NVIDIA Open Model License。它预测场景如何随机器人动作演化，因此是面向具身场景的世界模型，而非普通视频生成器或 VLA 策略。
它构建在 NVIDIA 的 Cosmos 动作条件 video-to-world 运行时之上，由一个 384 维的统一动作约定驱动，跨越多种形态——GR-1、G1、YAM、AgiBot、MANO 手部姿态以及潜在动作——让不同机器人映射到同一个共享动作空间。该发布包含一个 2B 的 GR-1 后训练 checkpoint，家族同时覆盖长时程 rollout 与一个蒸馏的实时变体。
在 WorldFoundry 中，你通过其内置运行时封装运行 DreamDojo，用于动作条件与交互式的机器人世界生成。完整生成还需要在本地准备好转换后的 checkpoint 资产与 GR-1 评测数据集。

whenToUse.en: Use DreamDojo when you want to imagine robot rollouts — generating how a scene changes under actions — across multiple embodiments through one unified action space, including long-horizon and real-time settings.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想生成机器人 rollout——通过一个统一动作空间、在多种形态上想象场景如何随动作变化，包括长时程与实时场景——DreamDojo 是合适的选择。

notFor.en: It's a world model, not a control policy that outputs joint commands, and not a general text-to-video tool. Full generation needs the converted checkpoint artifacts and evaluation dataset staged locally.
notFor.zh: 它是世界模型，而非输出关节指令的控制策略，也不是通用文生视频工具。完整生成需在本地准备好转换后的 checkpoint 资产与评测数据集。

en: Action-conditioned robot world model under the NVIDIA Open Model License
384-dim unified action contract spanning GR-1, G1, YAM, AgiBot, MANO, and latent actions
Built on NVIDIA's Cosmos video-to-world runtime
Long-horizon and distilled real-time variants; 2B GR-1 post-trained checkpoint
zh: NVIDIA Open Model License 下的动作条件机器人世界模型
384 维统一动作约定，跨 GR-1、G1、YAM、AgiBot、MANO 与潜在动作
构建于 NVIDIA 的 Cosmos video-to-world 运行时

tagline.en: IRASim — ByteDance's action-conditioned video world model for robotics: give it actions, it generates the resulting robot video.
tagline.zh: IRASim——字节跳动的动作条件视频世界模型，面向机器人：给它动作，它生成相应的机器人视频。

en: IRASim is a robotics world model from ByteDance that turns action sequences into video. Conditioned on a robot's actions, it generates a video of what the scene would look like as those actions play out — a diffusion-based, action-conditioned video generator for embodied settings.

In WorldFoundry the IRASim model, its diffusion core, and the inference pipeline are vendored as an in-tree runtime. You drive it with actions to produce robotics world-model video and action-conditioned generation.

Because the official checkpoint archives aren't distributed as standard downloadable model repos, running full generation requires you to stage the official checkpoint archives and task fixtures yourself.
zh: IRASim 是字节跳动推出的机器人世界模型，把动作序列转化为视频。以机器人的动作为条件，它生成这些动作展开时场景应有的视频——一个面向具身场景、基于扩散的动作条件视频生成器。
在 WorldFoundry 中，IRASim 的模型、扩散核心与推理 pipeline 以内置运行时的形式提供。你用动作来驱动它，生成机器人世界模型视频与动作条件生成结果。
由于官方 checkpoint 档案并未以标准可下载模型仓库的形式发布，完整生成需要你自行准备官方 checkpoint 档案与任务 fixtures。

whenToUse.en: Use IRASim when you want to render action-conditioned robot video — visualizing how a scene unfolds given a sequence of robot actions.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想渲染动作条件的机器人视频——即给定一段机器人动作序列、可视化场景如何展开时——可以使用 IRASim。

notFor.en: It generates video from actions rather than predicting control commands. You'll need to supply the official checkpoint archives and task fixtures before full generation runs.
notFor.zh: 它从动作生成视频，而不是预测控制指令。在完整生成前，你需要自行提供官方 checkpoint 档案与任务 fixtures。

tagline.en: MiniMax H3 — an Apache-2.0 joint audio-and-video generator that writes a synchronized soundtrack right into the MP4.
tagline.zh: MiniMax H3——Apache-2.0 许可的音视频联合生成模型，把同步的声轨直接写进 MP4。

en: MiniMax H3 is a video generation model from MiniMax that produces audio and video together. Rather than adding sound as a separate step, it jointly generates both, muxing a 32kHz stereo audio track into the output MP4 so picture and sound are synchronized from the start. It's released under Apache-2.0.

The model is a joint audio+video diffusion transformer (DiT) with a coupled rectified-flow denoiser, and it supports three modes: text-to-video-with-audio, a keyframe-conditioned mode from a first/last frame, and a reference-to-video-with-audio mode. It runs as single-GPU PyTorch and targets around 80GB of VRAM.

In WorldFoundry you run MiniMax H3 through the shared pipeline — give it a prompt (plus a keyframe or reference where relevant), and it writes an MP4 with a matched soundtrack. Supply the real H3 weights path at load time.
zh: MiniMax H3 是 MiniMax 推出的视频生成模型，能同时生成音频与视频。它不是把声音作为独立步骤后加，而是联合生成两者，把 32kHz 立体声音轨混流进输出的 MP4，让画面与声音从一开始就同步。该模型采用 Apache-2.0 许可。
模型是一个音视频联合的扩散 transformer（DiT），配合耦合的 rectified-flow 去噪器，支持三种模式：带音频的文生视频、由首/末帧驱动的关键帧模式，以及带音频的参考生视频模式。它以单 GPU PyTorch 运行，目标显存约 80GB。
在 WorldFoundry 中，你通过统一 pipeline 运行 MiniMax H3——给它提示词（必要时再加关键帧或参考），它便输出一段带匹配声轨的 MP4。加载时请提供真实的 H3 权重路径。

whenToUse.en: Reach for MiniMax H3 when you want video with a synchronized soundtrack in one shot — text-to-video, keyframe-driven, or reference-driven — under an open Apache-2.0 license.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想一步得到带同步声轨的视频——文生视频、关键帧驱动或参考驱动——且希望使用开放的 Apache-2.0 许可时，选用 MiniMax H3。

notFor.en: It's demanding on hardware, targeting around 80GB of VRAM. The bundled checkpoint id is a placeholder, so you must supply the real H3 weights path at load.
notFor.zh: 它对硬件要求较高，目标显存约 80GB。随附的 checkpoint id 是占位值，加载时你必须提供真实的 H3 权重路径。

en: Apache-2.0, joint audio+video generation
32kHz stereo soundtrack muxed into the output MP4
Three modes: text-to-video, keyframe, and reference-to-video (all with audio)
Single-GPU PyTorch; targets ~80GB VRAM
zh: Apache-2.0，音视频联合生成
32kHz 立体声音轨混流进输出 MP4
三种模式：文生视频、关键帧、参考生视频（均带音频）
单 GPU PyTorch；目标显存约 80GB

tagline.zh: MultiWorld——一个多智能体、交互式的视频世界模型，探索多个智能体同时行动的世界。

en: MultiWorld is an interactive video world model focused on multi-agent settings — worlds where more than one agent can act, illustrated by its 「It Takes Two」 configuration. It generates interactive, game-like video rather than acting as a robot control policy.

In WorldFoundry the MultiWorld It-Takes-Two pipeline is registered as the model-zoo entry with an in-tree wrapper, so you drive it through the shared interface for interactive and multi-agent video generation.
Full generation depends on additional runtime dependencies and checkpoints, which you stage locally before running end to end.
zh: MultiWorld 是一个交互式视频世界模型，聚焦多智能体场景——即多个智能体可同时行动的世界，其「It Takes Two」配置正体现了这一点。它生成交互式、类游戏的视频，而非充当机器人控制策略。
在 WorldFoundry 中，MultiWorld 的 It-Takes-Two pipeline 已作为 model-zoo 条目注册并配有内置封装，你可通过统一接口驱动它，用于交互式与多智能体视频生成。
完整生成依赖额外的运行时依赖与 checkpoint，需要你在端到端运行前于本地准备好。

whenToUse.en: Use MultiWorld when your scenario involves multiple interacting agents in a generated, game-like world rather than a single controllable stream.
whenToUse.zh: 当你的场景涉及在生成的类游戏世界中有多个相互作用的智能体，而非单一可控流时，可以使用 MultiWorld。

notFor.en: It's a video world model, not a control policy. Full generation is gated on extra dependencies and checkpoints you provide locally.
notFor.zh: 它是视频世界模型，而非控制策略。完整生成需依赖你在本地提供的额外依赖与 checkpoint。

In WorldFoundry the Pandora runtime is vendored in-tree, including the core model together with its ChatUniVi and DynamiCrafter components, exposed through a shared runtime plan wrapper for diffusion-world-model, world-generation, and text-to-video tasks.
Because the official weights aren't openly distributed, full generation is gated on caller-provided, official-compatible checkpoints that you stage locally.

在 WorldFoundry 中，Pandora 运行时以内置形式提供，包含核心模型及其 ChatUniVi 与 DynamiCrafter 组件，通过统一的运行时计划封装暴露，支持扩散世界模型、世界生成与文生视频任务。
由于官方权重未公开分发，完整生成需要你在本地提供官方兼容的 checkpoint。

whenToUse.en: Use Pandora when you want a diffusion world model that generates video and responds to text-based control of the unfolding scene.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想要一个基于扩散、能生成视频并响应文本控制场景演化的世界模型时，可以使用 Pandora。

notFor.en: The official weights aren't openly available, so full generation depends on official-compatible checkpoints you supply yourself.
notFor.zh: 官方权重未公开，完整生成依赖你自行提供的官方兼容 checkpoint。

tagline.en: pixelSplat — an MIT-licensed feed-forward model that reconstructs a 3D Gaussian scene from images for novel-view synthesis.
tagline.zh: pixelSplat——MIT 许可的前馈模型，从图像重建 3D 高斯场景以实现新视角合成。

en: pixelSplat is a 3D reconstruction model that predicts a 3D Gaussian Splatting scene directly from images in a single feed-forward pass, then renders new viewpoints of that scene. It targets fast novel-view synthesis without per-scene optimization, and is released under the MIT license.

In WorldFoundry the pixelSplat source and runtime are vendored in-tree with a lazy wrapper around the official test entrypoint, exposing 3D reconstruction, Gaussian splatting, and novel-view synthesis tasks.
Running inference requires two local prerequisites: a Gaussian rasterization extension built for your environment, and the RE10K checkpoint (re10k.ckpt) staged locally.
zh: pixelSplat 是一个 3D 重建模型，能在单次前馈中直接从图像预测 3D 高斯泼溅（Gaussian Splatting）场景，再渲染该场景的新视角。它面向无需逐场景优化的快速新视角合成，采用 MIT 许可。
在 WorldFoundry 中，pixelSplat 的源码与运行时以内置形式提供，围绕官方测试入口配有惰性封装，暴露 3D 重建、高斯泼溅与新视角合成任务。
运行推理需要两个本地前置条件：一个为你的环境编译的高斯光栅化扩展，以及本地准备好的 RE10K checkpoint（re10k.ckpt）。

whenToUse.en: Use pixelSplat when you want feed-forward 3D reconstruction and novel-view synthesis from images via Gaussian splatting, under a permissive MIT license.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想通过高斯泼溅、以前馈方式从图像做 3D 重建与新视角合成，并希望使用宽松的 MIT 许可时，选用 pixelSplat。

notFor.en: Inference won't run out of the box: you must provide a locally built Gaussian rasterization extension and stage the RE10K checkpoint first.
notFor.zh: 推理无法开箱即用：你必须先提供本地编译的高斯光栅化扩展，并准备好 RE10K checkpoint。

en: MIT-licensed 3D Gaussian Splatting reconstruction
Feed-forward, no per-scene optimization
Novel-view synthesis from images
Needs a local Gaussian rasterization extension and the RE10K checkpoint

前馈式，无需逐场景优化

In WorldFoundry the AdaWorld source is vendored in-tree under the world-model synthesis package, covering latent-action world modeling, action-conditioned video, and multi-domain world-model tasks.

tagline.en: Echo-Memory's spatial-memory world model — generate camera-controlled video from an image and keep revisited scenery consistent over long rollouts.
tagline.zh: Echo-Memory 的空间记忆世界模型——从一张图像出发生成相机轨迹可控的视频,并在长程推演中保持重访场景的一致性。

en: Echo-Memory is a memory-augmented world model built on the open Wan2.1 diffusion backbone. It takes a starting image, a text prompt and a camera trajectory, then rolls out video of an explorable scene — the memory mechanism is what keeps that scene coherent as the camera moves through it and comes back.

This identity fixes the spatial-memory configuration: past frames are held in a spatial frame store and fed back into generation, so regions you revisit look the way you left them. Every WorldFoundry model in the family pins one memory recipe, so you get consistent behaviour without picking a method at runtime.

In WorldFoundry you run it through the shared diffusion pipeline with a local Echo-Memory checkpoint; the runtime assembles the recipe from shared Wan components. It is aimed at memory research and interactive world-model experiments rather than one-shot clip generation.
zh: Echo-Memory 是一个带记忆机制的世界模型,构建在开源的 Wan2.1 扩散骨干之上。它以一张起始图像、一段文字提示词和一条相机轨迹为输入,推演出可探索场景的视频——记忆机制的作用,就是在相机移动、往返之间让场景保持连贯。
本模型固定使用空间记忆配置:过去的帧被保存在空间帧存储中,并重新注入生成过程,让你重访的区域仍保持原样。该家族的每个 WorldFoundry 身份都固定一种记忆配方,因此运行时无需自行选择方法,行为始终一致。
在 WorldFoundry 中,你通过统一的扩散 pipeline、配合一个本地 Echo-Memory checkpoint 来运行它;运行时会从共享的 Wan 组件组装出这套配方。它面向记忆机制研究与交互式世界模型实验,而非一次性的短片生成。

whenToUse.en: Reach for it when you're studying spatial memory in world models, or when you want an explorable, camera-controlled scene from a single image and need revisited areas to stay consistent.
whenToUse.zh: 当你研究世界模型中的空间记忆,或想从单张图像生成可探索、相机可控的场景、并需要重访区域保持一致时,可以选它。

notFor.en: Not a turnkey text-to-video tool — the memory method is fixed for this identity and you supply a compatible local checkpoint. If you want state-space memory instead, use one of the SSM variants.
notFor.zh: 它不是开箱即用的文生视频工具——本模型的记忆方法固定,需要你自备一个兼容的本地 checkpoint。若想改用状态空间记忆,请选择 SSM 系列变体。

tagline.zh: Echo-Memory 空间记忆的消融版本,关闭了记忆注入——用作对照,衡量注入步骤究竟带来多少作用。

en: Echo-Memory is a memory-augmented world model on the open Wan2.1 diffusion backbone: from a starting image, a text prompt and a camera trajectory it rolls out video of an explorable scene, with a memory mechanism meant to keep that scene coherent over long rollouts.

This identity is the no-injection ablation. It keeps the spatial memory store but does not inject those remembered frames back into generation. Set beside the full spatial-memory variant, it isolates the effect of injection — a clean baseline for seeing how much long-range consistency actually comes from the memory step.

In WorldFoundry you run it through the shared diffusion pipeline with a local Echo-Memory checkpoint, assembled from shared Wan components. It exists for controlled comparison rather than for producing the family's best-looking output.
zh: Echo-Memory 是构建在开源 Wan2.1 扩散骨干上的记忆增强世界模型:以起始图像、文字提示词和相机轨迹为输入,推演出可探索场景的视频,记忆机制则用来在长程推演中维持场景连贯。
本模型是关闭注入的消融版本。它保留了空间记忆存储,但不把记住的帧重新注入生成过程。与完整的空间记忆变体并列比较时,它能单独隔离出注入这一步的作用——是观察长程一致性究竟有多少来自记忆步骤的干净对照。
在 WorldFoundry 中,你通过统一扩散 pipeline、配合本地 Echo-Memory checkpoint 运行它,配方由共享 Wan 组件组装而成。它的定位是做可控对比,而非产出该家族画面最佳的结果。

whenToUse.en: Use it as the control in ablation studies — when you want to compare against the full spatial-memory variant and quantify what memory injection buys you.
whenToUse.zh: 把它作为消融实验的对照——当你想与完整空间记忆变体比较、量化记忆注入到底带来了什么时使用。

notFor.en: With injection disabled, expect weaker long-range consistency than the full spatial variant. It's a research control, not the configuration to pick for best output quality.
notFor.zh: 由于关闭了注入,它的长程一致性会弱于完整空间变体。它是研究对照,而非追求最佳画质时该选的配置。

tagline.zh: Echo-Memory 最精简的状态空间记忆配置——单帧上下文、每四步更新一次,是 SSM 系列中开销最低的一档。

en: Echo-Memory is a memory-augmented world model on the open Wan2.1 diffusion backbone. From a starting image, a text prompt and a camera trajectory it rolls out video of an explorable scene, using a memory mechanism to hold the scene together over long rollouts.

This identity uses a state-space memory (SSM) module tuned to its leanest setting: a context window of one frame, memory refreshed every four steps, and a hint length of 21. Compared with the denser SSM variants, it carries the least memory state and updates least often — the point on the family's curve that trades some long-range recall for lower cost.

In WorldFoundry you run it through the shared diffusion pipeline with a local Echo-Memory checkpoint, assembled from shared Wan components. It's meant for memory research and interactive world-model experiments where you want to probe how a light SSM configuration behaves.
zh: Echo-Memory 是构建在开源 Wan2.1 扩散骨干上的记忆增强世界模型。它以起始图像、文字提示词和相机轨迹为输入,推演出可探索场景的视频,并用记忆机制在长程推演中维持场景连贯。
本模型采用状态空间记忆(SSM)模块,并调到最精简的档位:上下文窗口为单帧、每四步刷新一次记忆、hint 长度为 21。与更密集的 SSM 变体相比,它携带的记忆状态最少、更新也最不频繁——处在该家族曲线上以部分长程记忆换取更低开销的一端。
在 WorldFoundry 中,你通过统一扩散 pipeline、配合本地 Echo-Memory checkpoint 运行它,配方由共享 Wan 组件组装而成。它面向记忆机制研究与交互式世界模型实验,适合探究轻量 SSM 配置的表现。

whenToUse.en: Pick it when you want the cheapest SSM memory setting in the family, or when you're mapping how context size and update frequency affect an SSM world model at the low end.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想要该家族中开销最低的 SSM 记忆配置,或在研究上下文大小与更新频率对 SSM 世界模型的影响、并聚焦低端时,选它。

notFor.en: The single-frame context and every-four-step updates mean weaker long-range recall than the denser ctx5 variants — not the choice when consistency across long revisits matters most. You also supply a compatible local checkpoint.

This identity runs a state-space memory (SSM) module at its most attentive: a context window of five frames, memory refreshed at every single step, and a hint length of 21. Among the SSM variants it keeps the most active memory state and updates most frequently — the setting to reach for when tracking the scene closely matters more than saving compute.

In WorldFoundry you run it through the shared diffusion pipeline with a local Echo-Memory checkpoint, assembled from shared Wan components. It's aimed at memory research and interactive world-model experiments where you want an SSM configuration that stays maximally in sync with the rollout.
zh: Echo-Memory 是构建在开源 Wan2.1 扩散骨干上的记忆增强世界模型。它以起始图像、文字提示词和相机轨迹为输入,推演出可探索场景的视频,并用记忆机制在长程推演中维持场景连贯。
本模型把状态空间记忆(SSM)模块调到最勤勉的档位:上下文窗口为五帧、每一步都刷新记忆、hint 长度为 21。在各 SSM 变体中,它维持的记忆状态最活跃、更新也最频繁——当紧密追踪场景比节省算力更重要时,就选它。
在 WorldFoundry 中,你通过统一扩散 pipeline、配合本地 Echo-Memory checkpoint 运行它,配方由共享 Wan 组件组装而成。它面向记忆机制研究与交互式世界模型实验,适合需要 SSM 配置与推演过程保持最大同步的场景。

whenToUse.en: Choose it when you want the SSM line's tightest long-range consistency, or when studying how a larger context updated every step changes an SSM world model's behaviour.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想要 SSM 系列中最紧密的长程一致性,或研究更大上下文、逐步更新如何改变 SSM 世界模型的行为时,选它。

notFor.en: Updating every step with a five-frame context is the costliest SSM setting here — if compute is tight, the leaner ctx1/every-4 variant fits better. You also supply a compatible local checkpoint.
notFor.zh: 五帧上下文加逐步更新是这里开销最高的 SSM 配置——若算力紧张,更精简的 ctx1/每四步变体更合适。此外你需自备兼容的本地 checkpoint。

tagline.en: Echo-Memory's balanced state-space memory setting — a five-frame context, updated every fourth step, with a long hint of 81.
tagline.zh: Echo-Memory 均衡型状态空间记忆配置——五帧上下文、每四步更新一次,并配一段长度为 81 的长 hint。

en: Echo-Memory is a memory-augmented world model on the open Wan2.1 diffusion backbone. From a starting image, a text prompt and a camera trajectory it rolls out video of an explorable scene, using a memory mechanism to hold the scene together over long rollouts.

This identity tunes the state-space memory (SSM) module toward a middle ground: a wide five-frame context like the most attentive variant, but refreshed only every fourth step to keep the update cost down, paired with a longer hint length of 81. That combination keeps a rich memory state while spacing out how often it's rewritten.

In WorldFoundry you run it through the shared diffusion pipeline with a local Echo-Memory checkpoint, assembled from shared Wan components. It's aimed at memory research and interactive world-model experiments where you want a wide context without paying to update it every step.
zh: Echo-Memory 是构建在开源 Wan2.1 扩散骨干上的记忆增强世界模型。它以起始图像、文字提示词和相机轨迹为输入,推演出可探索场景的视频,并用记忆机制在长程推演中维持场景连贯。
本模型把状态空间记忆(SSM)模块调向折中:采用与最勤勉变体相同的五帧宽上下文,但只每四步刷新一次以压低更新成本,并搭配长度为 81 的更长 hint。这一组合既保留了丰富的记忆状态,又拉开了记忆被改写的间隔。
在 WorldFoundry 中,你通过统一扩散 pipeline、配合本地 Echo-Memory checkpoint 运行它,配方由共享 Wan 组件组装而成。它面向记忆机制研究与交互式世界模型实验,适合想要宽上下文、又不愿为逐步更新付出代价的场景。

whenToUse.en: Reach for it when you want a wide five-frame memory context but a lower update frequency, or when studying how hint length interacts with context size in an SSM world model.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想要五帧宽的记忆上下文、又希望更新频率更低,或研究 hint 长度与上下文大小在 SSM 世界模型中如何相互作用时,选它。

notFor.en: Updating only every fourth step trades away some of the step-by-step tracking the every-1 variant offers. Different hint and update settings suit different studies, so compare across the SSM line. You supply a compatible local checkpoint.
notFor.zh: 只每四步更新一次,会舍弃 every-1 变体那种逐步追踪的一部分能力。不同的 hint 与更新设置适合不同的研究,建议在 SSM 系列间横向比较。你需自备兼容的本地 checkpoint。

tagline.zh: Echo-Memory 的视频 SSM 混合配置——将状态空间记忆与视频骨干结合,是该家族的主打配方。

en: Echo-Memory is a memory-augmented world model on the open Wan2.1 diffusion backbone. From a starting image, a text prompt and a camera trajectory it rolls out video of an explorable scene, using a memory mechanism to hold the scene together over long rollouts.

This identity is the video-SSM hybrid: rather than a pure ablation of one knob, it blends a state-space memory module into the video generation path, so remembered scene state and the diffusion backbone work together. It's presented as a primary configuration of the family rather than a single-variable study.

In WorldFoundry you run it through the shared diffusion pipeline with a local Echo-Memory checkpoint, assembled from shared Wan components. It's aimed at memory research and interactive world-model experiments — a good starting point when you want the family's flagship memory recipe rather than a targeted ablation.
zh: Echo-Memory 是构建在开源 Wan2.1 扩散骨干上的记忆增强世界模型。它以起始图像、文字提示词和相机轨迹为输入,推演出可探索场景的视频,并用记忆机制在长程推演中维持场景连贯。
本模型是视频 SSM 混合配置:它不是对单个旋钮的纯消融,而是把状态空间记忆模块融入视频生成路径,让记住的场景状态与扩散骨干协同工作。它被定位为该家族的主打配置,而非单变量研究。
在 WorldFoundry 中,你通过统一扩散 pipeline、配合本地 Echo-Memory checkpoint 运行它,配方由共享 Wan 组件组装而成。它面向记忆机制研究与交互式世界模型实验——当你想要该家族的旗舰记忆配方、而非针对性消融时,是不错的起点。

whenToUse.en: A good default within the Echo-Memory family when you want its flagship hybrid memory recipe rather than an isolated ablation — for exploring camera-controlled, memory-consistent world rollouts.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想用 Echo-Memory 家族的旗舰混合记忆配方、而非孤立的消融时,它是该家族里不错的默认选择——适合探索相机可控、记忆一致的世界推演。

notFor.en: If your goal is to isolate one memory knob, use the targeted SSM or spatial ablations instead. As with the family, you supply a compatible local checkpoint.
notFor.zh: 若你的目标是隔离某一个记忆旋钮,请改用针对性的 SSM 或空间消融版本。与该家族其他成员一样,你需自备兼容的本地 checkpoint。

tagline.en: IRIS — a transformer-based, sample-efficient world model that learns to imagine environment dynamics for reinforcement learning.
tagline.zh: IRIS——基于 Transformer 的样本高效世界模型,通过想象环境动态来支持强化学习。

en: IRIS, from Eloi Alonso and collaborators, is a world model for reinforcement learning. It learns the dynamics of an environment and then trains an agent largely inside that learned model — an approach known for being sample-efficient, letting an agent learn from relatively little real interaction.

The method pairs a discrete autoencoder, which turns observations into tokens, with an autoregressive transformer that predicts how those tokens evolve over time. The agent can then be rolled out in the model's imagined trajectories rather than only in the real environment.
In WorldFoundry, IRIS is tracked from its upstream source as a reference world-model project; the repository is the place to go for training and running it.
zh: IRIS 由 Eloi Alonso 等人提出,是一个面向强化学习的世界模型。它学习环境的动态,然后主要在这个学到的模型内部训练智能体——这类方法以样本高效著称,能让智能体从相对少量的真实交互中学习。
该方法把一个离散自编码器与一个自回归 Transformer 结合:前者把观测转成 token,后者自回归地预测这些 token 随时间的演化。于是智能体可以在模型想象出的轨迹中推演,而不必只在真实环境里训练。
在 WorldFoundry 中,IRIS 以参考性的世界模型项目形式从其上游来源被收录;若要训练和运行它,请前往其代码仓库。

whenToUse.en: Reach for IRIS when you're researching sample-efficient, model-based reinforcement learning and want a transformer world model that trains agents inside its own imagined rollouts.
whenToUse.zh: 当你研究样本高效的基于模型的强化学习,并想要一个能在自身想象推演中训练智能体的 Transformer 世界模型时,可以关注 IRIS。

notFor.en: It isn't a video-generation or text-to-video tool, and there's no in-tree WorldFoundry pipeline yet — you work with it through the upstream repository rather than the shared runtime.
notFor.zh: 它不是视频生成或文生视频工具,目前也没有随附的 WorldFoundry 内建 pipeline——你需要通过上游仓库使用它,而非统一运行时。
